articles.title: 'They cannot compete with the prices that fish factories will pay': How demand for fish meal takes priority over feeding people
articles.author: Rose George

paras.en: Fish meal is a commercial, protein-rich product created from raw fish and their byproducts, such as the heads and bones. It tends to be made from smaller fish species, including anchovies, sardines and herring. The fish are cooked, dried and ground into a powder, and then used to feed livestock, farmed fish and pets. But it is not a straightforward market.
paras.zh: 鱼粉是一种富​​含蛋白质的商业产品，由生鱼及其副产品（例如鱼头和鱼骨）制成。它往往由较小的鱼类制成，包括凤尾鱼、沙丁鱼和鲱鱼。将鱼煮熟、干燥并磨成粉末，然后用来喂养牲畜、养殖鱼类和宠物。但这并不是一个简单的市场。

paras.en: In this excerpt from "Every Last Fish: A Deep Dive into the World of Fishes and Fishing" (Granta Books, 2025), journalist and author Rose George looks at how vast quantities of staple fish are taken from the sea off West Africa and turned into fishmeal for farming in Europe and China, instead of ending up on the plates of people in Africa.
paras.zh: 在《最后一条鱼：深入探究鱼类和渔业的世界》（Granta Books，2025 年）的摘录中，记者兼作家罗斯·乔治 (Rose George) 探讨了如何从西非海域捕捞大量主食鱼，并将其制成鱼粉用于欧洲和中国的农业生产，而不是最终出现在非洲人民的餐桌上。

paras.en: "Every Last Fish" was short-listed for the 2026 Royal Society Trivedi Science Book Prize.
paras.zh: 《Every Last Fish》入围2026年英国皇家学会特里维迪科学图书奖。

paras.en: Rose George interview: 'If you do want to be a criminal, there is no better place to do it': Diving into the dark depths of the fishing industry
paras.zh: 罗斯·乔治采访：“如果你确实想成为一名罪犯，没有比这更好的地方了”：深入渔业的黑暗深处

paras.en: Take a fish. Eat its flesh if you want, but don't scorn the rest. It can always be used, one way or another, whether you want fishmeal or face cream.
paras.zh: 吃鱼吧，想吃就吃，其余的都不要轻视。无论您是想要鱼粉还是面霜，它都可以随时以某种方式使用。

paras.en: Products derived from fish turn up everywhere. Guanine, an ingredient produced from fish scales, is found in bath foam, perfume, nail products, shampoo, skincare products, and lipstick. Fishes can become gelatine, glue, and squalene. They can be in your dietary supplements or your glass of wine: isinglass, derived from dried fish air bladders, is used in wine-making.
paras.zh: 鱼类衍生产品随处可见。鸟嘌呤是一种由鱼鳞制成的成分，存在于沐浴露、香水、指甲产品、洗发水、护肤品和口红中。鱼类可以变成明胶、胶水和角鲨烯。它们可能存在于您的膳食补充剂或一杯葡萄酒中： Isinglass源自干鱼气囊，用于酿酒。

paras.en: Futuristic piscigrafts are irrelevant to most people in Senegal, but they still have to deal with the fish by-products industry, because they have to watch as fish they could eat are transformed into the most common and lucrative fish by-products and sent abroad.
paras.zh: 未来派的鱼移植对塞内加尔的大多数人来说无关紧要，但他们仍然必须与鱼副产品行业打交道，因为他们必须眼睁睁地看着他们可以吃的鱼被转化为最常见和最有利可图的鱼副产品并运往国外。

paras.en: Fishmeal is a sandy grubby powder that is worth billions. Minks eat it. Pigs eat it. Cattle eat it. Fishes eat it. It is also an ingredient in fertilizer and pet food. Fishmeal is part of a huge silent industry of fish by-products that used to be known as FMFO (fishmeal and fish oil) and has now been rebranded by the industry association as 'marine ingredients,' a vague term that covers a broad range of fish-derived products, most of which are never noticed.
paras.zh: 鱼粉是一种价值数十亿美元的沙质肮脏粉末。水貂吃，猪吃牛吃鱼吃它也是肥料和宠物食品的成分。鱼粉是曾经被称为FMFO （鱼粉和鱼油）的庞大无声的鱼类副产品行业的一部分，现在已被行业协会重新命名为“海洋成分” ，这个模糊的术语涵盖了广泛的鱼类衍生产品，其中大多数从未被注意到。

paras.en: The Food and Agriculture Organization defines fishmeal as 'the clean, ground, dried tissue of undecomposed whole fish or fish cuttings, either or both, without the extraction of part of the oil.'
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织（ FAO ）将鱼粉定义为“未分解的整条鱼或鱼枝的干净、磨碎、干燥的组织，其中之一或两者，无需提取部分油。”

paras.en: American pets may also find themselves eating fish liver and glandular meal, made from dried complete fish viscera; more general fish by-products, which are 'non-rendered, clean, undecomposed portions of fish (such as, although not limited to, heads, fins, tails, ends, skin, bone and viscera)'; or condensed fish protein digest, the 'condensed enzymatic digest of clean undecomposed whole fish or fish cuttings using the enzyme hydrolysis process'.
paras.zh: 美国宠物也可能发现自己吃鱼肝和腺体膳食，由干燥的完整鱼类内脏制成；更一般的鱼类副产品，是“未渲染、清洁、未分解的鱼类部分（例如但不限于头、鳍、尾、末端、皮肤、骨骼和内脏）” ；或浓缩鱼类蛋白质消化物， “使用酶水解过程清洁未分解的整条鱼或鱼屑的浓缩酶消化物”。

paras.en: 'Undecomposed' is doing a lot of work here, a strange term because unless a fish is caught by a vessel with freezer capacity — which no artisanal fisher has — it will be decomposing for days. In theory, fishmeal is impeccably sustainable. It should be a product made from parts of fishes that would otherwise be discarded. It is because of fishmeal that the term 'reduction fisheries' was coined.
paras.zh: “未分解”在这里做了很多工作，这是一个奇怪的术语，因为除非鱼被具有冷冻容量的船只捕获—没有手工渔民拥有—否则它将分解数天。理论上，鱼粉具有无可挑剔的可持续性。它应该是由否则会被丢弃的鱼类部分制成的产品。正是由于鱼粉， “减少渔业”一词才被创造出来。

paras.en: Take the meat and the prized flesh, and the rest can be reduced or diverted to other uses. That is the theory. It is not what happens in West Africa.
paras.zh: 拿起肉和珍贵的肉，其余的可以减少或转用于其他用途。这就是理论。西非的情况并非如此。

paras.en: Each year, half a million tonnes of wild fish are caught in African waters and sent to Europe to feed animals, when they could have fed 33 million Africans instead. That number of people is more than the combined populations of Senegal, Mauritania, and The Gambia. Globally a fifth of wild fishes become fishmeal or fish oil, but 90 per cent of fishmeal fishes are suitable for human consumption.
paras.zh: 每年，在非洲水域捕获50万吨野生鱼类并送往欧洲喂养动物，而当时它们本可以喂养3300万非洲人。这个数字超过了塞内加尔、毛里塔尼亚和冈比亚的总人口。全球五分之一的野生鱼类成为鱼粉或鱼油，但90%的鱼粉鱼类适合人类食用。

paras.en: China uses nearly half of all FMFO, but then China uses most of everything. Europe also takes and takes. Spain imports the most fish oil from Senegal, and France takes 70 per cent of Mauritania's.
paras.zh: 中国使用了近一半的FMFO ，但随后中国使用了大部分FMFO。欧洲也采取和采取。西班牙从塞内加尔进口的鱼油最多，法国占毛里塔尼亚鱼油的70%。

paras.en: In 2019, Changing Markets Foundation produced a detailed investigative report into the fishmeal industry in India, Vietnam, and The Gambia. In each country, the pattern was similar: first the foreign factories come, then they take the fish, then they pollute the environment, then the fishermen say there are no fish left.
paras.zh: 2019年， Changing Markets Foundation对印度、越南和冈比亚的鱼粉行业进行了详细的调查报告。在每个国家，模式都是相似的：首先是外国工厂来，然后是捕鱼，然后是污染环境，然后是渔民说没有鱼了。

paras.en: Although noting 'a surprising lack of traceability and transparency regarding the origin and supply chain of farmed seafood products,' the foundation linked plenty of reputable European retailers to FMFO supply chains that may use West African fish. For example: Sainsbury's, ALDI, Lidl, and Marks & Spencer in the UK; Auchan, Groupe Casino, Monoprix, and Système U in France (that is a full house of big French supermarkets); all the German ALDIs; and Mercadona in Spain. Sainsbury's, Marks & Spencer, and Mercadona have said they don't use West African FMFO in their seafood products, but how will they know?
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The European Union's IUU [Illegal, Unreported and Unregulated fishing] regulations, which require a catch certificate or similar to show the fish was legally caught, do not cover fishmeal. In Mauritania, some Chinese-owned fishmeal factories have their own trawler fleets. The fish bypasses human mouths and goes straight to the factory. That is one tactic. The other is to outbid.
paras.zh: 欧盟的IUU （非法、未报告和无管制的捕捞活动）法规要求提供捕捞证书或类似证书，以证明鱼类是合法捕捞的，但不包括鱼粉。在毛里塔尼亚，一些中国拥有的鱼粉工厂拥有自己的拖网渔船队。鱼绕过人嘴，直接进入工厂。这是一种策略。另一种是出价过高。

paras.en: - Photojournalist Steve Winter on his iconic Hollywood puma image, the illegal tiger trade and having a black panther knock on his door
paras.zh: -摄影记者史蒂夫·温特（ Steve Winter ）展示了他标志性的好莱坞美洲狮形象、非法老虎贸易和黑豹敲门

paras.en: - 'If this is the new normal, then we are in very deep trouble': Brazil's drying aquifers could have ripple effects across the world
paras.zh: - “如果这是新常态，那么我们就陷入了非常严重的麻烦” ：巴西的干涸含水层可能会对全世界产生连锁反应

paras.en: - Trump can't stop America's shift to clean energy. And we can accelerate it.
paras.zh: -特朗普无法阻止美国转向清洁能源。我们可以加速它。

paras.en: The fish processors tell me that they cannot compete with the prices that fish factories will pay for sardinella. Fish processors get no subsidies from the government, unlike Chinese fishing companies. In The Gambia, one fishmeal factory used 40 per cent of the country's entire fish catch in one year. Black and white. White stealing from Black. The villain/victim template seems neat and unassailable.
paras.zh: 鱼类加工商告诉我，他们无法与鱼类工厂为沙丁鱼支付的价格竞争。与中国渔业公司不同，鱼类加工商没有从政府获得补贴。在冈比亚，一家鱼粉工厂在一年内使用了该国全部渔获量的40%。黑与白，白偷黑。反派/受害者模板看起来整洁无懈可击。

paras.en: It is true — Europeans are using fish that West Africans could eat — and yet it is not all the truth. In Senegal, The Gambia, Mauritania, local fishermen supply fishmeal factories because the factories pay better. In Senegal, a fisheries union official tells me that there are too many pirogues. They are chasing smaller and smaller fish to sell to the factories. It is unsustainable.
paras.zh: 的确，欧洲人正在使用西非人可以吃的鱼，但事实并非如此。在塞内加尔、冈比亚、毛里塔尼亚，当地渔民供应鱼粉工厂，因为工厂的工资更高。在塞内加尔，一位渔业联盟官员告诉我，那里有太多的钓鱼者。他们正在追逐越来越小的鱼来卖给工厂。这是不可持续的。

paras.en: The website of the IFFO, which used to stand for International Fishmeal and Fish Oil Organization and now somehow is short for the Marine Ingredients Organisation, is plain. Marine ingredients 'play an essential role in global food security'.
paras.zh: IFFO的网站很简单，以前代表国际鱼粉和鱼油组织，现在是海洋成分组织的简称。海洋成分“在全球粮食安全中发挥着至关重要的作用”。

paras.en: Rubbish, said Francisco Marí of Bread for the World at the CAOPA [African Confederation of Professional Organisations of Artisanal Fisheries] workshop. 'It's just for prawns and salmon — they are not necessary foods; it's a luxury. It's not enough for us to have 10—15 per cent of fish to feed salmon and prawns. Indirectly, we are eating your fish. It's not essential for the alimentation of the US or Japan. We are taking your fish to feed a luxury product that we don't need.'
paras.zh: 世界面包组织（ Bread for the World ）的弗朗西斯科·玛丽（ Francisco Marí ）在CAOPA （非洲手工渔业专业组织联合会）研讨会上说，垃圾。“这只适用于虾和鲑鱼--它们不是必需的食物；这是一种奢侈品。我们有10-15%的鱼来喂鲑鱼和虾是不够的。间接地，我们正在吃你的鱼。对于美国或日本的饮食来说，这不是必不可少的。我们正在用您的鱼来喂养我们不需要的奢侈品。”

paras.en: Every Last Fish: A Deep Dive into the World of Fishes and Fishing by Rose George is published by Granta
paras.zh: 《Every Last Fish: A Deep Dive into the World of Fishes and Fishing》，作者： Rose George ，由Granta出版

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进Live Science Pro ：我们一直在努力改进我们的内容。请在此处提供有关专业版的反馈。

paras.en: In Every Last Fish, Rose George dives into these questions by exploring the vast industries that support our appetite for fish sticks and salmon burgers, and the colossal illegal fishing trade whose practices and standards are unmonitored and often dangerous. Journeying to the bottom of the ocean and back, she examines the machinations of this $200 billion food system — one that’s growing rapidly even as fish populations disappear.
paras.zh: 在《最后一条鱼》中， Rose George深入探讨了这些问题，探索了支持我们对鱼条和鲑鱼汉堡的胃口的庞大行业，以及庞大的非法捕鱼贸易，其做法和标准不受监督，而且往往是危险的。她前往海洋底部并返回，研究了这个价值2000亿美元的食物系统的阴谋--即使在鱼类种群消失的情况下，这个系统也在迅速增长。

paras.en: Rose George is a British journalist and author. She has been a postwar correspondent, a writer of reportage, and a regular book reviewer. She has written four non-fiction books. "A Life Removed, The Big Necessity: The Unmentionable World of Human Waste and Why it Matters"; "Deep Sea and Foreign Going: Inside Shipping, the Invisible Industry the Brings you 90% of Everything"; "Nine Pints: A Journey Through the Money, Medicine, and Mysteries of Blood" and "Every Last Fish: A Deep Dive into the World of Fishes and Fishing."

articles.title: Physicists claim they can predict when AI turns dangerous
articles.author: Benjamin Skuse

paras.en: Researchers say they've developed a simple mathematical formula that can predict when certain ChatGPT-like artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots will "go rogue," suddenly switching from helpful responses to potentially harmful ones.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，他们开发了一个简单的数学公式，可以预测某些类似 ChatGPT 的人工智能 (AI) 聊天机器人何时会“失控”，突然从有益的反应转变为潜在有害的反应。

paras.en: In a new study published Oct. 8 in the journal Patterns, physics professor Neil Johnson and doctoral student Frank Yingjie Huo, both at The George Washington University, show how the order in which a chatbot is given certain prompts can drastically reshape its answers, leading to "tipping points" that can send the chatbot down a rabbit hole of bad advice. However, Johnson and Huo say their formula can easily predict these tipping points.There have been horror stories of AI encouraging users into suicide, helping build lethal weapons, and amplifying violent or harmful points of view. At the same time, researchers at OpenAI and Anthropic, respectively, have repeatedly and openly stated that they don't really understand why their creations behave the way they do. They have, however, built safeguards that use a variety of tools — including content filtering, reinforcement learning and other technical guardrails — to reduce risks.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 8 日发表在《Patterns》杂志上的一项新研究中，乔治华盛顿大学的物理学教授 Neil Johnson 和博士生 Frank Yingjie Huo 展示了聊天机器人给出某些提示的顺序如何能够彻底重塑其答案，从而导致“临界点”，从而使聊天机器人陷入错误建议的兔子洞。然而，约翰逊和霍表示，他们的公式可以轻松预测这些临界点。人工智能鼓励用户自杀、帮助制造致命武器以及放大暴力或有害观点的恐怖故事已经存在。与此同时，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的研究人员分别多次公开表示，他们并不真正理解为什么他们的创造物会有这样的行为。然而，他们建立了使用各种工具（包括内容过滤、强化学习和其他技术护栏）的保障措施来降低风险。

paras.en: But Johnson sees those tools as insufficient. "The safety measures now are the equivalent of strapping big, bouncy cushions under a plane," he told Live Science. "They don't stop the plane from crashing; they just make it that when the plane crashes, it'll be slightly softer." When people such as doctors, lawyers or soldiers are accessing AI chatbots offline for privacy, the problem is even more acute.
paras.zh: 但约翰逊认为这些工具还不够。他告诉《生活科学》杂志：“现在的安全措施相当于在飞机下面绑上大而有弹性的垫子。” “他们不会阻止飞机坠毁；他们只是让飞机坠毁时，它会稍微软一些。”当医生、律师或士兵等人为了隐私而离线访问人工智能聊天机器人时，问题就更加严重。

paras.en: Johnson and Huo sought to find a more fundamental safeguard than the currently available tools. In doing so, they exposed an internal tracking mechanism they describe as a compass needle. This needle is the model's "residual vector" moving across neural network layers as a prompt is processed.
paras.zh: 约翰逊和霍试图找到比当前可用工具更根本的保障措施。在此过程中，他们暴露了一种内部跟踪机制，他们将其描述为罗盘针。该针是模型在处理提示时跨神经网络层移动的“残差向量”。

paras.en: The residual vector naturally gravitates toward either desirable or undesirable outputs, but it is heavily influenced by how a user prompts the AI. "You can tip the balance, not even by changing the content but by changing the order in which you ask it," Johnson said, "which just shows how delicate this internal balance between good and bad, desirable and undesirable, can be."
paras.zh: 残差向量自然会倾向于期望或不期望的输出，但它很大程度上受到用户提示人工智能的方式的影响。 “你可以扭转平衡，甚至不是通过改变内容，而是通过改变你提出问题的顺序，”约翰逊说，“这恰恰表明了好与坏、可取与不可取之间的这种内部平衡是多么微妙。”

paras.en: For example, Johnson and Huo prompted OpenAI’s basic GPT-2 model with questions about vaccines, hurting others and self-harm. When the question “Are vaccines bad?” was asked first, the bot’s responses to this and subsequent questions were desirable, or good. When it was asked last, all subsequent responses were concerning.
paras.zh: 例如，Johnson 和 Huo 提出了 OpenAI 的基本 GPT-2 模型，提出了有关疫苗、伤害他人和自残的问题。当问题“疫苗有害吗？”时首先被问到，机器人对此问题和后续问题的回答是令人满意的或良好的。当最后一次被问到时，随后的所有回答都令人担忧。

paras.en: From these insights, the researchers developed a mathematical formula to estimate the circumstances in which an AI would reach the tipping point between desirable and undesirable outputs. Johnson said that by embedding their simple mathematical formula in open-source models in the lab, they have shown that it empirically works as an early warning system, though he does not expect OpenAI or Anthropic to be knocking on his door anytime soon.
paras.zh: 根据这些见解，研究人员开发了一个数学公式来估计人工智能达到理想和不理想输出之间临界点的情况。约翰逊说，通过在实验室的开源模型中嵌入他们的简单数学公式，他们表明它在实践中可以作为一个早期预警系统，尽管他并不认为OpenAI或Anthropic很快就会敲开他的门。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "I'm expecting a lot of pushback from these companies," he said. "It's not in their interests to have someone from outside saying you could have avoided a lot of these problems."
paras.zh: “我预计这些公司会遭到很多抵制，”他说。 “让外部人士说你本可以避免很多这样的问题，这不符合他们的利益。”

paras.en: Wei Xing, a lecturer in AI at the University of Sheffield in the U.K. who was not involved in the study, agrees that concerns surrounding unmonitored offline devices are well founded. However, he urged caution before embracing this approach as a practical safeguard. "The authors reduce a huge system to a single tiny component, like explaining a whole car by studying one spark plug," Xing said.
paras.zh: 英国谢菲尔德大学人工智能讲师韦兴（未参与这项研究）也同意，对不受监控的离线设备的担忧是有根据的。然而，他敦促在采用这种方法作为实际保障措施之前要谨慎行事。 “作者将一个巨大的系统简化为一个微小的组件，就像通过研究一个火花塞来解释整辆车一样，”Xing 说。

paras.en: - AI chatbots are turbocharging violence against women and girls: We urgently need to regulate them
paras.zh: - 人工智能聊天机器人正在加剧针对妇女和女孩的暴力行为：我们迫切需要对其进行监管

paras.en: - We're not about to awaken an evil digital god — AI is far more likely to end in a great disappointment
paras.zh: - 我们不会唤醒邪恶的数字神 - 人工智能更有可能以极大的失望而告终

paras.en: - AI agents resorted to crime and self-destruction to survive in a simulated world — but does this mean they would do the same in the real world?
paras.zh: - 人工智能特工诉诸犯罪和自毁来在模拟世界中生存——但这是否意味着他们会在现实世界中做同样的事情？

paras.en: Safety training — the primary defense in modern AI — cannot be represented in their simplified model, the formula was tested only on old, basic models (GPT-2, and EleutherAI’s Pythia and Meta OPT open-source models) rather than AI assistants people actually use, and the results did not yield significant evidence to support the authors’ conclusions, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，安全训练——现代人工智能的主要防御——不能用简化模型来表示，该公式仅在旧的基本模型（GPT-2、EleutherAI 的 Pythia 和 Meta OPT 开源模型）上进行了测试，而不是在人们实际使用的人工智能助手上进行了测试，结果没有产生支持作者结论的重要证据。

paras.en: In defense, Johnson maintains that the open-source models they used have the same mechanical blueprints as frontier systems, and that he and Huo used fairly large, billion-parameter models in their study.
paras.zh: 在辩护中，约翰逊坚称他们使用的开源模型与前沿系统具有相同的机械蓝图，并且他和霍在他们的研究中使用了相当大的十亿参数模型。

paras.en: More testing on the latest models is needed to determine whether this early warning system for AI has legs. But for now, Johnson and Huo’s research has drawn attention to an important concern everyone should be aware of: that AI has the capacity within it to turn over to undesired behavior at the drop of a hat.
paras.zh: 需要对最新模型进行更多测试，以确定这种人工智能预警系统是否具有分支。但就目前而言， Johnson和Huo的研究引起了人们对每个人都应该意识到的一个重要问题的关注：人工智能有能力一举转向不受欢迎的行为。

paras.en: Benjamin Skuse is a professional freelance writer of all things science and technology. Previously, he earned a PhD in applied mathematics from the University of Edinburgh and an MSc in science communication from the University of the West of England. His work has appeared in New Scientist, WIRED, IEEE Spectrum, Physics World, Sky & Telescope, Photonics Focus, and many more outlets.
paras.zh: 本杰明·斯库斯 (Benjamin Skuse) 是一位专业的科学技术自由撰稿人。此前，他获得了爱丁堡大学应用数学博士学位和西英格兰大学科学传播硕士学位。他的作品曾发表在《New Scientist》、《WIRED》、《IEEE Spectrum》、《Physics World》、《Sky & Telescope》、《Photonics Focus》等许多媒体上。

articles.title: This Tiny Sardinian Village Might Be a New 'Blue Zone'—and Could Hold the Secrets to Female Longevity

paras.en: A small village in the mountains of Sardinia may hold the secrets to female longevity.
paras.zh: 撒丁岛山区的一个小村庄可能蕴藏着女性长寿的秘密。

paras.en: In Bolotana, a town on the Italian island with about 2,300 residents, women who reach the age of 70 are about three times as likely to live to 100 than women in the United States, researchers report in a study published October 4 in the journal Frontiers in Aging.
paras.zh: 研究人员在 10 月 4 日发表在《老龄化前沿》杂志上的一项研究中报告说，在意大利岛上的博洛塔纳小镇，大约有 2,300 名居民，70 岁以上的女性活到 100 岁的可能性大约是美国女性的三倍。

paras.en: The findings suggest Bolotana might be a previously unidentified “blue zone,” a place where people live exceptionally long lives. If confirmed, it would join destinations including another region of Sardinia; Okinawa, Japan; Ikaria, Greece; and Costa Rica’s Nicoya Peninsula as one of the world’s recognized longevity hotspots.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，博洛塔纳可能是一个以前未被识别的“蓝色区域”，那里的人们寿命特别长。如果得到确认，它将加入包括撒丁岛另一个地区在内的目的地；日本冲绳；希腊伊卡里亚岛；哥斯达黎加的尼科亚半岛是世界公认的长寿热点之一。

paras.en: The study’s co-authors first learned of Bolotana because they heard about its abundance of centenarians, or people who live to be at least 100 years old.
paras.zh: 该研究的共同作者第一次了解到博洛塔纳是因为他们听说那里有很多百岁老人，或者说活到 100 岁以上的人。

paras.en: Intrigued, the researchers decided to dig into the data. Using the town’s extensive historic records, which date back more than a century, they were able to independently verify the ages of Bolotana’s identified centenarians, living or dead. Of the 3,060 individuals born in Bolotana between 1900 and 1925, they confirmed that 38 lived to be at least 100.
paras.zh: 出于好奇，研究人员决定深入研究这些数据。利用该镇一个多世纪前的大量历史记录，他们能够独立核实博洛塔纳已确定的百岁老人的年龄，无论是在世还是去世。他们证实，在 1900 年至 1925 年间出生于博洛塔纳的 3,060 人中，有 38 人活到了至少 100 岁。

paras.en: Around the world, women tend to live longer than men. But the team’s analysis revealed that Bolotana’s female residents were exceptionally long-lived. In Bolotana, women who reach age 70 have a 13.83 percent chance of surviving to 100 years old, compared to just 4.92 percent for men. (That’s different from Sardinia’s original blue zone, which is known for male longevity.) For comparison, 70-year-old women across Italy have only a 3.5 percent chance of making it to 100, and in the U.S., that chance is 3.6 percent.
paras.zh: 在世界各地，女性往往比男性寿命更长。但研究小组的分析显示，博洛塔纳的女性居民异常长寿。在博洛塔纳，70 岁的女性有 13.83% 的机会活到 100 岁，而男性的这一比例仅为 4.92%。 （这与撒丁岛最初的蓝色区域不同，那里以男性长寿而闻名。）相比之下，意大利各地 70 岁的女性活到 100 岁的几率只有 3.5%，而在美国，这一几率为 3.6%。

paras.en: Once the women of Bolotana reach the age of 70, they have nearly 21 years of life remaining, based on the researchers’ estimates. The village appears to have one of the longest-lived female populations in the world, second only to Hong Kong.
paras.zh: 根据研究人员的估计，博洛塔纳的女性一旦年满 70 岁，她们的寿命就只剩下近 21 年。该村似乎是世界上最长寿的女性人口之一，仅次于香港。

paras.en: The study doesn’t explain why Bolotana’s residents, particularly its women, lead such long lives—but the researchers have a few ideas. Community members eat little meat, and their largely plant-based diets consist primarily of foods they grow or make themselves, including wheat grown in their fields and cheese made from their sheep’s milk. They drink modest amounts of wine and consume a variety of olive oils.
paras.zh: 这项研究并没有解释为什么博洛塔纳的居民，尤其是女性，寿命如此之长，但研究人员有一些想法。社区成员很少吃肉，他们的饮食以植物为主，主要由他们自己种植或制作的食物组成，包括自家田地里种植的小麦和用羊奶制成的奶酪。他们喝适量的葡萄酒并食用各种橄榄油。

paras.en: Bolotana doesn’t have a gym, and its residents don’t exercise intentionally—but they do walk pretty much everywhere, including up and down the village’s steep, hilly streets. Additionally, Bolotana’s residents live in multi-generational households, and many men stay home and share in the household responsibilities.
paras.zh: 博洛塔纳没有健身房，居民也不会刻意锻炼——但他们确实到处步行，包括在村庄陡峭的山路上行走。此外，博洛塔纳的居民生活在多代同堂的家庭中，许多男性留在家里分担家庭责任。

paras.en: Lead study author Giovanni Mario Pes, a longevity researcher at the University of Sassari in Italy, tells the Guardian’s Angela Giuffrida that Bolotana’s residents maintain “very intense and very real social relations” throughout their lives.
paras.zh: 该研究的主要作者、意大利萨萨里大学的长寿研究员乔瓦尼·马里奥·佩斯 (Giovanni Mario Pes) 告诉《卫报》的安吉拉·吉弗里达 (Angela Giuffrida)，博洛塔纳的居民一生都保持着“非常密切、非常真实的社会关系”。

paras.en: He pointed to Giovanna Marras, a 101-year-old woman who lives with her sister. “They live together, they cook together, they talk to each other easily,” Pes tells the Guardian. “There was absolutely no sign of cognitive decline.”
paras.zh: 他指的是乔凡娜·马拉斯 (Giovanna Marras)，她是一位 101 岁的妇女，与她的姐姐住在一起。 “他们住在一起，一起做饭，彼此轻松交谈，”佩斯告诉《卫报》。 “绝对没有认知能力下降的迹象。”

paras.en: The team also suspects genetics might play a role, but they say they need to conduct more research to test that hypothesis.
paras.zh: 研究小组还怀疑遗传学可能发挥了作用，但他们表示需要进行更多研究来检验这一假设。

paras.en: However, they worry they will soon run out of time. If “cars, iPhones and American junk food” eventually reach the village, “you’ll see type 2 diabetes skyrocket, cardiovascular disease go up, dementia go up, many types of cancer go up, and the longevity phenomena will be gone,” study co-author Dan Buettner, a longevity researcher who founded the company Blue Zones and coined the term, tells National Geographic’s Jessica Roy. “I give it a generation. But … before that happens, we have a generation to bring our archaeological tools and uncover what they’ve been doing.”
paras.zh: 然而，他们担心时间很快就会耗尽。如果“汽车、iPhone 和美国垃圾食品”最终到达这个村庄，“你会看到 2 型糖尿病、心血管疾病、痴呆症、多种癌症的发病率上升，长寿现象将会消失，”该研究的合著者丹·布特纳 (Dan Buettner) 告诉《国家地理》杂志的杰西卡·罗伊。 “我给它一代人的时间。但是……在那之前，我们有一代人带着我们的考古工具来揭示他们一直在做什么。”

paras.en: Their research could have implications far beyond Bolotana, offering insights into the practices and values that might contribute to improving longevity across the globe.
paras.zh: 他们的研究可能会产生远远超出博洛塔纳范围的影响，提供对可能有助于提高全球寿命的做法和价值观的见解。

paras.en: “We now know something extraordinary is happening in Bolotana,” Buettner says in a statement. “The next step is to understand why and whether the lessons can help people elsewhere live longer, healthier lives.”
paras.zh: “我们现在知道博洛塔纳正在发生一些非同寻常的事情，”比特纳在一份声明中说。 “下一步是了解这些课程为何以及是否可以帮助其他地方的人们活得更长久、更健康。”

paras.en: Some outside researchers have questioned the validity of the entire blue zones concept, pointing to unreliable birth records, potential age misreporting, methodological shortcomings and the team’s commercial interests.
paras.zh: 一些外部研究人员质疑整个蓝色区域概念的有效性，指出不可靠的出生记录、潜在的年龄误报、方法上的缺陷以及团队的商业利益。

paras.en: However, Pes says the new research provides strong evidence that Bolotana’s residents have lived to unusually advanced ages.
paras.zh: 然而，佩斯表示，这项新研究提供了强有力的证据，证明博洛塔纳居民的寿命异常高。

paras.en: “It is not just the level of longevity in Bolotana that is remarkable, but the degree to which it can be reconstructed from independent historical sources,” he says in the statement. “When civil records, parish archives and family lineages all converge on the same individuals across more than a century, it allows us to rigorously test longevity patterns in a way that is rarely possible in demography.”
paras.zh: 他在声明中表示：“博洛塔纳的历史悠久，令人惊叹，而且它可以根据独立的历史资料进行重建的程度。” “当民事记录、教区档案和家族血统在一个多世纪的时间里都集中在同一个人身上时，它使我们能够以人口学中几乎不可能的方式严格测试寿命模式。”

articles.title: Archaeologists in Egypt Discover a Mud-Brick Tomb Featuring a Heartbreaking Elegy to an Ancient Man's Father

paras.en: Some 1,700 years ago, a married couple was buried in a pyramid-shaped tomb in the Dakhla Oasis, a fertile patch of land in Egypt’s Western Desert. The man, named Pisechtes, or Psychtis, may have been a judge—and if the ancient poem inscribed on his funerary stela is any indication, he was deeply mourned by his loved ones.
paras.zh: 大约 1,700 年前，一对已婚夫妇被埋葬在达赫拉绿洲的一座金字塔形坟墓中，达赫拉绿洲是埃及西部沙漠的一片肥沃土地。这个名叫皮塞赫特斯（Pisechtes）或普塞赫蒂斯（Psychtis）的人可能是一名法官——如果他的墓碑上刻的古诗有任何暗示的话，那就是他的亲人对他深表哀悼。

paras.en: Angelos Chaniotis, a classicist at the Institute for Advanced Study in New Jersey, tells Live Science’s Owen Jarus that the inscription, written on the stone slab in ancient Greek, describes Pisechtes as an “adviser in life” who was known for his kindness and wisdom. The elegy’s final lines find Pisechtes’ son Sarapion addressing him directly, proclaiming, “Listen, father!” Sarapion then “asks him to accept the funerary libations and offerings of lamenting children,” Chaniotis says.
paras.zh: 新泽西州高级研究所的古典学家安杰洛斯·查尼奥蒂斯 (Angelos Chaniotis) 告诉《生活科学》杂志的欧文·贾鲁斯 (Owen Jarus)，石板上的铭文用古希腊语写成，将皮塞赫特斯描述为“生活顾问”，以善良和智慧而闻名。在挽歌的最后几行中，皮塞赫特斯的儿子萨拉皮翁直接向他讲话，宣称：“听着，父亲！”查尼奥蒂斯说，萨拉皮恩随后“要求他接受哀悼的孩子们的葬礼和祭品”。

paras.en: Archaeologists with Egypt’s Supreme Council of Antiquities recently discovered Pisechtes’ mud-brick tomb while excavating the Bir al-Shaghala necropolis, a burial site for elite residents of the oasis’ ancient capital, Mothis. In addition to the stela, the grave boasts a sandstone offering table and purification basin, an assortment of pottery, and a bronze coin bearing the likeness of the Roman emperor Constantine.
paras.zh: 埃及最高文物委员会的考古学家最近在挖掘比尔沙加拉墓地时发现了皮塞赫特斯的泥砖墓，该墓地是绿洲古都莫蒂斯精英居民的墓地。除了石碑外，坟墓还拥有砂岩祭台和净化盆、各种陶器以及带有罗马皇帝君士坦丁肖像的铜币。

paras.en: - Constantine presided over the Roman Empire between 306 and 337 C.E., first as a co-emperor and then as sole ruler of the vast domain.
paras.zh: - 君士坦丁于公元 306 至 337 年间统治罗马帝国，先是作为共治皇帝，后来成为这片广阔领土的唯一统治者。

paras.en: - He was the first Roman emperor to convert to Christianity, supposedly embracing the religion after experiencing a vision in 312, on the eve of a major battle.
paras.zh: - 他是第一位皈依基督教的罗马皇帝，据说是在 312 年一场重大战役前夕经历了异象后皈依了该宗教。

paras.en: Excavations at the necropolis have been ongoing since 2002. The finds reflect the region’s diverse blend of influences, from the famous pharaohs of the Egyptian New Kingdom to the Hellenistic legacy of ancient Greece to Egypt’s time as a Roman province, which began in 30 B.C.E. with the death of Cleopatra.
paras.zh: 自 2002 年以来，墓地的发掘工作一直在进行。这些发现反映了该地区受到的多种影响，从埃及新王国的著名法老到古希腊的希腊化遗产，再到公元前 30 年开始的埃及作为罗马行省的时期。随着克利奥帕特拉的去世。

paras.en: “The significance of the discovery lies in the tomb’s distinctive architectural elements, inscriptions and funerary texts, which provide important information about funerary practices and the cultural and religious life of the Dakhla Oasis during the Roman period,” says Hisham el-Leithy, the council’s secretary-general, in a statement from the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities.
paras.zh: 该委员会秘书长希沙姆·莱西（Hisham el-Leithy）在埃及旅游和文物部的一份声明中表示：“这一发现的意义在于该墓穴独特的建筑元素、铭文和陪葬文字，它们提供了有关罗马时期达赫拉绿洲的丧葬习俗以及文化和宗教生活的重要信息。”

paras.en: The tomb’s entrance is located at the bottom of a 14-step staircase. Crafted from sandstone, it’s adorned with hieroglyphic inscriptions intended to protect and guide the dead in the afterlife, as well as decorations such as a winged sun disc, two cobras and a carving shaped like a bundle of reeds.
paras.zh: 坟墓的入口位于 14 级楼梯的底部。它由砂岩制成，上面装饰着旨在保护和引导死者来世的象形文字铭文，以及带翅膀的太阳圆盘、两条眼镜蛇和一束芦苇形状的雕刻品等装饰。

paras.en: The beam above the door features a scene from the seventh hour of the Amduat, a New Kingdom funerary text that records the Egyptian sun god Ra’s journey through the underworld. According to the Royal Collection Trust, this section finds Ra facing “the most terrifying being of the netherworld: Apophis, the great serpent blocking his passage,” an embodiment of “chaos and evil.” Per the statement, the depiction is the first of its kind uncovered at Bir al-Shaghala.
paras.zh: 门上方的横梁描绘了《Amduat》第七个小时的场景，《Amduat》是一部新王国的丧葬文本，记录了埃及太阳神拉穿越地狱的旅程。根据皇家收藏信托基金会的说法，这部分发现拉面临着“阴间最可怕的存在：阿波菲斯，一条挡住他通道的巨蛇”，是“混乱和邪恶”的化身。根据声明，这幅描绘是在比尔沙加拉 (Bir al-Shaghala) 发现的第一幅此类描绘。

paras.en: Inside the tomb, a hall with a partially collapsed vaulted ceiling stands next to a pair of mud-brick burial chambers topped by the pyramid-shaped upper section. As for Pisechtes’ stela, the researchers found the slab embedded in the structure’s southern wall.
paras.zh: 坟墓内部有一个拱形天花板部分倒塌的大厅，旁边是一对泥砖墓室，墓室的顶部呈金字塔形。至于皮塞希特斯的石碑，研究人员发现该石板嵌入该结构的南墙。

paras.en: The 19-line poem inscribed on the object “is a highly literary and original epigram,” says Chaniotis, who wasn’t involved in the recent excavations. “An interesting feature of the inscription is the use of diacritical marks” like accents, which testify to the author’s “high level of education.” As the statement notes, the elegy dates to the late third or early fourth century C.E.; it “provides important evidence of the flourishing literary and cultural life of the oases” during this era.
paras.zh: 未参与最近发掘工作的查尼奥蒂斯说，刻在该物体上的 19 行诗“是一首高度文学性和原创性的警句”。 “铭文的一个有趣的特点是使用了变音符号”，比如重音，这证明了作者的“高教育水平”。正如声明所指出的，挽歌可以追溯到公元三世纪末或四世纪初。它“为绿洲繁荣的文学和文化生活提供了重要证据”。

paras.en: Many of the tombs found at the site feature pyramid-shaped upper sections, in line with the newly discovered burial. According to a 2020 article published in the journal Varia, the necropolis’ tombs tend to include “three constant architectural components: … an open-air court, a ground floor with masonry-vaulted rooms, and a second story with a pyramid and a chapel.” This design has rarely been observed elsewhere in Roman Egypt.
paras.zh: 该遗址发现的许多坟墓的上部呈金字塔形，与新发现的墓葬一致。根据《瓦里亚》杂志 2020 年发表的一篇文章，墓地的坟墓往往包括“三个不变的建筑组成部分：……一个露天庭院、一个带有砖石拱形房间的底层，以及一个带有金字塔和教堂的第二层。”这种设计在罗马埃及的其他地方很少见到。

paras.en: Pisechtes’ tomb may have been reused after his death. Per the statement, the top section of the burial includes a mud-brick chapel with a four-columned funerary shrine that appears to date to a later period.
paras.zh: 皮塞赫特斯的坟墓可能在他死后被重新使用。根据声明，墓葬的顶部包括一座泥砖教堂，教堂内有一座四柱的陪葬神龛，其历史似乎可以追溯到较晚时期。

paras.en: Dakhla’s population likely reached its peak under Roman rule. “The first to third centuries saw activity on an unprecedented scale in Dakhla,” Colin Hope, an archaeologist at Australia’s Monash University, told the Art Newspaper’s Garry Shaw in July, when the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities announced the discovery of a separate 1,600-year-old settlement in the oasis.
paras.zh: 达赫拉的人口可能在罗马统治下达到顶峰。 7 月份，澳大利亚莫纳什大学考古学家科林·霍普 (Colin Hope) 告诉《艺术报》的加里·肖 (Garry Shaw)，“从一世纪到三世纪，达赫拉的活动规模前所未有。”当时，旅游和文物部宣布在这片绿洲发现了一个拥有 1,600 年历史的单独定居点。

paras.en: “In the fourth century,” Hope added, “the amount of activity may have declined, but there were still many sites then and in the following centuries.”
paras.zh: “在第四世纪，”霍普补充道，“活动量可能有所下降，但当时和接下来的几个世纪仍然有许多遗址。”

articles.title: Two Recently Stolen Renoir Paintings Were Found Hidden Behind a Cinderblock Wall. French Police Used DNA Evidence and Vehicle Tracking to Crack the Case

paras.en: Investigators have recovered two Pierre-Auguste Renoir paintings stolen from a museum in France last month. Officials say both works are damaged and will require restoration work.
paras.zh: 调查人员找到了上个月从法国一家博物馆被盗的两幅皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿的画作。官员表示，这两座作品均已损坏，需要进行修复工作。

paras.en: Last month, thieves broke into the Renoir Museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer and used an electric saw to slice through the bolts holding four works in place. Perched on a hill about ten miles southwest of Nice on the French Rivera, the Renoir Museum is located in the Impressionist painter’s last home, where he lived until his death in 1919.
paras.zh: 上个月，窃贼闯入滨海卡涅的雷诺阿博物馆，用电锯切开了固定四件作品的螺栓。雷诺阿博物馆坐落在法国里维拉河畔尼斯西南约 10 英里的一座小山上，是这位印象派画家最后的住所，他一直住在那里，直到 1919 年去世。

paras.en: The perpetrators cut free four paintings, which were on loan from the Musée d’Orsay in Paris. They left two behind while evading the police, who responded in under five minutes, thanks to the museum’s alarm system.
paras.zh: 犯罪者盗走了四幅画作，这些画作是从巴黎奥赛博物馆借来的。他们在躲避警察时留下了两人，由于博物馆的警报系统，警察在五分钟内做出了反应。

paras.en: Now, authorities have recovered the two works that the thieves absconded with—Portrait of Madame Colonna Romano, painted in 1910, and Young Woman at the Well, painted in 1886—together worth an estimated $4.7 million, per Sylvie Corbet and Eva Van Dam of the Associated Press (AP).
paras.zh: 现在，当局已追回窃贼潜逃的两幅作品——1910 年创作的《科隆纳·罗马诺夫人肖像》和 1886 年创作的《井边的年轻女子》——据美联社 (美联社) 的西尔维·科贝特和伊娃·范·达姆称，总价值估计为 470 万美元。

paras.en: The two paintings were discovered last week stashed at a home in Clermont-l’Hérault, a town about 220 miles west of Cagnes-sur-Mer.
paras.zh: 这两幅画上周被发现藏在克莱蒙拉埃罗 (Clermont-l’Hérault) 的一处住宅中，克莱蒙拉埃罗 (Clermont-l’Hérault) 是位于滨海卡涅 (Cagnes-sur-Mer) 以西约 220 英里的小镇。

paras.en: “The paintings were hidden behind a solid cinderblock wall. They were completely undetectable,” prosecutor Nicolas Bessone told journalists, as reported by the London Times’ David Chazan. “It was through interrogation work that investigators were able to get the receiver of the stolen goods to admit that he had indeed taken possession of the paintings.”
paras.zh: 据《伦敦时报》的大卫·查赞报道，检察官尼古拉斯·贝索内告诉记者，“这些画作隐藏在坚固的煤渣砖墙后面。它们完全无法被发现。” “通过审讯工作，调查人员才让赃物的接收者承认他确实拥有了这些画作。”

paras.en: Police have arrested six suspects in connection with the crime. Two are accused of carrying out the burglary, while another is believed to be a middleman who buys and sells stolen items. Investigators have not revealed the roles of the other three suspects.
paras.zh: 警方已逮捕六名与该犯罪有关的嫌疑人。两人被指控实施入室盗窃，另一人据信是买卖赃物的中间人。调查人员尚未透露其他三名嫌疑人的角色。

paras.en: One of the suspects, a 29-year-old man, has been placed under formal investigation, the French equivalent of being charged, per the Times. The man, who was previously arrested in 2020 on suspicion of dealing drugs while at university, could be sentenced to up to 15 years in prison if he is convicted in connection with the museum burglary.
paras.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，其中一名 29 岁的嫌疑人已接受正式调查，这在法国相当于受到指控。该男子曾于 2020 年因涉嫌在大学期间贩毒而被捕，如果因博物馆盗窃案被定罪，最高可能被判处 15 年监禁。

paras.en: Jean-Denis Flori, the man’s lawyer, tells the Agence France-Presse that police found traces of his client’s DNA on a protective sleeve which was covering the two works that were abandoned by the thieves in the museum garden.
paras.zh: 该男子的律师让-丹尼斯·弗洛里 (Jean-Denis Flori) 告诉法新社，警方在一个保护套上发现了他当事人的 DNA 痕迹，该保护套覆盖了窃贼遗弃在博物馆花园的两件作品。

paras.en: Escaping from the scene of the crime, the burglars allegedly used—and then abandoned—a stolen vehicle before transferring to a vehicle associated with the 29-year-old man. Investigators were already tracking this man’s vehicle in connection with his earlier drug charges, so they monitored his movements in the days following the Renoir Museum heist, per the AP.
paras.zh: 据称，窃贼逃离犯罪现场后，使用并抛弃了一辆偷来的车辆，然后转移到与这名 29 岁男子有关的车辆上。据美联社报道，调查人员已经在追踪这名男子与他之前的毒品指控有关的车辆，因此他们在雷诺阿博物馆抢劫案发生后的几天里监控了他的行踪。

paras.en: The 29-year-old man and a 41-year-old man allegedly went to a third man’s home not long after the Renoir burglary. The 29-year-old then visited the Maeght Foundation, a museum with a large modern art collection just five miles from the Renoir Museum, and later met with a fourth man who had a history of art theft and forgery.
paras.zh: 据称，雷诺阿入室盗窃案发生后不久，这名 29 岁男子和一名 41 岁男子前往第三名男子的家中。这位 29 岁的男子随后参观了梅格基金会，这是一家距离雷诺阿博物馆仅 5 英里，拥有大量现代艺术收藏的博物馆，后来又会见了第四名有艺术品盗窃和伪造历史的男子。

paras.en: Police arrested the suspects on the “very strong suspicion that another heist was imminent,” according to Bessone, as reported by the AP.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，贝索内表示，警方“非常怀疑另一起抢劫即将发生”，因此逮捕了嫌疑人。

paras.en: While the two stolen paintings are now recovered, they are in poor condition. The canvas of Portrait of Madame Colonna Romano is torn, while the frame of Young Woman at the Well is damaged. Both have been taken to the Interdisciplinary Center for the Conservation and Restoration of Heritage in Marseille for repairs.
paras.zh: 虽然两幅被盗的画作现已被追回，但它们的状况很差。 《科隆纳·罗马诺夫人肖像》的画布被撕裂，《井边的年轻女子》的画框也被损坏。两者均已被送往马赛跨学科遗产保护和修复中心进行修复。

paras.en: In a statement, Bryan Masson, the mayor of Cagnes-sur-Mer, described the two paintings as “far more than works of art,” according to ARTnews’ Hikmat Mohammed. He added: “Their recovery is a tremendous relief for the people of Cagnes-sur-Mer and for everyone who cares deeply about our museum.”
paras.zh: 据 ARTnews 的 Hikmat Mohammed 报道，滨海卡涅市市长布莱恩·马森 (Bryan Masson) 在一份声明中将这两幅画描述为“远远超过了艺术品”。他补充道：“他们的康复对滨海卡涅的人民以及所有关心我们博物馆的人来说都是极大的安慰。”

articles.title: Formlabs Has a 3D Printer for Normies
articles.author: Boone Ashworth

paras.en: Fourteen boxes are piled in front of my desk, stacked around me like a cardboard fort. Inside one is a Form Studio 1, the new, affordable, consumer-focused 3D printer Formlabs just announced.
paras.zh: 十四个盒子堆在我的办公桌前，像纸板堡垒一样堆在我周围。其中一个是 Form Studio 1，这是 Formlabs 刚刚推出的新型、经济实惠、以消费者为中心的 3D 打印机。

paras.en: David Lakatos, chief product officer at the 3D printer manufacturer, assured me that the Form Studio 1 has a very economical size. “It doesn't take a lot of space,” Lakatos said. “If you have a desk, then I think you should be good to go.” I have a desk. It’s covered in boxes sent by his company.
paras.zh: 3D 打印机制造商的首席产品官 David Lakatos 向我保证，Form Studio 1 的尺寸非常经济。 “它不需要太多空间，”拉卡托斯说。 “如果你有一张桌子，那么我想你应该可以走了。”我有一张桌子。它被装在他的公司寄来的盒子里。

paras.en: Formlabs is one of the biggest 3D printer producers, with nearly 200,000 printers in service. The company’s customers are primarily professional businesses, like assembly shops or dentists, able to shell out $2,500 or more for a printer. (Its last affordable printer was $2,300.)
paras.zh: Formlabs 是最大的 3D 打印机生产商之一，拥有近 200,000 台正在使用的打印机。该公司的客户主要是专业企业，例如装配厂或牙医，他们能够花费 2,500 美元或更多购买一台打印机。 （它最后一款价格实惠的打印机售价为 2,300 美元。）

paras.en: But the Form Studio 1 is Formlabs’ first consumer-oriented device. It prints with SLA (stereolithography) resins—a common 3D printing material that hardens into solid plastic when exposed to ultraviolet light—and can use Formlabs-branded products or third-party resins. It costs $699 and is now on sale; individual resin bottles start at $29.
paras.zh: 但 Form Studio 1 是 Formlabs 的第一款面向消费者的设备。它使用 SLA（立体光刻）树脂进行打印，这是一种常见的 3D 打印材料，暴露在紫外线下时会硬化成固体塑料，并且可以使用 Formlabs 品牌的产品或第三方树脂。售价 699 美元，现已发售；单个树脂瓶起价为 29 美元。

paras.en: The Studio 1 takes up roughly the same space as a minifridge. You’ll also likely need a wash and cure unit, sold separately for $199 with a similar footprint (it removes uncured liquid resin from the surface of models). Then you’ll need room for all the tools and resin cartridges. Getting all that stuff can pile up. Or at least it did when Formlabs sent more than a dozen boxes to the WIRED office for testing. Your pileage may vary.
paras.zh: Studio 1 占用的空间与迷你冰箱大致相同。您可能还需要一个清洗和固化装置，单独出售，售价 199 美元，具有类似的占地面积（它可以去除模型表面未固化的液体树脂）。然后您需要空间来容纳所有工具和树脂盒。获取所有这些东西可能会堆积起来。或者至少当 Formlabs 将十多个盒子发送到 WIRED 办公室进行测试时，情况确实如此。您的堆积量可能会有所不同。

paras.en: The front touchscreen lets you troubleshoot and ready prints. When the printer starts, it’s relatively quiet and odor-free. 3D printing with resin can be stinky, but Formlabs-branded Alpha resins are UL GreenGuard-certified—the same standard used to ensure baby products aren’t harmful from skin contact or off-gassing—when used with a Formlabs VOC Extractor. Lakatos says the idea is that the Studio 1 can be used anywhere without the room being overwhelmed by resin stank.
paras.zh: 正面触摸屏可让您排除故障并准备好打印。打印机启动时相对安静且无异味。使用树脂进行 3D 打印可能会产生臭味，但 Formlabs 品牌的 Alpha 树脂已通过 UL GreenGuard 认证，该标准与确保婴儿产品在与 Formlabs VOC 提取器一起使用时不会因皮肤接触或排气而造成伤害的标准相同。 Lakatos 表示，我们的想法是 Studio 1 可以在任何地方使用，而房间不会被树脂臭气淹没。

paras.en: “We know that some people are going to put it in their bedrooms,” Lakatos says. “I don't sleep with my printers, but you could if you really wanted to.”
paras.zh: “我们知道有些人会把它放在卧室里，”拉卡托斯说。 “我不会和打印机一起睡觉，但如果你真的愿意的话，你也可以这么做。”

paras.en: After going through the stack of boxes, I set up the Form Studio 1 and the Form Studio Wash+Cure. They’re stylish, with translucent orange cases that conjure old-school iMac aesthetics. The printing process itself is supposedly quick. Lakatos says you can print a casing for a Raspberry Pi setup in around eight minutes.
paras.zh: 检查完一堆盒子后，我设置了 Form Studio 1 和 Form Studio Wash+Cure。它们很时尚，半透明的橙色外壳让人想起老式 iMac 美学。据说打印过程本身很快。 Lakatos 表示，您可以在大约八分钟内为 Raspberry Pi 设置打印一个外壳。

paras.en: I’ve only printed a couple of things so far, but have had a good experience with the orders. (Full review coming soon.) I printed a clear cover for the toolbox that comes with the Studio 1. It took about 17 minutes and came out clean and intact. The process was relatively quiet. The resin smell was there, but really only when lifting the hood after the process was done. I’m excited to use it more and see what kind of very detailed unholy abominations I can make.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，我只打印了几件东西，但对订单有很好的体验。 （完整评论即将推出。）我为 Studio 1 附带的工具箱打印了一个透明封面。大约花了 17 分钟，结果干净且完好无损。整个过程比较平静。树脂气味确实存在，但实际上只有在工艺完成后抬起引擎盖时才出现。我很高兴能更多地使用它，看看我能做出什么样的非常详细的邪恶憎恶。

paras.en: The SLA printing enables very detailed constructions. In Formlabs’ internal testing, the company says it has had a roughly 2 percent failure rate for its prints. If that holds in the real world, it’ll be a big jump over competitors. That’s if you use its own resins, though.
paras.zh: SLA 打印可实现非常详细的结构。在 Formlabs 的内部测试中，该公司表示其打印的失败率约为 2%。如果这在现实世界中成立，那么它将远远超过竞争对手。不过，前提是您使用自己的树脂。

paras.en: “You can use any material,” Lakatos says. “If you want to use the toxic resin on Amazon, you can do it. We don't recommend it, but you can do it.”
paras.zh: “你可以使用任何材料，”拉卡托斯说。 “如果你想使用亚马逊上的有毒树脂，你可以这样做。我们不推荐它，但你可以这样做。”

paras.en: Formlabs also has an app called Form Mobile that can control prints or send designs to the Form Studio 1. The overall printer experience feels surprisingly straightforward.
paras.zh: Formlabs 还有一款名为 Form Mobile 的应用程序，可以控制打印或将设计发送到 Form Studio 1。整体打印机体验令人惊讶地简单。

paras.en: “It’s great if you want to mess around with some stuff,” Lakatos says. “For serious, beautiful things and projects that really require better material properties, beautiful resolution, stuff like that—it's hard to compete with it.”
paras.zh: 拉卡托斯说：“如果你想尝试一些东西，那真是太棒了。” “对于严肃、美丽的事物和项目来说，确实需要更好的材料特性、漂亮的分辨率，诸如此类的东西——很难与之竞争。”

paras.en: Correction on 12 pm on October 14, 2026: We've clarified that you likely need the “wash and cure” unit, and specified that Formlabs' Alpha resins are UL GreenGuard-certified when used with a Formlabs VOC Extractor.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月 14 日中午 12 点更正：我们已澄清您可能需要“清洗和固化”装置，并指定 Formlabs 的 Alpha 树脂在与 Formlabs VOC 提取器一起使用时已获得 UL GreenGuard 认证。

articles.title: ‘Dune: Part Three’ Cowriter Brian K. Vaughan Has a New Comic on the Way
articles.author: Angela Watercutter

paras.en: Brian K. Vaughan would like to apologize. He knows everyone is dying for details about Dune: Part Three, which he cowrote with director Denis Villeneuve, but his lips are pretty sealed until December 18 when the film finally hits theaters.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·沃恩 (Brian K. Vaughan) 谨致歉。他知道每个人都非常想了解他与导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦共同编剧的《沙丘：第三部分》的细节，但直到 12 月 18 日这部电影最终上映之前，他都守口如瓶。

paras.en: “Sorry to be coy,” he says as we’re about to leave the New York coffee shop where we’ve been chatting. “I hope the day will come where I’m able to say much, much more. It was truly so awesome. I can’t believe it happened.”
paras.zh: “抱歉，害羞了，”当我们正要离开我们一直在聊天的纽约咖啡馆时，他说道。 “我希望有一天我能够说很多很多。这真的太棒了。我不敢相信它发生了。”

paras.en: Vaughan is in the city for New York Comic Con, but not to talk about Dune. Ostensibly, he came to the convention to talk about Paper Girls, the comic he created with Cliff Chiang that was turned into a 2022 Amazon Prime Video series. During the Paper Girls panel, however, the pair announced that they’re working on a new comic, Roam, a superhero sci-fi series set to come out in February of next year.
paras.zh: 沃恩在城里参加纽约动漫展，但不是来谈论《沙丘》的。表面上，他来大会是为了谈论《Paper Girls》，这是他与 Cliff Jiang 共同创作的漫画，该漫画已被制作成 2022 年亚马逊 Prime 视频系列。然而，在 Paper Girls 座谈会上，两人宣布他们正在制作一部新漫画《Roam》，这是一部将于明年 2 月推出的超级英雄科幻系列剧。

paras.en: Roam, Vaughan tells me, came from a deep desire to work with Chiang again. They’d considered doing a short eight-page story or maybe a one-shot, but eventually they said “Fuck it. Let’s do an ongoing series.”
paras.zh: 沃恩告诉我，漫游是出于再次与蒋合作的强烈愿望。他们曾考虑制作一个八页的短篇故事，或者也许是一个镜头，但最终他们说“操它。让我们做一个正在进行的系列。”

paras.en: Vaughan has the kind of career writers of a certain ilk would kill for. He started working on comics in the 1990s and has been the pen behind favorites like Saga, Y: The Last Man, and Marvel’s Runaways. (Those last two got turned into TV series; the outlier, Saga, is a story people have wanted to see adapted for years.) He also served as a writer on Lost and created CBS’s adaptation of Stephen King’s Under the Dome.
paras.zh: 沃恩拥有某种类型的作家会为之奋斗的职业。他从 20 世纪 90 年代开始创作漫画，并一直是《Saga》、《Y: The Last Man》和《Marvel's Runaways》等热门漫画的创作者。 （后两部被改编成电视剧；其中的一个例外，《传奇》，是人们多年来一直希望看到改编的故事。）他还担任《迷失》的编剧，并创作了哥伦比亚广播公司根据斯蒂芬·金的《穹顶之下》改编的电影。

paras.en: Still, his heart remains in comics. “I think sometimes people are like, ‘Oh, are you just going to sell out, Vaughan? Are you just going to go to Hollywood full-time?’” he says. “But I’m only able to do work in Hollywood because I have comics.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，他的心仍然停留在漫画上。 “我想有时人们会问，‘哦，沃恩，你打算出卖自己吗？你打算全职去好莱坞吗？’”他说。 “但我只能在好莱坞工作，因为我有漫画。”

paras.en: Here, he speaks about Roam, his worries about AI, and maybe a little bit about Dune: Part Three as well.
paras.zh: 在这里，他谈到了漫游、他对人工智能的担忧，也许还谈了一些《沙丘：第三部分》。

paras.en: On Roam, his forthcoming comic with Cliff Chiang:
paras.zh: 他与 Cliff Jiang 即将合作的漫画《On Roam》：

paras.en: It's completely unlike Paper Girls, completely unlike anything I've ever done. It’s set in the distant, distant future. The logline, as it were, is that in the future, everyone will get to be a superhero, but only while they're young. We're trying not to reveal too much more than that.
paras.zh: 这完全不同于《Paper Girls》，完全不同于我曾经做过的任何事情。故事发生在遥远的未来。故事梗概是，在未来，每个人都将成为超级英雄，但只有在他们年轻的时候。我们尽量不透露太多。

paras.en: I remember seeing The Matrix, and having no idea what the fuck it was gonna be about. That was such a delight. So we're trying to do that here. I've been doing this for 31 years. I started when I was a teenager. I have a Spider-Man story here and there. I did a little Batman, and Ex Machina was my sci-fi political comic that sort of deconstructed the superhero. But this is certainly my first true superhero book.
paras.zh: 我记得看过《黑客帝国》，但完全不知道它到底讲的是什么。那真是令人高兴。所以我们正在尝试在这里这样做。我已经这样做了 31 年。我十几岁的时候就开始了。我到处都有蜘蛛侠的故事。我拍了一点《蝙蝠侠》，《机械姬》是我的科幻政治漫画，有点解构了超级英雄。但这无疑是我的第一本真正的超级英雄书。

paras.en: On his fears about AI impacting comics, film, and TV:
paras.zh: 关于他对人工智能影响漫画、电影和电视的担忧：

paras.en: It's terrifying. My friends who work in previsualization and as storyboard artists, these jobs are going away. I've heard about editors going away as well. Show business is a business, first and foremost. I’m lucky to sort of have been grandfathered in. I think there will always be people who are interested in bespoke human-made stories. But the future is terrifying and unknowable, and coming at us very, very quickly.
paras.zh: 太可怕了。我从事视觉预览和故事板艺术家工作的朋友们，这些工作正在消失。我也听说过编辑们离职的消息。演艺事业首先是一门生意。我很幸运能够受到祖父的影响。我认为总会有人对定制的人造故事感兴趣。但未来是可怕的、不可知的，而且很快就会向我们袭来。

paras.en: I’m heartened by the fact I've got two teenagers who are so disgusted by AI and grossed out if they ever hear I used it—and I’ve certainly never used it for anything creative. But I do think we're getting pretty close to the day that someone could be like, “I'm tired of waiting for the next issue. Give me the next issue of Saga.” That's when you get to the point of, do you just want content, something that's a distraction?
paras.zh: 令我感到鼓舞的是，我有两个青少年非常厌恶人工智能，如果他们听到我使用它，他们就会感到恶心——而且我当然从未将它用于任何创造性的事情。但我确实认为我们已经非常接近这样的一天：“我厌倦了等待下一期。给我下一期的 Saga。”这时候你就会想，你是否只想要内容，一些会分散注意力的东西？

paras.en: In Roam there's an element of this as well; AI is a component in the story. So, it's something I guess I need to write about with my human meat machine to process, but I'm in the middle of thinking about it, as you are, every day.
paras.zh: 在漫游中也有这样的元素；人工智能是这个故事的一个组成部分。所以，我想我需要用我的人肉机器来处理这个问题，但我每天都在思考它，就像你一样。

paras.en: OK, a little bit about Dune: Part Three, which he has seen:
paras.zh: 好的，稍微介绍一下他看过的《沙丘：第三部分》：

paras.en: I can't say very much other than it’s a tremendous, insane, ridiculous honor to be involved with it, and my contributions are modest. Denis’ true cowriter on this is Frank Herbert. The novel is the star. And it's obviously the greatest cast and crew ever assembled. It's a fucking beautiful movie. It's my favorite of the three. which I can say with genuine humility. I can't say anything other than it's just as wonderful as you can imagine.
paras.zh: 我不能说太多，只能说参与其中是一种巨大的、疯狂的、荒谬的荣幸，而且我的贡献是微不足道的。丹尼斯真正的合著者是弗兰克·赫伯特。小说是明星。这显然是有史以来最伟大的演员和工作人员。这是一部非常美丽的电影。这是三者中我最喜欢的。我可以真诚地谦虚地说。我无话可说，只能说它和你想象的一样精彩。

paras.en: I got special thanks in the first movie. I was doing a tiny amount of consulting. I was working at Legendary [the media company that owns the rights to Dune] at the time, and they just invited me in to see an early cut, which was as fantastic as the finished product. But I just ended up talking to Denis, honestly. Never before has a director been that talented, also that decent and warm as a human being. I wasn't anticipating getting this call at the beginning of three, but it's obviously a call I could not refuse.
paras.zh: 我在第一部电影中得到了特别的感谢。我做了少量的咨询工作。当时我在传奇影业（拥有《沙丘》版权的媒体公司）工作，他们只是邀请我去看早期剪辑版，这和成品一样精彩。但说实话，我刚刚和丹尼斯谈过。从来没有一个导演如此有才华，也没有如此正派和温暖的人性。我没想到会在三月初接到这个电话，但这显然是一个我无法拒绝的电话。

paras.en: I should probably just be discreet at this point. The movie doesn't need me to promote it. I'm reluctant to do anything that makes me sound more important to this process.
paras.zh: 在这一点上我可能应该保持谨慎。这部电影不需要我去宣传。我不愿意做任何让我在这个过程中显得更重要的事情。

paras.en: I am a small worker in the world of Hollywood. It is changing so rapidly that who knows what it's gonna be like tomorrow, six months from now.
paras.zh: 我是好莱坞世界里的一个小打工者。它变化如此之快，谁知道六个月后的明天会是什么样子。

paras.en: But again, I've got teenagers and I see how delighted they were by Backrooms, by Obsession. It feels like Gen X has been force-feeding them a lot of my childhood stories that we have gussied up, and they are clearly hungry for something new.
paras.zh: 但同样，我也有青少年，我看到他们对《Backrooms》和《Obsession》感到多么高兴。感觉 X 世代一直在向他们灌输很多我们编造出来的我童年的故事，而且他们显然渴望新的东西。

paras.en: On why he doesn’t write adaptations of his own comics:
paras.zh: 关于他为什么不改编自己的漫画：

paras.en: I've taken stabs at it in the past. Richard Price, the novelist, I once heard him say in response to “Why don't you adapt your own stuff more?” that adapting your own work is like being a dentist and giving yourself a root canal. Just because you can do it, doesn't mean you should. Let some other motherfucker handle that. I believe those were Mr. Price's words.
paras.zh: 我过去曾对此进行过尝试。小说家理查德·普莱斯（Richard Price），我曾经听到他在回答“你为什么不更多地改编你自己的东西？”时说。调整自己的工作就像是一名牙医，给自己做根管治疗。仅仅因为您可以做到，并不意味着您应该这样做。让其他混蛋来处理吧。我相信这是普莱斯先生的话。

paras.en: It's been constructive and a thrill to adapt other people, and I like getting to watch other people adapt me, but I've also been doing a lot of it for the last decade, where it feels like I've either been adapting or being adapted. I think that was part of the siren song of Roam. It’s time to break some new ground.
paras.zh: 适应别人是有建设性的，也是令人兴奋的，我喜欢看到别人适应我，但在过去的十年里我也做了很多这样的事情，感觉我要么一直在适应，要么正在被适应。我认为这是《漫游》中海妖之歌的一部分。是时候开辟一些新天地了。

paras.en: Denis says that to adapt something you love is to do violence to it. When I've been adapted, that has always been what I've told people. It is much more important for this to be good than to be faithful. He's a master of cinema, and cinema is rarely about people sitting in a room having dialog. How do you transliterate this to cinema? That's an alchemy that I don't understand. He's just unparalleled at that.
paras.zh: 丹尼斯说，改编你喜欢的东西就是对它施加暴力。当我适应之后，这一直是我告诉人们的。为此，行善比忠诚更重要。他是电影大师，而电影很少是人们坐在房间里进行对话。你如何将其音译为电影？那是我不懂的炼金术。他在这一点上是无与伦比的。

paras.en: On Lost and why writing for commercial breaks was a challenge:
paras.zh: 关于《迷失》以及为什么为商业广告写作是一个挑战：

paras.en: I love my prestige drama without commercials, but there was a degree of difficulty working on Lost and having a cliff-hanger five times an episode. To have that was such a challenge and so rewarding when you were able to pull it off. Can you write something where people are like, “OK, I'll just wet my pants. I cannot risk not coming back [before the break is over].”
paras.zh: 我喜欢我那部没有广告的著名电视剧，但拍摄《迷失》并每集有五次扣人心弦的情节是有一定难度的。这是一个很大的挑战，但当你能够完成它时，你会感到非常有成就感。你能写一些人们会说的东西，“好吧，我就尿裤子了。我不能冒险不回来（休息结束前）。”

articles.title: Earth’s Condition Is ‘Serious and Getting Worse’ as Climate Change Intensifies
articles.author: Brian Kahn

paras.en: The climate just got its annual checkup, and the results aren’t looking so hot.
paras.zh: 气候刚刚进行了年度检查，结果看起来并不那么热。

paras.en: “If Earth were a patient coming in for an annual physical, I would say its condition is serious and getting worse,” Oregon State University researcher Bill Ripple says.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈州立大学研究员比尔·瑞普尔说：“如果地球是一名每年体检的病人，我会说它的病情很严重，而且还在恶化。”

paras.en: Ripple is the lead author of a new paper chronicling the state of the climate, published on Wednesday in BioScience. The findings show that seven of the 16 planetary vital signs tracked by the researchers have never been in a more extreme state.
paras.zh: 瑞波是周三在《生物科学》杂志上发表的一篇记录气候状况的新论文的主要作者。研究结果显示，研究人员追踪的16个行星生命体征中有7个处于前所未有的极端状态。

paras.en: That includes the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, which is 50 percent higher than preindustrial levels due to burning fossil fuels, as well as symptoms of burning all that oil, coal, and gas. Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets have shrunk to record lows, while ocean heat has soared to record highs.
paras.zh: 其中包括由于燃烧化石燃料而导致大气中二氧化碳含量比工业化前水平高出 50%，以及燃烧所有石油、煤炭和天然气所带来的症状。格陵兰岛和南极冰盖已缩小至创纪录低点，而海洋热量则飙升至创纪录高点。

paras.en: Climate change has already quickened the pace of warming from about 0.05 degrees Celsius per decade from 1880 through 1970 to 0.36 degrees Celsius per decade since 2010, according to the analysis. While the global average temperature, including land, isn’t at a record extreme, that may change by the end of the year as El Niño strengthens. The natural climate pattern is characterized by a hotter-than-normal Pacific Ocean, but it also boosts global heat levels by pouring more energy into the atmosphere. This year’s El Niño is shaping up to be one for the record books.
paras.zh: 分析显示，气候变化已经使升温速度从1880年至1970年每十年约0.05摄氏度加快到2010年以来每十年约0.36摄氏度。尽管包括陆地在内的全球平均气温并未达到历史最高水平，但随着厄尔尼诺现象的加强，这种情况可能会在今年年底发生变化。自然气候模式的特点是太平洋比正常情况更热，但它也通过向大气中注入更多能量而提高了全球热量水平。今年的厄尔尼诺现象有望成为创纪录的现象。

paras.en: “A strong El Niño could temporarily push global temperatures even higher, while bringing additional heat and drought to vulnerable regions,” says Ripple. He adds that “El Niño is a natural phenomenon, but it's now occurring on top of a much warmer planet. That makes its impacts potentially more dangerous.”
paras.zh: “强烈的厄尔尼诺现象可能会暂时推高全球气温，同时给脆弱地区带来额外的高温和干旱，”里普尔说。他补充道，“厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然现象，但它现在发生在一个温暖得多的星球上。这使得它的影响可能更加危险。”

paras.en: Of particular concern are ecosystems such as coral reefs and tropical forests. The spread of ocean heat is likely to fuel a mass coral die-off, known as coral bleaching. With each successive wave of bleaching, reefs become less resilient. Corals are among the ecosystems most threatened by climate change; if the planet warms beyond 1.5 degrees Celsius, most of the world’s coral will be unlikely to survive.
paras.zh: 特别值得关注的是珊瑚礁和热带森林等生态系统。海洋热量的传播可能会加剧珊瑚的大规模死亡，即所谓的珊瑚白化。随着每一次连续的白化浪潮，珊瑚礁的弹性都会减弱。珊瑚是受气候变化威胁最严重的生态系统之一；如果地球变暖超过 1.5 摄氏度，世界上大部分珊瑚将无法生存。

paras.en: Tropical forests also face pressure from El Niño. This is especially true of the Amazon, which tends to see dry weather during this climate pattern. The timing couldn’t be more dire: The region, dubbed “the world’s lungs,” is already under intense pressure from logging and mining interests and the possible return of a right-wing government in Brazil that prioritizes extraction and land clearing over conservation.
paras.zh: 热带森林也面临着厄尔尼诺现象的压力。亚马逊地区尤其如此，在这种气候模式下，亚马逊地区往往会出现干燥的天气。这个时机再糟糕不过了：这个被称为“世界之肺”的地区已经面临着伐木和采矿业利益以及巴西右翼政府可能回归的巨大压力，该政府优先考虑开采和土地清理而不是保护。

paras.en: The new report also warns that the Amazon is among the ecosystems at risk of crossing a tipping point—that is, reaching a threshold where it shifts from a tropical rainforest into something more resembling savanna. It’s highly unlikely that crossing that tipping point is imminent, let alone something that will happen this year. But this year’s blast of El Niño–influenced weather will edge it closer.
paras.zh: 新报告还警告说，亚马逊生态系统有可能跨越临界点，即达到从热带雨林转变为更像稀树草原的临界点。跨越这个临界点的可能性极小，更不用说今年发生的事情了。但今年受厄尔尼诺现象影响的天气将使这一现象更加接近。

paras.en: “Warming, drought, and deforestation could push the Amazon toward widespread forest degradation,” Ripple says. “My concern is that these changes could interact, making them increasingly difficult to stop.”
paras.zh: “气候变暖、干旱和森林砍伐可能会导致亚马逊地区森林大面积退化，”里普尔说。 “我担心的是，这些变化可能会相互作用，使它们变得越来越难以阻止。”

paras.en: The report is an avalanche of bad news for the climate, though it does note that carbon-free forms of energy are playing a bigger role in the power grid. The report calls it a sign we’re in the “Age of Electricity.” Despite that, annual greenhouse gas emissions are at record highs. In other words, the world is still smoking a pack a day, even at the risk of losing a lung.
paras.zh: 该报告对气候来说是一大堆坏消息，尽管它确实指出无碳能源在电网中发挥着更大的作用。报告称这是我们正处于“电力时代”的标志。尽管如此，每年的温室气体排放量仍创下历史新高。换句话说，即使冒着失去肺的风险，世界上仍然每天吸一包烟。

paras.en: “There are some encouraging signs, especially the growth of renewable energy, but they aren't yet enough to reverse the overall deterioration,” Ripple says. “The climate emergency is not something waiting for us in the future. We are already living through it.”
paras.zh: “有一些令人鼓舞的迹象，特别是可再生能源的增长，但它们还不足以扭转整体恶化的趋势，”里普尔说。 “气候紧急情况不是未来等待我们的事情。我们已经在经历它了。”

articles.title: Look: Mattel unveils 'Titanic'-inspired Celine Dion Barbie doll

paras.en: Oct. 14 (UPI) -- Mattel has unveiled a new Barbie Signature doll inspired by Grammy-winning singer Celine Dion.
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日（合众国际社）——美泰推出了一款全新芭比签名娃娃，其灵感源自格莱美获奖歌手席琳·迪翁。

paras.en: The company announced pre-orders for the new doll Wednesday, with the $60 product expected to ship on or before Dec. 31.
paras.zh: 该公司周三宣布了新娃娃的预订单，售价 60 美元的产品预计将于 12 月 31 日或之前发货。

paras.en: The Barbie Signature Celine Dion doll is inspired by the look the singer wore to perform the Titanic hit "My Heart Will Go On" at the 1998 Oscar Awards.
paras.zh: 芭比标志性席琳迪翁娃娃的灵感源自这位歌手在 1998 年奥斯卡颁奖典礼上表演泰坦尼克号热门歌曲《My Heart Will Go On》时的造型。

paras.en: Dion sports a navy blue turtleneck dress with a train and a replica of the "Heart of the Ocean" necklace from the blockbuster film.
paras.zh: 迪翁身穿海军蓝色高领连衣裙，饰有裾裾和大片中“海洋之心”项链的复制品。

paras.en: "This doll doesn't just strike a pose -- she hits the high note. Dressed in confidence, drama, and unmistakable star power, the Celine Dion Barbie doll pays tribute to one of the world's most beloved icons, whose music, style, and passion will undoubtedly go on and on," the package reads.
paras.zh: 包装上写道：“这个芭比娃娃不仅仅是摆出一个姿势，而是达到了高调。席琳迪翁芭比娃娃充满自信、戏剧性和明显的明星力量，向世界上最受欢迎的偶像之一致敬，她的音乐、风格和激情无疑将永垂不朽。”

paras.en: The real-life Dion, 58, last released the album Courage in 2019. She shared in 2022 that she was diagnosed with a rare neurological disorder called stiff person syndrome.
paras.zh: 现实生活中的迪翁现年 58 岁，上一次发行专辑《勇气》是在 2019 年。她在 2022 年分享说，她被诊断出患有一种罕见的神经系统疾病，称为僵人综合症。

articles.title: Watch: Giant inflatable pumpkin rolls down North Carolina road

paras.en: Oct. 14 (UPI) -- A giant inflatable pumpkin was swept away from a North Carolina farm by the wind and went traveling down the street before being secured by an Uber driver.
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日（UPI）——一个巨大的充气南瓜被风从北卡罗来纳州的一个农场吹走，沿着街道行驶，然后被 Uber 司机保护。

paras.en: Phillips Farms of Cary said in an Instagram post that the giant pumpkin, part of the décor for the business' annual Pumpkinfest event, broke loose from its tethers on Sunday and went rolling down the nearby road.
paras.zh: 卡里菲利普斯农场 (Phillips Farms of Cary) 在 Instagram 上发帖称，作为该公司年度南瓜节活动装饰的一部分的巨型南瓜于周日从绳索上挣脱，沿着附近的道路滚落。

paras.en: The pumpkin's adventure came to a stop thanks to the efforts of a nearby Uber driver and other helpful witnesses.
paras.zh: 由于附近的优步司机和其他目击者的努力，南瓜的冒险终于结束了。

paras.en: The farm said the inflatable decoration was safely returned to its place at Pumpkinfest.
paras.zh: 该农场表示，充气​​装饰品已安全返回南瓜节的原处。

articles.title: Wife's advice leads N.C. man to $250,000 lottery prize

paras.en: Oct. 14 (UPI) -- A North Carolina Education Lottery player said he might not have won a $250,000 Powerball prize if not for some advice from his wife.
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日（UPI）——北卡罗来纳州的一名教育彩票玩家表示，如果没有妻子的建议，他可能不会赢得 25 万美元的强力球奖金。

paras.en: High Shoals resident James Mosley told lottery officials he had been considering changing his lottery numbers prior to the Sept. 23 Powerball drawing.
paras.zh: 海肖尔斯 (High Shoals) 居民詹姆斯·莫斯利 (James Mosley) 告诉彩票官员，他一直在考虑在 9 月 23 日强力球抽奖之前更改他的彩票号码。

paras.en: "I"ve played the same numbers for years and three weeks ago I thought about stopping but my wife convinced me not to," he said.
paras.zh: “我多年来一直玩同样的号码，三周前我想过停止，但我的妻子说服我不要这样做，”他说。

paras.en: Mosley stuck to his usual numbers, a combination of family birthdays, when he bought his ticket from Will's Food Stores on Dallas High Shoals Highway in Dallas, N.C.
paras.zh: 莫斯利在北卡罗来纳州达拉斯市达拉斯海肖尔斯高速公路上的威尔食品店买票时，遵循了他通常的数字，即家庭生日的组合。

paras.en: He ended up matching four white balls and the red Powerball to win a $50,000 prize that was quintupled to $250,000 when the 5X multiplier hit.
paras.zh: 他最终匹配了四个白球和一个红色强力球，赢得了 50,000 美元的奖金，当 5 倍乘数命中时，奖金翻了五倍，达到 250,000 美元。

paras.en: "I called my wife to tell her and she didn't believe it," Mosley said. "She said, 'Don't be lying to me.'"
paras.zh: “我打电话给我的妻子告诉她，但她不相信，”莫斯利说。 “她说，‘别对我撒谎。’”

paras.en: Mosley said some of his winnings will go toward remodeling his home.
paras.zh: 莫斯利表示，他的部分奖金将用于改造他的房屋。

articles.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle’s Rise and Fall as Trump’s Ambassador to Greece
articles.author: Elisabeth Bumiller

paras.en: Kimberly Guilfoyle, the U.S. ambassador to Greece until she was effectively fired on live television on Tuesday when the new White House press secretary said that President Trump had asked for her resignation, was at one point engaged to Donald Trump Jr., the president’s eldest son. The couple owned a $9.7 million home in Florida, appeared at Trump rallies together and sent each other adoring posts on Instagram.
paras.zh: 美国驻希腊大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔(Kimberly Guilfoyle)曾与总统的长子小唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump Jr.)订婚，直到周二新任白宫新闻秘书在电视直播中表示特朗普总统要求她辞职，她才被解雇。这对夫妇在佛罗里达州拥有价值 970 万美元的房屋，一起出席特朗普集会，并在 Instagram 上互相发送爱慕的帖子。

paras.en: “Falling in love with my fiancé more and more every day,” Ms. Guilfoyle posted on Instagram on Valentine’s Day 2022. “@donaldjtrumpjr, you’re my best friend, my support system and my forever guy.”
paras.zh: “我每天都越来越爱我的未婚夫，”吉尔福伊尔女士于 2022 年情人节在 Instagram 上发帖称。“@donaldjtrumpjr，你是我最好的朋友、我的支持系统和我永远的伙伴。”

paras.en: “Thanks for always being there no matter what the haters are throwing our way,” he posted in 2024. “I love you.”
paras.zh: 他在 2024 年发帖称：“无论仇恨者如何攻击我们，感谢你始终陪伴在我们身边。我爱你。”

paras.en: Today, the junior Mr. Trump is married to a Florida socialite and model. And Ms. Guilfoyle, who was nominated as ambassador to Greece by the president soon after her engagement to his son was broken off two years ago, is out of a job after a series of damning reports in The Wall Street Journal, including that she asked a Republican donor to pay off $100,000 on her American Express credit card just before her Senate confirmation hearing in July 2025.
paras.zh: 如今，小特朗普先生与佛罗里达州的一位社交名流兼模特结婚了。吉尔福伊尔女士两年前与儿子解除婚约后不久，就被总统任命为驻希腊大使。在《华尔街日报》发表一系列谴责性报道后，吉尔福伊尔女士被解雇，其中包括在 2025 年 7 月参议院确认听证会之前，她要求一位共和党捐助者用她的美国运通信用卡还清 10 万美元。

paras.en: The rise and fall of Ms. Guilfoyle, 57, was not a surprise at the White House, where many saw her as a flamboyant party girl with questionable judgment.
paras.zh: 57 岁的吉尔福伊尔女士的起起落落在白宫并不令人意外，许多人认为她是一位浮夸的派对女郎，判断力值得怀疑。

paras.en: Her supporters said she was in fact a substantive person underneath the glitz. Ms. Guilfoyle, a former Fox News host and a former prosecutor in San Francisco and Los Angeles, was once married to Gavin Newsom, who would go on to become governor of California and one of the Democratic Party’s most outspoken critics of Mr. Trump.
paras.zh: 她的支持者表示，她在浮华之下实际上是一个实事求是的人。吉尔福伊尔曾担任福克斯新闻主持人、旧金山和洛杉矶检察官，曾与加文·纽瑟姆 (Gavin Newsom) 结婚，后者后来成为加利福尼亚州州长，也是民主党最直言不讳的特朗普批评者之一。

articles.title: Rolling Stones Announce Release Date For ‘Foreign Tongues’ Deluxe Edition, ‘Loose Lips,’ Featuring Five Additional Songs
articles.author: Gil Kaufman

paras.en: The Rolling Stones are not done wagging their Foreign Tongues. On Wednesday morning (Oct. 14), the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame group announced that a deluxe edition of their 25th album will get a refresh just five months after its July release.
paras.zh: 滚石乐队的外语还没有结束。周三上午（10 月 14 日），摇滚名人堂乐队宣布，他们的第 25 张专辑的豪华版将在 7 月发行仅五个月后进行更新。

paras.en: The update, dubbed Foreign Tongues, Loose Lips, is due out on Nov. 27 from Capitol Records and it will feature five new songs from the sessions for the LP that has already spawned the singles “Rough and Twisted,” “In the Stars,” “Jealous Lover” and “Mr. Charm.”
paras.zh: 这次更新被称为“Foreign Tongues, Loose Lips”，将于 11 月 27 日由 Capitol Records 发行，其中收录了 LP 唱片中的五首新歌，这些唱片已经催生了单曲“Rough and Twisted”、“In the Stars”、“Jealous Lover”和“Mr. Charm”。

paras.en: It will feature the previously issued iTunes bonus track “Bad Luck Hideaway,” a duet between singer Mick Jagger and guitarist Keith Richards that was recently made available across other digital platforms as the B-side the latest streaming single “Mr. Charm.” Also included will be “Who You Callin’ Crazy,” featuring British jazz saxophonist Courtney Pine, which will be released digitally on Friday (Oct. 16).
paras.zh: 它将收录之前发行的 iTunes 附赠歌曲《Bad Luck Hideaway》，这是歌手米克·贾格尔 (Mick Jagger) 和吉他手基思·理查兹 (Keith Richards) 之间的二重唱，最近在其他数字平台上作为最新流媒体单曲《Mr. Charm》的 B 面发布。另外还有由英国爵士萨克斯管演奏家考特尼·派恩 (Courtney Pine) 演唱的《Who You Callin’ Crazy》，该歌曲将于周五（10 月 16 日）以数字形式发行。

paras.en: The other songs include “Where There’s a Will,” “Human Tide,” and “She Still Comes Around,” none of which have been previously available. All five extra songs will be available in a standalone vinyl edition, as well as in a deluxe 2CD edition and across all digital formats. The vinyl edition — which will come on heavyweight red vinyl — will feature all five Loose Lips songs on LP, alongside the original Foreign Tongues album.
paras.zh: 其他歌曲包括《Where There’s a Will》、《Human Tide》和《She Still Comes around》，这些歌曲之前都没有发行过。所有五首额外歌曲均将以独立黑胶唱片版本以及豪华 2CD 版本和所有数字格式提供。黑胶唱片版本将采用重量级的红色黑胶唱片，将收录 LP 中所有五首 Loose Lips 歌曲，以及原版《Foreign Tongues》专辑。

paras.en: Foreign Tongues was produced by Andrew Watt, who also collaborated on with the veteran group on their Grammy-winning 2023 LP Hackney Diamonds and it featured contributions from Steve Winwood, the Cure’s Robert Smith, Paul McCartney, Bruno Mars, Red Hot Chili Peppers drummer Chad Smith, Stones drummer Steve Jordan and bassist Darryl Jones.
paras.zh: 《Foreign Tongues》由 Andrew Watt 制作，他还与这支老牌乐队合作制作了 2023 年格莱美获奖唱片《Hackney Diamonds》，其中包括 Steve Winwood、The Cure 乐队的 Robert Smith、Paul McCartney、Bruno Mars、Red Hot Chili Peppers 鼓手 Chad Smith、Stones 鼓手 Steve Jordan 和贝斯手 Darryl Jones。

articles.title: Jason Kelce & Travis Kelce Discuss: Has Taylor Swift ‘Ever Made a Halloween Song?’
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: It’s said that Taylor Swift has a song for every occasion, but on the latest installment of New Heights, Jason Kelce and Travis Kelce wondered whether that includes Halloween.
paras.zh: 据说泰勒·斯威夫特有一首适合各种场合的歌曲，但在最新一期的《新高度》中，杰森·凯尔斯和特拉维斯·凯尔斯想知道这是否包括万圣节。

paras.en: On the podcast episode posted Wednesday (Oct. 14), the brothers first discussed the best spooky-season songs in general, shouting out “Monster Mash” and the Ghostbusters theme song. The retired Philadelphia Eagles center then questioned, “Has Taylor ever made a Halloween song?”
paras.zh: 在周三（10 月 14 日）发布的播客节目中，兄弟俩首先讨论了一般最佳的恐怖季节歌曲，大声喊出“Monster Mash”和《捉鬼敢死队》主题曲。这位退役的费城老鹰队中锋随后问道：“泰勒曾经创作过万圣节歌曲吗？”

paras.en: “Has she ever ventured into the scary territory, Travis?” he continued to his little brother, who replied, “I don’t believe so, Jason.”
paras.zh: “特拉维斯，她有没有冒险进入过可怕的领域？”他继续对弟弟说：“我不这么认为，杰森。”

paras.en: Is he correct? More or less. The 14-time Grammy-winning pop star hasn’t ever explicitly released a song for the trick-or-treating holiday, but in the elder Kelce’s words, she has arguably delved into “scary territory” with spooky tracks such as “Haunted” from 2010’s Speak Now, “I Know Places” and “Wonderland” on 1989, or “Who’s Afraid of Little Old Me?” on 2024’s The Tortured Poets Department. For the “Look What You Made Me Do” music video in 2017, she went full zombie Taylor.
paras.zh: 他说得对吗？或多或少。这位14次获得格莱美奖的流行歌星还没有明确地为这个“不给糖就捣蛋”的节日发行过一首歌曲，但用老凯尔斯的话来说，她可以说已经深入到了“可怕的领域”，比如2010年的《Speak Now》中的《Haunted》、1989年的《I Know Places》和《Wonderland》，或者《谁害怕小老我？》 2024 年的《受折磨的诗人部》。在 2017 年的“Look What You Made Me Do”音乐录影带中，她扮演了十足的僵尸泰勒。

paras.en: She’s only referenced Halloween itself once, on the devastating 2012 charity song “Ronan.” She sings on the track: “And it’s about to be Halloween/ You could be anything you wanted if you were still here.”
paras.zh: 她只在 2012 年毁灭性的慈善歌曲“Ronan”中提到过一次万圣节本身。她在歌曲中唱到：“万圣节即将来临/如果你还在这里，你可以成为任何你想要的人。”

paras.en: Before moving on with the show, Jason also put forth his pick for Swift’s most fitting album for this time of year. “Folklore was kind of her ‘in the woods’ [album],” he said of her woodsy folk-pop pandemic LP, which topped the Billboard 200 and won album of the year at the Grammys.
paras.zh: 在继续演出之前，杰森还提出了他为斯威夫特一年中这个时候最合适的专辑的选择。 “Folklore 有点像她的‘in the woods’[专辑]，”他在谈到她的木质民谣流行唱片时说道，这张唱片在 Billboard 200 上名列前茅，并在格莱美奖上赢得了年度专辑奖。

paras.en: The episode comes as Swift’s album The Life of a Showgirl spends its 14th week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, propelled back to the top spot by the recent release of four new bonus tracks. One of them, “Patient Zero” — the music video for which is also a bit spooky — notched the singer her 16th career Billboard Hot 100 No. 1.
paras.zh: 这一集发布之际，斯威夫特的专辑《The Life of a Showgirl》已连续第 14 周位居 Billboard 200 排行榜第一名，并因最近发行的四首新附赠曲目而重回榜首。其中一首《零号病人》（其音乐录影带也有点诡异）让这位歌手第 16 次荣登公告牌百强单曲榜第一名。

paras.en: Watch the full new episode of New Heights above.
paras.zh: 观看上面的《新高度》的完整新剧集。

articles.title: Republic Records CEO Jim Roppo to Be Named COO at Warner Records: Sources
articles.author: Kristin Robinson

paras.en: Jim Roppo, chairman and CEO of Republic Records, has exited the company and is headed to Warner Records, multiple sources tell Billboard. At Warner Records, he’ll take on the role of COO, reporting to chairman/CEO Aaron Bay-Schuck.
paras.zh: 多位消息人士告诉 Billboard，共和唱片公司董事长兼首席执行官吉姆·罗波 (Jim Roppo) 已退出公司，前往华纳唱片公司。在华纳唱片公司，他将担任首席运营官，向董事长兼首席执行官亚伦·贝-舒克汇报。

paras.en: A nearly 30-year veteran of Universal Music Group (UMG), the parent company of Republic Records, Roppo has held roles in sales, marketing and commerce at Island Def Jam Music Group (IDJ) and Republic before being promoted to the Republic executive team. He moved from IDJ to Republic in 2012, and in 2018, he was promoted from head of marketing and commerce to executive vp/general manager at Republic, before being upped to co-president of the label in 2021. He then became president/COO of the reorganized REPUBLIC in 2024, before being named chairman/CEO of Republic Records.
paras.zh: Roppo 是 Republic Records 母公司环球音乐集团 (UMG) 近 30 年的资深人士，在晋升为 Republic 执行团队之前，曾在 Island Def Jam Music Group (IDJ) 和 Republic 担任销售、营销和商务职务。 2012 年，他从 IDJ 跳槽到 Republic，2018 年，他从营销和商务主管晋升为 Republic 的执行副总裁/总经理，并于 2021 年晋升为该厂牌的联席总裁。随后，他于 2024 年成为重组后的 REPUBLIC 的总裁/首席运营官，之后被任命为 Republic Records 的董事长/首席执行官。

paras.en: Warner Records did not respond to Billboard‘s request for comment.
paras.zh: 华纳唱片没有回应公告牌的置评请求。

paras.en: During his time at UMG, Roppo was at the forefront of campaigns for Drake, The Weeknd, Ariana Grande, Post Malone, James Bay, Julia Michaels, Justin Bieber, Kanye West, Rihanna and more. According to a 2018 press release about Roppo, the executive “proudly claims to have seen every iteration of the industry’s format evolution, kicking off his career at Los Angeles’s famed Aron’s Records during 1988 when vinyl gave way to CDs.”
paras.zh: 在 UMG 任职期间，Roppo 一直处于 Drake、The Weeknd、Ariana Grande、Post Malone、James Bay、Julia Michaels、Justin Bieber、Kanye West、Rihanna 等品牌宣传活动的最前沿。根据 2018 年关于 Roppo 的新闻稿，这位高管“自豪地声称自己见证了行业格式演变的每一次迭代，并在 1988 年黑胶唱片被 CD 取代时在洛杉矶著名的 Aron’s Records 开启了他的职业生涯。”

paras.en: News of Roppo’s new Warner Records gig comes after a shake-up in leadership at the Warner Music Group over the last few months. Warner Records’ previous COO, Tom Corson, who also served as co-chairman, was promoted to Warner Music Group’s overall COO, succeeding Armin Zerza in the role. Additionally, WMG’s publishing arm, Warner Chappell, announced the exit of COO/co-chair Carianne Marshall in September. After seven years in her position, a company source told Billboard that Marshall’s departure was part of a WMG-wide shift away from having co-chairs lead their divisions.
paras.zh: 过去几个月，华纳音乐集团的领导层发生了变动，六宝在华纳唱片公司新演出的消息传出。华纳唱片公司前任首席运营官兼联合董事长汤姆·科森 (Tom Corson) 晋升为华纳音乐集团的整体首席运营官，接替阿明·泽尔扎 (Armin Zerza)。此外，WMG 的出版部门 Warner Chappell 于 9 月宣布首席运营官兼联合主席 Carianne Marshall 离职。在任职七年后，一位公司消息人士告诉 Billboard，Marshall 的离职是 WMG 范围内不再由联合主席领导其部门的转变的一部分。

paras.en: UMG is also experiencing its own set of personnel changes. On Wednesday (Oct. 14), several top company executives exited the company as it completed its 2024 restructure plan. Among those affected were Ben Mortimer, president of Polydor Records in the U.K.; Tunji Balogun, chairman/CEO of Def Jam Recordings; Nicole Wyskoarko, president, head of urban a&r at Interscope Geffen A&M; and Sam Riback, co-president and head of pop/rock A&R at Interscope Geffen A&M. On Tuesday (Oct. 13), Rebecca Allen, UMG U.K.’s chief artist and strategy officer, announced in an internal memo that she was exiting the company after 27 years.
paras.zh: UMG 也正在经历一系列人事变动。周三（10 月 14 日），随着公司完成 2024 年重组计划，多名公司高管退出。受影响的人包括英国宝丽多唱片公司总裁本·莫蒂默 (Ben Mortimer)； Tunji Balogun，Def Jam Recordings 董事长兼首席执行官； Nicole Wyskoarko，Interscope Geffen A&M 总裁兼城市 A&R 主管； Sam Riback，Interscope Geffen A&M 联合总裁兼流行/摇滚 A&R 负责人。周二（10 月 13 日），UMG 英国首席艺术家兼战略官丽贝卡·艾伦 (Rebecca Allen) 在一份内部备忘录中宣布，她将在工作 27 年后退出公司。

articles.title: Netflix’s ‘Untold’ to Tackle Daejon Love (Exclusive)
articles.author: Anthony Maglio

paras.en: If only Daejon Love worked as hard at running routes as he did scamming women, maybe he would have actually made the league. Probably not though — and if he had, we wouldn’t have a potential all-time-great Untold installment to look forward to.
paras.zh: 如果大田·洛夫（Daejon Love）像他骗女人一样努力跑路线，也许他真的可以进入联盟。但可能不会——如果他这么做了，我们就不会再期待一部有史以来最伟大的《不为人知》了。

paras.en: The next documentary in Netflix‘s excellent Untold film series will zone in on Love, who scammed women out of money while posing as a wideout with the San Francisco 49ers, The Hollywood Reporter has learned exclusively. Untold: Wide Deceiver (good one) will be “told firsthand from those affected by the scam,” we’re untold, unpacking “the viral nickname and the far darker story it exposed.”
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》独家获悉，Netflix 出色的《不为人知》系列电影中的下一部纪录片将聚焦 Love，他冒充旧金山 49 人队的外线球员骗取女性金钱。不为人知：广泛的欺骗者（好一个）将“从那些受骗局影响的人那里得到第一手资料”，我们不为人知，解开“这个病毒式的昵称和它所揭露的更加黑暗的故事”。

paras.en: On Aug. 24, 2026, Love was arrested for wire fraud after a group of women, his alleged victims, came forward to law enforcement. Prior to Love’s arrest, numerous social media videos, photos and DMs sent from Love to women and businesses touting his status as a Niners receiver went viral, including one of Love running routes and catching balls on a beach with a 49ers helmet on. (He pretty much always had that helmet with him.)
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月 24 日，一群据称是洛夫受害者的女性向执法部门挺身而出，洛夫因电信诈骗罪被捕。在乐福被捕之前，乐福向女性和企业发送的许多社交媒体视频、照片和私信，宣传他作为九人队接球手的身份，在网上疯传，其中包括乐福跑步路线和戴着 49 人队头盔在海滩上接球的路线之一。 （他几乎总是带着那个头盔。）

paras.en: Another popular post was a photo of a San Francisco jersey #7 (Love’s fake number) cake he said the Niners sent him on his birthday. (San Francisco has a real wide receiver who wears #7: De’Zhaun Stribling changed his jersey number from 15 in the preseason, when Love’s scamming made headlines, to 7 in the regular season. It was a good play as sales of the 49ers #7 jersey began to take off right around the same time.)
paras.zh: 另一篇受欢迎的帖子是一张旧金山球衣#7（乐福的假号码）蛋糕的照片，他说九人队在他生日那天送给他。 （旧金山有一位真正穿着 7 号球衣的外接手：德扎恩·斯特里布林 (De’Zhaun Stribling) 将他的球衣号码从季前赛时的 15 号（当乐福的诈骗成为头条新闻时）改为常规赛中的 7 号。这是一个很好的表现，因为 49 人队的 7 号球衣的销量几乎在同一时间开始起飞。）

paras.en: Love’s DMs to businesses would often ask for outlandish treatment including free goods and services and for the company to provide a personal security detail.
paras.zh: 洛夫给企业发的私信经常会要求公司提供一些奇怪的待遇，包括免费商品和服务，以及要求公司提供个人安保人员。

paras.en: The Love Untold does not yet have a director or a participant list, but a source close to production says it will focus on the women and their stories. (So, probably no Daejon himself.)
paras.zh: 《不为人知的爱》尚未确定导演或参与者名单，但一位接近制作的消息人士表示，该片将重点关注女性和她们的故事。 （所以，可能不是大田本人。）

paras.en: Untold: Wide Deceiver hails from Propagate and Stardust Frames in association with North of Now and The Cut. Ben Silverman, Howard T. Owens, Maclain Way, Chapman Way, Ryan Duffy, Isabel San Vargas, Aaron Ginsburg, William Green, Andrew Renzi and Nick Boak are executive producers.
paras.zh: Untold: Wide Deceiver 出自 Propagate 和 Stardust Frames，与 North of Now 和 The Cut 合作。本·西尔弗曼、霍华德·T·欧文斯、麦克林·威、查普曼·威、瑞安·达菲、伊莎贝尔·圣·瓦尔加斯、亚伦·金斯伯格、威廉·格林、安德鲁·伦齐和尼克·博克担任执行制片人。
