articles.title: How mini-constellations could more quickly bring new tech to Europe, and to orbit
articles.author: Space Inventor

paras.en: When the European thermal-imagery company constellr began working with Space Inventor on its next generation of satellites, some of the most important details of the spacecraft had yet to be finalized.
paras.zh: 当欧洲热成像公司 constellr 开始与 Space Inventor 合作开发下一代卫星时，航天器的一些最重要的细节尚未最终确定。

paras.en: The Munich-based firm knew it wanted its HiVE, or High-precision Versatile Ecosphere, constellation to measure temperatures from space with the precision needed for agricultural applications and urban planning. But the requirements for the payload’s size, weight and power were still evolving.
paras.zh: 这家总部位于慕尼黑的公司知道它希望其 HiVE（高精度多功能生态圈）星座能够以农业应用和城市规划所需的精度从太空测量温度。但对有效载荷的尺寸、重量和功率的要求仍在不断变化。

paras.en: That presented what can be a familiar tradeoff in the small satellite community. Work on satellite buses often begins before every detail of a payload has been finalized. If engineers lock in the spacecraft design too early, the payload may need to conform to the bus. If the payload needs new iterations, the bus may require an extensive – and expensive – redesign.
paras.zh: 这在小型卫星领域是一种常见的权衡。卫星总线的工作通常在有效载荷的每个细节最终确定之前就开始了。如果工程师过早锁定航天器设计，有效载荷可能需要符合总线。如果有效负载需要新的迭代，总线可能需要进行广泛且昂贵的重新设计。

paras.en: But Space Inventor, the Danish manufacturer, took a different approach. Instead of demanding the payload fit a standardized satellite bus, it adapted its BIG CAT 600 bus as constellr’s requirements evolved.
paras.zh: 但丹麦制造商 Space Inventor 采取了不同的方法。它没有要求有效载荷适合标准化卫星总线，而是随着 constellr 要求的变化调整了 BIG CAT 600 总线。

paras.en: “We needed a platform built around the payload, not the other way around,” said Marius Bierdel, constellr’s co-founder and vice president of program management. “Space Inventor’s system-level approach means our thermal sensors perform exactly as designed once they’re in orbit.”
paras.zh: constellr 联合创始人兼项目管理副总裁 Marius Bierdel 表示：“我们需要一个围绕有效载荷构建的平台，而不是相反。” “Space Inventor 的系统级方法意味着我们的热传感器一旦进入轨道，就会完全按照设计运行。”

paras.en: That ability to repeatedly modify the spacecraft is the centerpiece of Space Inventor’s pitch to operators who need to build payload-centric mini-constellations. Unlike megaconstellations numbering in the hundreds or thousands, mini-constellations typically range from a few satellites to a few dozen and can target specific geographies or niche capabilities.
paras.zh: 反复修改航天器的能力是 Space Inventor 向需要建造以有效载荷为中心的迷你星座的运营商推销的核心内容。与数百或数千个巨型星座不同，迷你星座通常从几颗到几十颗卫星不等，可以针对特定的地理位置或利基功能。

paras.en: “These are high state-of-the-art payloads that often are still in development when we start building the bus,” said Jan Smolders, the chief commercial officer at Space Inventor. As one batch is being built, he said, Space Inventor is already applying lessons learned to the design of the next.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 首席商务官简·斯莫尔德斯 (Jan Smolders) 表示：“这些都是最先进的有效载荷，当我们开始建造巴士时，这些有效载荷通常仍在开发中。”他说，随着一批产品的制造，Space Inventor 已经将吸取的经验教训应用于下一批产品的设计中。

paras.en: “The standardization is in the satellite modules, not in the bus,” he added.
paras.zh: “标准化在于卫星模块，而不是总线，”他补充道。

paras.en: Mini-constellations occupy a middle ground in the satellite market.
paras.zh: 迷你星座在卫星市场中占据中间地位。

paras.en: Their smaller scale offers flexibility. Operators may want to incorporate lessons from the first satellites into later iterations. Or, as technology advances, they may want to upgrade the instruments.
paras.zh: 它们较小的规模提供了灵活性。运营商可能希望将第一批卫星的经验教训纳入以后的迭代中。或者，随着技术的进步，他们可能想要升级仪器。

paras.en: Space Inventor designed its BIG CAT family of services for exactly those moments.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 正是为了这些时刻而设计了 BIG CAT 系列服务。

paras.en: The BIG CAT 100, 300 and 600 platforms are sized for different spacecraft classes, but each is configurable rather than fixed. That means if a mission suddenly needs more power, improved pointing performance or a new communications capability, Space Inventor can often accommodate these changes by swapping out bus modules, rather than redesigning a spacecraft from scratch.
paras.zh: BIG CAT 100、300 和 600 平台的尺寸适合不同的航天器类别，但每个平台都是可配置的而不是固定的。这意味着，如果任务突然需要更多功率、改进的指向性能或新的通信能力，Space Inventor 通常可以通过更换总线模块来适应这些变化，而不是从头开始重新设计航天器。

paras.en: That philosophy of iteration is especially helpful in rapidly changing fields such as thermal imaging, space domain awareness and in-orbit servicing. It also means Space Inventor can avoid locking in a design around requirements developed years before launch.
paras.zh: 这种迭代理念对于快速变化的领域尤其有用，例如热成像、空间域感知和在轨服务。这也意味着 Space Inventor 可以避免围绕发射前几年制定的要求锁定设计。

paras.en: Space Inventor pairs its modular approach with another strategy: making most of its components itself.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 将其模块化方法与另一种策略相结合：自行制造大部分组件。

paras.en: The company manufactures nearly all of its components – with the exception of propulsion – in house at its factory in Aalborg, Denmark, offering more control over its design and less exposure to the volatility of the supply chain.
paras.zh: 该公司几乎所有部件（推进装置除外）均在其位于丹麦奥尔堡的工厂内部生产，从而对其设计提供了更多控制权，并减少了供应链波动的影响。

paras.en: If a new requirement calls for a modified PCB, Space Inventor can update the design, machine a revised housing, assemble the new component and test the change, all under the same roof. Such a change ordered from an outside supplier might take about six weeks. Space Inventor can make the same change in roughly one week, Smolders said.
paras.zh: 如果新要求需要修改 PCB，Space Inventor 可以更新设计、加工修改后的外壳、组装新组件并测试更改，所有这些都在同一屋檐下进行。从外部供应商处订购的此类变更可能需要大约六周的时间。斯莫尔德斯说，Space Inventor 可以在大约一周内做出同样的改变。

paras.en: “Because we make everything in house, we can easily add new modules to facilitate changing requirements, very fast,” he said.
paras.zh: “因为所有东西都是我们内部制造的，所以我们可以非常快速地轻松添加新模块，以适应不断变化的需求，”他说。

paras.en: This gives Space Inventor tighter quality control and reduces exposure to supply chain shortages.
paras.zh: 这使得 Space Inventor 能够进行更严格的质量控制，并减少供应链短缺的风险。

paras.en: Space Inventor also maintains a stock of its components, allowing it to offer next-day shipping. That reduces the risk that a small component or a supplier delay holds up the production of a spacecraft.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 还保留其组件库存，使其能够提供次日发货。这降低了因小部件或供应商延误而阻碍航天器生产的风险。

paras.en: For mini-constellation operators, this model makes it easier to change later satellites based on what they’ve learned from earlier ones.
paras.zh: 对于迷你星座运营商来说，这种模型可以更轻松地根据从早期卫星中学到的知识来更换后来的卫星。

paras.en: The same configurable approach that Space Inventor uses for commercial missions also underpins its offerings for the defense community.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 用于商业任务的相同可配置方法也支撑了其为国防界提供的产品。

paras.en: Rather than only offering military customers a satellite bus, the company can pair a BIG CAT platform with a mission-specific payload to provide a turnkey system.
paras.zh: 该公司不仅可以为军事客户提供卫星总线，还可以将 BIG CAT 平台与特定任务的有效载荷配对，以提供交钥匙系统。

paras.en: Space Inventor’s defense-specific Apex Predator series includes BC Lynx and BC Leopard, two turnkey surveillance solutions built on its BIG CAT platform.
paras.zh: Space Inventor 的国防专用 Apex Predator 系列包括 BC Lynx 和 BC Leopard，这是两种基于其 BIG CAT 平台构建的交钥匙监控解决方案。

paras.en: Lynx is designed to detect radio-frequency emissions, geolocate their source and identify activity that may warrant further investigation. Leopard can then be tasked with capturing high-resolution optical or thermal imagery in the same area.
paras.zh: Lynx 旨在检测射频发射、定位其来源并识别可能需要进一步调查的活动。然后 Leopard 的任务是在同一区域捕获高分辨率光学或热图像。

paras.en: The approach follows a “tip-and-cue” model, with one sensor identifying a potential target and then directing another sensor to collect more detailed information.
paras.zh: 该方法遵循“提示和提示”模型，其中一个传感器识别潜在目标，然后指示另一个传感器收集更详细的信息。

paras.en: The company has also developed a business case for detecting and investigating maritime activity in the heavily trafficked Baltic Sea, bordered by NATO members and Russia. There, Lynx satellites can identify anomalous RF emissions that could reveal dark vessels or help locate sources of GPS spoofing. It can then cue a Leopard satellite to collect additional intelligence.
paras.zh: 该公司还开发了一个商业案例，用于探测和调查与北约成员国和俄罗斯接壤的交通繁忙的波罗的海的海上活动。在那里，Lynx 卫星可以识别异常射频发射，从而揭示黑暗船只或帮助定位 GPS 欺骗源。然后它可以提示 Leopard 卫星收集更多情报。

paras.en: This space-based approach to surveillance, Smolders argues, offers a cost-effective complement to expensive drones and stealth aircraft that can only monitor a relatively contained area at once.
paras.zh: 斯莫尔德斯认为，这种基于太空的监视方法为昂贵的无人机和隐形飞机提供了一种经济有效的补充，因为这些飞机只能同时监视相对封闭的区域。

paras.en: “For the cost of one or two F-35s, you can actually get the intelligence to tell those planes where to go,” he said. “Affordable, proven ISR capability is ready to deploy in Europe today, with Space Inventor at the forefront of turning that capability into operational missions, but the decision-makers need to know about it.”
paras.zh: “只需花费一两架 F-35 的成本，你实际上就可以获得告诉这些飞机要去哪里的情报，”他说。 “如今，经济实惠、经过验证的 ISR 能力已准备好在欧洲部署，Space Inventor 处于将这种能力转化为作战任务的最前沿，但决策者需要了解这一点。”

articles.title: Perseverance Navcam Image Marks Record Drive

paras.en: Rover tracks and a rocky Martian landscape are shown in this image captured by one of the navigation cameras (navcams) aboard NASA’s Perseverance Mars rover on Oct. 11, 2026, the 2,006th Martian day, or sol, of the mission. During that sol’s drive, spanning 299.6 feet (91.31 meters), the mission passed a major milestone: pushing Perseverance’s total driving distance beyond that of the agency’s Opportunity rover, which logged 28.06 miles (45.16 kilometers) during its 15-year mission on Mars.
paras.zh: 这张图像显示了火星车的轨迹和岩石岩石景观，由 NASA 毅力号火星车上的一个导航摄像机 (navcams) 在 2026 年 10 月 11 日（任务的第 2006 个火星日，即太阳日）拍摄。在太阳号的行驶里程达到 299.6 英尺（91.31 米）的过程中，该任务跨越了一个重要的里程碑：将毅力号的总行驶距离超过了该机构的机遇号火星车，后者在 15 年的火星任务中行驶了 28.06 英里（45.16 公里）。

paras.en: NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory, which is managed for the agency by Caltech in Pasadena, California, built and manages operations of the Perseverance rover on behalf of the agency’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington, as part of NASA’s Mars Exploration Program portfolio.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局喷气推进实验室由位于加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳的加州理工学院管理，代表该机构位于华盛顿的科学任务理事会建造和管理毅力号火星车的运行，作为美国宇航局火星探索计划组合的一部分。

paras.en: For more about Perseverance: https://science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-2020-perseverance/
paras.zh: 有关“毅力”的更多信息：https://science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-2020-perseverance/

articles.title: NASA to Discuss Artemis Acceleration, Status of Upcoming Moon Missions
articles.author: Gerelle Q. Dodson

paras.en: NASA will provide an update on its plans to return American astronauts to the surface of the Moon by 2028 at 2 p.m. EDT, Friday, Oct. 23, at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
paras.zh: NASA 将于下午 2 点提供有关 2028 年美国宇航员重返月球表面计划的最新信息。美国东部时间 10 月 23 日星期五，在该机构位于佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心。

paras.en: - NASA Associate Administrator Amit Kshatriya
paras.zh: ——美国宇航局副局长阿米特·刹帝利 (Amit Kshatriya)

paras.en: - Jeremy Parsons, NASA’s Artemis program manager
paras.zh: - 杰里米·帕森斯 (Jeremy Parsons)，美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯项目经理

paras.en: The update will include details about NASA’s Artemis III mission that will send four astronauts to low Earth orbit next year to test critical systems needed for future lunar landings, and how plans to return American astronauts to the Moon by 2028 are progressing.
paras.zh: 更新内容将包括美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯 III 任务的详细信息，该任务将于明年将四名宇航员送入近地轨道，测试未来登月所需的关键系统，以及美国宇航员在 2028 年重返月球的计划进展情况。

paras.en: U.S. media interested in attending in person must apply online by 12 p.m., Friday, Oct. 16. To ask questions remotely, media must request the dial-in number from the Kennedy newsroom no later than one hour prior to the start of the update by emailing: ksc-newsroom@mail.nasa.gov. NASA’s media accreditation policy is online.
paras.zh: 有兴趣亲自参加的美国媒体必须在 10 月 16 日星期五中午 12 点之前在线申请。要远程提问，媒体必须在更新开始前一小时内通过电子邮件向肯尼迪新闻编辑室索取拨入号码：ksc-newsroom@mail.nasa.gov。 NASA 的媒体认证政策已上线。

paras.en: As part of a Golden Age of innovation and exploration, NASA will send Artemis astronauts on increasingly difficult missions near the lunar South Pole to explore more of the Moon than ever before. In addition to providing economic benefits and advancing scientific discovery through its Moon missions, NASA will establish an enduring human presence on the lunar surface and build on the agency’s foundation for the first crewed mission to Mars.
paras.zh: 作为创新和探索黄金时代的一部分，美国宇航局将派遣阿耳忒弥斯宇航员前往月球南极附近执行日益艰巨的任务，以探索比以往更多的月球区域。除了通过月球任务提供经济效益和推进科学发现外，美国宇航局还将在月球表面建立持久的人类存在，并为该机构首次载人火星任务奠定基础。

articles.title: NASA Develops Batteries to Power Humanity’s Return to Moon
articles.author: Joseph Atkinson

paras.en: If you’ve ever had your car start sluggishly, or not at all, on a particularly frigid winter morning, you know standard batteries do not like extreme cold. That’s why NASA researchers are working to develop a battery that could function in the brutal cold of the Moon’s South Pole, where nighttime temperatures plunge to minus 328 degrees Fahrenheit (minus 200 Celsius).
paras.zh: 如果您曾经在特别寒冷的冬天早晨遇到过汽车启动缓慢或根本无法启动的情况，您就知道标准电池不喜欢极冷的环境。这就是为什么 NASA 研究人员正在努力开发一种可以在月球南极的严寒环境下工作的电池，那里夜间温度骤降至负 328 华氏度（负 200 摄氏度）。

paras.en: For future lunar operations, a battery will need to work immediately when warmed up and be able to power everything from an astronaut’s emergency kit to a rover capable of exploring the Moon’s darkest craters — all without posing a fire hazard.
paras.zh: 对于未来的月球操作，电池需要在预热后立即工作，并能够为从宇航员的应急包到能够探索月球最黑暗的陨石坑的漫游车等所有东西提供动力，而且不会造成火灾危险。

paras.en: A team of NASA researchers is working to make all that happen. The project is called Solid Power for Extreme Environment Adaptability and Resilience in Space (SPEARS), and it could provide NASA with an important tool to help power humanity’s sustained presence on the Moon through the Artemis campaign.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局研究人员团队正在努力实现这一切。该项目被称为太空极端环境适应性和弹性固体动力（SPEARS），它可以为美国宇航局提供一个重要工具，帮助人类通过阿耳忒弥斯计划在月球上持续存在。

paras.en: “Batteries have become an important part of our lives here on Earth, which enable our laptops, cell phones, power tools, and even our vehicles,” said Donald Dornbusch, principal investigator for SPEARS at NASA’s Glenn Research Center in Cleveland, where the project is led. “We will need them on the Moon, too, and these batteries will be required to operate reliably and safely in this harsh environment. That’s why we’re working on this technology.”
paras.zh: “电池已经成为我们在地球上生活的重要组成部分，它为我们的笔记本电脑、手机、电动工具甚至我们的车辆提供了动力，”该项目的领导者、美国宇航局克利夫兰格伦研究中心 SPEARS 首席研究员唐纳德·多恩布什 (Donald Dornbusch) 说道。 “我们在月球上也需要它们，并且这些电池需要在这种恶劣的环境中可靠、安全地运行。这就是我们致力于这项技术的原因。”

paras.en: Traditional lithium-ion batteries like those in your cell phone and laptop have a critical weakness: they rely on liquid electrolytes. Cool a conventional battery to the Moon’s nighttime temperatures, and that liquid would freeze, potentially damaging the battery. Heat it up too much — say, to daytime lunar temperatures of 212 F (100 C) — and it won’t work until cooled. Expose the liquid to the vacuum of space, and it evaporates.
paras.zh: 手机和笔记本电脑等传统锂离子电池有一个严重的弱点：它们依赖液体电解质。将传统电池冷却到月球夜间温度，液体会冻结，可能会损坏电池。如果将其加热得太多，例如白天的月球温度达到 212 华氏度（100 摄氏度），那么在冷却之前它将无法工作。将液体暴露在太空真空中，它就会蒸发。

paras.en: SPEARS batteries solve these problems by replacing the liquid electrolyte with a solid ceramic- or polymer-based material. This change could unlock several advantages. First and foremost, they could operate in the heat and extreme cold.
paras.zh: SPEARS 电池通过用固体陶瓷或聚合物材料代替液体电解质来解决这些问题。这一变化可以释放一些优势。首先也是最重要的是，它们可以在炎热和极冷的情况下运行。

paras.en: During recent thermal vacuum testing at NASA’s Langley Research Center in Hampton, Virginia, small prototype battery cells operated well up to 176 F (80 C), down to minus 76 F (minus 60 C), and with slightly reduced performance down to minus 112 F (minus 80 C).
paras.zh: 最近在弗吉尼亚州汉普顿的 NASA 兰利研究中心进行的热真空测试中，小型原型电池在高达 176 F（80 C）、低至负 76 F（负 60 C）的温度下运行良好，并且在低至负 112 F（负 80 C）的温度下性能略有下降。

paras.en: “We proved for the first time that these cells can work down to minus 80 degrees Celsius,” said Yi Lin, SPEARS testing and research lead at NASA Langley.
paras.zh: NASA 兰利的 SPEARS 测试和研究负责人 Yi Lin 表示：“我们首次证明这些电池可以在低至 -80 摄氏度的温度下工作。”

paras.en: Lin also said he’s confident they can improve performance and maybe even expand that range in coming years.
paras.zh: 林还表示，他相信他们可以提高性能，甚至可能在未来几年扩大这个范围。

paras.en: The batteries need to remain reliable through exposure to the Moon’s wild temperature swings between day and night. The thermal vacuum testing showed that after exposure to temperature extremes from 212 F (100 C) to minus 274 F (minus 170 C), SPEARS batteries don’t sustain damage.
paras.zh: 电池需要在月球昼夜剧烈温度波动的情况下保持可靠。热真空测试表明，在暴露于 212 F（100 C）至负 274 F（负 170 C）的极端温度后，SPEARS 电池不会受到损坏。

paras.en: Just like the chemistry in your earbuds is different from the chemistry in your phone, which is different from the chemistry in your car, all these chemistries can still function with a solid electrolyte. We can tune for energy, tune for power, tune for durability, depending on the application.
paras.zh: 就像耳塞中的化学物质与手机中的化学物质不同、汽车中的化学物质不同一样，所有这些化学物质仍然可以在固体电解质的情况下发挥作用。我们可以根据应用情况调整能量、功率、耐用性。

paras.en: Not even solid-state batteries will function while they’re at a temperature as low as minus 274 F, but because solid electrolytes don’t freeze like a liquid, the batteries can survive the extreme low temperatures.
paras.zh: 即使固态电池在低至 -274 F 的温度下也无法工作，但由于固态电解质不会像液体那样冻结，因此电池可以在极低的温度下生存。

paras.en: In order to get the batteries working again after exposure to such cold, small heaters come into play. SPEARS batteries wouldn’t need to be kept warm all the time, just warmed up to operational temperature. That could reduce the need for heavy thermal management systems in spacecraft and lunar habitats, allowing for lighter designs, lower costs, and longer mission durations.
paras.zh: 为了让电池在暴露在如此寒冷的环境后再次工作，小型加热器就发挥了作用。 SPEARS 电池不需要一直保温，只需预热到工作温度即可。这可以减少航天器和月球栖息地对重型热管理系统的需求，从而实现更轻的设计、更低的成本和更长的任务持续时间。

paras.en: The applications for these solid-state batteries are nearly limitless, from small tools like drills that must operate in shadowed lunar craters, to rovers and emergency power packs for astronauts. They also could provide power solutions for long-duration scientific instruments.
paras.zh: 这些固态电池的应用几乎是无限的，从必须在阴影月球陨石坑中操作的钻机等小型工具，到漫游车和宇航员的应急电源组。他们还可以为长期科学仪器提供电源解决方案。

paras.en: “We can tune the chemistry by using different electrode materials,” said Lin. “Just like the chemistry in your earbuds is different from the chemistry in your phone, which is different from the chemistry in your car, all these chemistries can still function with a solid electrolyte. We can tune for energy, tune for power, tune for durability, depending on the application.”
paras.zh: “我们可以通过使用不同的电极材料来调整化学反应，”林说。 “就像耳塞中的化学物质与手机中的化学物质不同、汽车中的化学物质不同一样，所有这些化学物质仍然可以在固体电解质下发挥作用。我们可以根据应用调整能量、功率、耐用性。”

paras.en: While SPEARS is designed for space, the technology could be spun off into Earth-based applications. In fact, SPEARS evolved out of a previous battery project Lin and Dornbusch worked on that focused on aeronautic applications.
paras.zh: 虽然 SPEARS 是为太空设计的，但该技术可以衍生到地球上的应用中。事实上，SPEARS 是从 Lin 和 Dornbusch 之前从事的一个专注于航空应用的电池项目演变而来的。

paras.en: “The potential market for solid-state batteries is very broad,” said Ji Su, a polymer materials scientist and the task lead at NASA Langley. “Automobiles, cell phones, communication devices, drones — anything that needs a portable power supply.”
paras.zh: “固态电池的潜在市场非常广阔，”美国宇航局兰利分校的聚合物材料科学家、任务负责人苏季说。 “汽车、手机、通信设备、无人机——任何需要便携式电源的东西。”

paras.en: The SPEARS project began in 2026 with funding through the Advanced Research and Technology division within the agency’s Research and Technology Mission Directorate. The project is set to focus on technology development in its first stages before potentially shifting toward commercial collaboration. NASA’s Ames Research Center in California’s Silicon Valley is working to develop flight hardware such as test boards and electronics to help prepare the SPEARS batteries for spaceflight and test them in space environments.
paras.zh: SPEARS 项目于 2026 年开始，由该机构研究和技术任务理事会内的高级研究和技术部门提供资金。该项目的第一阶段将重点关注技术开发，然后可能转向商业合作。美国宇航局位于加利福尼亚州硅谷的艾姆斯研究中心正在致力于开发测试板和电子设备等飞行硬件，以帮助为太空飞行准备 SPEARS 电池并在太空环境中对其进行测试。

articles.title: ‘Need for UN has never been greater,’ UN chief says, proposing slimmer $3.3 billion budget for 2027

paras.en: ‘Need for UN has never been greater,’ UN chief says, proposing slimmer $3.3 billion budget for 2027
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长表示，“对联合国的需求从未如此强烈”，并提议将 2027 年预算削减至 33 亿美元

paras.en: - The proposed 2027 programme budget is 1.2 per cent below the 2026 approved level
paras.zh: - 2027 年拟议方案预算比 2026 年核准水平低 1.2%

paras.en: - UN80 Initiative reforms will continue, with more cuts, staff relocations and the abolition or downgrading of some posts
paras.zh: - UN80倡议改革将继续进行，将进行更多裁员、人员调动以及取消或降级一些职位

paras.en: - Predictable cashflow and timely payment of dues are essential as efficiency gains will not be sufficient to resolve the liquidity crisis
paras.zh: - 可预测的现金流和及时支付会费至关重要，因为效率提升不足以解决流动性危机

paras.en: “The challenges before us are profound,” Mr. Guterres told the General Assembly’s Fifth Committee, comprising all 193 UN Member States that handle administrative and budgetary matters at UN Headquarters in New York.
paras.zh: “我们面临的挑战是严峻的，”古特雷斯先生对大会第五委员会表示，该委员会由在纽约联合国总部处理行政和预算事务的所有 193 个联合国会员国组成。

paras.en: “Geopolitical divisions continue to deepen, conflicts persist across regions and humanitarian needs are soaring, international law is trampled, climate disruption is hitting every continent and artificial intelligence is reshaping economies and societies,” said the Secretary-General.
paras.zh: 秘书长表示：“地缘政治分歧继续加深，地区间冲突持续存在，人道主义需求飙升，国际法遭到践踏，气候破坏正在袭击各大洲，人工智能正在重塑经济和社会。”

paras.en: Moreover, the planet’s collective Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), aimed at leaving no one behind, “are slipping further from reach”, Mr. Guterres said.
paras.zh: 此外，古特雷斯表示，旨在不让任何人掉队的地球集体可持续发展目标“正在进一步偏离目标”。

paras.en: “And yet, in this era of uncertainty and fragmentation, the need for the United Nations has never been greater,” he declared.
paras.zh: “然而，在这个充满不确定性和分裂的时代，对联合国的需求从未如此强烈，”他宣称。

paras.en: Reminding the committee that more than a year has passed since the UN80 Initiative was launched, the UN chief said “with your support, we set in motion far-reaching changes guided by a clear objective: to make the Secretariat more efficient, more effective, and better equipped to serve in a rapidly changing world.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长提醒委员会，自联合国80倡议启动以来已经过去了一年多，“在你们的支持下，我们在一个明确的目标的指导下启动了影响深远的变革：使秘书处更有效率、更有效、更有能力在快速变化的世界中提供服务。”

paras.en: Taking stock of UN80 achievements, he said the Secretariat had already “moved from proposals to implementation”:
paras.zh: 在回顾联合国80周年成就时，他表示秘书处已经“从提案转向实施”：

paras.en: - The number of underrepresented Member States fell from 28 to 26 between August 2024 and August 2026
paras.zh: - 2024年8月至2026年8月期间，代表性不足的会员国数量从28个减少到26个

paras.en: - Gender parity has been reached among internationally recruited staff
paras.zh: - 国际招聘的工作人员已实现性别平等

paras.en: - Payroll operations have been consolidated
paras.zh: - 薪资业务已合并

paras.en: - Phase one of common administrative platforms had launched in New York and Bangkok
paras.zh: - 共同行政平台第一阶段已在纽约和曼谷启动

paras.en: - Some functions have moved to lower-cost duty stations
paras.zh: - 一些职能已转移到成本较低的工作地点

paras.en: - The UN Secretariat has absorbed a reduction of 3,116 regular budget posts
paras.zh: - 联合国秘书处削减了3,116个经常预算员额

paras.en: Through a voluntary early separation programme and reassignments, he said the impact on staff was “much smaller than what could be imagined” because planning began a year and a half in advance in the anticipated shortfalls.
paras.zh: 他表示，通过自愿提前离职计划和重新分配，对员工的影响“比想象的要小得多”，因为针对预期的短缺，提前一年半就开始了规划。

paras.en: Watch the Secretary-General’s introduction of the proposed 2027 budget:
paras.zh: 观看秘书长对 2027 年拟议预算的介绍：

paras.en: For 2027, the Secretary-General proposed additional post relocations across 12 entities, with the largest going to the Kenyan capital, Nairobi.
paras.zh: 秘书长提议到 2027 年在 12 个实体中进行额外职位调动，其中最大的一个将调往肯尼亚首都内罗毕。

paras.en: He also proposed abolishing some high-level posts, downgrading 14 senior positions and extending administrative platforms to Geneva, Nairobi, Vienna and Addis Ababa.
paras.zh: 他还提议裁撤一些高级职位，降级14个高级职位，并将行政平台扩展到日内瓦、内罗毕、维也纳和亚的斯亚贝巴。

paras.en: At the same time, he pointed out that the proposed budget incorporates standard-cost adjustments from the outset for the first time, so there will be no separate recosting later in the year.
paras.zh: 同时他指出，拟议预算从一开始就首次纳入了标准成本调整，因此今年晚些时候不会单独重新计算成本。

paras.en: However, the Secretary-General stressed that “efficiency alone cannot compensate for an unstable financial foundation”.
paras.zh: 然而，秘书长强调，“仅靠效率并不能弥补不稳定的财政基础”。

paras.en: “Member States must fulfil their financial obligations in full and on time, as required by the UN Charter,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“会员国必须按照《联合国宪章》的要求，足额、按时履行其财政义务。”

paras.en: The Secretary-General also stressed that the world body needs predictable financing and timely payments of national dues to implement the mandates the Member States themselves have approved.
paras.zh: 秘书长还强调，这个世界机构需要可预测的资金和及时缴纳的国家会费，以执行会员国本身批准的任务。

paras.en: “Taken together, these measures will help address the liquidity challenges of the Organization and support the effective implementation of mandates,” he said.
paras.zh: “总的来说，这些措施将有助于解决本组织的流动性挑战，并支持有效执行任务，”他说。

articles.title: WHO calls for urgent health action across the Eastern Mediterranean

paras.en: WHO calls for urgent health action across the Eastern Mediterranean
paras.zh: 世卫组织呼吁东地中海地区采取紧急卫生行动

paras.en: The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) has called for promoting, providing and protecting health in the Eastern Mediterranean region, home to some of the world’s top humanitarian crises such as Sudan, Yemen and the Occupied Palestinian Territory.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）总干事呼吁促进、提供和保护东地中海地区的健康，该地区是苏丹、也门和巴勒斯坦被占领土等世界上一些最严重的人道主义危机的发源地。

paras.en: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus was speaking on Wednesday to health leaders and senior officials attending the WHO regional committee meeting underway in Cairo, Egypt.
paras.zh: 谭德塞周三向出席在埃及开罗举行的世卫组织区域委员会会议的卫生领导人和高级官员发表讲话。

paras.en: “Over the past year, Member States have continued to advance the health and wellbeing of their people, often under the most difficult circumstances,” he said in remarks on the annual report for the region, which spans 22 countries and territories.
paras.zh: 他在针对涵盖 22 个国家和地区的地区年度报告时表示：“过去一年里，会员国经常在最困难的情况下，继续促进本国人民的健康和福祉。”

paras.en: He highlighted numerous achievements, including strengthened response to noncommunicable diseases – such as cardiovascular disease, cancer and diabetes –which account for roughly two thirds of all deaths in the region, with more than 2.8 million lives lost every year.
paras.zh: 他强调了许多成就，包括加强对心血管疾病、癌症和糖尿病等非传染性疾病的应对，这些疾病约占该地区所有死亡人数的三分之二，每年有超过 280 万人丧生。

paras.en: Yet, the report was also a reminder that the Eastern Mediterranean continues to face a multitude of challenges.
paras.zh: 然而，该报告也提醒人们，东地中海仍然面临着诸多挑战。

paras.en: “This region remains the epicentre of global humanitarian need, with more than 117 million people in need of humanitarian assistance,” he said. It is also home to some of the world’s largest displacement crises.
paras.zh: 他说：“该地区仍然是全球人道主义需求的中心，有超过 1.17 亿人需要人道主义援助。”它也是世界上一些最大的流离失所危机的发源地。

paras.en: “Conflict continues to affect millions of people across several countries and territories,” he said.
paras.zh: “冲突继续影响多个国家和地区的数百万人，”他说。

paras.en: “We continue to see an appalling number of attacks on healthcare and climate-related shocks continue to place additional pressure on already fragile health systems.”
paras.zh: “我们继续看到数量惊人的医疗保健攻击和气候相关冲击继续给本已脆弱的卫生系统带来额外压力。”

paras.en: These developments are unfolding amid a sharp fall in international funding for both healthcare and humanitarian operations and increasing fiscal constraints at the national level.
paras.zh: 这些事态发展是在用于医疗保健和人道主义行动的国际资金急剧下降以及国家一级财政限制日益加剧的情况下展开的。

paras.en: “At the very moment when needs are increasing, resources are declining,” he said.
paras.zh: “在需求增加的同时，资源却在减少，”他说。

paras.en: Tedros urged leaders to continue measures that promote health, such as reducing tobacco use and other risk factors for noncommunicable diseases and ensuring that all children are vaccinated.
paras.zh: 谭德塞敦促领导人继续采取促进健康的措施，例如减少烟草使用和其他非传染性疾病风险因素，并确保所有儿童都接种疫苗。

paras.en: Governments should also continue to invest in strong, equitable and resilient health systems and in health workers.
paras.zh: 各国政府还应继续投​​资于强大、公平和有复原力的卫生系统和卫生工作者。

paras.en: “Make every primary healthcare facility a place where a woman can receive quality care during pregnancy, where every newborn and child can get a healthy start in life and where hypertension, diabetes and cancer can be detected and managed early,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“让每个初级医疗机构成为妇女在怀孕期间能够获得优质护理的地方，让每个新生儿和儿童都能获得健康的人生开端，让高血压、糖尿病和癌症能够得到早期发现和治疗。”

paras.en: The WHO chief called for protecting health by strengthening preparedness, security and resilience.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事呼吁通过加强准备、安全和复原力来保护健康。

paras.en: “The threats facing this region are evolving,” he warned, noting that conflicts and outbreaks continue while climate risks continue to grow.
paras.zh: 他警告说：“该地区面临的威胁正在演变。”他指出，冲突和疫情仍在持续，而气候风险也在持续增加。

paras.en: “Preparedness cannot be an afterthought. Preparedness saves lives before emergencies begin,” he said, underlining the need for continued investment in surveillance, laboratories, emergency workforces, resilient health facilities and supply chains.
paras.zh: 他说：“做好准备不能是事后才想到的。做好准备可以在紧急情况发生之前拯救生命。”他强调需要继续投资于监测、实验室、应急人员、有弹性的卫生设施和供应链。

articles.title: Yemen: WFP warns of potential ‘humanitarian catastrophe’ as fighting blocks aid delivery

paras.en: Yemen: WFP warns of potential ‘humanitarian catastrophe’ as fighting blocks aid delivery
paras.zh: 也门：粮食计划署警告称，战斗阻碍了援助的运送，可能造成“人道主义灾难”

paras.en: Intensifying fighting in Yemen has cut off life-saving assistance to 800,000 people as shifting frontlines, blocked roads and growing insecurity severely restrict access to the city of Taiz and other conflict zones, the UN World Food Programme (WFP) said on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 联合国世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 周三表示，由于前线转移、道路封锁和日益严重的不安全局势严重限制了前往塔伊兹市和其他冲突地区的交通，也门战事加剧，导致对 80 万人的救生援助被切断。

paras.en: “We are critically concerned about the escalating conflict, but even more so about the growing number of people we can no longer reach because of it,” said El-Khidir Daloum, WFP country director in Yemen.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署驻也门国家主任埃尔-希迪尔·达卢姆表示：“我们对冲突不断升级深表担忧，但更重要的是，我们因此无法接触到越来越多的人。”

paras.en: He noted that many of the affected families have been displaced multiple times and were already struggling to afford even basic food items.
paras.zh: 他指出，许多受影响的家庭已经多次流离失所，甚至连基本食品都已经难以负担。

paras.en: “This is the kind of situation that can rapidly spiral into a humanitarian catastrophe if assistance cannot move safely and reach those who need it most,” he warned.
paras.zh: 他警告说：“如果援助无法安全地运送到最需要的人手中，这种情况可能会迅速演变为人道主义灾难。”

paras.en: Taiz is Yemen’s third largest city and capital of an eponymous governorate in which some districts have hosted the largest numbers of people displaced by the mounting violence between Saudi-supported Government troops and Iran-backed Houthi rebels.
paras.zh: 塔伊兹是也门第三大城市，也是也门同名省的首府，该省的一些地区收容了因沙特支持的政府军与伊朗支持的胡塞叛乱分子之间不断升级的暴力而流离失所的人数最多的地区。

paras.en: Many of the displaced are now inaccessible due to ongoing fighting and imminent road closures around the governorate.
paras.zh: 由于该省周围持续的战斗和即将封闭的道路，许多流离失所者现在无法进入。

paras.en: WFP said the situation is especially alarming as Taiz has some of the highest levels of food insecurity, with 10 out of 16 districts already classified at emergency levels.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署表示，情况尤其令人担忧，因为塔伊兹是粮食不安全程度最高的地区之一，16 个地区中有 10 个地区已被列为紧急级别。

paras.en: The latest monitoring indicates that wheat flour stocks are nearly depleted while local markets are running out of food, according to the UN agency.
paras.zh: 据联合国机构称，最新监测表明，小麦面粉库存几乎耗尽，而当地市场的粮食也即将耗尽。

paras.en: WFP and partners cannot access more than 600,000 people in Taiz who depend on humanitarian assistance, including more than 200,000 women and children.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署及其合作伙伴无法接触塔伊兹超过 60 万依靠人道主义援助的人，其中包括超过 20 万妇女和儿童。

paras.en: Some 800,000 people are now out of reach nationwide, taking into account communities affected by access losses on the West Coast.
paras.zh: 考虑到西海岸受接入中断影响的社区，目前全国约有 80 万人无法获得服务。

paras.en: The UN continues to sound the alarm over the crisis in Yemen, where more than 18 million people face acute food insecurity. Some 2.2 million children under five are acutely malnourished, including 500,000 suffering from severe acute malnutrition, the most life-threatening form of the condition.
paras.zh: 联合国继续对也门危机发出警报，该国有超过 1800 万人面临严重的粮食不安全。约 220 万五岁以下儿童严重营养不良，其中 50 万人患有严重急性营养不良，这是最危及生命的疾病。

paras.en: Recent WFP monitoring in accessible areas found that nearly 75 per cent of households were unable to meet their basic food needs – a record number for this year and a sign that food security is significantly deteriorating.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署最近在可进入地区进行的监测发现，近 75% 的家庭无法满足其基本粮食需求——这一数字创下今年的纪录，表明粮食安全正在严重恶化。

paras.en: WFP said the escalation has also severely disrupted its operations, with offices breached, assets and food stocks lost and critical supply chain routes cut off.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署表示，事态升级也严重扰乱了其行动，办公室遭到破坏，资产和粮食库存丢失，关键供应链路线被切断。

paras.en: Disrupted operations, detained personnel
paras.zh: 运营中断、人员被拘留

paras.en: Meanwhile, 37 of its staff are among 72 UN personnel who remain detained by Houthi de facto authorities. WFP has joined UN Secretary-General António Guterres in repeatedly calling for their immediate and unconditional release.
paras.zh: 与此同时，72 名联合国人员中，有 37 名工作人员仍被胡塞事实上的当局拘留。粮食计划署与联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯一起多次呼吁立即无条件释放他们。

paras.en: The agency continues to uphold the critical need for safe and sustained humanitarian access in Yemen along with immediate funding. Teams have provided emergency assistance to more than 115,000 newly displaced people are preparing to expand to include 1.5 million people when access is restored.
paras.zh: 该机构继续满足也门安全和持续人道主义准入的迫切需要，并提供即时资金。各小组已向超过 115,000 名新流离失所者提供了紧急援助，并准备在恢复通行后扩大到 150 万人。

paras.en: WFP stressed that it requires $268 million to sustain operations through 2027, which include emergency food assistance, nutrition programmes, school meals, resilience activities and critical humanitarian logistics services.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署强调，需要 2.68 亿美元来维持到 2027 年的行动，其中包括紧急粮食援助、营养计划、学校供餐、复原力活动和关键的人道主义后勤服务。

articles.title: Semenyo ‘froze’ after alleged racial abuse by Liverpool fan, court hears

paras.en: Antoine Semenyo: Manchester City forward ‘froze’ after alleged racial abuse by Liverpool fan, court hears
paras.zh: 安托万·塞梅尼奥：法庭审理称，曼城前锋在被利物浦球迷涉嫌种族虐待后“僵住了”

paras.en: Antoine Semenyo was allegedly racially abused by a Liverpool fan while playing for Bournemouth at Anfield last August; the court heard Semenyo was left shocked and upset by the abuse; Mark Mogan, 47, denies racially aggravated behaviour
paras.zh: 安托万·塞梅尼奥据称去年八月在安菲尔德为伯恩茅斯队效力时遭到一名利物浦球迷的种族歧视；法庭获悉，塞梅尼奥对这种虐待行为感到震惊和不安； 47 岁的马克·莫根否认种族歧视行为

paras.en: Footballer Antoine Semenyo "froze" after he was allegedly racially abused by a Liverpool fan at Anfield, a court has heard.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，足球运动员安托万·塞梅尼奥据称在安菲尔德遭到一名利物浦球迷的种族歧视后“僵住了”。

paras.en: Semenyo, who was then playing for Bournemouth, was allegedly racially abused by Mark Mogan, 47, as he went to take a throw-in about 30 minutes into the opening match of the Premier League season on August 15 last year.
paras.zh: 去年8月15日，当时效力于伯恩茅斯队的塞梅尼奥据称在英超联赛揭幕战开始约30分钟后去发界外球时遭到47岁的马克·莫根的种族歧视。

paras.en: Simon Jones, prosecuting, told Liverpool Magistrates' Court on Wednesday the footballer saw Mogan, a wheelchair-user, to his right-hand side and heard him shout: "Hurry up and take the throw-in, you black b*****d."
paras.zh: 检控官西蒙·琼斯周三告诉利物浦地方法院，这名足球运动员看到坐在轮椅上的莫根在他的右手边，并听到他喊道：“快点发界外球，你这个黑混蛋。”

paras.en: He said: "That racial abuse was shouted directly at Antoine Semenyo, who was close to him. Mr Semenyo briefly froze as he couldn't believe what the male had said."
paras.zh: 他说：“种族歧视是直接对着他身边的安东尼·塞梅尼奥大喊大叫的。塞梅尼奥先生短暂地愣住了，因为他无法相信这名男子所说的话。”

paras.en: Mogan then shouted "I'm talking to you, you c***", the court heard.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，莫根随后大喊“我在跟你说话，你这个混蛋”。

paras.en: Mr Jones said: "He looked straight at Antoine Semenyo when directing this abuse to him.
paras.zh: 琼斯先生说：“当他对安托万·塞梅尼奥进行辱骂时，他直视着他。

paras.en: "Antoine Semenyo didn't say anything back to him and went to take the throw-in, however he was clearly hurt and upset with the racial abuse that had come his way."
paras.zh: “安托万·塞梅尼奥没有对他说什么，而是去接受掷球入界，但他显然对自己遭遇的种族虐待感到受伤和不安。”

paras.en: The footballer, who now plays for Manchester City, reported the incident to match referee Anthony Taylor when the ball next went out of play and Mogan was removed from the stadium at half time, the court was told.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，这位现效力于曼城队的足球运动员向比赛裁判安东尼·泰勒报告了这一事件，当时球已停止比赛，莫根在中场休息时被带离球场。

paras.en: Two short video clips of the incident were shown to the court, in which Mr Jones said the defendant could be seen in an "agitated and angry state".
paras.zh: 法庭上播放了该事件的两段短片，琼斯表示，在视频中可以看到被告处于“焦躁和愤怒的状态”。

paras.en: He said witnesses saw Mogan take chewing gum from his mouth and throw it at Semenyo, striking him on the right side of his shorts.
paras.zh: 他说，目击者看到莫根从嘴里掏出口香糖，扔向塞梅尼奥，击中了他短裤的右侧。

paras.en: Mr Jones said: "We say that was plainly an unsavoury action from an angry man."
paras.zh: 琼斯先生说：“我们认为这显然是一个愤怒的人的令人厌恶的行为。”

paras.en: In a statement read to the court, fellow Liverpool fan Neil Sherratt said he saw Mogan, who sits next to him at matches, leave his bay in the disabled section of the Main Stand and approach the pitch as Semenyo came to take the throw in.
paras.zh: 在向法庭宣读的一份声明中，利物浦球迷尼尔·谢拉特表示，他看到比赛中坐在他旁边的莫根离开主看台残疾人区的座位，在塞梅尼奥来罚球时走近球场。

paras.en: He said he heard Mogan shout something along the lines of "hurry up" and saw Semenyo turn towards him.
paras.zh: 他说他听到莫根大喊“快点”，然后看到塞梅尼奥转向他。

paras.en: He said: "Semenyo had a shocked look on his face and I believe he has replied back by saying 'you what'."
paras.zh: 他说：“塞梅尼奥脸上露出震惊的表情，我相信他已经回答说‘你什么’。”

paras.en: Another fan, Nicholas Collins, said after the incident Mogan became "very cocky and brazen" and said: "If the bizzies (police) come I'm going to deck them. I'm not going anywhere."
paras.zh: 另一位粉丝尼古拉斯·柯林斯 (Nicholas Collins) 表示，事件发生后莫根变得“非常自大和厚颜无耻”，并表示：“如果警察来了，我就会打倒他们。我哪儿也不去。”

paras.en: Mogan, who had an intermediary with him in court, was interviewed by police the following day and told officers he had shouted at Semenyo to "hurry up".
paras.zh: 莫根在法庭上有一名中间人陪同，第二天他接受了警方的讯问，并告诉警察他曾对塞梅尼奥大喊“快点”。

paras.en: "His account was that Antoine Semenyo called him a cripple which upset him," Mr Jones said.
paras.zh: 琼斯先生说：“他的说法是安托万·塞梅尼奥称他为跛子，这让他很不安。”

paras.en: "He said he then threw some chewing gum onto the floor but not at Antoine Semenyo.
paras.zh: “他说，然后他把一些口香糖扔到地板上，但没有扔到安托万·塞梅尼奥身上。

paras.en: "The prosecution say Mr Mogan clearly lied in that police interview."
paras.zh: “检方称莫根先生在警方的采访中明显撒了谎。”

paras.en: Semenyo is expected to give evidence over a videolink on Wednesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 塞梅尼奥预计将于周三下午通过视频链接提供证据。

paras.en: Mogan, of Templehill Close, Dovecot, denies racially aggravated behaviour.
paras.zh: 来自达夫科特坦普尔希尔克洛斯的莫根否认存在种族歧视行为。

articles.title: 'They need a reset' - Has trust broken down between Hamilton, Ferrari pit wall?

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton: Has trust broken down between Ferrari driver and team's pit wall after Singapore GP issues?
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿：在新加坡大奖赛出现问题后，法拉利车手和车队维修区之间的信任是否已经破裂？

paras.en: Listen to the latest episode of The F1 Show podcast as Simon Lazenby, Bernie Collins and Karun Chandhok look back at all the big talking points from the Singapore Sprint weekend; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: 收听最新一集的 The F1 Show 播客，其中 Simon Lazenby、Bernie Collins 和 Karun Chandhok 回顾了新加坡冲刺周末的所有重要话题；观看 10 月 23 日至 25 日在奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛的每一场比赛，天空体育 F1 直播

paras.en: Ferrari's strategy decisions and communication with their drivers came under fresh scrutiny at the Singapore Grand Prix after Lewis Hamilton overrode a call to pit.
paras.zh: 在刘易斯·汉密尔顿推翻了进站的要求后，法拉利的战略决策以及与车手的沟通在新加坡大奖赛上受到了新的审查。

paras.en: Hamilton finished finish sixth instead of a likely third in last Sunday's race after not heeding a call from the team's pit wall to stop under a lap-39 Virtual Safety Car.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿在上周日的比赛中没有理会车队维修区墙上发出的在第 39 圈虚拟安全车下停车的要求，最终获得第六名，而不是可能获得第三名。

paras.en: On team radio after the race following his struggle on worn tyres, Hamilton apologised for "my call" around the strategy, a position he subsequently reiterated on social media when he admitted he had learned a "painful lesson" by choosing "a strategy that ultimately didn't deliver".
paras.zh: 赛后，汉密尔顿在车队广播中为磨损轮胎的“我的决定”道歉，他随后在社交媒体上重申了这一立场，承认自己通过选择“最终没有实现的策略”而吸取了“痛苦的教训”。

paras.en: - How Kimi Antonelli could win F1 world title as soon as the next race
paras.zh: - 基米·安东内利如何能够在下一场比赛中赢得 F1 世界冠军

paras.en: It was the second weekend in a row that post-race debate around Ferrari had centred on race strategy.
paras.zh: 这是连续第二个周末围绕法拉利的赛后辩论集中在比赛策略上。

paras.en: At the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia the week before, Ferrari's drivers slipped to the back of the field in the twice-delayed race's early stages after the team had been among those to make the mistake of starting on slick tyres when the track was too wet.
paras.zh: 一周前在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛上，法拉利车队的车手在两次推迟的比赛的早期阶段就滑落到了赛场的后面，因为车队是在赛道太湿的情况下使用光头轮胎起步的错误之一。

paras.en: Hamilton later said the process around that call, which he had questioned at the time, had prompted a "huge discussion" after the race.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿后来表示，他当时对此提出质疑的整个过程在赛后引发了“巨大的讨论”。

paras.en: Hamilton eventually fought back to an impressive third place at Sepang after deciding to stay on the slicks longer than team-mate Charles Leclerc, a gamble aided by the timely appearance of the Safety Car as the track dried.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿决定在光头胎上停留的时间比队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔更长，最终在雪邦赛道上奋力夺回令人印象深刻的第三名，这场赌博得益于赛道干燥时安全车的及时出现。

paras.en: So after further issues in Singapore, this time with Hamilton overriding Ferrari's request to pit under the VSC, the latest edition of the The F1 Show podcast included analysis on the situation at the Scuderia...
paras.zh: 因此，在新加坡发生更多问题之后，这一次汉密尔顿推翻了法拉利在 VSC 下进站的要求，最新一期的 F1 Show 播客包括了对 Scuderia 情况的分析……

paras.en: Has trust broken down over strategy calls?
paras.zh: 信任是否因战略呼吁而破裂？

paras.en: Sky Sports F1's Bernie Collins, a former head of race strategy at Aston Martin, was first asked whether Singapore was evidence that the trust between Hamilton and the Ferrari pit wall had broken down.
paras.zh: 天空体育F1的伯尼·柯林斯（阿斯顿·马丁前比赛策略主管）首先被问及新加坡是否证明汉密尔顿和法拉利维修站之间的信任已经破裂。

paras.en: "Lewis started on the medium tyre, which is one of the things he actually came out and said he thought in hindsight was the wrong decision, but was his decision," said Collins.
paras.zh: “刘易斯开始使用中性轮胎，这是他实际上出来的事情之一，他说事后认为这是错误的决定，但这是他的决定，”柯林斯说。

paras.en: "He decided to go that way strategically at the beginning of the race.
paras.zh: “他在比赛一开始就决定战略性地走这条路。

paras.en: "He stops earlier than everybody else so instantly when we're watching at home, we're thinking, 'okay, he's probably on a two-stop here' because he's the first of any of the cars really to stop.
paras.zh: “他比其他人停车得早，所以当我们在家观看比赛时，我们会想，‘好吧，他可能在这里停了两站’，因为他是所有真正停下来的赛车中第一辆。

paras.en: "He puts on that soft tyre. Then they get this perfect opportunity with the virtual safety car to stop again, take another set of soft tyres. You could see the soft was a better tyre and you could see that it was going to be much faster to put a new set on.
paras.zh: “他穿上了软胎。然后他们在虚拟安全车的帮助下再次停下来，换上另一套软胎。你可以看到软胎是更好的轮胎，你可以看到换上新胎会更快。

paras.en: "On the coverage at home, we didn't hear any call from Ferrari to box Lewis, but we don't hear a lot of the calls that happen. Fred [Vasseur] obviously came out afterwards and said, yes, they did call him, Lewis missed the entry or ignored the call, whichever way you want to think about it.
paras.zh: “在国内的报道中，我们没有听到法拉利打给刘易斯的任何电话，但我们没有听到很多发生的电话。弗雷德[瓦瑟]显然后来出来说，是的，他们确实打电话给他，刘易斯错过了入场或忽略了电话，无论你想怎么想。

paras.en: "But someone of Lewis's stature doesn't forget to do a pit stop. So let's say it's a decision to not take the pit entry or the call didn't come in time or whatever. But that was crucial, I think, to the race at that point.
paras.zh: “但是像刘易斯这样的人不会忘记进站。所以我们可以说，这是一个不进站的决定，或者电话没有及时到来或者其他什么。但我认为，这对当时的比赛至关重要。

paras.en: "If we go back a week, we had the same sort of lack of trust, for want of another word, in Malaysia."
paras.zh: “如果我们回到一周前，我们在马来西亚也同样缺乏信任，因为需要用另一个词来形容。”

paras.en: After Ferrari's tyre choice at the start in Malaysia saw their drivers fall more than a minute off the lead, Hamilton's decision from the car to cut their losses and wait it out on the slicks ultimately paid dividends.
paras.zh: 在马来西亚站出发时，法拉利的轮胎选择导致他们的车手落后领先优势一分多钟，汉密尔顿决定在赛车上减少损失并在光头胎上等待，最终获得了回报。

paras.en: Collins added: "That shows, more globally, that Lewis isn't trusting that Ferrari team.
paras.zh: 柯林斯补充道：“这表明，从全球范围来看，刘易斯并不信任法拉利车队。

paras.en: "He's questioning their decisions and in this sort of quick-decision VSC moment, there's not the time to have all the back and forth about what he thinks or why he thinks it or doesn't think it.
paras.zh: “他在质疑他们的决定，在这种快速决策的 VSC 时刻，没有时间来回讨论他的想法或为什么他这么认为或不这么认为。

paras.en: "But it's very difficult from a pit wall and Lewis's side to then think, 'okay, last week I questioned them. I think I was correct. This week I'm going to question them, maybe I'm correct or incorrect.'
paras.zh: “但是从维修区墙和刘易斯这边很难想，‘好吧，上周我质疑了他们。我认为我是对的。本周我将质疑他们，也许我是对的或不正确的。’”

paras.en: "And then there was opportunity later on, I think, even after they missed the VSC, to do a full pit stop and still be able to beat Piastri and they didn't take that either.
paras.zh: “我认为，即使他们错过了 VSC，后来也有机会进行一次完整的进站，但仍然能够击败皮亚斯特里，但他们也没有抓住这个机会。

paras.en: "There was the decision then to string it out and hope for another safety car.
paras.zh: “当时我们决定推迟比赛并希望再派出另一辆安全车。

paras.en: "There were lots of decisions that should have been done differently and they should be having a very difficult conversation between Lewis and his engineers, or the strategy team or Fred [Vasseur], whoever needs to be involved, to say, 'where is the trust?
paras.zh: “有很多决定应该以不同的方式做出，他们应该在刘易斯和他的工程师、战略团队或 Fred [Vasseur] 之间进行非常艰难的对话，无论谁需要参与，他们都会说，‘信任在哪里？

paras.en: 'When we make these decisions, what is the protocol for how that decision is taken and why?'"
paras.zh: “当我们做出这些决定时，如何做出决定的协议是什么？为什么？”

paras.en: Do Ferrari need to give Hamilton more information in the car earlier?
paras.zh: 法拉利是否需要提前向汉密尔顿提供更多赛车信息？

paras.en: Collins believes that, generally, drivers do need to defer to the pit wall around such decisions given a team's strategists have a fuller picture of what is going on in the race.
paras.zh: 柯林斯认为，一般来说，考虑到车队的策略师对比赛中发生的情况有更全面的了解，车手确实需要遵守维修区的决定。

paras.en: However, she used an example from her time at Aston Martin with four-time world champion Sebastian Vettel as showing how teams can also give drivers more information leading up to pit stops.
paras.zh: 然而，她用了她在阿斯顿·马丁与四届世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔一起工作时的例子来展示车队如何在进站前为车手提供更多信息。

paras.en: "In my opinion, yes, [drivers] should [defer to the pit wall]," said Collins. "They're the people with the most information. They're the people with the big picture.
paras.zh: “在我看来，是的，[车手]应该[服从维修区墙壁]，”柯林斯说。 “他们是掌握最多信息的人。他们是了解全局的人。

paras.en: "However, there's another band of thought that says the driver is the most expensive sensor in the car. And I often had situations with Sebastian Vettel, who was very strong strategically, where we ended up starting to give him pit stop information earlier than we would give another driver in order to give him a sort of right to reply.
paras.zh: “然而，还有另一种观点认为，车手是赛车中最昂贵的传感器。我经常遇到塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔的情况，他在战略上非常强大，我们最终开始向他提供进站信息，然后再向其他车手提供，以便给他某种回复权。

paras.en: "If your driver regularly questions strategy, then you need to maybe give them the information.
paras.zh: “如果你的司机经常质疑策略，那么你可能需要向他们提供信息。

paras.en: "Many teams, lots and lots of teams in the situation that Ferrari were in, five laps before the safety car would have said, 'if there's a safety car now, we will take it and double stack the cars'. And that gives Lewis a chance to say, 'I think that's right, I think that's wrong'.
paras.zh: “很多车队，很多很多车队在法拉利所处的情况下，在安全车出动前五圈时都会说，‘如果现在有安全车，我们会接受它并双层堆放赛车’。这让刘易斯有机会说，‘我认为这是对的，我认为这是错的’。

paras.en: "You've a bit of a discussion about it. Yes, you're giving away information to other teams, which people don't want to do, but you're making the right decision for you and that is your P1 goal. So they need to bring the conversation forward if there's going to be a back and forth."
paras.zh: “你们对此进行了一些讨论。是的，你向其他团队泄露了信息，人们不想这样做，但你正在做出正确的决定，这就是你的 P1 目标。因此，如果需要来回讨论，他们需要推进对话。”

paras.en: What are the lessons for both Hamilton and Ferrari?
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿和法拉利的教训是什么？

paras.en: Fellow Sky Sports F1 pundit and former driver Karun Chandhok believes "they've got to have some sort of reset" in terms of how they approach strategy discussions and decisions at Ferrari.
paras.zh: 天空体育 F1 评论员兼前车手卡伦·钱德霍克 (Karun Chandhok) 认为，在法拉利如何进行战略讨论和决策方面，“他们必须进行某种重新调整”。

paras.en: "Lewis was annoyed with the way Ferrari played that whole race," said Chandhok.
paras.zh: “刘易斯对法拉利整场比赛的表现感到恼火，”钱多克说。

paras.en: "If you look at it, he started on the medium tyre. Of the top-seven finishers, he was the only one to start on the medium tyre, yet he pitted first. They were clearly unhappy with his pace on the medium. We know it was a less preferred tyre, so they tried to get him off that tyre quickly. Fine.
paras.zh: “如果你看一下，他是用中性轮胎起步的。在前七名的车手中，他是唯一一个用中性轮胎起步的人，但他先进站。他们显然对他在中性轮胎上的速度不满意。我们知道这是一个不太受欢迎的轮胎，所以他们试图尽快让他摆脱那个轮胎。很好。

paras.en: "But then you have to look at the overall race time and they didn't look at that. They put him out behind Leclerc and then he sat there getting annoyed [at] the fact that he's not getting past Leclerc, and they didn't explain to either driver, that they need a swap. They didn't do a good job in that phase of the race.
paras.zh: “但是你必须看看整个比赛时间，而他们没有考虑这一点。他们把他放在勒克莱尔后面，然后他坐在那里，因为他没有超越勒克莱尔而感到恼火，他们没有向任何一位车手解释他们需要交换。他们在比赛的那个阶段做得不好。

paras.en: "So then you've got Lewis who's now three seconds behind Charles annoyed that he's not been allowed to get in front. The VSC comes out, Charles boxes and he thinks, 'well, I'm going to have free air. I'm going to go for it.'
paras.zh: “所以现在落后查尔斯三秒的刘易斯很恼火，因为他不被允许领先。VSC 出来了，查尔斯装箱，他想，‘好吧，我将有自由空气。我要努力。’”

paras.en: "He's not thinking of the big picture of the race and that's why I think the strategy team needed to say to him, 'Lewis, your tyres are 21 laps old now, you are going to get passed. You're going to drop like a stone when it comes to pace with all these people.'
paras.zh: “他没有考虑比赛的大局，这就是为什么我认为策略团队需要对他说，‘刘易斯，你的轮胎现在已经用了 21 圈了，你将会超越。当你跟上所有这些人的速度时，你会像石头一样掉下来。’”

paras.en: "Leclerc didn't have new soft tyres but he had a set that had done one run in qualy, and you could just see, he came out of the pits and was two seconds a lap faster than Lewis when the VSC cleared.
paras.zh: “勒克莱尔没有新的软胎，但他有一套在排位赛中跑过一圈的轮胎，你可以看到，当 VSC 清空时，他从维修站出来，每圈比刘易斯快两秒。

paras.en: "And that's where any driver has to trust and believe their strategy team and take the inputs and make that decision. But, equally, it's on the team to explain the big picture to the driver and navigate the whole thing and I don't think Ferrari did a good job across the whole race there."
paras.zh: “这就是任何车手都必须信任和相信他们的策略团队并接受意见并做出决定的地方。但是，同样地，团队有责任向车手解释大局并引导整个事情，我不认为法拉利在整场比赛中做得很好。”

articles.title: Red Bull extend team boss Mekies' contract

paras.en: Laurent Mekies: Red Bull team principal signs contract extension to 2031 and vows recent wins 'only the beginning'

paras.zh: 红牛宣布与上赛季取代克里斯蒂安·霍纳的球队主教练劳伦特·梅基斯续签五年合同；观看 10 月 23 日至 25 日在奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛的每一场比赛，天空体育 F1 直播

paras.en: Laurent Mekies has signed a five-year contract extension to continue as Red Bull team principal and chief executive until 2031.
paras.zh: 劳伦特·梅基斯 (Laurent Mekies) 签署了一份为期五年的续约合同，将继续担任红牛车队领队兼首席执行官，直至 2031 年。

paras.en: Mekies joined the team from sister outfit Racing Bulls in July 2025 after Christian Horner was sacked following 20 years in charge.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳 (Christian Horner) 在执掌球队 20 年后被解雇后，梅基斯于 2025 年 7 月从姐妹球队 Racing Bulls 加入球队。

paras.en: News of Mekies' contract renewal comes in the wake of Red Bull claiming their first two wins of the season, both courtesy of Max Verstappen, over the past fortnight in Malaysia and Singapore.
paras.zh: 梅基斯续约的消息传出之前，红牛在过去两周的马来西亚和新加坡比赛中赢得了本赛季的前两场胜利，这两项胜利均由马克斯·维斯塔潘提供。

paras.en: They are fourth in the Constructors' Championship but have closed to within seven points of third-placed McLaren in what is shaping up to be a very competitive end to their first year as an engine manufacturer.
paras.zh: 他们在车队积分榜上排名第四，但与第三名迈凯轮的差距仅差七分，这将是他们作为发动机制造商第一年的极具竞争力的结局。

paras.en: Verstappen extended his Red Bull contract to 2030 in August, while Isack Hadjar was also handed a contract renewal into 2027 after impressing in his first season at Milton Keynes.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在八月份将他的红牛合同延长至2030年，而伊萨克·哈贾尔在米尔顿凯恩斯的第一个赛季给人留下了深刻的印象后也将合同续约至2027年。

paras.en: In a joint statement announcing Mekies' extended deal, Red Bull shareholders Chalerm Yoovidhya and Mark Mateschitz said: "The strength of Red Bull has always come from its people and from creating an environment where talented individuals can achieve extraordinary things together.
paras.zh: 在一份宣布 Mekies 续约的联合声明中，红牛股东 Chalerm Yoovidhya 和 Mark Mateschitz 表示：“红牛的力量始终来自其员工，以及创造一个让才华横溢的个人能够共同实现非凡成就的环境。

paras.en: "Laurent has played a crucial role in guiding the team through an important period of transition while maintaining the competitive spirit and the Red Bull principles that define us.
paras.zh: “劳伦特在引导球队度过一个重要的过渡时期方面发挥了至关重要的作用，同时保持了竞争精神和定义我们的红牛原则。

paras.en: "This extension reflects our confidence in his leadership and our shared belief in the long term vision of the team.
paras.zh: “这次延期反映了我们对他的领导能力的信心以及我们对团队长期愿景的共同信念。

paras.en: "We are ambitious about what lies ahead and we are committed to building on this momentum together."
paras.zh: “我们对未来充满雄心，并致力于共同巩固这一势头。”

paras.en: Mekies, who has also previously worked at Ferrari and the FIA, said: "I am incredibly proud to continue this journey with Oracle Red Bull Racing, and I would like to thank Chalerm, Mark, and Oliver [Mintzlaff], the entire team, and everyone involved for the trust they have placed in the project.
paras.zh: 曾在法拉利和国际汽联工作过的梅基斯表示：“我非常自豪能够与甲骨文红牛车队一起继续这一旅程，我要感谢查勒姆、马克和奥利弗[明茨拉夫]、整个团队以及所有参与人员对该项目的信任。

paras.en: "What makes this team special is the way everyone comes together in pursuit of the same goal, and I feel privileged to work alongside such a talented and committed group every day.
paras.zh: “这个团队的特别之处在于每个人都聚集在一起追求同一个目标，我很荣幸每天能与这样一个才华横溢、忠诚的团队一起工作。

paras.en: "Together, with Pierre Wache's and Ben Hodgkinson's teams playing a central role in shaping our future, we have a strong platform for the years ahead, and we genuinely believe this is only the beginning.
paras.zh: “皮埃尔·瓦什 (Pierre Wache) 和本·霍奇金森 (Ben Hodgkinson) 的团队在塑造我们的未来方面发挥着核心作用，我们为未来几年提供了一个强大的平台，我们真诚地相信这只是一个开始。

paras.en: "As we look ahead, we will continue to embrace the principles that define us: being free in our thinking, fast in our actions and bold in our decisions."
paras.zh: “展望未来，我们将继续秉承定义我们的原则：自由思考、快速行动、大胆决策。”

paras.en: Oliver Mintzlaff, Red Bull's CEO of corporate projects and investments, also hailed the 49-year-old's Mekies' leadership qualities.
paras.zh: 红牛公司项目和投资首席执行官奥利弗·明茨拉夫 (Oliver Mintzlaff) 也对这位 49 岁的梅基斯的领导才能表示赞赏。

paras.en: "Laurent has demonstrated outstanding leadership since returning to the Red Bull family," he said.
paras.zh: “自从回到红牛大家庭以来，劳伦特表现出了出色的领导能力，”他说。

paras.en: "He combines technical expertise, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of what makes our team successful. Just as importantly, he embodies the values and mentality that define the Red Bull way: courage, teamwork, determination, and an unrelenting desire to compete at the highest level.
paras.zh: “他结合了技术专长、战略思维以及对我们团队成功因素的深刻理解。同样重要的是，他体现了定义红牛方式的价值观和心态：勇气、团队合作、决心以及在最高水平竞争的不懈渴望。

paras.en: "Continuity in leadership is a key ingredient for sustained success, and we are delighted that Laurent will continue to lead the team through the next chapter of our journey."
paras.zh: “领导力的连续性是持续成功的关键因素，我们很高兴 Laurent 将继续带领团队完成我们旅程的下一个篇章。”

articles.title: Pope Leo slept well after cancer surgery, but recovery could take ‘longer than expected’
articles.author: Corky Siemaszko

paras.en: VATICAN CITY — Pope Leo XIV’s recovery from lung surgery could take “longer than expected,” the president of Peru warned Wednesday, as the leader of the Roman Catholic Church continued to mend at Rome’s Gemelli Hospital.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈城——秘鲁总统周三警告说，教皇利奥十四世从肺部手术中恢复过来可能需要“比预期更长的时间”，而这位罗马天主教会领袖仍在罗马杰梅利医院继续康复。

paras.en: Keiko Fujimori, in an interview on Peruvian television, said the pace of the pope’s recovery could determine whether Leo makes his weeklong apostolic visit to Peru, which was set to start on Nov. 11.
paras.zh: 藤森庆子在接受秘鲁电视台采访时表示，教宗康复的速度可能会决定利奥是否会进行为期一周的宗座访问秘鲁，这次访问定于 11 月 11 日开始。

paras.en: “I want the pope to know that here in Peru, millions of us are praying for his speedy recovery,” Fujimori said. “We will also be watching for any announcements from the Vatican, because we understand that his recovery will take several weeks longer than expected and, therefore, we also understand that there could be some changes to the schedule of his visit.”
paras.zh: 藤森说：“我想让教皇知道，在秘鲁，我们数百万人正在祈祷他早日康复。” “我们还将关注梵蒂冈的任何公告，因为我们知道他的康复时间将比预期长几周，因此我们也知道他的访问日程可能会发生一些变化。”

paras.en: Leo, who is a Chicago native, spent more than two decades working in Peru and maintains close ties with that South American country.
paras.zh: 利奥是芝加哥人，他在秘鲁工作了二十多年，并与这个南美国家保持着密切的联系。

paras.en: Fujimori’s announcement was somewhat at odds with the Vatican’s assertion on Wednesday that the pope was recovering as expected after a surgery to remove part of his right lung, which confirmed a cancer diagnosis.
paras.zh: 藤森的声明与梵蒂冈周三的说法有些不一致，梵蒂冈周三称教皇在接受部分右肺切除手术后正在按预期康复，该手术证实了癌症诊断。

paras.en: The medical team taking care of the 71-year-old pontiff said he had undergone routine blood tests and a chest X-ray and that, so far, the results “confirm a normal post-operative course: the values are within the expected range for the type of procedure performed.”
paras.zh: 照顾这位 71 岁教皇的医疗团队表示，他已经接受了常规血液检查和胸部 X 光检查，到目前为止，结果“证实了正常的术后过程：这些值在所执行手术类型的预期范围内”。

paras.en: The pope has begun walking around his hospital room and ate both breakfast and lunch on Wednesday, they said.
paras.zh: 他们说，教皇已经开始在他的病房里走动，并在周三吃了早餐和午餐。

paras.en: So far, Leo’s doctors have given no indication that the pontiff might need any further treatment. And the Vatican has not indicated whether the cancer might have spread.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，利奥的医生没有任何迹象表明教皇可能需要任何进一步的治疗。梵蒂冈尚未表明癌症是否可能已经扩散。

paras.en: Leo was diagnosed with adenocarcinoma, a type of non-small cell lung cancer, after doctors examined the nodule they had removed from his right lung.
paras.zh: 医生检查了从利奥右肺取出的结节后，利奥被诊断出患有腺癌，这是一种非小细胞肺癌。

paras.en: Non-small cell lung cancer accounts for 80% of all cases of the disease, according to the American Lung Association.
paras.zh: 根据美国肺脏协会的数据，非小细胞肺癌占所有肺癌病例的 80%。

paras.en: Leo spent a calm night in the hospital after surgery to remove a malignant lung nodule was completed “successfully, on schedule and as planned,” the Vatican said Tuesday. Leo was in the operating room for nearly three hours, it said.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈周二表示，恶性肺结节切除手术“成功、按计划、按计划”完成后，利奥在医院度过了一个平静的夜晚。据称，利奥在手术室待了近三个小时。

paras.en: The initial lump was detected during a routine check, the Vatican has said. The leader of the world’s 1.4 billion Catholics took the rare step of revealing the health issue — the first of his papacy — during his Sunday noon prayer.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈表示，最初的肿块是在例行检查中发现的。这位世界 14 亿天主教徒的领袖在周日中午的祈祷中采取了罕见的举措，披露了这一健康问题，这是他就任教皇以来的第一个举措。

paras.en: Leo waved to crowds outside Rome’s Gemelli Hospital as he entered Tuesday.
paras.zh: 利奥周二进入罗马杰梅利医院时向人群挥手致意。

paras.en: The procedure was led by Dr. Stefano Margaritora, Gemelli’s chief thoracic surgeon, with medical staff reciting the rosary prayer in the hospital chapel as the operation began.
paras.zh: 手术由 Gemelli 的首席胸外科医生 Stefano Margaritora 博士主持，手术开始时，医护人员在医院教堂里背诵玫瑰经。

paras.en: Following his surgery, the pontiff “woke up normally and, after a brief period of observation, returned to his room on the tenth floor,” the Vatican said. The room is next to the usual papal apartment, complete with private chapel, which is currently undergoing renovations.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈表示，手术后，教皇“正常醒来，经过短暂的观察后，回到了十楼的房间”。该房间毗邻通常的教皇公寓，配有私人教堂，目前正在进行装修。

paras.en: This type of cancer affects both smokers and nonsmokers, although Leo is not known to ever have been a smoker.
paras.zh: 这种类型的癌症会影响吸烟者和非吸烟者，尽管人们并不知道利奥曾经吸烟过。

paras.en: The cancer diagnosis could complicate his busy schedule.
paras.zh: 癌症的诊断可能会使他繁忙的日程变得更加复杂。

paras.en: Just weeks earlier, hundreds of thousands of people packed the streets of Paris for an outdoor Mass on a visit that saw Leo warn about the risks of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 就在几周前，数十万人涌上巴黎街头参加户外弥撒，利奥对人工智能的风险提出了警告。

paras.en: He was planning to take a historic two-week visit to South America next month, although it is unclear if that will still go ahead.
paras.zh: 他计划下个月对南美洲进行历史性的为期两周的访问，尽管目前尚不清楚这是否仍会继续进行。

paras.en: Messages of support and sympathy flowed in after the news.
paras.zh: 消息传出后，人们纷纷表示支持和同情。

paras.en: Dr. Fernando Daniels III, a 67-year-old physician from Maryland was among many praying for Leo’s swift recovery in the Vatican’s St. Peter’s Square.
paras.zh: 来自马里兰州的 67 岁医生费尔南多·丹尼尔斯三世 (Fernando Daniels III) 博士是众多在梵蒂冈圣彼得广场为利奥早日康复祈祷的人之一。

paras.en: “I’ve seen miracles in medicine. I’ve seen people told with terminal illnesses they wouldn’t live and they did,” he told NBC News.
paras.zh: “我见过医学奇迹。我见过患有绝症的人被告知他们无法生存，但他们却活了下来，”他告诉 NBC 新闻。

paras.en: “Prayers of all should heal him,” said Daniels, who was traveling as part of a group.
paras.zh: “所有人的祈祷应该可以治愈他，”随团旅行的丹尼尔斯说。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said he and his wife, Jeanette Rubio, were praying for the pope.
paras.zh: 国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，他和妻子珍妮特·卢比奥正在为教皇祈祷。

paras.en: “May the Lord give him strength and the Holy Spirit guide the medical professionals taking care of the Holy Father,” Rubio said on X.
paras.zh: 卢比奥在 X 频道上说道：“愿主赐予他力量，愿圣灵引导医疗专业人员照顾教宗。”

paras.en: “We thank God that the surgery on Pope Leo was, by all accounts, successful, and that he continues his recovery and recuperation,” New York City’s Archbishop Ronald Hicks said in a statement.
paras.zh: 纽约市大主教罗纳德·希克斯在一份声明中说：“我们感谢上帝，教皇利奥的手术从各方面来看都是成功的，并且他正在继续康复。”

paras.en: German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier, whose role is largely ceremonial, wished Leo a speedy and full recovery, the German Catholic news agency KNA reported.
paras.zh: 据德国天主教通讯社 KNA 报道，德国总统弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔的角色主要是仪式性的，他祝愿利奥早日完全康复。

paras.en: “The pope’s voice on the current issues and challenges of our time is of particular importance and of value to many people worldwide, including in Germany, beyond denominational boundaries,” Steinmeier was quoted as saying.
paras.zh: 施泰因迈尔表示：“教皇就我们这个时代当前的问题和挑战发出的声音，对于包括德国在内的世界各地的许多人来说，超越教派界限，特别重要和有价值。”

paras.en: Claudio Lavanga reported from Vatican City, Mithil Aggarwal reported from Hong Kong, and Corky Siemaszko reported from New York City.
paras.zh: Claudio Lavanga 从梵蒂冈城报道，Mithil Aggarwal 从香港报道，Corky Siemaszko 从纽约市报道。

articles.title: Ukraine accuses SpaceX of restricting Starlink, disrupting military as it reels from intel gaps
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Ukraine has accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of undermining its ability to defend itself by limiting Starlink internet services, as the country reeled from intense Russian ballistic missile attacks that it said came without the usual advance warning from allies.
paras.zh: 乌克兰指责埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 通过限制 Starlink 互联网服务来削弱其自卫能力，因为该国正遭受俄罗斯猛烈弹道导弹袭击，并称这些袭击是在没有得到盟友通常提前警告的情况下进行的。

paras.en: Facing pressure from President Donald Trump to halt strikes on Russia’s energy industry, Kyiv and its backers have worried Washington could cut off battlefield support to try and force it into concessions at the negotiating table.
paras.zh: 面对唐纳德·特朗普总统要求停止对俄罗斯能源工业的打击，基辅及其支持者担心华盛顿可能会切断战场支持，试图迫使其在谈判桌上让步。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials and their European partners were already scrambling to understand the status of U.S. intelligence sharing after the lack of alert ahead of two Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv this week, two Ukrainian and two European officials told NBC News.
paras.zh: 两名乌克兰官员和两名欧洲官员告诉NBC新闻，在俄罗斯本周对基辅进行两次弹道导弹袭击之前，乌克兰官员及其欧洲合作伙伴已经开始争先恐后地了解美国情报共享的现状。

paras.en: Trump insisted the U.S. was still sharing intel, but with relations spiraling Ukrainian officials and military units were on Wednesday accusing SpaceX of throttling a technology essential to their battlefield communications and drone operations.
paras.zh: 特朗普坚称美国仍在分享情报，但随着关系不断升级，乌克兰官员和军事单位周三指责 SpaceX 限制了对其战场通信和无人机行动至关重要的一项技术。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear what might be behind the Starlink interruptions, though some Ukrainian officials said the timing could not be a coincidence given that Musk is a close Trump ally.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚星链中断背后的原因，但一些乌克兰官员表示，考虑到马斯克是特朗普的亲密盟友，这一时机不可能是巧合。

paras.en: The Ukrainian government has yet to receive a response from SpaceX, a Ukrainian official told NBC News, and Ukrainian units are already reporting issues with performance even at lower UAV speeds.
paras.zh: 乌克兰政府尚未收到 SpaceX 的回应，一名乌克兰官员告诉 NBC 新闻，乌克兰单位已经报告了即使在较低无人机速度下也存在性能问题。

paras.en: Asked about the importance of the technology, Ukraine’s Charge d’Affaires to the U.S. Denys Sienik said Starshield is live saving. “The technology helps us save the lives of civilians and prevent more destructions in Ukraine caused by Russian side.”
paras.zh: 当被问及这项技术的重要性时，乌克兰驻美国临时代办丹尼斯·西尼克表示，“星盾”可以拯救生命。 “该技术帮助我们拯救平民的生命，并防止俄罗斯方面在乌克兰造成更多破坏。”

paras.en: SpaceX had introduced speed limits on the operation of its Starlink satellite internet terminals overnight, according to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s defense tech adviser, Serhii Beskrestnov.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 的国防技术顾问谢尔希·别斯克雷斯诺夫 (Serhii Beskrestnov) 表示，SpaceX 已在一夜之间对其 Starlink 卫星互联网终端的运行进行了速度限制。

paras.en: “Our defence forces received no warning of such a restriction, and this led to the failure of a number of missions,” Beskrestnov said on Telegram. “It is obvious that this action cannot be a coincidence and is connected to the current political situation,” he added.
paras.zh: 贝斯克雷斯诺夫在 Telegram 上表示：“我们的国防军没有收到有关此类限制的警告，这导致了许多任务的失败。” “显然，这一行动不可能是巧合，而是与当前的政治局势有关，”他补充道。

paras.en: An army unit fighting in the southeastern Zaporizhzhia region said Wednesday it had been forced to cancel some planned operations.
paras.zh: 在扎波罗热地区东南部作战的一支军队周三表示，他们被迫取消了一些计划中的行动。

paras.en: The 7th Rapid Reaction Corps of the Ukrainian air assault forces said it began “noticing Starlink connectivity problems caused by data transfer speed limits” overnight, adding that the changes directly affected drones that use the service for in-flight control.
paras.zh: 乌克兰空中突击部队第七快速反应军表示，他们在一夜之间开始“注意到数据传输速度限制导致的星链连接问题”，并补充说这些变化直接影响了使用该服务进行飞行控制的无人机。

paras.en: “The drones kept flying, but the interruptions made them harder to control,” it said in a statement.
paras.zh: “无人机继续飞行，但中断使它们更难控制，”该公司在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: Beskrestnov said that restrictions were specifically put on the operation of the military-grade version of Starlink at speeds above 100 mph.
paras.zh: 贝斯克雷斯诺夫表示，军用级星链版本的运行速度超过 100 英里/小时时受到了特别限制。

paras.en: Starlink was also key for Ukraine’s aerial defenses as it was used to intercept the jet-powered drones that Moscow has unleashed on Ukrainian cities in recent months, he added. Asked about the importance of the technology, Ukraine’s Charge d’Affaires to the U.S. Denys Sienik said “the technology helps us save the lives of civilians and prevent more destruction in Ukraine caused by the Russian side.”
paras.zh: 他补充说，星链对于乌克兰的防空也至关重要，因为它被用来拦截莫斯科近几个月向乌克兰城市发射的喷气式无人机。当被问及这项技术的重要性时，乌克兰驻美国临时代办丹尼斯·希尼克表示，“这项技术有助于我们拯救平民的生命，并防止俄罗斯方面在乌克兰造成更多破坏。”

paras.en: Ukraine has reached out to the U.S. government and SpaceX for clarification on the rationale for the new restrictions but has yet to receive a response, according to a Ukrainian official.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员表示，乌克兰已联系美国政府和 SpaceX，要求澄清新限制的理由，但尚未收到回应。

paras.en: Ukraine’s armed forces learned about the limitations from customer support after filing a complaint regarding operational issues, the official said, adding that SpaceX had not warned of the move.
paras.zh: 该官员表示，乌克兰武装部队在提交有关操作问题的投诉后从客户支持中了解到了这些限制，并补充说 SpaceX 并未就此举发出警告。

paras.en: Ukrainian military units were already reporting issues with drone performance at even lower speeds, the official added.
paras.zh: 这位官员补充说，乌克兰军事单位已经报告了无人机在更低速度下的性能问题。

paras.en: The White House, SpaceX and Starlink did not immediately respond to requests for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: 白宫、SpaceX 和 Starlink 没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: The disruption follows days of mounting tensions between Kyiv and Washington, as Trump pushes to lower gas prices ahead of the midterm elections. Trump’s latest reversal in his bid to settle the war saw him stun Kyiv by striking a diesel deal with Russia that upended years of U.S. sanctions.
paras.zh: 由于特朗普在中期选举前推动降低天然气价格，基辅和华盛顿之间的紧张局势持续几天，造成了混乱。特朗普在解决战争问题上的最新转变是，他与俄罗斯达成了一项柴油协议，推翻了美国多年的制裁，震惊了基辅。

paras.en: He then demanded that Ukraine stop attacking Russian oil refineries and called for Zelenskyy to be replaced. Trump also announced an “energy ceasefire” that neither warring side appears to have agreed to.
paras.zh: 随后他要求乌克兰停止袭击俄罗斯炼油厂，并呼吁泽连斯基被替换。特朗普还宣布了“能源停火”，但交战双方似乎都没有同意。

paras.en: Kyiv said it had refrained from striking Russian energy targets to respect Trump’s wishes, but the Kremlin has continued to hit Ukrainian energy infrastructure in its annual effort to leave its neighbor in the freezing dark as winter sets in.
paras.zh: 基辅表示，为了尊重特朗普的意愿，它没有袭击俄罗斯的能源目标，但克里姆林宫继续袭击乌克兰的能源基础设施，以使其邻国在冬季来临之际陷入寒冷的黑暗之中。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said Tuesday that Ukraine had not received any early warning from its partners about “a particularly vile ballistic missile strike on Kyiv” a day earlier. Explosions rang out before an alert was issued, according to an NBC News producer in the capital.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周二表示，乌克兰没有收到其合作伙伴关于一天前“对基辅进行特别邪恶的弹道导弹袭击”的任何预警。据首都的一位 NBC 新闻制片人称，在发出警报之前就发生了爆炸。

paras.en: “Intelligence on Russian ballistic missile launches helps save lives, and this is one of the most critical issues,” Zelenskyy said, without singling out the U.S.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示：“有关俄罗斯弹道导弹发射的情报有助于拯救生命，这是最关键的问题之一。”但他没有单独点名美国。

paras.en: Later Tuesday, he reported another strike on Kyiv was “the second time Ukraine was not warned.”
paras.zh: 周二晚些时候，他报告说，对基辅的另一次袭击是“乌克兰第二次没有收到警告”。

paras.en: Since Russia invaded Ukraine more than four years ago, the U.S. has provided significant satellite and eavesdropping intelligence to Kyiv. European partners also share intelligence with Kyiv, but Ukrainian officials see the U.S. intelligence assistance as crucial to their fight against Russia.
paras.zh: 自四年多前俄罗斯入侵乌克兰以来，美国向基辅提供了重要的卫星和窃听情报。欧洲伙伴也与基辅分享情报，但乌克兰官员认为美国的情报援助对于他们对抗俄罗斯至关重要。

paras.en: Trump denied withholding information critical to Ukraine’s defense, despite reported threats to cut off U.S. intelligence if Kyiv failed to stop its attacks on Russian refineries.
paras.zh: 特朗普否认隐瞒对乌克兰国防至关重要的信息，尽管有报道称，如果基辅未能阻止对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击，他将切断美国情报。

paras.en: “We are helping them and we are sharing intel,” the president told reporters Tuesday.
paras.zh: “我们正在帮助他们，我们正在分享情报，”总统周二告诉记者。

paras.en: After the first Russian attack Monday, when five ballistic missiles were able to strike civilian infrastructure without advance notice from the U.S., two Ukrainian officials told NBC News it was the result of a technical issue, or glitch, in U.S. intelligence sharing.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯周一发动首次袭击，五枚弹道导弹在没有美国事先通知的情况下袭击了民用基础设施，两名乌克兰官员告诉 NBC 新闻，这是美国情报共享中出现技术问题或故障的结果。

paras.en: Speaking at the Warsaw Security Forum, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha also reassured the audience that U.S. intelligence sharing continued, blaming the delayed alert on a “special type of the weaponry” used by Russia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈在华沙安全论坛上发表讲话时也向观众保证，美国情报共享仍在继续，并将延迟警报归咎于俄罗斯使用的“特殊类型武器”。

paras.en: But after the second attack Tuesday, Ukrainian and European officials said the reason was less clear.
paras.zh: 但周二发生第二次袭击后，乌克兰和欧洲官员表示原因尚不清楚。

paras.en: “We didn’t receive warning for a second time, and this doesn’t look like a coincidence,” one of the Ukrainian officials said.
paras.zh: “我们没有第二次收到警告，这看起来不像巧合，”一名乌克兰官员表示。

paras.en: The second Ukrainian official attributed the issue to bad weather. Two European officials told NBC News they were still trying to understand why there was no advance notice.
paras.zh: 第二位乌克兰官员将此问题归咎于恶劣天气。两名欧洲官员告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，他们仍在试图了解为什么没有提前通知。

paras.en: Ukrainian air force spokesman Col. Yurii Ihnat said Wednesday that after the second ballistic strike on Kyiv without a warning, “in the next three waves of attacks, notifications from partners about the use of ballistic weapons did come through.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰空军发言人尤里·伊纳特上校周三表示，在没有警告的情况下对基辅进行第二次弹道袭击后，“在接下来的三波袭击中，确实收到了合作伙伴关于使用弹道武器的通知。”

paras.en: The Kremlin noted the confusion Wednesday, but said it was “too early to draw any systemic conclusions.”
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周三注意到了这种混乱，但表示“现在得出任何系统性结论还为时过早”。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said that at least 600,000 people across Ukraine were without power Wednesday after the latest wave of Russian attacks, adding that President Vladimir Putin was in clear violation of the energy truce announced by Trump. “Russia has never before shown such ostentatious disrespect toward the United States,” he added.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，在俄罗斯最新一波袭击之后，周三乌克兰各地至少有 60 万人断电，并补充说总统弗拉基米尔·普京明显违反了特朗普宣布的能源休战协议。 “俄罗斯以前从未对美国表现出如此明显的不尊重，”他补充道。

paras.en: Like Trump, Musk has repeatedly oscillated in his stance on the war.
paras.zh: 和特朗普一样，马斯克在战争问题上的立场也多次摇摆不定。

paras.en: The billionaire turned on the Starlink satellite internet service over Ukraine shortly after Russia’s full-scale invasion in 2022.
paras.zh: 2022 年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后不久，这位亿万富翁就开启了乌克兰的星链卫星互联网服务。

paras.en: It has become a lifeline for war-torn parts of the country, but has also facilitated battlefield communications and enabled the use of longer-range drones, given its resistance to signal jamming.
paras.zh: 它已成为该国饱受战争蹂躏的地区的生命线，但由于其抗信号干扰能力，也促进了战场通信并允许使用远程无人机。

paras.en: Musk agreed to turn off thousands of Russian-used Starlinks in Ukraine this year, causing problems for the Kremlin’s forces. But in recent days, Musk has echoed Trump’s criticism.
paras.zh: 马斯克今年同意关闭乌克兰境内数千个俄罗斯使用的星链，这给克里姆林宫的军队带来了麻烦。但最近几天，马斯克回应了特朗普的批评。

paras.en: The suggestion that his company might have deliberately limited Ukraine’s battlefield operations drew criticism in Europe.
paras.zh: 有关他的公司可能故意限制乌克兰战场行动的说法引起了欧洲的批评。

paras.en: “Hey, @elonmusk, big man, are you playing politics with your products again?” Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski wrote in a post on X, referencing a past clash over Starlink in which Musk called him a “small man.”
paras.zh: “嘿，@elonmusk，大佬，你又用你的产品玩政治了吗？”波兰外交部长拉多斯瓦夫·西科尔斯基 (Radosław Sikorski) 在 X 上发表了一篇文章，提到了过去因星链而发生的冲突，马斯克在冲突中称他为“小人物”。

paras.en: Sikorski continued; “As your European customers, we are watching you.”
paras.zh: 西科尔斯基继续说道； “作为您的欧洲客户，我们正在关注您。”

articles.title: Cracking firetrucks, $1b funding shortfall identified in Victorian audit
articles.author: Kate Ashton

paras.en: Victoria's auditor-general says a $1.5 billion investment is needed to maintain and replace the state's fire trucks.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州审计长表示，需要投资 15 亿澳元来维护和更换该州的消防车。

paras.en: A report has found that a cracking issue with some trucks put firefighters at "direct risk".
paras.zh: 一份报告发现，一些卡车的裂纹问题使消防员面临“直接风险”。

paras.en: Premier Ben Carroll has acknowledged further investment is needed and the opposition has flagged that it is working on a plan to modernise the state's fire trucks.
paras.zh: 州长本·卡罗尔承认需要进一步投资，反对派则表示正在制定一项计划，使该州的消防车现代化。

paras.en: Victoria's auditor-general has found more than $1 billion in extra investment is needed to provide critical upgrades to the state's fleet of aging fire trucks.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州审计长发现，需要超过 10 亿澳元的额外投资来对该州老化的消防车车队进行关键升级。

paras.en: A report released by the auditor-general on Wednesday examined whether the fleet of more than 3,000 fire trucks were fit to meet the state's firefighting needs.
paras.zh: 审计长周三发布的一份报告审查了由 3,000 多辆消防车组成的车队是否适合满足该州的消防需求。

paras.en: The audit found almost 60 per cent of Country Fire Authority (CFA) and Fire Rescue Victoria (FRV) trucks were more than 15 years old, despite FRV internal documents recommending fire trucks be replaced at that age.
paras.zh: 审计发现，近 60% 的国家消防局 (CFA) 和维多利亚消防救援 (FRV) 卡车的车龄超过 15 年，尽管 FRV 内部文件建议在该车龄后更换消防车。

paras.en: Auditor-General Andrew Greaves found $1.5 billion in investment was needed between 2024-25 and 2033-34 to maintain and replace the trucks that make up the multi-agency firefighting fleet.
paras.zh: 审计长安德鲁·格里夫斯发现，2024-25 年至 2033-34 年期间需要 15 亿美元的投资来维护和更换组成多机构消防队的卡车。

paras.en: He found only $390.4 million — about a quarter of what was needed — had been allocated in grant and budget funds so far, an investment shortfall of more than $1 billion.
paras.zh: 他发现，迄今为止，赠款和预算资金中仅分配了 3.904 亿美元（约为所需资金的四分之一），投资缺口超过 10 亿美元。

paras.en: "It clearly shows that we have more work to do," Premier Ben Carroll said.
paras.zh: “这清楚地表明我们还有更多工作要做，”州长本·卡罗尔说。

paras.en: Cracking issue put crews 'at direct risk'
paras.zh: 裂缝问题使船员“面临直接风险”

paras.en: A recent Labor election promise to deliver 150 new fire trucks by 2030 was not considered in the audit, but United Firefighter Union boss Peter Marshall said that offer was only a fraction of what was needed.
paras.zh: 最近工党选举时承诺到 2030 年交付 150 辆新消防车的承诺并未在审计中考虑，但联合消防员工会主席彼得·马歇尔表示，这一承诺只是所需数量的一小部分。

paras.en: He said the report demonstrated what firefighters had been saying for a long time.
paras.zh: 他说，这份报告证明了消防员长期以来一直在说的话。

paras.en: "Those persons responsible for the budget cutting, the cost cutting, allowing firefighters to use equipment that was just not suitable and dangerous, they should be made accountable," Mr Marshall said.
paras.zh: 马歇尔表示：“那些负责削减预算、削减成本、允许消防员使用不合适且危险的设备的人应该承担责任。”

paras.en: The audit also found a widespread cracking issue among trucks managed by the Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action (DEECA) had "put firefighters at direct risk".
paras.zh: 审计还发现，能源、环境和气候行动部 (DEECA) 管理的卡车普遍存在裂纹问题，“使消防员面临直接风险”。

paras.en: The cracking problem became so widespread DEECA had to suspend more 54 per cent of its own fleet — nearly 350 trucks — ahead of the 2025-26 summer.
paras.zh: 由于裂纹问题变得如此普遍，DEECA 不得不在 2025-26 年夏季之前暂停其自有车队 54% 的车辆（近 350 辆卡车）。

paras.en: The audit found DEECA, the lead agency for bushfire prevention on public land and state forests, continued to use fire trucks with known cracks and also operated trucks over safe weight limits.
paras.zh: 审计发现，公共土地和国有森林森林火灾预防的牵头机构 DEECA 继续使用已知有裂缝的消防车，并且操作卡车的重量也超过安全限制。

paras.en: Former state treasurer Jaclyn Symes was forced to defend her record after the report pointed out that the FRV and CFA shrunk recent funding requests in response to the treasurer's instructions to limit asks in line with the government’s fiscal strategy.
paras.zh: 报告指出，FRV 和 CFA 缩减了最近的资金请求，以回应财政部长根据政府财政战略限制请求的指示，后，前州财政部长 Jaclyn Symes 被迫为自己的记录辩护。

paras.en: The audit said FRV initially requested almost $160 million in fleet capital in 2024-25, which it found would have covered just over half of the investment required.
paras.zh: 审计称，FRV 最初要求在 2024-25 年提供近 1.6 亿美元的机队资本，发现这将覆盖所需投资的一半以上。

paras.en: FRV's actual funding proposal was reduced to just $14 million, less than five per cent of what the audit calculated was needed.
paras.zh: FRV 的实际资金提案减少至仅 1,400 万美元，不到审计计算出的所需资金的 5%。

paras.en: Ms Symes said fiscal responsibility was necessary and that there was no "special treatment" for some organisations in need of state funding.
paras.zh: 赛姆斯女士表示，财政责任是必要的，对于一些需要国家资助的组织来说，没有“特殊待遇”。

paras.en: "[All government agencies] are asked to make sure that they bid for what they need, not necessarily everything that they want, because it's difficult decisions that need to be made," she said.
paras.zh: “[所有政府机构]都被要求确保他们投标的是他们需要的东西，不一定是他们想要的一切，因为需要做出困难的决定，”她说。

paras.en: Opposition Leader Jess Wilson said the restrictions on Victorian fire services was proof the current government had "not managed the finances."
paras.zh: 反对党领袖杰西·威尔逊表示，对维州消防服务的限制证明现任政府“没有管理好财务”。
