paras.en: But Emergency Services Shadow Minister Danny O'Brien acknowledged the investment required was "a very big figure".
paras.zh: 但紧急服务影子部长丹尼·奥布莱恩承认所需的投资是“一个非常大的数字”。

paras.en: Mr O'Brien did not say if a Liberal-National government could commit to reaching the $1.5 billion investment the auditor said was needed, but said the opposition would have further announcements on this topic soon.
paras.zh: 奥布莱恩先生没有透露自由党和国家党政府是否可以承诺实现审计师所说的 15 亿美元投资，但表示反对派很快就会就这一话题发表进一步声明。

paras.en: "We have been working on this for sometime, to trying to work out how we can afford to modernise our firefighting fleet," he said.
paras.zh: “我们已经为此努力了一段时间，试图弄清楚我们如何能够负担得起消防队的现代化，”他说。

articles.title: Zelenskyy says partners not warning Ukraine of incoming ballistic missiles

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine received no early warning from partner nations about incoming Russian ballistic missiles.
paras.zh: 总统泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰没有收到伙伴国家关于俄罗斯弹道导弹来袭的预警。

paras.en: Russian forces struck Kyiv on Tuesday, killing two people in a high-rise apartment, then hitting a critical thermal power plant.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯军队周二袭击了基辅，造成高层公寓内两人死亡，然后袭击了一座重要的火力发电厂。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump insists Washington is still sharing intelligence, even as he pressured Kyiv to halt attacks on Russian refineries.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普坚称华盛顿仍在分享情报，尽管他向基辅施压，要求其停止袭击俄罗斯炼油厂。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he received no early warning from international partners about incoming Russian ballistic missile strikes on civilian infrastructure in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，他没有收到国际伙伴关于俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击基辅民用基础设施的预警。

paras.en: Russian forces struck the Ukrainian capital with ballistic missiles on Tuesday, killing two people in a high-rise apartment, then hitting a critical thermal power plant in the second attack in 24 hours.
paras.zh: 周二，俄罗斯军队用弹道导弹袭击了乌克兰首都，造成高层公寓内两人死亡，随后又击中了一座重要的火力发电厂，这是 24 小时内的第二次袭击。

paras.en: "Once again, no advance warning from our partners. The main target was energy infrastructure, specifically thermal plant No. 4," Mr Zelenskyy said in a post on Telegram.
paras.zh: “我们的合作伙伴再一次没有发出提前警告。主要目标是能源基础设施，特别是四号热电厂，”泽连斯基在 Telegram 上发帖称。

paras.en: Mr Zelenskyy said it was unfair that Kyiv was enduring attacks without warnings from partners.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，基辅在没有得到合作伙伴警告的情况下遭受袭击，这是不公平的。

paras.en: "According to our intelligence, the Russians are preparing further ballistic missile launches.
paras.zh: “根据我们的情报，俄罗斯正在准备进一步发射弹道导弹。

paras.en: "The facts show that the Russians do not consider themselves bound to abide by what the president of the United States said," he added, referring to US President Donald Trump's announcement of an energy ceasefire at the weekend.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“事实表明，俄罗斯人认为自己没有义务遵守美国总统的言论。”他指的是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周末宣布的能源停火。

paras.en: "And it is certainly unfair that they are destroying our energy infrastructure while Ukraine is not even receiving warnings about ballistic missile launches."
paras.zh: “他们正在摧毁我们的能源基础设施，而乌克兰甚至没有收到有关弹道导弹发射的警告，这当然是不公平的。”

paras.en: Kyiv relies heavily on US intelligence for early warnings of missile strikes.
paras.zh: 基辅在导弹袭击预警方面严重依赖美国情报。

paras.en: Mr Zelenskyy had earlier said Ukraine had again received no warning from Western partners before a previous overnight attack on the capital.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基早些时候曾表示，在首都发生夜间袭击之前，乌克兰再次没有收到西方伙伴的警告。

paras.en: Mr Trump said Washington was still sharing intelligence, even as he pressured Kyiv to halt attacks on Russian refineries.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，尽管他向基辅施压，要求其停止袭击俄罗斯炼油厂，但华盛顿仍在分享情报。

paras.en: Reuters and other media have reported that US officials have threatened to cut off intelligence sharing and weapons sales to Ukraine unless it stops attacking Russian refineries.
paras.zh: 路透社和其他媒体报道称，美国官员威胁称，除非乌克兰停止攻击俄罗斯炼油厂，否则将切断对乌克兰的情报共享和武器销售。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Ukrainian officials confirmed SpaceX had introduced a limit on some Starlink services in Ukraine, disrupting combat drone missions that rely on the technology.
paras.zh: 周三，乌克兰官员证实 SpaceX 对乌克兰的一些 Starlink 服务实施了限制，扰乱了依赖该技术的战斗无人机任务。

paras.en: The satellite internet terminals from Elon Musk's company are crucial in guiding Ukraine's longer-range drone strikes in occupied southern and eastern Ukraine, which have assisted in disrupting Russian logistics.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克公司的卫星互联网终端对于指导乌克兰在被占领的乌克兰南部和东部进行远程无人机袭击至关重要，这有助于扰乱俄罗斯的后勤。

paras.en: "Our defence forces did not receive a warning about this limitation, and this led to the disruption of several missions," presidential adviser Serhiy Beskrestnov wrote on Telegram.
paras.zh: 总统顾问谢尔盖·别斯克雷斯诺夫在 Telegram 上写道：“我们的国防军没有收到有关这一限制的警告，这导致了多项任务的中断。”

paras.en: Beskrestnov said SpaceX had stopped the operation of its military-grade version above 100 miles per hour (160 km/h).
paras.zh: Beskrestnov 表示，SpaceX 已停止其军用级版本超过 100 英里/小时（160 公里/小时）的运行。

paras.en: Ukraine's 7th Rapid Reaction Corps, deployed in the south-east, said units had been forced to cancel some missions.
paras.zh: 部署在东南部的乌克兰第七快速反应军表示，部队被迫取消了一些任务。

paras.en: "According to our observations, during flights, the connection could drop for 10-20 seconds at speeds of just 110-120 km/h. The drones kept moving, but these interruptions made them harder to control," the Rapid Reaction Corps said in a statement.
paras.zh: 快速反应部队在一份声明中表示：“根据我们的观察，在飞行过程中，如果速度仅为 110-120 公里/小时，连接可能会中断 10-20 秒。无人机继续移动，但这些中断使它们更难以控制。”

paras.en: SpaceX did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside regular US business hours.
paras.zh: SpaceX 没有立即回应美国正常工作时间以外的置评请求。

paras.en: Although it was not immediately clear why Starlink's service was throttled, the move comes as Washington pressures Kyiv to halt strikes on Russian oil refineries.
paras.zh: 尽管目前尚不清楚星链服务被限制的原因，但此举是在华盛顿向基辅施压，要求其停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的罢工之际采取的。

paras.en: Starlink does not work inside Russia, and the Ukrainian drones hitting Russia's oil industry use other means of communication.
paras.zh: 星链在俄罗斯境内不起作用，攻击俄罗斯石油工业的乌克兰无人机使用其他通信方式。

paras.en: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the strike on a nine-storey building had killed two people and injured 21. Sixteen people were being treated in hospital, and four were in serious condition.
paras.zh: 基辅市长维塔利·克利琴科表示，对一栋九层建筑的袭击已造成两人死亡、21 人受伤。16 人正在医院接受治疗，其中 4 人伤势严重。

paras.en: Emergency crews were battling fires in apartments throughout the building, and residents were being evacuated.
paras.zh: 紧急救援人员正在整栋大楼的公寓内扑救火灾，居民正在被疏散。

paras.en: Ukrainian authorities confirmed on Wednesday morning that the hours-long missile and drone attack that unfolded overnight, primarily targeting Kyiv and Kharkiv, Ukraine's second-largest city, had damaged 30 energy facilities.
paras.zh: 乌克兰当局周三上午证实，夜间发生的持续数小时的导弹和无人机袭击主要针对基辅和乌克兰第二大城市哈尔科夫，已损坏 30 个能源设施。

paras.en: At least 600,000 people were left without power, according to Mr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，至少有 60 万人断电。

paras.en: Mr Trump, who lifted sanctions on Russian diesel last week in a bid to lower politically sensitive fuel prices, has said that both sides agreed to halt strikes on energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 特朗普上周取消了对俄罗斯柴油的制裁，以降低政治敏感的燃油价格，他表示双方同意停止对能源基础设施的袭击。

paras.en: "The strike was entirely deliberate and demonstrative in its scale – Russia has never before shown such ostentatious disrespect toward the United States," Mr Zelenskyy wrote on X.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在 X 上写道：“这次袭击的规模完全是蓄意且具有示范性的——俄罗斯以前从未对美国表现出如此明目张胆的不尊重。”

paras.en: "Russia does not consider the American president's statements strong."
paras.zh: “俄罗斯认为美国总统的声明并不有力。”

paras.en: Russia's defence ministry said on Wednesday it had struck four power plants in and around Kyiv and two in Kharkiv, among other targets.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部周三表示，它袭击了基辅及其周边地区的四座发电厂和哈尔科夫的两座发电厂等目标。

articles.title: Russell Brand a 'ruthless, calculated sexual predator', court hears
articles.author: Mazoe Ford

paras.en: The prosecution has made its opening statement in Russell Brand's trial for numerous sex offences.
paras.zh: 检方在拉塞尔·布兰德（Russell Brand）多项性犯罪案的审判中发表了开庭陈词。

paras.en: In London on Wednesday, the court was told women were "simply a means to an end" for the entertainer.
paras.zh: 周三在伦敦，法庭被告知，对于这位艺人来说，女性“只是达到目的的一种手段”。

paras.en: The trial is expected to last several weeks.
paras.zh: 审判预计将持续数周。

paras.en: A "ruthless, calculated and manipulative sexual predator". That is how the Crown Prosecutor has described British entertainer Russell Brand in her opening address at his trial for multiple sex offences on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 一个“无情、有计划、善于操纵的性掠夺者”。周三，皇家检察官在英国艺人拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 多项性犯罪审判的开庭陈词中是这样描述他的。

paras.en: For almost two decades, Brand was a stand-up comedian, popular TV and radio presenter, and eventually, a Hollywood movie star.
paras.zh: 近二十年来，布兰德是一位单口喜剧演员、受欢迎的电视和广播节目主持人，并最终成为好莱坞电影明星。

paras.en: The 51-year-old is now in the dock at London's Southwark Crown Court, accused of three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault, and one count of indecent assault relating to six women over a 10-year period from 1999. He has pleaded not guilty to all seven charges.
paras.zh: 这名 51 岁的男子目前在伦敦南华克刑事法庭受审，被指控自 1999 年起的 10 年间对六名妇女犯有三项强奸罪、三项性侵犯罪和一项猥亵罪。他对所有七项指控均表示无罪。

paras.en: Barrister Riel Karmy-Jones KC spent about two hours laying out the prosecution's case against the world-famous defendant on Wednesday morning, local time.
paras.zh: 当地时间周三上午，大律师 Riel Karmy-Jones KC 花了大约两个小时阐述检方对这位世界著名被告的指控。

paras.en: She told the court the women who will give evidence during the trial "did not know each other, have never met each other, and came forward independently of each other".
paras.zh: 她告诉法庭，将在审判期间提供证据的女性“彼此不认识，从未见过面，并且彼此独立地站出来”。

paras.en: "Their paths all crossed the defendant's either through their employment, social events through work, or through attending gigs where he was performing," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“他们的道路都与被告有过交集，要么是通过工作、工作中的社交活动，要么是通过参加被告的演出。”

paras.en: Ms Karmy-Jones told the jury of eight men and four women that each of the alleged victims' experiences occurred when Brand's career "was beginning to flourish".
paras.zh: 卡米-琼斯女士告诉由八名男性和四名女性组成的陪审团，每一位所谓受害者的经历都发生在布兰德的职业生涯“开始蓬勃发展”时。

paras.en: She told the court Brand had met the women in different settings; one at a political conference, three in various media-industry settings (including radio stations), one at a London bar and one in the foyer of a venue where he was performing.
paras.zh: 她告诉法庭，布兰德在不同的场合见过这些女性。一场在政治会议上，三场在各种媒体行业环境（包括广播电台），一场在伦敦的一家酒吧，一场在他表演场地的门厅。

paras.en: "Offending took place in a number of locations: a hotel room, workplaces, a toilet cubicle, in a bar, and at his home address," Ms Karmy-Jones told the court.
paras.zh: 卡米-琼斯女士告诉法庭：“犯罪行为发生在多个地点：酒店房间、工作场所、厕所隔间、酒吧和他的家庭住址。”

paras.en: "Some of the women involved protested and said no, others had no opportunity to protest, but it mattered not to the defendant.
paras.zh: “一些涉案女性提出抗议并表示不，其他人没有机会抗议，但这对被告来说并不重要。

paras.en: "Regardless of who they were and what they said or did, Russell Brand was not deterred. His desire, his strong desire, for some form of sexual contact was indiscriminate and voracious."
paras.zh: “无论他们是谁，说什么或做什么，拉塞尔·布兰德都没有被吓倒。他对某种形式的性接触的渴望，他的强烈渴望是不分青红皂白和贪婪的。”

paras.en: The Crown Prosecutor told the jury graphic details of the alleged sexual assaults the "demanding" and "entitled" Brand had inflicted on women who were left feeling "stupid" and "ashamed".
paras.zh: 皇家检察官向陪审团讲述了所谓的性侵犯的详细细节，“要求很高”和“有权利”的布兰德对女性造成了“愚蠢”和“羞耻”。

paras.en: "To the defendant, women were simply a means to an end," Ms Karmy-Jones told the court, pointing out Brand was a much-younger man at the time of his alleged crimes.
paras.zh: 卡米-琼斯女士在法庭上表示：“对于被告来说，女性只是达到目的的一种手段。”她指出，布兰德在犯罪时还年轻得多。

paras.en: "Over the years he may have changed both physically and as a person, however, despite that passage of time, his responsibility for wrongs done, and crimes committed at a younger age remain," she told the court.
paras.zh: “多年来，他的身体和性格可能都发生了变化，然而，尽管时间流逝，他对所犯下的错误和年轻时犯下的罪行的责任仍然存在，”她告诉法庭。

paras.en: The court heard Brand had declined to answer questions when police interviewed him about the allegations, but did provide written statements.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，当警方就这些指控采访布兰德时，他拒绝回答问题，但提供了书面陈述。

paras.en: In these statements, Ms Karmy-Jones told the court, Brand claimed he did not remember the alleged incidents, had never engaged in non-consensual sexual activity, and that his accusers' accounts may have been "re-imagined".
paras.zh: 卡米-琼斯女士在这些声明中告诉法庭，布兰德声称他不记得所指控的事件，从未参与过未经同意的性活动，并且原告的叙述可能是“重新想象的”。

paras.en: The first prosecution witness called was Mark Pinheiro, who performed with Brand in cabaret shows on the sidelines of the 1999 Labour Party Conference, at which the first alleged victim claims she was raped.
paras.zh: 第一个被传唤的控方证人是马克·皮涅罗 (Mark Pinheiro)，他在 1999 年工党会议间隙与布兰德一起表演歌舞表演，会上第一个所谓的受害者声称她被强奸了。

paras.en: Pinheiro told the court that in the car on the way from London to Bournemouth — where the conference was held — Brand had said "he hoped one day he would have slept with 5,000 girls".
paras.zh: 皮涅罗告诉法庭，在从伦敦开往会议举办地伯恩茅斯的车上，布兰德曾说过“他希望有一天他能和 5000 个女孩上床”。

paras.en: Pinheiro also told the court several months after the conference, Brand told him he had sex with a woman while they were in Bournemouth and that "things got a little bit heated and a little bit out of hand".
paras.zh: 皮涅罗还在会议几个月后告诉法庭，布兰德告诉他，他在伯恩茅斯时与一名女子发生了性关系，“事情变得有点激烈，有点失控”。

paras.en: During cross examination, Brand's barrister Ian Winter KC challenged Pinhero's evidence as inconsistent.
paras.zh: 在交叉询问期间，布兰德的律师伊恩·温特·KC (Ian Winter KC) 对皮尼罗的证据提出质疑，称其证据不一致。

paras.en: The trial before Mr Justice Joel Bennathan is expected to run for at least six weeks. Mr Brand's barrister Ian Winter KC will have the chance to set out the defence case later in the trial, which is the subject of significant global interest.
paras.zh: 法官乔尔·本纳森 (Joel Bennathan) 的审判预计将持续至少六周。布兰德先生的大律师伊恩·温特·KC (Ian Winter KC) 将有机会在审判后期阐述辩护理由，这是全球关注的焦点。

paras.en: During proceedings Brand sat up straight in the dock and listened intently to what was being said.
paras.zh: 在诉讼过程中，布兰德在被告席上坐直，专心聆听法庭的发言。

paras.en: Earlier, as he arrived for his trial with is wife Laura Gallacher, Brand told reporters he felt "blessed".
paras.zh: 早些时候，当布兰德与妻子劳拉·加拉赫 (Laura Gallacher) 一起出庭受审时，他告诉记者，他感到“很幸运”。

paras.en: "I feel, of course, concerned but hopeful that this process will lead to good outcomes for everybody involved, that's my prayer," Brand said outside Southwark Crown Court.
paras.zh: 布兰德在南华克刑事法院外表示：“我当然感到担忧，但希望这一过程将为所有相关人员带来良好的结果，这是我的祈祷。”

articles.title: From Ohio to Maine, key U.S. midterm races for Canadians to watch

paras.en: From Ohio to Maine, key U.S. midterm races for Canadians to watch
paras.zh: 从俄亥俄州到缅因州，加拿大人值得关注的美国中期选举

paras.en: In Maine, a close neighbour to Canada, the race has implications beyond the state's borders
paras.zh: 在加拿大的近邻缅因州，这场竞选的影响超出了该州的边界

paras.en: As the U.S. midterms near, Ohio, Maine and Texas are emerging as key states to watch in what could be a closely contested election.
paras.zh: 随着美国中期选举的临近，俄亥俄州、缅因州和德克萨斯州正在成为这场竞争激烈的选举中值得关注的关键州。

paras.en: In Maine, the race has implications beyond the state's borders. A close neighbour to Canada, Maine shares deep economic and cultural ties with New Brunswick and Quebec. Generations of cross-border trade, family connections and shared language have shaped the region — making the impact of U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods a particularly contentious issue for Maine businesses.
paras.zh: 在缅因州，这场竞选的影响超出了该州的边界。缅因州是加拿大的近邻，与新不伦瑞克省和魁北克省有着深厚的经济和文化联系。几代人的跨境贸易、家庭联系和共同语言塑造了该地区——这使得美国对加拿大商品征收关税的影响成为缅因州企业特别有争议的问题。

paras.en: Republican Sen. Susan Collins has represented Maine in the Senate since 1997, making her one of the state's longest-serving political figures. Now seeking a sixth term, Collins faces a challenge from Democrat Troy Jackson.
paras.zh: 共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯 (Susan Collins) 自 1997 年以来一直代表缅因州参议院，使她成为该州任职时间最长的政治人物之一。柯林斯现在正在寻求第六个任期，他面临着民主党人特洛伊·杰克逊的挑战。

paras.en: Washington correspondents Katie Simpson, Willy Lowry and Paul Hunter break down what the contest could signal for the rest of the country, how Collins is navigating her relationship with U.S. President Donald Trump and what's also at stake in Ohio and Texas.
paras.zh: 华盛顿记者凯蒂·辛普森、威利·洛瑞和保罗·亨特详细分析了这场竞选可能向全国其他地区发出的信号、柯林斯如何处理与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的关系，以及俄亥俄州和德克萨斯州的利害关系。

paras.en: We've included some highlights below, edited for length and clarity. Listen to the full podcast discussion here.
paras.zh: 我们在下面列出了一些要点，并对其长度和清晰度进行了编辑。在这里收听完整的播客讨论。

paras.en: Katie Simpson: Why don't we start with the state that is closest to Canada, and that of course is Maine. Willy, how is the historical friendship between Canada and this northern neighbour? What [effect] is it having on the midterm elections?
paras.zh: 凯蒂·辛普森：我们为什么不从距离加拿大最近的州开始，当然是缅因州。威利，加拿大和这个北方邻国之间的历史友谊怎么样？对中期选举有何影响？

paras.en: Willy Lowry: I think it's having a significant impact. This is a state that both economically, but also perhaps more importantly, socially, is interconnected with Canada — with New Brunswick, Quebec, among the provinces that it borders. You have a voter base that some will rely financially [and] economically on trade with Canada, but also whose grandparents are from Quebec or New Brunswick. On top of the numbers of it, there is [also] the cultural connection, which I think should not be underestimated in a state like Maine.
paras.zh: 威利·洛瑞：我认为它产生了重大影响。这个州在经济上，也许更重要的是在社会上，都与加拿大——与它接壤的省份中的新不伦瑞克省、魁北克省——相互联系。你有一个选民基础，其中一些人在经济上依赖与加拿大的贸易，但也有一些人的祖父母来自魁北克省或新不伦瑞克省。除了数量之外，还有文化联系，我认为在缅因州这样的州不应低估这种联系。

paras.en: And then you look at who's running — you've got Susan Collins, a five-term U.S. senator. She is literally the picture of consistency. She has a perfect attendance record casting over 10,000 votes in the Senate — the second most in the history of this country.
paras.zh: 然后你看看谁在竞选——苏珊·柯林斯(Susan Collins)，一位五届美国参议员。她确实是一致性的代表。她在参议院拥有超过 10,000 票的完美出勤记录，这是美国历史上第二高的记录。

paras.en: Katie Simpson: We should also point out that when she originally campaigned, she believed in term limits — two terms and then peace out.
paras.zh: 凯蒂·辛普森：我们还应该指出，当她最初竞选时，她相信任期限制——两个任期，然后和平结束。

paras.en: Willy Lowry: Her opponent, Troy Jackson, is a fifth-generation logger, and I don't know exactly how to put this in the most polite way, but he's not the most articulate candidate.
paras.zh: 威利·洛瑞：她的对手特洛伊·杰克逊是第五代伐木工，我不知道如何以最礼貌的方式表达这一点，但他不是最善于表达的候选人。

paras.en: He also got a bit of a late start to this race. Graham Platner, the original candidate, stepped aside due to sexual assault allegations against him, which he denied. But that basically has given Jackson a short runway to try and unseat, if not a popular, a very long-serving senator, and the numbers are pretty close right now.
paras.zh: 他在这场比赛中起步也有点晚。最初的候选人格雷厄姆·普拉特纳因对他的性侵犯指控而辞职，但他否认了这一指控。但这基本上给了杰克逊一个很短的跑道，可以尝试推翻一位任期很长的参议员（即使不是一位受欢迎的参议员），而且现在的数字非常接近。

paras.en: Katie Simpson: The incumbent senator, Susan Collins, [has] been distancing herself from Trump. What can you tell us more about why she's doing that?
paras.zh: 凯蒂·辛普森：现任参议员苏珊·柯林斯[一直]与特朗普保持距离。您能告诉我们更多关于她这样做的原因吗？

paras.en: Willy Lowry: Cause she has to. There's two things that are really going to be impactful in Maine right now.
paras.zh: 威利·洛瑞：因为她必须这么做。现在有两件事将对缅因州产生真正的影响。

paras.en: For the most part, they're the things that can be impactful across this country, but in Maine, particularly, [it’s] tariffs — super unpopular — they are really striking at some of the most important industries in that state — lumber, fisheries, all of that.
paras.zh: 在很大程度上，它们是对整个国家产生影响的事情，但在缅因州，特别是关税——非常不受欢迎——它们确实对该州一些最重要的行业造成了打击——木材、渔业等等。

paras.en: Tourism also — Canadians not going there as much. It is historically a very popular tourism destination for Eastern Canadians.
paras.zh: 旅游业也是如此——加拿大人去那里的次数不多。它历来是加拿大东部非常受欢迎的旅游目的地。

paras.en: But then there's also the price of oil and heating oil. Maine is a state where 50 per cent of people use oil to heat in the winter. It is 80 per cent more expensive than it was a year ago. That's a significant number.
paras.zh: 但还有石油和取暖油的价格。缅因州 50% 的人在冬天使用石油取暖。与一年前相比，价格上涨了 80%。这是一个很大的数字。

paras.en: That was a subject during one of the debates that they're having — like four debates in the run up to this, which is good because people are gonna get an opportunity to hear from them, but Collins has to distance herself from Trump because obviously tariffs direct Trump policy, and then the war in Iran has caused oil, gas, diesel to skyrocket and that's very unpopular in a state like Maine.
paras.zh: 这是他们正在进行的一场辩论中的一个主题——就像在这之前的四场辩论一样，这很好，因为人们将有机会听到他们的声音，但柯林斯必须与特朗普保持距离，因为显然关税直接影响特朗普的政策，然后伊朗战争导致石油、天然气、柴油价格飙升，这在缅因州这样的州非常不受欢迎。

paras.en: Paul Hunter: I think it speaks to the broader climate in this country as well. When the Democrats had to change candidates, I think everybody [went], ‘Oh, there goes Maine’ from a Democratic hopeful's perspective. And yet, [they’re] not only contending, but ahead in the game at this point. It's kind of remarkable. When you take a helicopter view, it's like, what's going on in this country, then Maine becomes another example of that.
paras.zh: 保罗·亨特：我认为这也反映了这个国家更广泛的气候。当民主党不得不更换候选人时，我认为从民主党候选人的角度来看，每个人都会说，“哦，缅因州走了”。然而，[他们]不仅在竞争，而且在这一点上处于领先地位。这有点了不起。当你从直升机上俯瞰时，就像是，这个国家正在发生什么，然后缅因州就成为了另一个例子。

paras.en: Willy Lowry: It does, though I would caution — in 2020, Collins trailed in the polls basically the entirety of the race and then she ended up winning by like nine percentage points.
paras.zh: 威利·洛瑞（Willy Lowry）：确实如此，不过我要提醒一下——2020 年，柯林斯在民意调查中基本上在整个竞选过程中都落后，然后她最终以大约 9 个百分点的优势获胜。

paras.en: Katie Simpson: One of the viral moments that came out of one of those debates [was] when Susan Collins was fighting the Trump administration, to try to get certain tariffs or certain goods removed from the tariff list.
paras.zh: 凯蒂·辛普森：其中一场辩论中出现的热门时刻之一是苏珊·柯林斯与特朗普政府作斗争，试图将某些关税或某些商品从关税清单中删除。

paras.en: Willy Lowry: And she did succeed on that.
paras.zh: 威利·洛瑞：她确实在这方面取得了成功。

paras.en: Katie Simpson: She did, and one of the ones she promoted was road salt. ‘We got road salt,’ but Troy Jackson came back and said, ‘That's great that you got those off, but we can't eat road salt. What about the cost of everything else?’
paras.zh: 凯蒂·辛普森：她做到了，她推广的产品之一是道路盐。 “我们有路盐，”但特洛伊·杰克逊回来后说，“你把它们去掉了真是太好了，但我们不能吃路盐。”其他一切的成本怎么样？

paras.en: And it exploded into this moment that I think, in this moment, it is giving Democrats hope, but Willy, I think you're very right in pointing out that she has trailed before in the past, but she continues to win.
paras.zh: 我认为这一刻爆发了，这给民主党带来了希望，但是威利，我认为你指出她过去曾落后过，但她继续获胜，这是非常正确的。

articles.title: IN PHOTOS | Albania's Education Ministry caught fire amid student protests

paras.en: IN PHOTOS | Albania's Education Ministry caught fire amid student protests
paras.zh: 照片 |阿尔巴尼亚教育部在学生抗议中起火

paras.en: Thousands protest in Tirana over conditions at universities, higher education costs
paras.zh: 数千人在地拉那抗议大学条件和高等教育费用

paras.en: Tens of thousands of students stormed the streets of Tirana on Wednesday, setting alight Albania's Education Ministry building and two banks and hurling stones at police, during the second-straight day of protests over rising education costs and corruption.
paras.zh: 周三，数万名学生冲上地拉那街头，焚烧阿尔巴尼亚教育部大楼和两家银行，并向警察投掷石块，这是针对教育成本上涨和腐败的抗议活动连续第二天发生。

paras.en: Police responded with water cannons and tear gas to disperse protesters who started the fire, overturned garbage cans and smashed the fronts of local businesses.
paras.zh: 警方用水枪和催泪瓦斯驱散放火的抗议者，推翻垃圾桶并砸碎当地企业的门面。

paras.en: Fire burns as a person reacts to being sprayed with water from a water cannon.
paras.zh: 当人被高压水枪喷出的水做出反应时，就会发生火灾。

paras.en: A person throws an object towards riot police officers during the protest.
paras.zh: 抗议期间，有人向防暴警察投掷物体。

paras.en: The unrest is part of a broader wave of student activism sweeping Europe over education and living conditions. In France, high school students have staged weeks of protests and school blockades demanding more teachers and better facilities — arguing that deteriorating school buildings and overcrowded classrooms are undermining education.
paras.zh: 这次骚乱是席卷欧洲的针对教育和生活条件的更广泛的学生激进主义浪潮的一部分。在法国，高中生进行了数周的抗议和封锁学校，要求增加教师和改善设施，他们认为日益恶化的校舍和过度拥挤的教室正在损害教育。

paras.en: The unrest in Albania has been the most violent outburst of anti-corruption protests, which started in May and have posed a growing challenge to Prime Minister Edi Rama's government.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚的骚乱是五月开始的最暴力的反腐败抗议活动，对总理埃迪·拉马的政府构成了越来越大的挑战。

paras.en: "Protesting is a legitimate right, but it cannot be used as an excuse for violence, city destruction or ugly fighting in the middle of the road," Deputy Prime Minister Albana Koçiu said on Facebook.
paras.zh: 副总理阿尔巴纳·科丘在脸书上表示：“抗议是一项合法权利，但不能用作暴力、破坏城市或丑陋的路中间打斗的借口。”

paras.en: "I call on students and every honest citizen who believes in the right to protest: Distance yourself from violence and vandalism!"
paras.zh: “我呼吁学生和每一个相信抗议权利的诚实公民：远离暴力和破坏行为！”

paras.en: Student organizers said the protest was over conditions at universities, higher education costs, financial support and employment prospects after graduation.
paras.zh: 学生组织者表示，抗议活动的主题是大学的条件、高等教育费用、经济支持和毕业后的就业前景。

articles.title: Joni Mitchell becomes a U.S. citizen, 'a journey that began 62 years ago'
articles.author: Christine Pagulayan

paras.en: Joni Mitchell becomes a U.S. citizen, 'a journey that began 62 years ago'
paras.zh: 乔尼·米切尔 (Joni Mitchell) 成为美国公民，“旅程始于 62 年前”

paras.en: Canada-born singer-songwriter, 82, posted footage of citizenship ceremony to social media
paras.zh: 82 岁的加拿大出生创作型歌手在社交媒体上发布了入籍仪式的片段

paras.en: More than six decades after leaving Canada, legendary singer-songwriter Joni Mitchell has officially become a U.S. citizen.
paras.zh: 离开加拿大六十多年后，传奇歌手兼作曲家乔尼·米切尔 (Joni Mitchell) 正式成为美国公民。

paras.en: The 82-year-old artist shared the news on Instagram and X on Tuesday, posting a photo and video from her naturalization ceremony.
paras.zh: 这位 82 岁的艺术家周二在 Instagram 和 X 上分享了这一消息，并发布了她入籍仪式的照片和视频。

paras.en: In the image, Mitchell is seen smiling and wearing a red beret and sunglasses, holding a small American flag with stars and stripes pinned to her cardigan. The second slide shows a video of her being applauded as she steps forward at the ceremony.
paras.zh: 在照片中，米切尔面带微笑，戴着红色贝雷帽和墨镜，开衫上别着一面带有星条旗的小美国国旗。第二张幻灯片显示了她在仪式上向前走时受到鼓掌的视频。

paras.en: Her caption was brief: "A journey that began 62 years ago."
paras.zh: 她的说明文字很简短：“一段 62 年前开始的旅程。”

paras.en: CBC News reached out to Mitchell's representatives, but did not hear back. CBC News found no further explanation of her decision elsewhere.
paras.zh: 加拿大广播公司新闻联系了米切尔的代表，但没有收到回复。加拿大广播公司新闻在其他地方没有找到对她的决定的进一步解释。

paras.en: Born Roberta Joan Anderson in Fort Macleod, Alta., in 1943, Mitchell moved to the United States in the mid-1960s during a brief marriage to American musician Chuck Mitchell.
paras.zh: 米切尔 1943 年出生于阿尔伯塔省麦克劳德堡，原名罗伯塔·琼·安德森 (Roberta Joan Anderson)，在 20 世纪 60 年代中期与美国音乐家查克·米切尔 (Chuck Mitchell) 短暂结婚后移居美国。

paras.en: She lived in Detroit and New York before settling in California, where she became a defining figure in the Laurel Canyon music scene.
paras.zh: 在定居加利福尼亚州之前，她曾居住在底特律和纽约，在那里她成为了劳雷尔峡谷音乐界的标志性人物。

paras.en: While she now resides in Santa Barbara, Calif., she continues to maintain a second residence on British Columbia’s Sunshine Coast.
paras.zh: 虽然她现在居住在加利福尼亚州圣巴巴拉，但她仍然在不列颠哥伦比亚省阳光海岸拥有第二处住所。

paras.en: Mitchell is known for songs like Big Yellow Taxi and Woodstock and for the 1971 album Blue, widely regarded as one of her landmark works.
paras.zh: 米切尔因《Big Yellow Taxi》和《Woodstock》等歌曲以及 1971 年的专辑《Blue》而闻名，这张专辑被广泛认为是她的里程碑式作品之一。

paras.en: Mitchell’s career has seen her evolve from a folk singer in Toronto coffee houses to one of the most influential songwriters in history.
paras.zh: 米切尔的职业生涯见证了她从多伦多咖啡馆的民谣歌手发展成为历史上最有影响力的歌曲作者之一。

paras.en: With 19 studio albums, her accolades include 11 Grammys, five Juno Awards and induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
paras.zh: 她拥有 19 张录音室专辑，获得的荣誉包括 11 次格莱美奖、5 次朱诺奖，并入选摇滚名人堂。

paras.en: - Joni Mitchell: 20 things you didn't know about one of Canada's greatest musicians
paras.zh: - Joni Mitchell：关于加拿大最伟大的音乐家之一你不知道的 20 件事

paras.en: - Junos 2026: Joni Mitchell, Rush make Junos history, the Beaches take home record-breaking win
paras.zh: - Junos 2026：Joni Mitchell、Rush 创造了 Junos 的历史，海滩队赢得了破纪录的胜利

paras.en: Given Mitchell's vocal political stances in recent years, the timing of her U.S. citizenship has sparked some curiosity. According to a press release posted on her website, at a 2024 Hollywood Bowl performance, Mitchell used an expletive to describe U.S. President Donald Trump and urged the crowd to vote.
paras.zh: 鉴于米切尔近年来直言不讳的政治立场，她获得美国公民身份的时机引发了一些好奇。据米切尔网站上发布的新闻稿称，在 2024 年好莱坞露天剧场的一场表演中，米切尔用脏话形容美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，并敦促观众投票。

paras.en: "I wish I could vote [in the U.S.]. I’m Canadian," she told the audience at the time. "I’m one of those lousy immigrants." She did not say whether that experience influenced her decision to become a U.S. citizen.
paras.zh: “我希望我能[在美国]投票。我是加拿大人，”她当时对观众说。 “我是那些糟糕的移民之一。”她没有说这段经历是否影响了她成为美国公民的决定。

paras.en: The transition to citizenship does not mean a parting of ways with her home country. Canada and the U.S. allow for dual citizenship, meaning Mitchell will retain her Canadian passport.
paras.zh: 过渡到公民身份并不意味着与祖国分道扬镳。加拿大和美国允许双重国籍，这意味着米切尔将保留她的加拿大护照。

paras.en: Mitchell’s decision to become a U.S. citizen has drawn mixed reactions on social media. Some celebrated the news. On X, user @NicoFranckerdk called it a "special moment for Joni."
paras.zh: 米切尔成为美国公民的决定在社交媒体上引起了不同的反应。一些人庆祝这个消息。在 X 上，用户@NicoFranckerdk 称其为“Joni 的特殊时刻”。

paras.en: X user @NicoFranckerdk celebrates Joni Mitchell’s announcement that she has become a U.S. citizen. (NicoFranckerdk/X)
paras.zh: X 用户@NicoFranckerdk 庆祝 Joni Mitchell 宣布她已成为美国公民。 （尼科弗兰克德克/X）

paras.en: X user @CanadaLinty wrote, "Just in time to vote in the midterms. Welcome aboard from another Cdn expat."
paras.zh: X 用户@CanadaLinty 写道：“正好赶上中期选举投票。欢迎另一位 Cdn 外籍人士加入。”

paras.en: Others questioned the timing of the announcement amid strained U.S.-Canada relations and Mitchell's outspoken criticism of Trump.
paras.zh: 在美加关系紧张以及米切尔对特朗普的直言不讳的批评之际，其他人质疑这一宣布的时机。

paras.en: X user @QueenofLaundry expressed her disapproval, writing "What?! Jesus READ THE ROOM Joni! Not impressed at all."
paras.zh: X 用户@QueenofLaundry 表达了她的不满，并写道“什么？！耶稣读一下房间乔尼！一点也不印象深刻。”

paras.en: X user @QueenofLaundry expressed disapproval of Mitchell’s news. (@QueenofLaundry/X)
paras.zh: X用户@QueenofLaundry对米切尔的消息表示不认可。 （@QueenofLaundry/X）

paras.en: X user @FDelicioso wrote, "Never did I think I’d see Joni Mitchell be so completely tone deaf."
paras.zh: X 用户@FDelicioso 写道：“我从来没有想过我会看到 Joni Mitchell 如此完全五音不全。”

paras.en: After a 2015 brain aneurysm impacted her speech and mobility, Mitchell spent years in recovery before returning to public performance in 2022.
paras.zh: 2015 年，米切尔因脑动脉瘤影响了她的言语和行动能力，之后花了数年时间进行康复，然后于 2022 年重返公开表演。

paras.en: In March, Prime Minister Mark Carney presented her with a lifetime achievement award at the Juno Awards in Hamilton, Ont.
paras.zh: 3 月，马克·卡尼总理在安大略省汉密尔顿举行的朱诺奖颁奖典礼上向她颁发了终身成就奖。

paras.en: As Mitchell officially joins the ranks of American citizens, the world may soon see her life story on the big screen. According to IMDb, a biopic is reportedly in development, with director Cameron Crowe and actor Meryl Streep attached to the project.
paras.zh: 随着米切尔正式加入美国公民的行列，世界可能很快就会在大银幕上看到她的人生故事。据 IMDb 报道，一部传记片据报道正在制作中，导演卡梅隆·克罗和演员梅丽尔·斯特里普都参与了该项目。

articles.title: Climate change and drone attacks exacerbate the humanitarian crisis in war-torn Sudan

paras.en: In Sudan, clashes between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) have intensified in North Kordofan and parts of Blue Nile state. The fighting has forced thousands of civilians to flee amid the planting season.
paras.zh: 在苏丹，苏丹武装部队（SAF）和快速支援部队（RSF）在北科尔多凡州和青尼罗州部分地区的冲突加剧。战斗迫使数千名平民在播种季节逃离。

paras.en: Since war broke out between the two factions and their allied militias in April 2023, both sides have fought for power. However, neither has managed to establish control over the entire country.
paras.zh: 自2023年4月两派及其同盟民兵爆发战争以来，双方一直在争夺权力。然而，两者都未能建立对整个国家的控制。

paras.en: The SAF, the nation's official army, is in control of Sudan's north and center, including the capital, Khartoum, while the RSF maintains its presence in the western Darfur region and parts of the south.
paras.zh: 苏丹武装部队是该国的官方军队，控制着苏丹北部和中部地区，包括首都喀土穆，而无国界部队则维持在西达尔富尔地区和南部部分地区的存在。

paras.en: The brutal war has plunged Sudan into one of the world's worst humanitarian and displacement crises, according to the United Nations and international aid organizations. The estimated death toll ranges from 40,000 to 250,000 people as reliable figures remain difficult to obtain amid the ongoing fighting. More than 12.4 million Sudanese have also been displaced, both within Sudan and to neighboring countries.
paras.zh: 据联合国和国际援助组织称，残酷的战争使苏丹陷入了世界上最严重的人道主义和流离失所危机之一。由于持续的战斗仍难以获得可靠的数字，估计死亡人数为 40,000 至 250,000 人。超过 1,240 万苏丹人也在苏丹境内或流向邻国流离失所。

paras.en: This week, the aid organization Action Against Hunger sounded the alarm.
paras.zh: 本周，援助组织反饥饿行动敲响了警钟。

paras.en: "24.6 million people are experiencing high levels of acute food insecurity," Jan Sebastian Friedrich-Rust, executive director of the German section of the NGO, told DW.
paras.zh: 该非政府组织德国分部执行主任扬·塞巴斯蒂安·弗里德里希·鲁斯特（Jan Sebastian Friedrich-Rust）告诉德国之声：“2460万人正经历严重的粮食不安全状况。”

paras.en: Friedrich-Rust added that an estimated 825,000 children younger than 5 suffer from severe acute malnutrition in 2026, while a total of 4.2 million children and pregnant or breastfeeding women are thought to be acutely malnourished.
paras.zh: 弗里德里希-鲁斯特补充说，预计到 2026 年，将有 825,000 名 5 岁以下儿童患有严重急性营养不良，而总共有 420 万儿童以及孕妇或哺乳期妇女被认为患有严重营养不良。

paras.en: In October, the Famine Early Warning Systems Network (FEWS NET) — which monitors food insecurity and uses the internationally recognized Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) system — also warned that several areas including camps for internally displaced people in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, are expected to face Catastrophe (IPC Phase 5), the most severe classification of acute food insecurity.
paras.zh: 十月，监测粮食不安全并使用国际公认的综合粮食安全阶段分类（IPC）系统的饥荒预警系统网络（FEWS NET）也警告说，包括大达尔富尔和大科尔多凡州境内流离失所者营地在内的几个地区预计将面临灾难（IPC第5阶段），这是急性粮食不安全最严重的分类。

paras.en: "The situation in Sudan continues to deteriorate and humanitarian needs are growing, even as the resources to respond are shrinking," Fabrizia Falcione, the Sudan representative of the United Nations Population Fund, the UN agency for sexual and reproductive health, said.
paras.zh: 联合国负责性健康和生殖健康的机构联合国人口基金驻苏丹代表法布里齐亚·法尔西奥内表示：“尽管应对资源不断减少，但苏丹局势持续恶化，人道主义需求不断增加。”

paras.en: "I recently visited the displacement camp Tawila and I am still struggling to find the words to describe what I witnessed," Falcione told DW. "Imagine a population larger than that of Frankfurt, Germany, forced to flee their homes and seek refuge in one place in less than three years."
paras.zh: 法尔西奥内告诉德国之声：“我最近访问了塔维拉流离失所者营地，但我仍在努力寻找词语来描述我所目睹的一切。” “想象一下，在不到三年的时间里，有比德国法兰克福还要多的人口被迫逃离家园，到一个地方寻求庇护。”

paras.en: She added that more than 700,000 people there rely on just one hospital capable of performing Caesarean sections.
paras.zh: 她补充说，那里有超过 700,000 人依赖于一家能够进行剖腹产手术的医院。

paras.en: Despite repeated warnings about the deteriorating humanitarian situation, the 2026 Humanitarian Response Plan, which calls for $2.9 billion (€2.59 bn), is just 41% funded, with $1.2 billion (€1.07 bn) received from international donors so far.
paras.zh: 尽管多次警告人道主义局势不断恶化，但需要 29 亿美元（25.9 亿欧元）的 2026 年人道主义应对计划仅完成 41%，迄今为止从国际捐助者那里收到的资金为 12 亿美元（10.7 亿欧元）。

paras.en: Climate shocks exacerbate Sudan's humanitarian crisis
paras.zh: 气候冲击加剧苏丹的人道主义危机

paras.en: The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) recently warned that extreme heat and heavy flooding are worsening the crisis in Sudan.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义事务协调办公室（OCHA）最近警告说，极端高温和严重洪水正在加剧苏丹的危机。

paras.en: "This year, a massive heatwave brought power cuts of up to 12 hours per day in some regions," Hager Ali, a Sudan researcher at the German Institute for Global and Area Studies (GIGA), told DW. "Riverbeds and dried-out fields are barren, which comes on top of the damage from combat, the RSF's scorched-earth tactics and environmental destruction."
paras.zh: 德国全球与地区研究所（GIGA）苏丹研究员海格·阿里（Hager Ali）告诉德国之声：“今年，一场大规模热浪导致部分地区每天停电长达12小时。” “除了战斗造成的破坏、无国界医生组织的焦土战术和环境破坏之外，河床和干涸的田地都是贫瘠的。”

paras.en: While the drought is affecting roughly half the country, heavy rains and localized flooding have worsened conditions in other areas of Sudan.
paras.zh: 虽然干旱影响了大约一半的国家，但暴雨和局部洪水使苏丹其他地区的情况更加恶化。

paras.en: "As if that wasn't enough, there is also a massive shortage of fertilizer and diesel," Ali told DW.
paras.zh: 阿里告诉德国之声：“好像这还不够，化肥和柴油还严重短缺。”

paras.en: Sudan relies on imported fertilizer and diesel shipped from the Persian Gulf through the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. However, amid the wider Iran war, Iran has been blocking shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, while the Iran-aligned Houthi rebels in Yemen have threatened and at times disrupted shipping through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
paras.zh: 苏丹依赖从波斯湾通过霍尔木兹海峡和曼德海峡进口的化肥和柴油。然而，在更广泛的伊朗战争中，伊朗一直在封锁霍尔木兹海峡的航运，而也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞叛军则威胁并有时扰乱通过曼德海峡的航运。

paras.en: "Fertilizer supply collapsed from 450,000 metric tons to only about 50,000" in 2026, Ali said, adding that a similar diesel shortage and the soaring cost of diesel compound the situation in two ways.
paras.zh: 阿里表示，“到 2026 年，化肥供应量将从 45 万吨锐减至仅 5 万吨左右”。他补充说，类似的柴油短缺和柴油成本飙升在两个方面使情况变得更加复杂。

paras.en: "Agricultural equipment uses diesel and the transportation of humanitarian and agricultural goods within the country is getting a lot more expensive," Ali said.
paras.zh: 阿里说：“农业设备使用柴油，国内人道主义和农产品的运输变得越来越昂贵。”

paras.en: In October, the International Food Policy Research Institute warned that staple food- and fuel prices in Sudan rose sharply in September 2026.
paras.zh: 10 月，国际粮食政策研究所警告称，苏丹的主粮和燃料价格将于 2026 年 9 月大幅上涨。

paras.en: Limited arms embargo curbs hope for an end to the war
paras.zh: 有限的武器禁运抑制了结束战争的希望

paras.en: Observers have long pointed out that the war in Sudan will not end until foreign backers stop supplying arms. The SAF is officially supported by Egypt, Turkey, Russia and Iran while the United Arab Emirates is alleged to be the RSF's main backer, a claim Abu Dhabi denies.
paras.zh: 观察家早就指出，除非外国支持者停止供应武器，否则苏丹战争不会结束。苏丹武装部队得到埃及、土耳其、俄罗斯和伊朗的正式支持，而阿拉伯联合酋长国据称是无国界部队的主要支持者，但阿布扎比否认了这一说法。

paras.en: However, in October, the UN Security Council extended the existing arms embargo only on Sudan's Darfur region until December 11, dropping calls for a nationwide embargo.
paras.zh: 然而，10月，联合国安理会仅将针对苏丹达尔富尔地区的现有武器禁运延长至12月11日，放弃了全国范围内禁运的呼吁。

paras.en: "To expand the UN embargo across Sudan would have included drones in particular," Hager Ali said, noting that Sudan is one of the biggest theaters for drone warfare: As of 2026, the leading cause of civilian casualties in Sudan are drone strikes.
paras.zh: 海格·阿里表示：“要扩大联合国对苏丹的禁运，尤其要包括无人机。”他指出，苏丹是无人机战争的最大战场之一：截至 2026 年，无人机袭击是苏丹平民伤亡的主要原因。

paras.en: She also told DW that Al-Harith Idriss al-Harith Mohamed, Sudan's permanent representative to the United Nations, opposed the extention of the embargo over concerns that it would disproportionately limit the Sudanese Armed Forces on the battlefield.
paras.zh: 她还告诉德国之声，苏丹常驻联合国代表哈里斯·伊德里斯·哈里斯·穆罕默德反对延长禁运，因为担心这会过度限制战场上的苏丹武装部队。

paras.en: "An arms embargo would deter potential backers from cooperating with the Sudanese Armed Forces, whereas the Rapid Support Forces don't necessarily source their weapons through official ways," Hager Ali said.
paras.zh: 哈格·阿里说：“武器禁运将阻止潜在的支持者与苏丹武装部队合作，而快速支援部队不一定通过官方途径采购武器。”

paras.en: "The RSF rely on trafficking with other militias, private military contractors and traders in the region," she said, adding that because the RSF obtains supplies from numerous sources and actors, it is difficult to target the group through a single embargo.
paras.zh: 她说：“无国界部队依靠与该地区其他民兵、私人军事承包商和贸易商进行贩运。”她补充说，由于无国界部队从众多来源和参与者那里获得物资，因此很难通过单一禁运来瞄准该组织。

articles.title: Albania: Fire at Education Ministry as students protest

paras.en: Albania's Education Ministry caught fire on Wednesday in a second day of student protests over corruption and education.
paras.zh: 周三，阿尔巴尼亚教育部在学生针对腐败和教育的抗议活动第二天起火。

paras.en: The scenes were at least somewhat reminiscent of the protracted student demonstrations in France in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 这些场景至少在某种程度上让人想起最近几周法国旷日持久的学生示威活动。

paras.en: They are probably the most violent outburst of low-level anti-corruption protests against Prime Minister Edi Rama's government and the main opposition led by Sali Barisha that started in May this year.
paras.zh: 这可能是今年5月开始的针对总理埃迪·拉玛政府和萨利·巴里沙领导的主要反对派的低级别反腐败抗议活动中最暴力的一次。

paras.en: What happened in Tirana's student protests?
paras.zh: 地拉那的学生抗议活动发生了什么？

paras.en: Police deployed riot police and used tear gas and water cannons to disperse crowds in the capital Tirana.
paras.zh: 首都地拉那警方部署防暴警察，并使用催泪瓦斯和水枪驱散人群。

paras.en: Thousands of protesters gathered in front of the Education Ministry on Wednesday, many obscuring their faces. Some threw bricks at the building, damaged barriers on the sidewalks and overturned trash cans.
paras.zh: 周三，数千名抗议者聚集在教育部前，许多人遮住了脸。一些人向建筑物投掷砖块，损坏人行道上的护栏，并掀翻垃圾桶。

paras.en: A bank near the Education Ministry also caught fire, according to the Reuters news agency citing a witness.
paras.zh: 据路透社援引目击者的消息称，教育部附近的一家银行也起火。

paras.en: The demonstration started on Tuesday with a peaceful gathering of several hundred people outside the Education Ministry but quickly escalated and turned violent in places.
paras.zh: 示威活动于周二开始，数百人在教育部外和平集会，但很快升级并在一些地方演变为暴力活动。

paras.en: Police early on Wednesday reported around 40 detentions and 13 people injured, including six police officers. Unrest continued long after these figures were issued.
paras.zh: 周三早些时候，警方报告称，约有 40 人被拘留，13 人受伤，其中包括 6 名警察。这些数字发布后很长一段时间，骚乱仍在继续。

paras.en: Government says demonstrations degenerated into 'orchestrated violence'
paras.zh: 政府称示威活动已沦为“精心策划的暴力”

paras.en: Deputy Prime Minster Albana Kociu posted a video of demonstrations on Facebook saying it was "disheartening to see the culture of protest degenerate into orchestrated violence."
paras.zh: 副总理阿尔巴纳·科丘在脸书上发布了一段示威视频，称“看到抗议文化堕落为精心策划的暴力，令人沮丧”。

paras.en: She said that the attacks on institutions and police and the "senseless destruction of public property" were "not the language through which the youth should express themselves." Instead, she said they were reminiscent of the "old habits of those who use young people to mask their own political incompetence."
paras.zh: 她说，对机构和警察的袭击以及“对公共财产的无谓破坏”“不是年轻人应该表达自己的语言”。相反，她说，它们让人想起“那些利用年轻人来掩盖自己政治无能的人的旧习惯”。

paras.en: In another post, Kociu called on students who believe in the right to protest to "distance" themselves from "violence and vandalism."
paras.zh: 在另一篇帖子中，科丘呼吁相信抗议权的学生与“暴力和破坏行为”“保持距离”。

paras.en: Student organizers say the protests revolve around conditions at universities, higher education costs, financial support and employment prospects after graduation.
paras.zh: 学生组织者表示，抗议活动围绕大学条件、高等教育费用、经济支持和毕业后的就业前景。

paras.en: More generally, Albania has faced a series of demonstrations this year sometimes referred to as the "Flamingo Revolution." These were at least partly prompted by a controversial construction project on the Adriatic Coast in a protected area where flamingos live.
paras.zh: 更广泛地说，阿尔巴尼亚今年面临一系列有时被称为“火烈鸟革命”的示威活动。这些至少部分是由于亚得里亚海海岸火烈鸟居住的保护区内一个有争议的建设项目引起的。

paras.en: But these partly environmental protests have also had a more general theme of dissatisfaction with Albania's dominant political forces. PM Edi Rama's Socialists and Sali Barisha's right-wing Democrats have alternated in government for more than 30 years, ever since the post-Cold War democratic transition in the former communist country.
paras.zh: 但这些部分环境抗议活动还有一个更普遍的主题，即对阿尔巴尼亚主导政治力量的不满。自这个前共产主义国家进行冷战后民主转型以来，埃迪·拉马总理领导的社会党和萨利·巴里沙领导的右翼民主党在政府中交替执政已有 30 多年。

paras.en: The timing is also conspicuous, with the demonstrations starting amid prominent international coverage of widespread school and student protests in France in recent weeks leading to similarly restless scenes.
paras.zh: 时机也很引人注目，示威活动开始之际，国际社会对最近几周法国广泛的学校和学生抗议活动进行了广泛报道，导致了类似的不安场面。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: India urges Russia, Ukraine to protect Black Sea shipping

paras.en: India has urged both Russia and Ukraine to ensure safe passage for commercial shipping through the Black Sea as attacks on merchant vessels put Indian seafarers at risk and threaten to disrupt vital food and energy supplies.
paras.zh: 印度敦促俄罗斯和乌克兰确保黑海商业航运的安全通道，因为对商船的袭击使印度海员面临风险，并可能扰乱重要的粮食和能源供应。

paras.en: New Delhi says discussions with both sides are under way.
paras.zh: 新德里表示正在与双方进行讨论。

paras.en: "The targeting of commercial shipping and seafarers in the region must end, and free and unimpeded navigation and commerce through the international waterways must be restored at the earliest," Foreign Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said last week.
paras.zh: 外交部发言人兰迪尔·贾伊斯瓦尔 (Randhir Jaiswal) 上周表示：“必须停止针对该地区商业航运和海员的攻击，必须尽早恢复国际水道的自由、畅通无阻的航行和商业。”

paras.en: India accounts for more than 12% of the global seafaring workforce, with 311,936 maritime professionals, according to a 2026 industry report. And attacks on commercial vessels in and around the Black Sea in recent months have highlighted the risks facing civilian crews.
paras.zh: 根据 2026 年行业报告，印度拥有 311,936 名海事专业人员，占全球海事劳动力的 12% 以上。近几个月来黑海及其周边地区对商船的袭击凸显了平民船员面临的风险。

paras.en: The Turkish-owned MV Royad Mammadov, a cargo ship carrying grain from Ukraine, caught fire and sank following an attack on Monday, killing two crew members. The three Indian nationals aboard the vessel survived, but sustained injuries and were taken to Romania to receive medical treatment.
paras.zh: 土耳其拥有的 MV Royad Mammadov 号是一艘从乌克兰运载谷物的货船，周一遭遇袭击后起火沉没，造成两名船员死亡。船上的三名印度国民幸存，但受伤，被送往罗马尼亚接受治疗。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy blamed Russia for launching the strike.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基指责俄罗斯发动了这次袭击。

paras.en: The Defense Ministry in Moscow separately said it had struck two Ukrainian cargo vessels in the Black Sea but did not specifically identify the ships.
paras.zh: 莫斯科国防部另外表示，它在黑海袭击了两艘乌克兰货船，但没有具体说明这些船只的身份。

paras.en: The Liberian-flagged oil tanker Aframax Rio was also recently attacked by unmanned vessels off Russia's Black Sea coast near Sochi, according to Russian authorities. The vessel was carrying 23 Indians, but all of them were rescued.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯当局称，悬挂利比里亚国旗的油轮阿芙拉型油轮最近也在索契附近的俄罗斯黑海沿岸遭到无人船袭击。该船载有23名印第安人，但全部获救。

paras.en: Anil Wadhwa, a former Indian diplomat, said India's proposal to halt attacks on commercial shipping in the Black Sea covered energy infrastructure, safe passage for grain and energy exports, and an end to strikes on merchant vessels.
paras.zh: 印度前外交官阿尼尔·瓦德瓦表示，印度关于停止对黑海商业航运的袭击的提议涵盖能源基础设施、粮食和能源出口的安全通道以及停止对商船的袭击。

paras.en: "Securing an ironclad guarantee depends entirely on a broader cessation of hostilities between Russia and Ukraine in the maritime theater," Wadhwa told DW.
paras.zh: 瓦德瓦对德国之声表示：“获得铁定保证完全取决于俄罗斯和乌克兰在海上战区更广泛地停止敌对行动。”

paras.en: India's close relations with Russia and expanding engagement with Ukraine give New Delhi access to both sides, but do not guarantee either will honor a shipping arrangement.
paras.zh: 印度与俄罗斯的密切关系以及与乌克兰不断扩大的接触使新德里能够进入双方，但并不能保证任何一方都会遵守航运安排。

paras.en: Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has described India's proposal for a possible ceasefire with Russia as the "broadest" of the four offers Kyiv has received.
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈(Andrii Sybiha)将印度与俄罗斯可能停火的提议描述为基辅收到的四项提议中“最广泛”的一项。

paras.en: Russia has not publicly endorsed a binding safe-passage deal proposed by India, despite welcoming New Delhi's peace efforts.
paras.zh: 尽管俄罗斯欢迎新德里的和平努力，但尚未公开支持印度提出的具有约束力的安全通道协议。

paras.en: Rajan Kumar of the Center for Russian and Central Asian Studies at Jawaharlal Nehru University said India could use its diplomatic leverage with Moscow to help bring the two sides towards an agreement.
paras.zh: 贾瓦哈拉尔尼赫鲁大学俄罗斯和中亚研究中心的拉詹·库马尔表示，印度可以利用其对莫斯科的外交影响力，帮助双方达成协议。

paras.en: "India could play a constructive role in facilitating dialogue between Russia and Ukraine, particularly on the issue of ensuring the safety of commercial shipping in the Black Sea," Kumar told DW.
paras.zh: 库马尔告诉德国之声：“印度可以在促进俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的对话方面发挥建设性作用，特别是在确保黑海商业航运安全的问题上。”

paras.en: Working with other powers to reach a deal
paras.zh: 与其他国家合作达成协议

paras.en: He argued that India should also work with other influential countries from the Global South, particularly China, Brazil and South Africa.
paras.zh: 他认为印度还应该与南半球其他有影响力的国家合作，特别是中国、巴西和南非。

paras.en: "A coordinated approach with these countries could enhance their collective diplomatic leverage and strengthen their capacity to persuade both parties to adopt mutually acceptable arrangements for maritime security," said Kumar.
paras.zh: 库马尔表示：“与这些国家采取协调一致的做法可以增强它们的集体外交影响力，并增强它们说服双方采取双方都能接受的海上安全安排的能力。”

paras.en: India's initiative comes as US President Donald Trump announced an "energy ceasefire” between Russia and Ukraine over the weekend, although its scope and implementation mechanism remain unclear.
paras.zh: 印度提出这一倡议之际，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周末宣布俄罗斯和乌克兰之间实现“能源停火”，但其范围和实施机制仍不清楚。

paras.en: Harsh Pant, vice president of the New Delhi-based think tank Observer Research Foundation, said Trump's intervention could help India's efforts but might produce a narrower agreement that fails to address New Delhi's wider concerns.
paras.zh: 总部位于新德里的智库观察者研究基金会副总裁哈什·潘特表示，特朗普的干预可能有助于印度的努力，但可能会产生一个范围较小的协议，无法解决新德里更广泛的担忧。

paras.en: "The energy ceasefire could be an initial confidence-building measure, whereas a Black Sea shipping arrangement requires additional commitments on attacks against merchant vessels, ports, maritime routes and the security of commercial traffic," Pant told DW.
paras.zh: 潘特告诉德国之声：“能源停火可能是一项初步的建立信任措施，而黑海航运安排则需要对针对商船、港口、海上航线和商业交通安全的攻击作出额外承诺。”

paras.en: "India need not compete with Washington for the public credit of mediation. It could instead press for the inclusion of broader maritime provisions in any US agreement.”
paras.zh: “印度无需与华盛顿争夺调解的公共信誉。相反，它可以敦促美国的任何协议中纳入更广泛的海事条款。”

paras.en: Wadhwa said the proposed energy truce could also benefit Indian seafarers if it secured safe passage for energy cargoes.
paras.zh: 瓦德瓦表示，拟议的能源休战如果能确保能源货物的安全通行，也可能使印度海员受益。

paras.en: "Although Ukraine alleges that the Russians have already breached this so-called truce, there will be pressure on both sides to allow energy cargoes safe passage. India is bound to gain as far as its crews are concerned in such a scenario," he said.
paras.zh: “尽管乌克兰声称俄罗斯已经违反了所谓的停战协议，但双方都会面临允许能源货物安全通过的压力。在这种情况下，就其船员而言，印度必然会受益，”他说。

paras.en: The disruption to Black Sea shipping also has other implications for India such as delays in shipments of key commodities and higher transport costs.
paras.zh: 黑海航运的中断还对印度产生其他影响，例如主要商品的运输延误和运输成本上升。

paras.en: "A prolonged Black Sea disruption would elevate India's import bill mainly via higher freight on Russian crude and constrained soft oil supplies, with the strongest near-term transmission to domestic edible oil prices and food inflation," said Lekha Chakraborty, professor at the National Institute of Public Finance and Policy.
paras.zh: 印度国家公共财政与政策研究所教授莱卡·查克拉博蒂（Lekha Chakraborty）表示：“黑海的长期中断将导致印度的进口费用增加，主要是因为俄罗斯原油运费上涨和软油供应受限，近期对国内食用油价格和食品通胀的影响最为强烈。”

articles.title: Suspected Israeli online operations cause alarm in Iran and Lebanon

paras.en: One Instagram account, presenting itself as belonging to Israel’s foreign intelligence agency Mossad, has published Arabic-language messages encouraging people to make contact through confidential channels.
paras.zh: 一个自称属于以色列外国情报机构摩萨德的 Instagram 账户发布了阿拉伯语信息，鼓励人们通过保密渠道进行联系。

paras.en: The account, which is verified and operates under the handle @themossad_official, has posted recruitment appeals in colloquial Lebanese Arabic, including inviting people to explore new opportunities by initiating a private conversation.
paras.zh: 该账户已通过@themossad_official 账号进行验证并以通俗的黎巴嫩阿拉伯语发布招聘呼吁，包括邀请人们通过发起私人对话来探索新的机会。

paras.en: The profile prominently features pinned highlight reels with Arabic titles such as “Lebanon” displaying a photo of fighters, “Israel”, “Mossad wants you!”, “Protection”, and “Think about your future”.
paras.zh: 该简介的显着特征是带有阿拉伯标题的固定亮点卷轴，例如显示战士照片的“黎巴嫩”、“以色列”、“摩萨德想要你！”、“保护”和“想想你的未来”。

paras.en: In August 2025, Lebanon’s General Security Directorate warned residents against interacting with the Instagram account.
paras.zh: 2025 年 8 月，黎巴嫩安全总局警告居民不要与 Instagram 账户互动。

paras.en: In Lebanon, where years of economic turmoil have left many residents facing financial hardship, security officials have warned of suspected Israeli intelligence recruitment efforts involving social media.
paras.zh: 在黎巴嫩，多年的经济动荡使许多居民面临经济困难，安全官员警告说，以色列涉嫌利用社交媒体招募情报。

paras.en: Retired Brigadier General Mounir Chehade told the newspaper that the recruitment efforts targeted areas with significant support for Hezbollah, including Beirut’s southern suburbs, southern Lebanon and the Bekaa Valley.
paras.zh: 退役准将穆尼尔·切哈德告诉该报，招募工作针对的是真主党大力支持的地区，包括贝鲁特南部郊区、黎巴嫩南部和贝卡谷地。

paras.en: Also in January 2025, Lebanon’s General Security Directorate warned against interacting with a Facebook page called SAWA, which it suspected was a Mossad front aimed at recruiting Lebanese citizens.
paras.zh: 同样是在 2025 年 1 月，黎巴嫩安全总局警告不要与名为 SAWA 的 Facebook 页面互动，怀疑该页面是旨在招募黎巴嫩公民的摩萨德阵线。

paras.en: Similarly, in December 2025, another Lebanese newspaper L’Orient Today reported that the security agency had warned residents against interacting with a social media page calling itself “Unit 504”.
paras.zh: 同样，2025 年 12 月，另一家黎巴嫩报纸《今日东方报》报道称，安全机构警告居民不要与自称“Unit 504”的社交媒体页面互动。

paras.en: The page claimed to represent the Israeli military’s human intelligence unit and said it was looking for individuals interested in joining its ranks.
paras.zh: 该页面声称代表以色列军方的人类情报部门，并表示正在寻找有兴趣加入其队伍的个人。

paras.en: The concerns have been accompanied by arrests of people accused of passing sensitive information to Israel. Lebanese authorities were reported in October 2025 to have previously arrested 32 people suspected of giving information to Israel that was used to target Hezbollah leaders.
paras.zh: 与此同时，一些被指控向以色列传递敏感信息的人也遭到逮捕。据报道，黎巴嫩当局于 2025 年 10 月逮捕了 32 名涉嫌向以色列提供用于针对真主党领导人的信息的人。

paras.en: Academic and political researcher Wissam Nassif Yassin told Al Jazeera that Israeli intelligence uses colloquial Lebanese Arabic on these platforms to avoid arousing suspicion and to facilitate communication.
paras.zh: 学术和政治研究员维萨姆·纳西夫·亚辛告诉半岛电视台，以色列情报机构在这些平台上使用黎巴嫩阿拉伯语口语，以避免引起怀疑并促进沟通。

paras.en: “The Israeli side focuses on all segments of society because it considers that every person can be penetrated from their own angle, based on the fact that Hezbollah in Lebanon is integrated into the core of Lebanese society,” Yassin said.
paras.zh: 亚辛说：“以色列方面关注社会各阶层，因为它认为每个人都可以从自己的角度进行渗透，因为黎巴嫩真主党已融入黎巴嫩社会的核心。”

paras.en: “It focuses on the party’s members primarily, then on the resistance environment secondarily, and on the environment surrounding it thirdly.”
paras.zh: “首先关注的是党员，其次是抵抗环境，第三是周围的环境。”

paras.en: While Israel has had notable sucesses in its intelligence operations in Lebanon – including in gathering information leading to attacks on Hezbollah leaders and members, Yassin argued that collaboration with Israel remained widely rejected in Lebanon.
paras.zh: 尽管以色列在黎巴嫩的情报行动中取得了显着的成功，包括收集导致对真主党领导人和成员发动袭击的信息，但亚辛认为，黎巴嫩仍然普遍拒绝与以色列合作。

paras.en: He also pointed to Hezbollah’s own counterintelligence capabilities, arguing that the group has a long history of identifying and disrupting Israeli intelligence activity.
paras.zh: 他还指出了真主党自身的反情报能力，认为该组织在识别和破坏以色列情报活动方面有着悠久的历史。

paras.en: Yassin pointed to the case of Elhanan Tannenbaum, an alleged Israeli spy who was captured in 2000 after being lured abroad, and was released in 2004 in a prisoner exchange deal.
paras.zh: 亚辛提到了埃尔哈南·坦南鲍姆（Elhanan Tannenbaum）的案件，他被指控为以色列间谍，2000年被引诱出国后被捕，并于2004年通过囚犯交换协议获释。

paras.en: The use of digital platforms to recruit potential informants also forms part of the longstanding intelligence war between Israel and Iran, which has intensified alongside the military conflict between the two countries.
paras.zh: 利用数字平台招募潜在线人也是以色列和伊朗之间长期情报战的一部分，随着两国之间的军事冲突，这场战争也愈演愈烈。

paras.en: Hassan Ahmadian, an assistant professor of political science at the University of Tehran, described the current situation as one of the most intense periods in decades-long espionage between the two countries.
paras.zh: 德黑兰大学政治学助理教授哈桑·艾哈迈迪安将当前局势描述为两国之间长达数十年的间谍活动最激烈的时期之一。

paras.en: “This is an intelligence war. The confrontation between Iran and Israel has continued for decades, but in recent years it has reached its peak,” Ahmadian told Al Jazeera. “Both sides are engaged in intelligence operations. It is an intense conflict that has never stopped.”
paras.zh: “这是一场情报战。伊朗和以色列之间的对抗已经持续了几十年，但近年来达到了顶峰，”艾哈迈迪安告诉半岛电视台。 “双方都在进行情报行动。这是一场从未停止过的激烈冲突。”

paras.en: Ahmadian said that Israeli recruitment efforts in Iran were sometimes carried out through openly advertised opportunities on social media.
paras.zh: 艾哈迈迪安表示，以色列在伊朗的招募工作有时是通过社交媒体上公开宣传的机会进行的。

paras.en: He suggested that openly advertising such opportunities could have a psychological goal beyond recruiting informants, in an attempt to reinforce perceptions of Israel’s intelligence reach inside Iran.
paras.zh: 他表示，公开宣传此类机会可能除了招募线人之外还有一个心理目标，试图强化人们对以色列在伊朗境内的情报影响力的看法。

paras.en: “Israel uses propaganda, but this blatant method is perhaps partly to amplify the Israeli presence,” Ahmadian noted.
paras.zh: 艾哈迈迪安指出：“以色列使用宣传手段，但这种明目张胆的方法可能部分是为了扩大以色列的存在。”

paras.en: The academic also pointed to cases in which Iran had conducted its own counter-operations.
paras.zh: 这位学者还指出了伊朗自己进行反击行动的案例。

paras.en: In October 2024, for example, Israeli authorities announced the arrest of seven Israeli nationals accused of spying for Iran by gathering intelligence on military facilities and other sensitive sites.
paras.zh: 例如，2024 年 10 月，以色列当局宣布逮捕七名以色列国民，他们被指控通过收集军事设施和其他敏感地点的情报为伊朗从事间谍活动。

paras.en: Separately, the former Israeli Energy Minister Gonen Segev was arrested in 2018 on accusations of spying for Iran. He subsequently pled guilty and was sentenced to 11 years in prison in 2019.
paras.zh: 另外，以色列前能源部长戈南·塞格夫 (Gonen Segev) 于 2018 年因涉嫌为伊朗从事间谍活动而被捕。他随后认罪，并于 2019 年被判处 11 年监禁。

paras.en: Authorities in Lebanon and Iran have threatened severe penalties for anyone interacting with Israeli accounts.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩和伊朗当局威胁对任何与以色列账户互动的人进行严厉处罚。

paras.en: In July, the Iranian newspaper Kayhan reported that Iran’s Ministry of Intelligence had warned of social media accounts allegedly set up by Mossad to extract information and spread fake news following recent security operations. The ministry claimed that Mossad even offered medical advice to people injured during the United States-Israeli war on Iran, in an attempt to gather sensitive intelligence.
paras.zh: 7月，伊朗报纸《Kayhan》报道称，伊朗情报部对据称摩萨德在最近的安全行动后建立的社交媒体账户发出警告，目的是提取信息并传播虚假新闻。该部声称，摩萨德甚至为美以对伊朗战争期间受伤的人提供医疗建议，试图收集敏感情报。

paras.en: In the same month, the Iranian judiciary also warned that sending images or information to networks deemed to be hostile could result in sentences of 10 to 15 years in prison, heavy fines and potential charges of “corruption on Earth”, which carries the death penalty.
paras.zh: 同月，伊朗司法部门还警告称，向被视为敌对的网络发送图像或信息可能会导致 10 至 15 年监禁、巨额罚款，并可能被指控“地球腐败”，最高可判处死刑。

paras.en: In Lebanon, collaboration with Israel carries a penalty of imprisonment.
paras.zh: 在黎巴嫩，与以色列合作会被判处监禁。

paras.en: As the covert conflict expands online, Ahmadian said that there was little indication that the confrontation would ease.
paras.zh: 艾哈迈迪安表示，随着秘密冲突在网上扩大，几乎没有迹象表明对抗会缓和。

paras.en: “I do not expect this intelligence war to stop at any moment between the two parties,” Ahmadian said, “it will remain ongoing and will continue to affect the entire conflict.”
paras.zh: 艾哈迈迪安说：“我预计双方之间的这场情报战不会在任何时候停止，它将继续持续下去，并将继续影响整个冲突。”

articles.title: Ukraine accuses Elon Musk’s SpaceX of throttling Starlink terminals

paras.en: Ukrainian officials have accused SpaceX of throttling Starlink satellite services, disrupting its ability to carry out military operations and leaving Kyiv vulnerable to deadly attacks.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员指责 SpaceX 限制 Starlink 卫星服务，破坏其开展军事行动的能力，并使基辅容易遭受致命攻击。

paras.en: An adviser to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that without warning, services had been limited for terminals travelling over 100mph overnight on Wednesday – effectively limiting Ukraine’s ability to launch drones, which use satellite internet to pilot the craft.
paras.zh: 总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)的一名顾问警告称，在没有任何警告的情况下，周三夜间时速超过 100 英里/小时的航站楼服务受到限制，这实际上限制了乌克兰发射无人机的能力，无人机使用卫星互联网来驾驶无人机。

paras.en: Writing on Telegram, defence technology adviser Serhii Beskrestnov said Ukraine was “deprived of one of the few chances to defend itself from Shahed drones”.
paras.zh: 国防技术顾问谢尔希·贝斯克雷斯诺夫 (Serhii Beskrestnov) 在 Telegram 上撰文称，乌克兰“被剥夺了为数不多的抵御沙赫德无人机攻击的机会之一”。

paras.en: He added that frontline logistics and long-distance missions were also disrupted.
paras.zh: 他补充说，前线后勤和长途任务也受到干扰。

paras.en: The suggestion that Elon Musk’s company had throttled Starlink services drew the ire of Poland, which pays for Ukrainian Starlink subscriptions on Kyiv’s behalf.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克的公司限制星链服务的说法引起了波兰的愤怒，波兰代表基辅支付乌克兰星链的订阅费。

paras.en: “Hey Elon Musk, big man, are you playing politics with your products again?” wrote Radoslaw Sikorski, Poland’s foreign minister. “As your European customers, we are watching you.”
paras.zh: “嘿埃隆·马斯克，大人物，你又用你的产品玩政治了吗？”波兰外交部长拉多斯瓦夫·西科尔斯基写道。 “作为您的欧洲客户，我们正在关注您。”

paras.en: The “big man” jibe refers to a public dispute on social media between Musk, Sikorski and United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio in 2025, when the SpaceX boss told Sikorski to “be quiet, small man” on his X platform.
paras.zh: “大人物”的嘲讽指的是 2025 年马斯克、西科尔斯基和美国国务卿马可·卢比奥之间在社交媒体上的公开争论，当时 SpaceX 老板在他的 X 平台上告诉西科尔斯基“安静点，小人物”。

paras.en: The clash broke out when Musk, the trillionaire former senior adviser to US President Donald Trump and key midterm election donor for his Republican Party, said that Ukraine’s “entire frontline could collapse” if he switched off Starlink.
paras.zh: 这场冲突爆发的原因是，亿万富翁、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的前高级顾问、共和党中期选举的重要捐助者马斯克表示，如果他关闭星链，乌克兰的“整个前线可能会崩溃”。

paras.en: He later said, “No matter how much I disagree with the Ukraine policy, Starlink will never turn off its terminals … We would never do such a thing or use it as a bargaining chip.”
paras.zh: 他后来说，“无论我多么不同意乌克兰政策，星链永远不会关闭其终端……我们永远不会做这样的事情，也不会用它作为讨价还价的筹码。”

paras.en: The slowdown comes after Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv for the second night in a row, killing at least nine people and damaging electricity and heating infrastructure.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯弹道导弹连续第二晚袭击基辅，造成至少九人死亡，电力和供暖基础设施受损，导致经济放缓。

paras.en: Zelenskyy says Ukraine did not receive its usual warnings from Western allies, without specifying which partners.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰没有收到西方盟友通常发出的警告，但没有具体说明是哪些伙伴。

paras.en: Trump said the US has not stopped sharing intelligence.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，美国并未停止分享情报。

paras.en: Beskrestnov warned that the slowdown “cannot be a coincidence” after Trump struck a deal with President Vladimir Putin to import Russian diesel – despite international sanctions to isolate Moscow.
paras.zh: 贝斯克雷斯诺夫警告说，尽管国际制裁孤立了莫斯科，但特朗普与总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)达成协议进口俄罗斯柴油后，经济放缓“不可能是巧合”。

paras.en: Speaking to AFP, another Ukrainian official accused Washington of throttling Starlink and helping Russia.
paras.zh: 另一位乌克兰官员在接受法新社采访时指责华盛顿限制星链并帮助俄罗斯。

paras.en: On Saturday, Trump suggested Zelenskyy had not done enough to end the war with Russia, blaming him for high diesel prices in the US.
paras.zh: 周六，特朗普暗示泽伦斯基在结束与俄罗斯的战争方面做得不够，并指责他造成了美国柴油价格居高不下。

articles.title: Kenya’s health ministry confirms second Ebola case

paras.en: Kenya has reported a second Ebola infection, about a week after confirming its first-ever case of the disease when a citizen who had been living in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) travelled to Kenya and died two days later at a Nairobi hospital.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚报告了第二例埃博拉感染病例，大约一周前，一名居住在刚果民主共和国（DRC）的公民前往肯尼亚，两天后在内罗毕一家医院死亡，确认了该国首例埃博拉病例。

paras.en: The second patient, a 39-year-old man who is a close family member of the first case, fell ill on Tuesday and was already in quarantine when he came down with symptoms of fever, fatigue and joint pain, the Ministry of Health said in a statement Wednesday.
paras.zh: 卫生部周三在一份声明中表示，第二名患者是一名 39 岁男子，是第一例病例的近亲，他于周二发病，出现发烧、疲劳和关节疼痛症状时已被隔离。

paras.en: Last week’s case raised concerns about deficiencies in border screening systems in the region after the patient drove from the DRC to Uganda and flew to Nairobi from there.
paras.zh: 上周的病例引发了对该地区边境筛查系统缺陷的担忧，该患者从刚果民主共和国开车前往乌干达，然后从那里飞往内罗毕。

paras.en: Given the closure of the border between the DRC and Uganda since May because of the outbreak of the virus, it is not clear how he was able to enter the country.
paras.zh: 鉴于自五月起因病毒爆发而关闭刚果民主共和国和乌干达之间的边境，目前尚不清楚他是如何进入该国的。

paras.en: Alan Kasujja, executive director of the Ugandan government’s media centre, questioned how Kenya allowed the man to enter via its airport.
paras.zh: 乌干达政府媒体中心执行主任艾伦·卡苏贾质疑肯尼亚如何允许该男子通过机场入境。

paras.en: “Leave Uganda out of this conversation. We don’t have Ebola here,” he wrote on X.
paras.zh: “把乌干达排除在这次谈话之外。我们这里没有埃博拉病毒，”他在 X 上写道。

paras.en: When asked how the patient was able to travel through three countries undetected, Kenya’s Director-General for Health Patrick Amoth said last week that a meeting was scheduled with officials from the DRC and Uganda and the Africa CDC to investigate.
paras.zh: 当被问及该患者如何能够穿越三个国家而不被发现时，肯尼亚卫生总干事帕特里克·阿莫斯上周表示，已安排与刚果民主共和国、乌干达和非洲疾病预防控制中心的官员举行会议进行调查。

paras.en: Kenya has intensified its national response to the disease since the country recorded the first case. At the time, Kenya traced everyone who came in contact with the patient and reported at least 57 people, with 10 immediately quarantined, Health Minister Aden Duale told journalists on October 7.
paras.zh: 自从该国记录第一例病例以来，肯尼亚加强了对该疾病的全国应对措施。肯尼亚卫生部长亚丁·杜阿勒 (Aden Duale) 10 月 7 日告诉记者，当时，肯尼亚追踪了所有与该患者接触过的人，并报告了至少 57 人，其中 10 人立即被隔离。

paras.en: Kenya is the fourth country to record a case linked to the Ebola epidemic in the DRC, the second-largest on record globally with more than 9,000 cases and more than 4,000 deaths.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚是刚果民主共和国第四个出现埃博拉疫情相关病例的国家，是全球有记录以来第二大病例的国家，病例数超过 9,000 例，死亡人数超过 4,000 人。

paras.en: Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths earlier in the year but was declared Ebola-free in August. A doctor who returned to France in June from the DRC tested positive, but there was no further spread of the virus.
paras.zh: 乌干达今年早些时候报告了 20 例病例和 2 人死亡，但 8 月份宣布已消除埃博拉病毒。一名六月从刚果民主共和国返回法国的医生检测结果呈阳性，但病毒没有进一步传播。

paras.en: Ebola spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people, whether living or dead. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding.
paras.zh: 埃博拉病毒通过直接接触感染者（无论是生者还是死者）的体液进行传播。这种疾病会导致发烧、呕吐、腹泻，严重时还会导致内出血和外出血。

paras.en: The second patient is currently at a designated treatment centre, where he is receiving the appropriate care, the Health Ministry said. It will continue to share information on his progress, the ministry added.
paras.zh: 卫生部表示，第二名患者目前正在指定的治疗中心接受适当的护理。该部补充说，它将继续分享有关他的进展的信息。

articles.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
articles.author: Diaa Hadid

paras.en: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
paras.zh: 这些工人帮助训练机器人，有一天它们会抢走他们的工作

paras.en: KARUR, India — Three men stride across a cavernous textile factory floor of Texworth in the southern Indian city of Karur, handing GoPros and smart glasses to workers, including 40-year-old Shoba Kirubakaran. She's packing yellow aprons decorated with chickens into plastic wrapping for the brand Designs By Danica. It's the third time Kirubakaran says she's been told to don a GoPro.
paras.zh: 印度卡鲁尔——三名男子大步走过印度南部城市卡鲁尔特克斯沃斯一个巨大的纺织工厂车间，将 GoPro 摄像机和智能眼镜递给工人，其中包括 40 岁的 Shoba Kirubakaran。她正在为 Designs By Danica 品牌将装饰有小鸡的黄色围裙装入塑料包装中。这是 Kirubakaran 第三次被告知要戴 GoPro。

paras.en: It's recording her every hand gesture, to train AI robots to take over this job — a fact that she says the company did not share with her. NPR informed her when they interviewed her on a recent day. "Nobody told me anything about it," she says.
paras.zh: 它正在记录她的每一个手势，以训练人工智能机器人来接管这项工作——她说公司没有与她分享这一事实。美国国家公共广播电台在最近一天采访她时告知了她这一消息。 “没有人告诉我任何关于这件事的事情，”她说。

paras.en: Kirubakaran has worked in the factory for 10 years, six days a week, from around 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. She makes $90 a month. With that money, she's helped her husband, a rickshaw driver, raise their two sons. And she adds, "I only know how to do this job."
paras.zh: Kirubakaran 在这家工厂工作了 10 年，每周工作六天，工作时间从上午 9 点左右到下午 6 点。她每月挣 90 美元。她用这笔钱帮助她的人力车夫丈夫抚养两个儿子。她补充道，“我只知道如何做这份工作。”

paras.en: Scenes like these shook the Indian public in April after a video went viral showing rows of textile factory workers wearing these headsets. "This is not a scene from a science fiction film," warned one news anchor from outlet News9Live. "That is happening right now on factory floors across India." Another outlet, AsiaNet News warned: "Indian workers are training AI robots to take their jobs."
paras.zh: 四月份，一段视频显示纺织厂工人戴着这些耳机的视频在网上疯传，这样的场景震惊了印度公众。 “这不是科幻电影中的场景，”News9Live 的一位新闻主播警告说。 “这种情况现在正在印度各地的工厂车间发生。”另一家媒体《亚洲网新闻》警告称：“印度工人正在训练人工智能机器人来抢走他们的工作。”

paras.en: India is emerging as one key place to record this kind of footage because of its large population, relatively low wages and relative openness to new tech. And developers need millions of hours of this footage, what the industry calls egocentric data — data gathered from the perspective of a human with a camera to train AI robots.
paras.zh: 由于人口众多、工资相对较低以及对新技术相对开放，印度正在成为记录此类镜头的关键地点之一。开发人员需要数百万小时的这些镜头，也就是业界所说的以自我为中心的数据——从人类的角度通过摄像头收集的数据来训练人工智能机器人。

paras.en: "That can be obtained only by emulating or collecting data from real human beings that does the job," says Prathosh A.P., a professor at the Indian Institute of Science in Bengaluru. Like many other Indians, he uses initials to refer to his family name. "Think of today's AIs as brains without a body," he says. "Now you have to give them all motor skills ... to do all kinds of intricate motions that we do using a physical body."
paras.zh: 班加罗尔印度科学研究所教授 Prathosh A.P. 表示：“这只能通过模拟或收集从事这项工作的真人的数据来实现。”和许多其他印度人一样，他用缩写来指代他的姓氏。 “把今天的人工智能想象成没有身体的大脑，”他说。 “现在你必须给他们所有的运动技能......来做我们用身体做的各种复杂的动作。”

paras.en: Some workers are signing up because they're paid by the hour for the data. But it appears many others, like Kirubakaran, are simply made to record herself working without any explanation. "Call it what it is, which is exploitation of labor," says Astha Kapoor, co-founder of the Aapti Institute, which studies the impact of technology on people.
paras.zh: 一些员工之所以注册，是因为他们的数据按小时付费。但似乎还有许多其他人，比如基鲁巴卡兰，只是简单地记录下自己的工作，没有任何解释。 “就其本质而言，这就是对劳动力的剥削”，阿普蒂研究所 (Aapti Institute) 联合创始人阿斯塔·卡普尔 (Astha Kapoor) 说道，该研究所致力于研究技术对人类的影响。

paras.en: What will the impact be for India's workforce — the world's second largest, with 600 million people working or seeking work? "Training workers, retraining workers, absorbing them into new occupations," says Amit Basole, economics professor at Azim Premji University. "Do we have the policy agility to do that? I doubt it."
paras.zh: 印度是世界第二大劳动力市场，有 6 亿人在工作或寻找工作，这会对印度的劳动力市场产生什么影响？阿齐姆·普莱姆吉大学经济学教授阿米特·巴索尔表示：“培训工人、再培训工人、让他们从事新的职业。” “我们有政策灵活性来做到这一点吗？我对此表示怀疑。”

paras.en: But that vision of a future full of factory and domestic robots isn't exactly around the corner, say some experts. AI robots are unlikely to be deployed at scale in India — in the near future at least — because they cost a lot of money and consume a lot of power, which is both unreliable and costly across parts of India. "We may be able to make the robots, but they're bloody expensive to run, right?" says Kapoor of the Aapti Institute. "Humans are cheaper to run than robots."
paras.zh: 但一些专家表示，充满工厂和家用机器人的未来愿景并不完全指日可待。人工智能机器人不太可能在印度大规模部署——至少在不久的将来——因为它们花费大量资金并消耗大量电力，而这在印度部分地区不仅不可靠而且成本高昂。 “我们也许能够制造机器人，但它们的运行成本太高了，对吧？”阿普蒂研究所的卡普尔说。 “人类的运行成本比机器人要低。”

paras.en: That power crisis is evident even in Karur, where an Indian tech company, Objectways, gathers egocentric data to sell onto AI developers. Massive generators loudly rumble to ensure seamless electricity in the buildings it powers. The company appears to be one of the town's biggest white-collar employers, occupying at least four building blocks in the town.
paras.zh: 即使在卡鲁尔，这种权力危机也很明显，印度科技公司 Objectways 收集以自我为中心的数据出售给人工智能开发人员。巨大的发电机发出巨大的隆隆声，以确保其供电的建筑物无缝供电。该公司似乎是该镇最大的白领雇主之一，占据了该镇至少四个街区。

paras.en: The CEO, Ravi Shankar, is a Karur native who migrated to Arizona decades ago. He's in perhaps unlikely agreement with Kapoor about the deployment of AI robots in India. "I think it will be more expensive," he says of AI robots, in comparison to human labor. "I don't think it's going to be cheaper."
paras.zh: 首席执行官拉维·香卡 (Ravi Shankar) 是卡鲁尔人，几十年前移民到亚利桑那州。他可能不太可能与卡普尔就在印度部署人工智能机器人达成一致。 “我认为它会更昂贵，”他在谈到人工智能机器人时表示，与人类劳动力相​​比。 “我不认为它会更便宜。”

paras.en: He says his Indian clients want help designing AI robots for jobs that they can't find people to do, like tapping rubber from rubber trees; jobs that are geographically isolated, like dusting off solar panels in rural areas, and jobs that are physically grueling, like destemming chiles for processing.
paras.zh: 他说，他的印度客户希望得到帮助，设计人工智能机器人来完成他们找不到人做的工作，比如从橡胶树上割橡胶；地理上孤立的工作，例如在农村地区除尘太阳能电池板的灰尘，以及体力消耗很大的工作，例如将辣椒去梗进行加工。

paras.en: Inside Objectways, employee Rajeshkumar Ramaswamy shows us how they are training other robots to do repetitive industrial jobs for foreign clients, through what he calls collecting exocentric data — that's data collected from the point of view of a robot. Instead of filming hands of actual workers, young men with GoPro cameras strapped to their heads record themselves doing jobs while holding and manipulating what look like grippy robot claws. One man records himself using the claws to screw bottle lids off and on.
paras.zh: 在 Objectways 内部，员工 Rajeshkumar Ramaswamy 向我们展示了他们如何训练其他机器人为外国客户完成重复性的工业工作，通过他所说的收集外心数据——即从机器人的角度收集的数据。年轻人并没有拍摄实际工人的手，而是将 GoPro 相机绑在头上，记录自己在拿着和操纵看起来像机器人爪子的东西时的工作情况。一名男子记录了自己用爪子拧开或拧开瓶盖的过程。

paras.en: There are dozens of bottles — big, small, plastic, metallic. Ramaswamy says it's to teach robots how to identify all the different shapes and sizes of this thing called a water bottle. The "robot needs to learn what is [a] water bottle," he says.
paras.zh: 有几十个瓶子——大的、小的、塑料的、金属的。拉马斯瓦米说，这是为了教机器人如何识别水瓶这个东西的所有不同形状和大小。 “机器人需要学习什么是水瓶，”他说。

paras.en: Ramaswamy says they'll repeat this process of screwing bottle tops about 100 times and feed that data into an AI robot, so it can see for itself how to use its own grippy hands to do the job.
paras.zh: 拉马斯瓦米表示，他们将重复拧紧瓶盖的过程大约 100 次，并将这些数据输入人工智能机器人，这样它就可以自己了解如何使用自己的抓握手来完成这项工作。

paras.en: "The robot is like a child," Ramaswamy says. "We are the humans. We are teaching the robots what needs to be done."
paras.zh: “机器人就像一个孩子，”拉马斯瓦米说。 “我们是人类。我们正在教机器人需要做什么。”

paras.en: The company also trains robots to do household tasks — like folding towels, putting away books and unpacking bags. It sells that data to AI companies hoping to create domestic robots — there's already a few on the market, including one prominent model that looks like a faceless servant and retails for $20,000.
paras.zh: 该公司还训练机器人做家务，比如折叠毛巾、收起书籍和打开袋子。该公司将这些数据出售给希望制造家用机器人的人工智能公司——市场上已经有一些机器人，其中包括一款看起来像无脸仆人的著名模型，零售价为 20,000 美元。

paras.en: Up a few flights of stairs, Ramaswamy shows us where they have humans recording themselves doing domestic jobs, on a floor kitted out to look like an Ikea-style three-bedroom house. In a fake kitchen, a woman, Rani N., records herself chopping onions.
paras.zh: 爬上几段楼梯，拉马斯瓦米向我们展示了人类在哪里记录自己做家务的情况，地板布置得像宜家风格的三居室房子。在一个假厨房里，一位名叫 Rani N. 的女士记录了自己切洋葱的过程。

paras.en: Most clients who want first-person recordings of domestic chores are in the U.S., so Ramaswamy says they also pay Americans to record themselves doing housework — so their clients can train AI robots on American-specific data.
paras.zh: 大多数想要第一人称录制家务的客户都在美国，因此拉马斯瓦米说，他们还付钱给美国人来录制自己做家务的情况，这样他们的客户就可以根据美国特定的数据来训练人工智能机器人。

paras.en: For instance, in India, many folks use stainless steel plates to eat. A robot trained to pick up a stainless steel plate could use a lot of pressure to grip it, and could drop it — no harm done. But if the same robot tried to pick up a ceramic plate, which is what many Americans use, the same pressure would cause it to "be separated into minute particles," Ramaswamy says — that is, smashed to bits.
paras.zh: 例如，在印度，许多人使用不锈钢盘子吃饭。经过训练可以拿起不锈钢板的机器人可以使用很大的压力来抓住它，也可以将其掉落——不会造成任何伤害。但拉马斯瓦米说，如果同一个机器人试图拿起陶瓷盘（许多美国人都使用陶瓷盘），同样的压力会导致它“分离成微小颗粒”，也就是说，被粉碎成碎片。

paras.en: And to amass recordings of humans doing work with their hands for clients who request ecocentric data, Ramaswamy says, they pay hundreds of people across India to undertake domestic jobs, like Sneha Jegadish, a 24-year-old who lives on the edge of town.
paras.zh: 拉马斯瓦米说，为了为需要以生态为中心的数据的客户收集人类手工劳动的记录，他们付钱给印度各地数百人从事家务工作，比如住在城镇边缘的 24 岁男子斯内哈·杰加迪什 (Sneha Jegadish)。

paras.en: Jegadish clipped her smart phone to a headset and began chopping a carrot, her phone recording her every hand movement.
paras.zh: 杰加迪什将她的智能手机夹在耳机上，开始切胡萝卜，她的手机记录了她的每一个手部动作。

paras.en: She records herself doing housework for a few hours a day, for about $2.60 an hour, and makes around $120 a month. Jegadish folds clothes, wipes the floor, does the dishes — jobs she was never expected to do growing up, because her mother wanted her to focus on her studies. So when she got this gig a few months ago, "my mother had to show me how to do those jobs," she smiles.
paras.zh: 她记录自己每天做几个小时的家务，每小时收入约为 2.60 美元，每月收入约为 120 美元。杰加迪什叠衣服、擦地板、洗碗——她在成长过程中从未被期望做这些​​工作，因为她的母亲希望她专注于学业。因此，当她几个月前得到这份工作时，“我妈妈必须向我展示如何做这些工作，”她笑着说。

paras.en: Money or not, it's still drudgery, says Jegadish. One day, she hopes, she'll have a robot to do her housework. "The work we are doing now is going to be done by robots in the future," she says.
paras.zh: 杰加迪什说，无论有没有钱，这仍然是苦差事。她希望有一天，她能拥有一个机器人来帮她做家务。 “我们现在所做的工作将来将由机器人完成，”她说。

paras.en: That's the same conclusion that 42-year-old textile worker Kannagi Periyasaamy has come to.
paras.zh: 42 岁的纺织工人 Kannagi Periyasaamy 也得出了同样的结论。

paras.en: At the textile factory, Periyasaamy was folding and packing aprons with a GoPro fastened to her head.
paras.zh: 在纺织厂，Periyasaamy 正在折叠和包装围裙，头上戴着 GoPro。

paras.en: She's one of the few workers who is paid about $2.60 an hour to record herself, and she's been told why. She explains: "We are training them [the robots] on how to package the aprons, how to do a quality check, how to fold the aprons."
paras.zh: 她是为数不多的每小时工资约为 2.60 美元的录音工作者之一，而且她也被告知了原因。她解释说：“我们正在培训他们（机器人）如何包装围裙、如何进行质量检查、如何折叠围裙。”

paras.en: Periyasaamy says she's been doing this for the past three months, enough for her to be convinced that someday, a robot will take over her job. When that day comes, she says, "I'm thinking about taking up farming" — the family owns a scrap of land where she could raise cattle. Meanwhile, Periyasaamy thinks of AI robots as her students and says, "I'm proud I can teach it to do a good job."
paras.zh: Periyasaamy 说，过去三个月她一直在这样做，这足以让她相信有一天，机器人会接管她的工作。当那一天到来时，她说，“我正在考虑从事农业”——家里拥有一小块土地，她可以在那里养牛。与此同时，Periyasaamy 将人工智能机器人视为她的学生，并表示：“我很自豪能够教它做好工作。”

paras.en: With additional reporting by Vinodh Arulappan
paras.zh: Vinodh Arulappan 的补充报道
