articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的造型而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: James Talarico torches Biden border policies in stunning attack ad as progressive tries to flip Texas blue

paras.en: Despite spewing a seemingly hawkish and downright right-leaning border stance in the recent ad, Talarico previously called to slash Texas’ entire border-security budget in an unearthed interview.
paras.zh: 尽管塔拉里科在最近的广告中表达了看似鹰派和彻头彻尾右倾的边境立场，但塔拉里科此前在一次出土的采访中呼吁削减德克萨斯州的全部边境安全预算。

paras.en: "I called out Joe Biden for failing us on the border," Talarico says in the opening of the ad released this week.
paras.zh: 塔拉里科在本周发布的广告开头说道：“我指责乔·拜登在边境让我们失望。”

paras.en: But Talarico’s campaign couldn’t give Fox News Digital an example of him ever publicly criticizing Biden during his presidency. And the Texas Democrat explicitly made a call to put Texas’ entire $800 million two-year border security budget toward public education in a 2019 interview with The Austin Chronicle.
paras.zh: 但塔拉里科的竞选活动无法向福克斯新闻数字提供他在总统任期内公开批评拜登的例子。这位德克萨斯州民主党人在 2019 年接受《奥斯汀纪事报》采访时明确呼吁将德克萨斯州两年期 8 亿美元的全部边境安全预算用于公共教育。

paras.en: "We're also sending about $800 million per biennium to the border with Mexico for ‘increased border security,’" Talarico said in the more than seven-year-old interview.
paras.zh: 塔拉里科在长达七年多的采访中表示：“我们每两年还向墨西哥边境提供约 8 亿美元，以‘加强边境安全’。”

paras.en: The two-year deal allocating $400 million per year toward border security in the state of Texas was the state’s entire budget toward warding off illegal immigration at the time Talarico made the call to replace that funding.
paras.zh: 这份为期两年的协议每年为德克萨斯州边境安全拨款 4 亿美元，是塔拉里科呼吁更换这笔资金时该州用于阻止非法移民的全部预算。

paras.en: "I'd rather take that money and put it back into public education and help increase the basic allotment, for instance," he said in the interview.
paras.zh: 他在采访中说：“我宁愿把这笔钱重新投入到公共教育中，并帮助增加基本拨款。”

paras.en: Talarico has ramped up his efforts to come off more moderate amid claims that he is too progressive to win a Senate seat in notoriously red Texas. His move to a more moderate stance on immigration only started during his Senate bid in the state with the highest rates of illegal immigration.
paras.zh: 塔拉里科加大了努力表现得更加温和，因为有人称他过于进步，无法在臭名昭著的红色德克萨斯州赢得参议院席位。他在移民问题上采取更为温和的立场是在他在非法移民率最高的州竞选参议员期间才开始的。

paras.en: "Putting a bunch of boats, planes and border patrol agents on the physical border is expensive and also does not solve the problem," he said in the interview.
paras.zh: 他在接受采访时表示：“在实际边界上部署大量船只、飞机和边境巡逻人员成本高昂，而且也不能解决问题。”

paras.en: His 2019 criticism of border enforcement comes to the surface as border crossings under the Trump administration fell to a new record low level in 55 years in 2025, according to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The decline in illegal immigration followed a series of immigration enforcement measures implemented by the administration.
paras.zh: 根据国土安全部 (DHS) 的数据，随着特朗普政府领导下的边境口岸数量在 2025 年降至 55 年来的新低水平，他 2019 年对边境执法的批评浮出水面。政府实施了一系列移民执法措施后，非法移民数量有所下降。

paras.en: "Everyone will admit it's just political grandstanding," Talarico said in the interview. "Certain lawmakers want to appease extreme parts of their base. And they do it by pumping money we don't have down to the border."
paras.zh: “每个人都会承认这只是政治哗众取宠，”塔拉里科在采访中说。 “某些立法者希望安抚他们的极端派。他们通过向边境注入我们没有的资金来做到这一点。”

paras.en: In his run for Senate, Talarico has now labeled himself a "border security" Democrat, despite an extensive history of pushing back on border security reform and authorities.
paras.zh: 在竞选参议员时，塔拉里科现在将自己称为“边境安全”民主党人，尽管他长期以来一直反对边境安全改革和当局。

paras.en: A former member of the Texas legislature and a former school teacher, Talarico has been in the spotlight repeatedly for many of his far-left controversies, particularly comments regarding immigration enforcement. He has called to dismantle Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), claiming it was "time to tear down this secret police force."
paras.zh: 塔拉里科曾任德克萨斯州立法机关成员和前学校教师，因其许多极左争议，特别是有关移民执法的评论而多次成为人们关注的焦点。他呼吁解散移民和海关执法局（ICE），声称现在是“解散这支秘密警察部队的时候了”。

paras.en: Talarico also referred to illegal aliens as his "constituents."
paras.zh: 塔拉里科还将非法外国人称为他的“选民”。

paras.en: He labeled Republican Texas Gov. Greg Abbott’s border security policies as "atrocities" and accused him of "hunting" illegal immigrants. The Senate candidate also said he "taught a lot of undocumented students," and that those illegal aliens were more patriotic than Americans.
paras.zh: 他将共和党德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特的边境安全政策称为“暴行”，并指责他“追捕”非法移民。这位参议院候选人还表示，他“教了很多无证学生”，而且那些非法移民比美国人更爱国。

paras.en: "James is proud to be the only candidate in this race who has unveiled a border security agenda endorsed by Republican and Democratic border county sheriffs," Talarico's campaign spokesperson JT Ennis told Fox News Digital when asked about the flip-flop.
paras.zh: 当被问及这一转变时，塔拉里科的竞选发言人 JT Ennis 告诉福克斯新闻数字：“詹姆斯很自豪成为这场竞选中唯一公布了共和党和民主党边境县治安官认可的边境安全议程的候选人。”

paras.en: He continued, "James supports stronger border security and immigration enforcement — it’s why he’s called for more border patrol agents and has said we should be arresting and deporting violent criminals and human traffickers — not moms and babies."
paras.zh: 他继续说道，“詹姆斯支持加强边境安全和移民执法——这就是为什么他呼吁增加边境巡逻人员，并表示我们应该逮捕和驱逐暴力犯罪分子和人口贩运者——而不是母亲和婴儿。”

paras.en: The Texas Senate hopeful went briefly missing from the campaign trail this month, prompting viral rumors online to swirl that he was at a behavioral health center. Talarico debunked these claims after clearing the air on his whereabouts when he reappeared Friday, reassuring voters that he was recovering from the flu.
paras.zh: 这位德克萨斯州参议员候选人本月在竞选活动中短暂失踪，导致网上流传他在行为健康中心的谣言。塔拉里科周五再次露面时澄清了自己的行踪，并澄清了这些说法，并向选民保证他正在从流感中康复。

paras.en: Talarico is running against GOP rival Ken Paxton for the Senate seat in Texas. The race has remained close as November’s midterms approach.
paras.zh: 塔拉里科正在与共和党竞争对手肯·帕克斯顿竞选德克萨斯州参议员席位。随着 11 月中期选举的临近，这场竞选依然胶着。

articles.title: Rory McIlroy calls LIV Golf 'half a good idea' before saying he'd vote yes on having players return to Tour

paras.en: In the months leading up to LIV Golf's inception in 2021 and its inaugural event in June 2022, no one was a harsher critic of the breakaway league than Rory McIlroy. As the years have passed and with LIV's future now a complete uncertainty, McIlroy has taken a wider-lensed look at things and, as a result, softened his disdain for the league.
paras.zh: 在 LIV Golf 于 2021 年成立和 2022 年 6 月首次举办赛事之前的几个月里，没有人比罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 对这个脱离联盟的批评更为严厉。随着时间的流逝，LIV 的未来现在完全不确定，麦克罗伊以更广阔的视角看待事物，因此软化了他对联盟的蔑视。

paras.en: Perhaps there is a piece of McIlroy that feels bad for certain players who left the PGA Tour to join LIV Golf. Maybe he's simply grown a bit softer as a now 37-year-old, or with the career grand slam box finally checked, perhaps he's stopped giving a thought to anything that does not directly involve him.
paras.zh: 也许麦克罗伊的某些部分让某些离开美巡赛加入 LIV Golf 的球员感到难过。也许他现在已经37岁了，只是变得更加柔和了一些，或者随着职业生涯大满贯的盒子终于被选中，也许他已经不再考虑任何与他无关的事情了。

paras.en: While we may never know the why of it all, there is no denying that McIlroy's tune about LIV has changed, and his recent comments during the Bloomberg New Economy Forum only confirm that.
paras.zh: 虽然我们可能永远不知道这一切的原因，但不可否认的是，麦克罗伊对 LIV 的态度已经改变，他最近在彭博新经济论坛上的评论也证实了这一点。

paras.en: With LIV Golf filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and the writing on the wall at least beginning to form that the LIV 2.0 endeavor could be a failure-to-launch situation, McIlroy has begun reflecting on the first iteration of the league.
paras.zh: 随着 LIV Golf 根据美国破产法第 11 章申请破产，并且不祥之兆至少开始表明 LIV 2.0 的努力可能会失败，麦克罗伊已经开始反思联盟的第一次迭代。

paras.en: "LIV had probably like half of a good idea that was executed pretty poorly," McIlroy shared during the forum in New Delhi. "They had a lot of capital, but I think a lot of that capital was wasted in some ways, and I think they could have used that money a lot more strategically, and they could have partnered with some of the governing bodies of the game, and they certainly could have done better things with it instead of just enriching tour pros that were already making a lot of money."
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊在新德里的论坛上分享道：“LIV 可能有一半的好想法执行得很糟糕。” “他们有很多资本，但我认为很多资本在某些方面都被浪费了，我认为他们可以更有策略地使用这些钱，他们可以与比赛的一些管理机构合作，他们当然可以用它做更好的事情，而不是仅仅让已经赚了很多钱的巡回赛职业选手变得更加富有。”

paras.en: A year ago, maybe even sooner, it would have been hard to imagine McIlroy sharing thoughts such as these about LIV Golf and what the business could have done. In the past, it would have only been a moment to strictly criticize LIV.
paras.zh: 一年前，甚至更早之前，很难想象麦克罗伊会分享有关 LIV Golf 以及该业务可以做什么的想法。放在以前，严厉批评LIV只是一时的事。

paras.en: McIlroy taking this approach was likely made easier with the Saudi Public Investment Fund (PIF) officially cutting off all funding to the circuit earlier this year, but it's still an interesting change of pace from the former World No. 1.
paras.zh: 随着沙特公共投资基金（PIF）今年早些时候正式切断了对巡回赛的所有资金，麦克罗伊采取这种方法可能会变得更加容易，但这与前世界第一相比仍然是一个有趣的变化。

paras.en: On that topic of change, McIlroy began softening his stance about LIV players returning to the PGA Tour months ago. In May, he said LIV players making a return to the Tour would be "good business."
paras.zh: 在这个改变的话题上，麦克罗伊几个月前开始软化他对LIV球员重返美巡赛的立场。五月份，他表示 LIV 球员重返巡回赛将是“一笔好生意”。

paras.en: When asked at the forum if he would welcome players back on Tour, he stuck to the same idea with his answer.
paras.zh: 当在论坛上被问到是否欢迎球员重返巡回赛时，他的回答也坚持了同样的想法。

paras.en: "Yes, I would," McIlroy explained. "A rising tide lifts all boats, and I think having some of these players back is beneficial for the business of the tours."
paras.zh: “是的，我会的，”麦克罗伊解释道。 “水涨船高，我认为其中一些球员的回归对巡回赛的业务有利。”

articles.title: Washington HS girls blast male athlete participating in track meet: 'Don't think that that's right or fair'

paras.en: Charlie Garret and Sierra Retzlaff were among the Washington high school girls who walked away from a cross-country race on Tuesday, refusing to compete against a male athlete who began the season on the boys' team.
paras.zh: 查理·加雷特（Charlie Garret）和塞拉·雷茨拉夫（Sierra Retzlaff）是周二退出越野比赛的华盛顿高中女生之一，她们拒绝与男子队开始本赛季的男运动员比赛。

paras.en: Instead of bolting off the line when the gun sounded, Garret, Retzlaff and about a dozen other girls walked a few meters and then left the course, while the male athlete took off.
paras.zh: 当枪声响起时，加勒特、雷茨拉夫和其他十几名女孩并没有冲出跑道，而是走了几米，然后离开了赛道，而男运动员则起飞了。

paras.en: "He’s taking that spot. I don’t think that that’s right or fair," Retzlaff said during an appearance on Fox News' "Fox & Friends."
paras.zh: “他占据了这个位置。我认为这不正确也不公平，”雷茨拉夫在福克斯新闻的“福克斯与朋友”节目中露面时说道。

paras.en: "I agree with Sierra, I don’t think it’s fair at all and he’s taking away a spot from every single girl that lines up on that line," Garret, who appeared on "Fox & Friends" with Retzlaff, said.
paras.zh: “我同意塞拉的观点，我认为这根本不公平，他从排队的每个女孩身上夺走了一个位置，”与雷茨拉夫一起出现在“福克斯与朋友”节目中的加勒特说。

paras.en: In addition to walking off, Garret and Retzlaff used body paint to write "keep women in women's sports" on their arms and legs.
paras.zh: 除了走开之外，加勒特和雷茨拉夫还用人体彩绘在手臂和腿上写下了“让女性参与女性运动”。

paras.en: The male runner finished first in the girls' varsity race on Sept. 29 after finishing 76th in the boys' junior varsity race on Sept. 5.
paras.zh: 这位男选手在 9 月 5 日在男子少年代表队比赛中获得第 76 名后，于 9 月 29 日在女子代表队比赛中获得第一名。

paras.en: Garret and Retzlaff both attend Skyview High, while the male runner attends Camas. During Tuesday's race, some members of the male runner's team joined the protest, refusing to compete.
paras.zh: 加勒特和雷茨拉夫都就读于 Skyview 高中，而男运动员则就读于卡马斯高中。在周二的比赛中，男跑队的一些成员加入了抗议，拒绝参加比赛。

paras.en: "I think it’s amazing what they did and I think it’s really brave and courageous of them," Garret said. "Especially since they are running with this person and is one of their teammates. So, I really applaud those Camas girls, I couldn’t be more proud of them."
paras.zh: 加勒特说：“我认为他们所做的事情令人惊奇，我认为他们真的很勇敢。” “特别是因为她们和这个人一起跑步，并且是她们的队友之一。所以，我真的为那些卡马斯女孩鼓掌，我为她们感到无比自豪。”

paras.en: Retzlaff's parents brought signs supporting their daughter, but her father was removed from the event . The athletic director reportedly said the signs were inappropriate . Although the signs weren't allowed, Retzlaff appreciated her parents' support.
paras.zh: 雷茨拉夫的父母带来了支持女儿的标语，但她的父亲被从活动中除名。据报道，体育总监表示这些标志不合适。尽管这些标志是不允许的，雷茨拉夫还是感谢父母的支持。

paras.en: "Obviously it’s great not feeling like you’re the only one doing something and having the people that are always with me through everything really helped a lot," Retzlaff said.
paras.zh: 雷茨拉夫说：“显然，感觉自己不是唯一一个在做某事的人，并且在所有事情上始终与我在一起的人真的很有帮助，这真是太好了。”

paras.en: Garret said the community as a whole was supportive of their decision to protest, even if their team was a little shocked at first.
paras.zh: 加勒特说，整个社区都支持他们抗议的决定，尽管他们的团队一开始有点震惊。

paras.en: The Camas School District said it follows Washington Interscholastic Activities Association eligibility rules and Washington state law, but an upcoming vote could change the policy.
paras.zh: 卡马斯学区表示，它遵循华盛顿校际活动协会的资格规则和华盛顿州法律，但即将举行的投票可能会改变该政策。

paras.en: On Nov. 3, Washington voters will vote on Initiative 638, which would prohibit students defined as biologically male from competing in certain female-only interscholastic athletic competitions. The initiative would require students to provide verification of biological sex from a healthcare provider to enter those competitions.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日，华盛顿选民将对 638 号倡议进行投票，该倡议将禁止生物学上被定义为男性的学生参加某些仅限女性的校际体育比赛。该倡议将要求学生提供医疗保健提供者提供的生物性别证明才能参加这些比赛。

paras.en: However, even if the initiative is approved, it would not take effect in time for Garret, Retzlaff and the other protesting girls. Washington's state cross-country championships are scheduled for Nov. 7, and the measure would go into effect 30 days after the election.
paras.zh: 然而，即使该倡议获得批准，对于加勒特、雷茨拉夫和其他抗议女孩来说，也无法及时生效。华盛顿州越野锦标赛定于 11 月 7 日举行，该措施将在选举后 30 天生效。

paras.en: OutKick's Jackson Thompson contributed to this report.
paras.zh: OutKick 的 Jackson Thompson 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: UK’s ‘incoherent’ approach to China plagued by lack of expertise, report says
articles.author: Rebecca Bailey China correspondent

paras.en: The UK’s approach to China is “beset by incoherence” and plagued by a lack of senior expertise, according to a report warning of the risks inherent in misjudging the bilateral relationship.
paras.zh: 一份报告警告称，英国对中国的态度“缺乏连贯性”，并且缺乏高级专业知识，警告误判双边关系所固有的风险。

paras.en: An audit by the Inter-Parliamentary Alliance on China (Ipac), an international grouping of China-sceptic legislators, says past engagement with Beijing has often exposed the UK to the risks of interference without delivering the opportunities promised.
paras.zh: 由对中国持怀疑态度的立法者组成的国际组织中国问题议会间联盟（Ipac）的一项审计显示，过去与北京的接触经常使英国面临干涉的风险，而没有兑现承诺的机会。

paras.en: “Successful UK engagement with China must always be framed by an understanding that the PRC (People’s Republic of China) is an inherently hostile authoritarian state that does not share our values,” an underlined sentence in the audit, published on Wednesday, reads.
paras.zh: “英国与中国的成功接触必须始终建立在这样的理解之上：中华人民共和国是一个本质上充满敌意的独裁国家，与我们的价值观不同，”周三发布的审计报告中强调的一句话写道。

paras.en: The inherent power imbalance in the relationship with the world’s second largest economy is “further compounded by muddled policy and weak engagement”, it says.
paras.zh: 报告称，与世界第二大经济体的关系中固有的权力失衡“因政策混乱和接触薄弱而进一步加剧”。

paras.en: It cites the example of a visiting Chinese delegation who had noted that no one who engaged with Beijing at a senior level in government was a Mandarin speaker, or had significant experience of living in China.
paras.zh: 它引用了一个来访的中国代表团的例子，该代表团指出，与北京政府高层接触的人中没有人会说普通话，也没有在中国生活的丰富经验。

paras.en: Although British expertise exists, it is often siloed and “not translated into capability”, Ipac, which counts members from all the UK’s major parties, says.
paras.zh: IPAC表示，尽管英国的专业知识存在，但它往往是孤立的， “没有转化为能力” ，该委员会包括来自英国所有主要政党的成员。

paras.en: In an endorsement, the former security minister Tom Tugendhat said the report was “a clear-eyed and realistic take on the defining foreign policy problem of this century, filling a gap left by years of policy neglect”.
paras.zh: 前安全部长汤姆·图根哈特(Tom Tugendhat)在背书中表示，该报告“对本世纪决定性的外交政策问题做出了清醒而现实的看法，填补了多年来政策忽视留下的空白”。

paras.en: While the report accepts that “disengagement was not an option”, it advocates for clearly defined red lines around issues such as critical infrastructure, frontier technologies and human rights.
paras.zh: 尽管该报告承认“脱离接触不是一种选择”，但它主张围绕关键基础设施、前沿技术和人权等问题明确界定红线。

paras.en: The document offers several recommendations, including better institutional coordination, the strengthened use of national security tools, and diversification of supply chains.
paras.zh: 该文件提出了多项建议，包括加强机构协调、加强国家安全工具的使用以及供应链多元化。

paras.en: It identifies emerging technologies such as AI as posing new challenges, in terms of disinformation and surveillance capabilities.
paras.zh: 它认为人工智能等新兴技术在虚假信息和监视能力方面提出了新的挑战。

paras.en: The climate crisis is identified as a low-risk area for cooperation and alignment.
paras.zh: 气候危机被确定为合作与协调的低风险领域。

paras.en: “Climate targets as set will not be met without cooperation with China, and accepting medium-term dependence. This means accepting supply chains tainted by forced labour and unfair trade practices,” the audit says.
paras.zh: “如果不与中国合作并接受中期依赖，既定的气候目标就无法实现。这意味着接受被强迫劳动和不公平贸易行为污染的供应链，”审计报告称。

paras.en: The Guardian has contacted the UK government and the Chinese embassy in London for comment.
paras.zh: 《卫报》已联系英国政府和中国驻伦敦大使馆请其置评。

paras.en: It was “very welcome” that there was an understanding that better language skills were needed to deal with China, said Kerry Brown, a former diplomat and director of the Lau China Institute at King’s College London.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院刘中国研究所所长、前外交官克里·布朗表示，人们认识到需要更好的语言技能来与中国打交道，这是“非常受欢迎的”。

paras.en: However, he said, “the critical issue now is lived experience” in China.
paras.zh: 然而，他表示，“现在的关键问题是在中国的生活经验”。

paras.en: “Some of the members of Ipac … are really keen on promoting this very security-oriented idea that going to China is in some ways opening you up to exposure,” he said.
paras.zh: “Ipac 的一些成员……非常热衷于推广这种非常注重安全的想法，即去中国在某种程度上会让你暴露在外，”他说。

paras.en: “You can’t teach really important things in a classroom; you can only go and learn them through daily life … and that is the thing that is very difficult to do now, and it’s also the thing that doesn’t seem to be supported.”
paras.zh: “你无法在课堂上教授真正重要的东西；你只能通过日常生活去学习它们……这是现在很难做到的事情，也是似乎不受支持的事情。”

articles.title: Two container ships sink near strait of Hormuz amid surge in Iranian attacks
articles.author: Peter Beaumont Senior international correspondent

paras.en: Two container ships have sunk near the strait of Hormuz after being struck by missiles amid the sharpest rise in Iranian attacks on shipping since the start of the US-Israel war with Iran.
paras.zh: 两艘集装箱船在霍尔木兹海峡附近被导弹击中沉没，伊朗对航运的袭击是自美以与伊朗战争爆发以来最严重的一次。

paras.en: The increase in attacks suggests Iran is trying to fully close the strategic waterway in a deliberate attempt to frustrate Donald Trump’s efforts to bring down fuel prices before the US midterm elections on 3 November.
paras.zh: 袭击事件的增加表明，伊朗正试图完全关闭战略航道，蓄意挫败唐纳德·特朗普在 11 月 3 日美国中期选举之前降低燃油价格的努力。

paras.en: The Trump administration has been attempting to deflect attention from the economic impact of the war on Iran by blaming Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries for increased fuel prices.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府一直试图将油价上涨归咎于乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击，以此转移人们对伊朗战争对经济影响的注意力。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported at least five incidents including drone strikes in the previous 48 hours targeting tankers and other commercial ships around the Hormuz area.
paras.zh: 周三，英国海事贸易运营部 (UKMTO) 报告了至少 5 起事件，其中包括在过去 48 小时内针对霍尔木兹地区周围的油轮和其他商船进行无人机袭击的事件。

paras.en: “There is a tempo increase in strikes, which looks deliberate,” one maritime security source said.
paras.zh: 一位海上安全消息人士表示：“袭击节奏加快，看起来是故意的。”

paras.en: The Singapore-flagged GFS Pride container ship sank on Wednesday after an attack the previous day. Hours later, the Antigua and Barbuda-flagged Cape Dao also sank close to the strait after being previously hit by a projectile on 23 September, according to data from the International Maritime Organization.
paras.zh: 悬挂新加坡国旗的 GFS Pride 集装箱船在前一天遭遇袭击后于周三沉没。根据国际海事组织的数据，几小时后，悬挂安提瓜和巴布达国旗的 Cape Dao 号在 9 月 23 日被炮弹击中后也在海峡附近沉没。

paras.en: Apparently referring to the GFS Pride, Iran said a cargo ship had sunk after hitting a naval mine while travelling an unauthorised passage through the strait.
paras.zh: 伊朗显然指的是“GFS Pride”号，称一艘货船在未经授权通过海峡时触雷后沉没。

paras.en: State television quoted a statement from Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corp (IRGC) that said the ship was travelling on an “illegal and dangerous route” when it hit the mine.
paras.zh: 国家电视台援引伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）的一份声明称，这艘船撞上水雷时正在“非法且危险的路线”上行驶。

paras.en: The unidentified ship, which was shown tilted in the water and spewing a thick plume of smoke, was carrying 2,500 containers, the broadcast said.
paras.zh: 广播称，这艘身份不明的船只在水中倾斜并喷出浓烟，船上载有 2,500 个集装箱。

paras.en: However, the UKMTO suggested that both ships had been hit by unidentified projectiles, raising questions over Tehran’s account.
paras.zh: 然而，英国海上贸易组织表示，两艘船都被不明弹丸击中，这引发了对德黑兰说法的质疑。

paras.en: Iran has repeatedly warned ships from trying to transit through the strait without its approval. The US military has been guiding ships through the waterway on a route nearer to Oman’s coast.
paras.zh: 伊朗多次警告船只不要在未经伊朗批准的情况下试图通过该海峡。美国军方一直在引导船只通过靠近阿曼海岸的航道。

paras.en: Ships in the area were reporting an intense series of attacks in recent days with six vessels attacked on Sunday alone, according to UKMTO’s monitoring.
paras.zh: 根据 UKMTO 的监测，该地区的船只最近几天报告了一系列严重的袭击事件，仅周日就有六艘船只遭到袭击。

paras.en: Analysis by the Financial Times said 24 ships were hit in the two weeks to 11 October. Of the vessels hit, three were refined energy product tankers while two others were crude oil tankers.
paras.zh: 英国《金融时报》分析称，截至 10 月 11 日的两周内，有 24 艘船只遭到袭击。在受影响的船只中，三艘是精炼能源产品油轮，另外两艘是原油油轮。

paras.en: The increased tempo of Iranian attacks appears to have caused a dramatic drop-off in oil shipments through the strait, as Tehran appears determined to demonstrate its ability to strike ships before the US midterms that will decide control of Congress.
paras.zh: 伊朗袭击的节奏加快似乎导致通过该海峡的石油运输量急剧下降，因为德黑兰似乎决心在美国中期选举之前展示其打击船只的能力，而中期选举将决定国会的控制权。

paras.en: US fuel prices have surged by almost 70% since Trump launched his war on Iran, and the Republican party is bracing for punishment at the polls.
paras.zh: 自特朗普对伊朗发动战争以来，美国燃油价格已飙升近70%，共和党正准备在民意调查中受到惩罚。

paras.en: According to two Iranian officials, Iran has recently begun using new tactics against vessels it considered in violation of its restrictions. The strategy included a change in the type as well as the pace of attacks, with one goal being to influence the outcome of the US vote, they said.
paras.zh: 据两名伊朗官员称，伊朗最近开始对其认为违反限制的船只采取新的策略。他们表示，该战略包括改变攻击类型和速度，其目标之一是影响美国投票结果。

paras.en: “The aim is to frustrate efforts by the United States and its allies to bring down global oil prices,” one of the two officials told Reuters.
paras.zh: 两名官员之一对路透表示：“此举的目的是挫败美国及其盟国压低全球油价的努力。”

paras.en: The decision to adopt the new strategy had been taken at the highest levels of Iran’s leadership and was fully coordinated across the country’s ruling system, the officials added.
paras.zh: 官员们补充说，采用新战略的决定是由伊朗最高领导层做出的，并在整个国家的统治体系中得到了充分协调。

paras.en: A US military official, speaking on condition of anonymity, confirmed that Tehran had changed tactics in one significant way. After the US destroyed much of Iran’s radar capabilities, the IRGC had started using unarmed spotters in small boats to identify potential targets, including American naval vessels, the official said.
paras.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的美国军方官员证实，德黑兰已经在一个重大方面改变了策略。这位官员表示，在美国摧毁了伊朗的大部分雷达能力后，伊朗革命卫队开始使用小船上的非武装侦察员来识别潜在目标，包括美国海军舰艇。

paras.en: Last week, in a previously unreported incident, the US military determined that Iranian spotters were operating from a dhow, calling in targets to the IRGC, the official said. US forces confronted the vessel, told its occupants to abandon ship and then destroyed it. There were no casualties, the US official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示，上周，在一次此前未报道的事件中，美国军方确定伊朗观察员在一艘单桅帆船上进行行动，向伊斯兰革命卫队呼叫目标。美军与该船对峙，要求船上人员弃船，然后将其摧毁。美国官员称，没有造成人员伤亡。

articles.title: Student protests in Albania turn violent as demonstrators clash with police
articles.author: Guardian staff and agencies in Tirana

paras.en: Tens of thousands of students have taken to the streets of Tirana, the Albanian capital, setting alight a government building and two banks and hurling stones at police during a protest over rising education costs and corruption.
paras.zh: 数万名学生走上阿尔巴尼亚首都地拉那街头，焚烧一栋政府大楼和两家银行，并向警察投掷石块，抗议教育费用上涨和腐败。

paras.en: Police responded with water cannon and teargas to disperse protesters who started a fire at the ministry of education building, overturned bins and smashed the fronts of local businesses. A branch of Raiffeisen Bank near the education ministry also caught fire.
paras.zh: 警方用水枪和催泪瓦斯驱散抗议者，他们在教育部大楼放火，掀翻垃圾箱并砸毁当地企业的门面。教育部附近的 Raiffeisen 银行一家分行也起火。

paras.en: The protests are the most violent outburst yet against Edi Rama, the prime minister, who won a fourth term in office in May last year but has since faced growing discontent at perceived graft surrounding top officials. Protesters also dismiss opposition figures as unpalatable alternatives.
paras.zh: 这些抗议活动是迄今为止针对总理埃迪·拉玛(Edi Rama)最暴力的一次。拉玛去年5月赢得了第四个任期，但自那以后，人们对高层官员腐败现象日益不满。抗议者还认为反对派人物是令人不快的替代品。

paras.en: The unrest caps a summer of peaceful protests against Rama, triggered by the proposed development of a luxury resort along Albania’s pristine southern coast backed by Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner, which has been caught up in legal disputes.
paras.zh: 这场骚乱为今年夏天针对拉玛的和平抗议活动画上句号，抗议活动是由唐纳德·特朗普女婿贾里德·库什纳支持的阿尔巴尼亚原始南部海岸开发豪华度假村的提议引发的，该度假村已陷入法律纠纷。

paras.en: “This is a revolution. We are tired of peaceful protests. We will not stop until Rama resigns,” said Lora, a student who declined to give her last name as she threw rocks at the police.
paras.zh: “这是一场革命。我们厌倦了和平抗议。在拉玛辞职之前我们不会停止，”学生洛拉（Lora）说，她在向警察投掷石块时拒绝透露自己的姓氏。

paras.en: Others chanted “resignation” and “police of crime”.
paras.zh: 其他人则高呼“辞职”和“犯罪警察”。

paras.en: Student organisers said the protest was over conditions at universities, higher education costs, a lack of financial support and employment prospects after graduation.
paras.zh: 学生组织者表示，抗议活动的主题是大学条件、高等教育成本、缺乏经济支持以及毕业后的就业前景。

paras.en: The unrest is part of a broader wave of student activism sweeping Europe over education and living conditions. In France, high school students have staged weeks of protests and school blockades demanding more teachers and better facilities, arguing that deteriorating school buildings and overcrowded classrooms are undermining education.
paras.zh: 这次骚乱是席卷欧洲的针对教育和生活条件的更广泛的学生激进主义浪潮的一部分。在法国，高中生进行了数周的抗议和封锁学校，要求增加教师和改善设施，他们认为日益恶化的校舍和过度拥挤的教室正在破坏教育。

paras.en: Albanian media reported that Wednesday’s protests had spread to universities at Elbasan and Shkodër.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚媒体报道称，周三的抗议活动已蔓延至爱尔巴桑和斯库台的大学。

paras.en: Albana Koçiu, the deputy prime minister of Albania, said on Facebook: “Protesting is a legitimate right, but it cannot be used as an excuse for violence, city destruction or ugly fighting in the middle of the road. I call on students and every honest citizen who believes in the right to protest: distance yourself from violence and vandalism!”
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚副总理阿尔巴纳·科丘在脸书上表示：“抗议是一项合法权利，但不能作为暴力、破坏城市或丑陋的路中间打斗的借口。我呼吁学生和每一个相信抗议权利的诚实公民：远离暴力和破坏行为！”

paras.en: The police issued a statement calling for calm. “Any person who uses violence, burns or destroys property, or attacks police officers, bears individual responsibility and will face the law, in accordance with the offences committed,” they said.
paras.zh: 警方发表声明呼吁民众保持冷静。他们说：“任何使用暴力、焚烧或毁坏财产、或袭击警察的人，均需承担个人责任，并将根据所犯罪行受到法律制裁。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, the EU, which the Balkan nation aspires to join, voiced concern over what it called the “violent escalation at the protest in Tirana”.
paras.zh: 与此同时，这个巴尔干国家渴望加入的欧盟对所谓的“地拉那抗议活动暴力升级”表示担忧。

paras.en: A statement by the EU delegation in Tirana said: “We take note of the allegations of excessive violence by the police against protesters and journalists,”
paras.zh: 欧盟代表团在地拉那发表声明称：“我们注意到警方对抗议者和记者过度使用暴力的指控。”

paras.en: Calling for a prompt investigation, the delegation encouraged “all sides to de-escalate the tension”.
paras.zh: 代表团呼吁立即展开调查，并鼓励“各方缓和紧张局势”。

articles.title: Burnham says he wants to 'repair bridges' between Ukraine and US

paras.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said he will try to "repair bridges" between Ukraine and the United States, ahead of a meeting with President Volodymyr Zelensky at Downing Street.
paras.zh: 总理安迪·伯纳姆表示，在唐宁街与总统泽伦斯基会面之前，他将努力“修复”乌克兰和美国之间的桥梁。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president was welcomed by a military ceremonial guard outside Number 10 as he arrived for the meeting, in what is thought to be a first for a foreign leader.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统抵达出席会议时受到了10号门外军事仪仗队的欢迎，这被认为是外国领导人的第一次。

paras.en: It comes after President Donald Trump said he had struck a deal with Moscow to import Russian diesel.
paras.zh: 此前，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，他已与莫斯科达成协议，进口俄罗斯柴油。

paras.en: Asked about Trump's move during Prime Minister's Questions, Burnham resisted criticising the US president, saying he wanted to "be careful in terms of laying the ground to bring people back together".
paras.zh: 当被问及特朗普在总理提问期间的举动时，伯纳姆拒绝批评美国总统，称他希望“在为让人们重新团结起来奠定基础方面要小心谨慎”。

paras.en: However, he stressed that Zelensky would not be leaving the UK "empty-handed", as he said further military and financial support would be drawn up in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: 不过，他强调泽伦斯基不会“空手”离开英国，他表示将在未来几周内制定进一步的军事和财政支持。

paras.en: Burnham is expected to use the visit to promise further sanctions against Russia, while also announcing the UK will accelerate its delivery of air defence missiles to Kyiv.
paras.zh: 预计伯纳姆将利用这次访问承诺对俄罗斯实施进一步制裁，同时宣布英国将加快向基辅运送防空导弹。

paras.en: The UK will also urge allies to step up pressure on Russia, with Chancellor John Healey using International Monetary Fund meetings to call for a ban on Russian liquefied natural gas (LNG).
paras.zh: 英国还将敦促盟友加大对俄罗斯的压力，英国财政大臣约翰·希利利用国际货币基金组织会议呼吁禁止俄罗斯液化天然气（LNG）。

paras.en: It is Zelensky's second visit to the UK since Burnham became prime minister.
paras.zh: 这是伯纳姆出任首相以来泽伦斯基第二次访问英国。

paras.en: While other world leaders have received military welcomes, Number 10 said it could not find a record of one taking place on Downing Street.
paras.zh: 虽然其他世界领导人受到了军事欢迎，但《10号》表示，它找不到在唐宁街举行的军事欢迎活动的记录。

paras.en: During PMQs, Liberal Democrat leader Sir Ed Davey asked whether he agreed the diesel deal was "yet another shameful Trump betrayal of the Ukrainian people and European security".
paras.zh: 在PMQ期间，自由民主党领袖埃德·戴维爵士询问他是否同意柴油交易是“特朗普对乌克兰人民和欧洲安全的又一可耻背叛”。

paras.en: In response, Burnham did not echo Sir Ed's condemnation of Trump, saying: "What I have to do in my role is try and repair bridges so that the support comes back and therefore I should at this moment in time be careful in terms of laying the ground to bring people back together."
paras.zh: 作为回应，伯纳姆没有回应埃德爵士对特朗普的谴责，他说：“我在我的角色中要做的就是尝试修复桥梁，以便重新获得支持，因此我现在应该小心谨慎，为让人们重新团结起来奠定基础。”

paras.en: The PM said he had spoken to Zelensky over the phone on Saturday "because I recognised it was another very dark and difficult moment for him as they contemplate a winter that will be severe for his people".
paras.zh: 总理表示，他周六与泽连斯基通了电话，“因为我认识到这对他来说又是一个非常黑暗和困难的时刻，因为他们正在考虑一个对他的人民来说将是严峻的冬天”。

paras.en: The phone call came after Trump announced that President Vladimir Putin had agreed to release millions of tonnes of Russian diesel into the US, as he suspended sanctions on diesel from Moscow.
paras.zh: 在特朗普宣布总统弗拉基米尔·普京同意向美国释放数百万吨俄罗斯柴油后，他暂停了对莫斯科柴油的制裁。

paras.en: Zelensky branded the move a gift to Putin, warning it would provide Moscow with money to continue its war against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基称此举是给普京的礼物，警告称这将为莫斯科提供资金以继续对乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: Trump responded by saying it was "time for Ukraine to get a new president".
paras.zh: 特朗普回应称，“乌克兰是时候选出新总统了”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Zelensky has said at least 600,000 people across Ukraine were left without electricity after deadly overnight Russian missile and drone strikes.
paras.zh: 与此同时，泽连斯基表示，在俄罗斯隔夜导弹和无人机发动致命袭击后，乌克兰各地至少有 60 万人断电。

paras.en: He said "critical" energy infrastructure had been hit â despite Trump's claim on Sunday that a ceasefire on strikes on energy infrastructure was in place between Russia and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 他表示，“关键”的能源基础设施受到了打击——尽管特朗普周日声称俄罗斯和乌克兰之间已经就针对能源基础设施的袭击达成停火协议。

paras.en: Russia said its strikes had hit communications and energy facilities used by Ukraine's military.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯表示，其袭击袭击了乌克兰军方使用的通讯和能源设施。

paras.en: Zelensky has said Ukraine is ready to halt its strikes on Russian oil refineries and other energy facilities if Moscow did the same.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，如果莫斯科也这样做，乌克兰准备停止对俄罗斯炼油厂和其他能源设施的袭击。

paras.en: But Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov has said Ukraine does not deserve the "respite" a ceasefire would bring.
paras.zh: 但俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫表示，乌克兰不值得停火带来的“喘息”。

articles.title: Netflix to lay off 1,000 staff in steepest cuts since 2022

paras.en: Netflix has said it will cut 1,000 jobs globally as the streaming giant faces competition from rivals.
paras.zh: Netflix 表示，由于这家流媒体巨头面临竞争对手的竞争，将在全球范围内裁员 1,000 人。

paras.en: The cuts - the steepest since 2022 - will mainly affect its human resources, legal, product and technology teams and equates to around 6% of its total workforce.
paras.zh: 此次裁员是 2022 年以来最大幅度的裁员，将主要影响其人力资源、法律、产品和技术团队，约占员工总数的 6%。

paras.en: Last month, Netflix 's co-chief executive, Ted Sarandos, told the Bloomberg Screentime summit that the company was "not growing as fast as I want us to".
paras.zh: 上个月，Netflix 联席首席执行官泰德·萨兰多斯 (Ted Sarandos) 在彭博屏幕时间峰会上表示，该公司“的增长速度没有我希望的那么快”。

paras.en: The streaming industry is going through a period of consolidation following Paramount's $110bn (Â£83.6bn) merger with Warner Bros, the owner of HBO, while free platforms such as YouTube and TikTok continue to attract viewers.
paras.zh: 派拉蒙以 1100 亿美元（836 亿英镑）的价格与 HBO 的所有者华纳兄弟合并后，流媒体行业正在经历一段整合期，而 YouTube 和 TikTok 等免费平台继续吸引观众。

paras.en: In an email to staff, Sarandos and co-chief executive Greg Peters said Netflix would "continue to invest aggressively in high-impact areas to improve our service and further drive growth and innovation".
paras.zh: 萨兰多斯和联席首席执行官格雷格·彼得斯在给员工的电子邮件中表示，Netflix 将“继续在高影响力领域积极投资，以改善我们的服务并进一步推动增长和创新”。

paras.en: Netflix had come close to its own deal with Warner Bros but was outbid in the end by Paramount.
paras.zh: Netflix 曾一度接近与华纳兄弟达成协议，但最终被派拉蒙出价高于。

paras.en: Commenting on the "organisational changes", Sarandos and Peters said: "Our mission - to entertain the world - is ambitious, and delivering on it requires us to be disciplined about where we prioritise our people and resources."
paras.zh: 萨兰多斯和彼得斯在评论“组织变革”时表示：“我们的使命——娱乐世界——是雄心勃勃的，要实现这一目标，我们需要严格控制人员和资源的优先顺序。”

paras.en: Managers will tell employees whether their job has been cut "soon".
paras.zh: 经理们将告诉员工他们的工作是否“很快”被裁掉。

paras.en: The email added that the firm was on track to meet its financial forecasts. The streaming service is due to report its latest results on 20 October.
paras.zh: 该电子邮件补充说，该公司有望实现其财务预测。该流媒体服务将于 10 月 20 日报告最新业绩。

paras.en: Investors have been weighing up user engagement - the amount of time customers spend on Netflix - as it competes with platforms such as YouTube and TikTok.
paras.zh: 由于 Netflix 与 YouTube 和 TikTok 等平台竞争，投资者一直在权衡用户参与度，即客户在 Netflix 上花费的时间。

paras.en: The firm has continued to commission shows - its most popular at the moment is "Below", an underwater mystery series.
paras.zh: 该公司继续委托制作节目——目前最受欢迎的是水下悬疑系列剧《Below》。

paras.en: It has also been attempting to expand its business, including gaming and allowing adverts to play before and during shows and films.
paras.zh: 它还一直在尝试扩大业务，包括游戏以及允许在演出和电影之前和期间播放广告。

paras.en: However, "they haven't been able to find another line of major revenue," said Ross Benes, senior analyst at eMarketer.
paras.zh: 然而，“他们还没有找到另一条主要收入来源”，eMarketer 的高级分析师罗斯·贝内斯 (Ross Benes) 表示。

paras.en: He added that the company remains reliant on a subscription business that could be approaching a plateau.
paras.zh: 他补充说，该公司仍然依赖订阅业务，而该业务可能已接近稳定状态。

paras.en: "Eventually, because they're nearing a ceiling with that, they'll need another revenue stream to diversify, and that's where it's been more of a struggle," he said.
paras.zh: “最终，因为他们已经接近上限，他们将需要另一个收入来源来实现多元化，而这正是他们更加挣扎的地方，”他说。

articles.title: Kenya confirms second Ebola case - a relative of the first victim

paras.en: Kenya has confirmed a second case of Ebola, 10 days after a businessman died of the virus after he had travelled to the East African nation from the Democratic Republic of Congo.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚确认了第二例埃博拉病例，十天前，一名商人从刚果民主共和国前往这个东非国家后死于该病毒。

paras.en: The new patient, a 39-year-old man, is a close relative of the first case and was already in quarantine when he fell ill on Tuesday, Kenya's health ministry said.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生部表示，这名新患者是一名 39 岁男子，是第一例病例的近亲，周二发病时已处于隔离状态。

paras.en: The incubation period for Ebola ranges from two to 21 days, meaning those exposed to the virus may not become ill for several weeks.
paras.zh: 埃博拉病毒的潜伏期为 2 至 21 天，这意味着接触该病毒的人可能在几周内不会生病。

paras.en: Detecting his illness early had improved his chances of recovery and limited the chance of him passing the virus on to others, the ministry said, as it urged the public to "stay calm but vigilant".
paras.zh: 卫生部表示，及早发现他的病情提高了他康复的机会，并限制了他将病毒传播给其他人的机会，并敦促公众“保持冷静但保持警惕”。

paras.en: "Both cases are linked, and there is no evidence of spread in the wider community," the ministry added.
paras.zh: 卫生部补充说：“这两起案件都是相关的，没有证据表明在更广泛的社区中传播。”

paras.en: The 40-year-old Kenyan man who died on 5 October was diagnosed with Ebola shortly after being admitted to hospital in the capital, Nairobi.
paras.zh: 10月5日死亡的40岁肯尼亚男子在首都内罗毕入院后不久被诊断出感染埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: A relative had taken him there shortly after picking him up at the airport. He had travelled from DR Congo, through Uganda to Kenya without his illness being detected.
paras.zh: 一位亲戚在机场接他后不久就带他去了那里。他从刚果民主共和国出发，经乌干达到达肯尼亚，但他的病情并未被发现。

paras.en: Since his death, officials had determined that he had been in contact with 128 people - and since Tuesday 113 of them had been found, the health ministry said.
paras.zh: 卫生部表示，自他去世以来，官员们已确定他与 128 人有过接触，自周二以来，已发现其中 113 人。

paras.en: Of these, 108 were in quarantine in Kenya and tracing of the remaining 15 continued, it said.
paras.zh: 报告称，其中 108 人在肯尼亚接受隔离，其余 15 人的追踪工作仍在继续。

paras.en: More than 4,000 people have died from Ebola in DR Congo this year, in what is the second most deadly known outbreak to date.
paras.zh: 今年，刚果民主共和国已有 4,000 多人死于埃博拉病毒，这是迄今为止已知的第二次最致命的埃博拉疫情。

paras.en: The Ebola virus spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids such as blood or vomit.
paras.zh: 埃博拉病毒通过接触受感染的体液（例如血液或呕吐物）传播。

paras.en: The current outbreak in DR Congo, which began in May, has been caused by the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, which is relatively rare, with no approved vaccine or treatment - though trials are under way.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国目前的疫情始于五月，是由本迪布焦埃博拉病毒引起的，这种埃博拉病毒相对罕见，目前尚无批准的疫苗或治疗方法，但试验正在进行中。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: Carlisle 推出 EL121 盘式制动器，以提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州梅迪纳，2023 年 9 月 12 日）——Carlisle Brake & Friction 很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用运输卡车应用的 EL121 盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为Extend Life，即EL系列，EL121将是该系列中首款推出的摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的 EL121 系列摩擦材料使前轴、矿用运输卡车刹车片的使用寿命几乎延长了一倍。使用 OEM 卡钳和转子时，可以增加设备的正常运行时间并降低维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自动运输卡车的刹车片温度较高，当使用缓速器和行车制动器时，制动周期的增加会导致刹车片磨损加剧。 EL121 采用高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片的使用寿命，并具有一致且防褪色的制动性能。 EL121 是当今自动矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和使用寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司摩擦产品产品线总监 Ron Ratell 表示：“我们了解矿山运营商需要让运输卡车继续工作，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新技术可将前轴矿用运输卡车制动片的使用寿命延长一倍，并且是现有 OEM 制动片的理想替代品。这些制动片经过了彻底的实验室测试以及小松 830E-1 卡车的现场测试。”

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.
paras.zh: EL121 摩擦力经过测功机测试以复制应用，并被证明可以提供创新的高能材料来满足市场需求。 EL121 盘式刹车片还采用经过行业验证的机械固定系统，采用背板技术，旨在实现卓越的粘合性和耐用性，甚至能够承受最恶劣的非公路环境中的恶劣条件。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.
paras.zh: Carlisle 的 EL121 系列盘式刹车片现已通过 Carlisle 授权经销商和分销商发售。要了解更多信息，请访问 https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el。要查找您附近的卡莱尔授权经销商，请搜索我们的在线经销商列表 https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司推出了新产品解决方案视频：卡莱尔拖拉机应用解决方案，展示适用于农业设备（特别是拖拉机应用）的所有最新运动控制技术。

paras.en: From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
paras.zh: 从动力阀到盘式制动器，再到取力器和梭式离合器摩擦选项，该视频详细介绍了卡莱尔最新制动系统和动力总成解决方案的所有功能和优点。

paras.en: For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。
