articles.title: With the Help of Family Wealth and Instagram, Gen Z Is Spending Big in the Art Market

paras.en: A new survey about trends and participation in global art collecting has yielded a surprising finding: Wealthy members of Generation Z, defined by the report as those between the ages of 20 and 29, are now the art market’s biggest spenders.
paras.zh: 一项关于全球艺术收藏趋势和参与度的新调查得出了一个令人惊讶的发现：报告将 Z 世代定义为 20 至 29 岁之间的富裕成员，他们现在是艺术市场上最大的消费者。

paras.en: According to the latest Survey of Global Collecting, which is jointly published by Art Basel and the bank UBS, high-net-worth Gen Z collectors outspent every other generation on fine art in 2025 and the first half of 2026. The margin wasn’t particularly close. Individual average spending by Gen Z during that 18-month span was more than double that of individuals from every other age bracket.
paras.zh: 巴塞尔艺术展和瑞银银行联合发布的最新《全球收藏调查》显示，2025 年和 2026 年上半年，高净值 Z 世代收藏家在艺术品上的支出超过了其他世代。但差距并不是特别接近。在这 18 个月的时间里，Z 世代的个人平均支出是其他年龄段个人的两倍多。

paras.en: The survey only measured the spending of what it calls “high-net-worth individuals … who are currently active in the art market.” Family wealth and inherited art-buying habits clearly influenced the younger generation. But the unexpected result still challenges the impression that younger people are detached from the world of art. Those with money, at least, appear willing to spend.
paras.zh: 该调查仅衡量了所谓的“目前活跃在艺术市场的高净值人士”的支出。家庭财富和继承的艺术品购买习惯明显影响了年轻一代。但出乎意料的结果仍然挑战了年轻人脱离艺术世界的印象。至少那些有钱的人似乎愿意花钱。

paras.en: “It’s always interesting when you have a notion or an idea going in, and it just gets completely disproved,” Clare McAndrew, the founder of the Arts Economics consultancy and the author of the report, tells the Art Newspaper’s Carlie Porterfield.
paras.zh: “当你有一个想法或想法时，它总是很有趣，但它却被彻底反驳了，”艺术经济咨询公司的创始人、该报告的作者克莱尔·麦克安德鲁告诉《艺术报》的卡莉·波特菲尔德。

paras.en: She adds: “So many people are saying that younger collectors are not so engaged or not really interested, and they’re not focusing on art, or they’re just buying a load of other stuff. Whereas this survey showed very much a different picture, that they were among the most engaged of all the different age brackets, and the spending levels were pretty amazing.”
paras.zh: 她补充道：“很多人都说年轻的收藏家不那么投入或不太感兴趣，他们不专注于艺术，或者只是购买大量其他东西。而这项调查显示了截然不同的情况，他们是所有不同年龄段中最投入的收藏家之一，而且支出水平相当惊人。”

paras.en: The report shows that Gen Z collectors’ willingness to open their wallets has gained significant momentum in recent years. Their average spending on fine art jumped 19 percent from 2024 (around $292,000) to 2025 ($347,000). Average spending in the first half of 2026 has already reached $329,000.
paras.zh: 报告显示，近年来，Z 世代收藏家愿意掏腰包的意愿显着增强。从 2024 年（约 292,000 美元）到 2025 年（347,000 美元），他们在美术上的平均支出增长了 19%。 2026 年上半年的平均支出已达到 329,000 美元。

paras.en: High-net-worth baby boomers, the next-closest spenders, were left in Gen Z’s dust over those same years. Boomers spent an average of just $158,000 in 2024, $165,000 in 2025 and $156,000 so far in 2026.
paras.zh: 婴儿潮一代的高净值人士，也就是第二大的消费群体，在同一年里被 Z 世代抛在了身后。 2024 年，婴儿潮一代的平均支出仅为 158,000 美元，2025 年为 165,000 美元，2026 年迄今为 156,000 美元。

paras.en: Crucially, the report flags two major qualifiers regarding its findings. The first is sample size. Of the 3,100 high net-worth-individuals who participated in the survey, just 9 percent were Gen Z. Forty-four percent were millennials, 25 percent were Gen X and 22 percent were baby boomers.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，该报告针对其调查结果提出了两个主要限定条件。首先是样本大小。在参与调查的 3,100 名高净值人士中，只有 9% 是 Z 世代。44% 是千禧一代，25% 是 X 世代，22% 是婴儿潮一代。

paras.en: The second caveat is that average spending figures were likely skewed by the small percentage of collectors, across all generations, who shelled out significantly more money on art than their peers. Among Gen Z collectors, 13 percent spent more than $1 million on art in the first half of 2026, while 75 percent spent less than $100,000. Still, only 3 percent of boomer respondents, 2 percent of millennials and 1 percent of Gen X spent more than $1 million.
paras.zh: 第二个警告是，平均支出数据可能会受到各代收藏家中一小部分人的影响，他们在艺术品上花费的钱比同龄人多得多。在 Z 世代收藏家中，13% 的人在 2026 年上半年在艺术品上的花费超过 100 万美元，而 75% 的人花费不到 10 万美元。尽管如此，只有 3% 的婴儿潮一代受访者、2% 的千禧一代和 1% 的 X 一代的消费超过 100 万美元。

paras.en: Leonardo da Vinci’s Salvator Mundi, painted around 1500, is the most expensive artwork ever sold at auction. It sold for $450.3 million at Christie’s New York in November 2017.
paras.zh: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇的《救世主》绘制于 1500 年左右，是拍卖会上售出的最昂贵的艺术品。它于 2017 年 11 月在纽约佳士得以 4.503 亿美元的价格售出。

paras.en: The report sheds light on the ways in which Gen Z behavior adheres to traditional collecting trends—as well as how members of this generation buck them.
paras.zh: 该报告揭示了 Z 世代行为遵循传统收藏趋势的方式，以及这一代人如何反抗这些趋势。

paras.en: For every generation, paintings are the most popular medium to purchase. However, Gen Z outspends the next-highest generation on jewelry and gems by a factor of more than five. And though Gen Z is heavily reliant on social media for art advice, the survey notes that those who began collecting through online channels are the most likely to attend in-person, art-related events.
paras.zh: 对于每一代人来说，绘画都是最受欢迎的购买媒介。然而，Z 世代在珠宝和宝石方面的支出比下一代最高一代高出五倍多。尽管 Z 世代严重依赖社交媒体获取艺术建议，但调查指出，那些开始通过在线渠道进行收藏的人最有可能亲自参加与艺术相关的活动。

paras.en: “Instagram reaches such a wide audience,” Mazdak Sanii, founder of Avant Arte, an art marketplace aimed at reaching a younger generation of art collectors, tells the Financial Times’ Melanie Gerlis. “Not everyone on it has $1,000 to start collecting, but they might discover an artist that way, then visit one of their exhibitions. It’s the start.”
paras.zh: “Instagram 拥有如此广泛的受众，”旨在吸引年轻一代艺术收藏家的艺术市场 Avant Arte 的创始人 Mazdak Sanii 告诉英国《金融时报》的 Melanie Gerlis。 “并不是每个人都有 1,000 美元开始收藏，但他们可能会通过这种方式发现一位艺术家，然后参观他们的一个展览。这就是开始。”

paras.en: Even so, Gen Z was also the most adventurous group of buyers. Per the report, 56 percent of Gen Z respondents bought an unfamiliar artist’s work, compared with just 36 percent of boomers.
paras.zh: 即便如此，Z 世代也是最具冒险精神的买家群体。根据该报告，56% 的 Z 世代受访者购买了不熟悉的艺术家的作品，而婴儿潮一代的这一比例仅为 36%。

paras.en: The survey’s findings suggest an art world in flux, with younger buyers finding their way into the market and the market finding ways to adapt.
paras.zh: 调查结果表明，艺术世界正在不断变化，年轻买家正在寻找进入市场的方式，而市场也在寻找适应的方法。

paras.en: “This tells a very different picture of who’s out there buying art,” Matthew Newton, head of Art Advisory Americas at UBS, tells CNBC’s Robert Frank. “There is a wide conversation happening in the art world to accommodate and attract this generation. This tells us that those individuals are already out there and already very active.”
paras.zh: 瑞银美洲艺术咨询主管马修·牛顿 (Matthew Newton) 告诉 CNBC 的罗伯特·弗兰克 (Robert Frank)：“这揭示了购买艺术品的人的截然不同的情况。” “艺术界正在展开广泛的对话，以适应和吸引这一代人。这告诉我们，这些人已经在那里，并且已经非常活跃。”

articles.title: An Unprecedented Trove of Ancient Wooden Tools Uncovered at a Rock Shelter in Spain Shows Neanderthals Were Skilled Woodworkers

paras.en: When you think of Neanderthal technology, you probably envision stone tools. But a trove of ancient wooden artifacts uncovered in Spain is giving an unprecedented look at how our extinct relatives used other resources.
paras.zh: 当您想到尼安德特人的技术时，您可能会想到石器。但在西班牙发现的一批古代木制文物让我们以前所未有的方式了解我们已灭绝的亲戚如何使用其他资源。

paras.en: Researchers examined hundreds of wooden objects—including imprints left by decayed ones—at a site called Abric Romaní, about 30 miles west of Barcelona. The array of relics further show that Neanderthals were skilled woodworkers who used the material to create trays, plates, weapons and other items. The findings, described in a study published in the journal Science Advances on October 7, add to a growing body of evidence that demonstrates Neanderthals weren’t as simple as previously believed.
paras.zh: 研究人员在巴塞罗那以西约 30 英里的一个名为 Abric Romaní 的地点检查了数百件木制品，其中包括腐烂的木制品留下的印记。一系列文物进一步表明，尼安德特人是熟练的木工，他们使用这种材料制作托盘、盘子、武器和其他物品。 10 月 7 日发表在《科学进展》杂志上的一项研究描述了这一发现，为越来越多的证据表明尼安德特人并不像之前认为的那么简单。

paras.en: “Not so long ago, Neanderthals were considered our less complex cousins,” says study co-author M. Gema Chacón, an archaeologist at the Catalan Institute of Human Paleoecology and Social Evolution (IPHES-CERCA) in Spain, to Andrew Curry at Science. “Now it looks like their behaviors were very close to those of Homo sapiens.”
paras.zh: “不久前，尼安德特人还被认为是我们不太复杂的表亲，”该研究的合著者、西班牙加泰罗尼亚人类古生态和社会进化研究所 (IPHES-CERCA) 的考古学家 M. Gema Chacón 对《科学》杂志的安德鲁·库里 (Andrew Curry) 说道。 “现在看起来他们的行为与智人非常接近。”

paras.en: Most archaeological evidence we have from the Paleolithic period, which spans around 12,000 to 2.6 million years ago, is made from stone for a rather simple reason—organic materials decompose, and stone doesn’t. “Stone survives extremely well, so naturally, stone tools dominate the archaeological record,” explains study co-author Josep Vallverdú, also an archaeologist at IPHES-CERCA, to Gayoung Lee at Gizmodo. “Wood usually disappears. But wood is an incredibly versatile material.”
paras.zh: 我们掌握的旧石器时代（距今约 12,000 至 260 万年前）的大多数考古证据都是由石头制成的，原因相当简单——有机材料会分解，而石头则不会。 “石头保存得非常好，所以自然地，石器在考古记录中占主导地位，”该研究的合著者、IPHES-CERCA 的考古学家 Josep Vallverdú 向 Gizmodo 的 Gayoung Lee 解释道。 “木材通常会消失。但木材是一种用途极其广泛的材料。”

paras.en: Other evidence of ancient woodworking has been found at sites in Italy and Germany, but these were mostly digging tools for foraging and weapons for hunting found on muddy lake shores. Abric Romaní in Spain, on the other hand, has a diversity of wooden objects because it was a living space. The roughly 3,200-square-foot shelter had fireplaces, trash pits, sleeping areas and more.
paras.zh: 在意大利和德国的遗址中还发现了古代木工的其他证据，但这些大多是在泥泞的湖岸上发现的用于觅食的挖掘工具和狩猎武器。另一方面，西班牙的 Abric Romani 拥有各种各样的木制物品，因为它是一个生活空间。这个大约 3,200 平方英尺的避难所设有壁炉、垃圾坑、睡眠区等。

paras.en: In 1948, amateur archaeologists found a 125,000-year-old straight-tusked elephant skeleton with a nearly eight-foot-long wooden stick between its ribs at a German site called Lehringen. But because of poor documentation of the discovery, some experts argued the wooden object was a digging stick. In March, researchers reported that cut marks on the elephant’s bones suggest that the tool was, indeed, a spear—and that it further shows Neanderthals hunted big game.
paras.zh: 1948 年，业余考古学家在德国莱林根 (Lehringen) 遗址发现了一具 125,000 年前的直牙大象骨架，其肋骨之间有一根近八英尺长的木棍。但由于对这一发现的记录很少，一些专家认为这个木制物体是一根挖掘棒。今年三月，研究人员报告说，大象骨头上的切痕表明该工具确实是一支矛，并且进一步表明尼安德特人捕猎大型动物。

paras.en: Since the 1980s, researchers have been uncovering charred wooden remains and impressions left behind by some that decomposed at the Spanish site. Periodic flooding probably helped prevent these objects from quickly rotting, per Science. Minerals in the water hardened into travertine, a type of limestone, trapping the wooden artifacts within and preserving them, or at least their outlines.
paras.zh: 自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，研究人员一直在西班牙遗址中发现烧焦的木质遗骸和一些腐烂留下的印记。据《科学》杂志报道，定期洪水可能有助于防止这些物体快速腐烂。水中的矿物质硬化成石灰华（一种石灰石），将木制文物困在其中并保存它们，或者至少保存它们的轮廓。

paras.en: In the new study, Vallverdú, Chacón and their colleagues documented 597 wooden artifacts from 16 different archaeological layers, which were dated to between 40,000 and 62,000 years old. The researchers poured resin into some of the imprints to create casts of the original objects. They also scanned some artifacts to make 3D models.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，Vallverdú、Chacón 及其同事记录了来自 16 个不同考古层的 597 件木制文物，这些文物的历史可以追溯到 40,000 至 62,000 年前。研究人员将树脂倒入一些印记中，以制作原始物体的铸件。他们还扫描了一些文物来制作 3D 模型。

paras.en: Many objects were things like branches, roots and firewood accumulations, but 13 items were clearly shaped by human hands. They include trays made from bark, wooden poles that may have been used for a small shelter, pointed sticks that appear to be weapons and a knife-shaped object that may have been a club. Together, the items offer a glimpse of what life looked like tens of thousands of years ago.
paras.zh: 许多物品是树枝、树根和柴火堆积物等，但有 13 件物品明显是由人手塑造的。其中包括由树皮制成的托盘、可能用于小型庇护所的木杆、看起来像是武器的尖棍以及可能是棍棒的刀形物体。通过这些物品，我们可以一睹数万年前的生活面貌。

paras.en: “When you put all these objects together, you suddenly see wood appearing in many different parts of Neanderthal life,” says study co-author Palmira Saladié, an archaeologist at IPHES-CERCA, to Gizmodo.
paras.zh: “当你把所有这些物体放在一起时，你会突然发现木材出现在尼安德特人生活的许多不同部分，”该研究的合著者、IPHES-CERCA 的考古学家帕尔米拉·萨拉迪 (Palmira Saladié) 向 Gizmodo 说道。

paras.en: Other experts agree. Chris Stringer, an anthropologist at the Natural History Museum in London who wasn’t involved in the study, tells James Woodford at New Scientist that the work reveals Neanderthals had a wide technological repertoire of woodworking skills.
paras.zh: 其他专家也同意这一点。伦敦自然历史博物馆的人类学家克里斯·斯金格（Chris Stringer）没有参与这项研究，他告诉《新科学家》杂志的詹姆斯·伍德福德（James Woodford），这项研究揭示了尼安德特人拥有广泛的木工技能。

paras.en: “This is, of course, evidence from only one site, in one area, and one time span,” he says. “So it’s just the tip of the iceberg in terms of a whole and mostly hidden technology that ran in parallel with the much better-known stone tools of the Paleolithic.”
paras.zh: “当然，这只是来自一个地点、一个地区、一个时间跨度的证据，”他说。 “因此，就与旧石器时代更为人所知的石器并行运行的整个且大部分隐藏的技术而言，这只是冰山一角。”

paras.en: The wooden items are “remarkable,” Naoki Morimoto, an anthropologist at Kyoto University in Japan who also wasn’t involved in the study, tells New Scientist. “Preserved organic materials are truly rare, and they reveal a ‘hidden’ aspect of Neanderthals that we have been missing.”
paras.zh: 日本京都大学人类学家森本直树（Naoki Morimoto）也没有参与这项研究，他告诉《新科学家》杂志，这些木制品“非同寻常”。 “保存下来的有机材料确实非常罕见，它们揭示了我们一直缺失的尼安德特人‘隐藏’的一面。”

articles.title: Mourners Placed an Ancient Sippy Cup in a Roman Toddler's Grave. It May Have Been Meant to Sustain the Child on the Journey to the Afterlife

paras.en: Nearly 2,000 years ago, a Roman toddler, just two or three years old, was laid to rest in what is now southwest England. Into the grave, dated to the second century C.E., mourners placed a rooster figurine of enameled copper, as well as a tettina—something like an ancient sippy cup.
paras.zh: 近 2000 年前，一名年仅两三岁的罗马幼儿被埋葬在如今英格兰西南部的地方。哀悼者在这座公元二世纪的坟墓中放置了一个搪瓷铜公鸡雕像，以及一个类似古代吸管杯的东西。

paras.en: Researchers from Cotswold Archaeology unearthed the grave’s contents in 2011, as part of a years-long excavation of a major Roman cemetery located in the modern-day town of Cirencester. The cemetery contained 118 inhumations and eight cremation burials, while the child’s grave was discovered just outside the cemetery’s walls.
paras.zh: 科茨沃尔德考古学的研究人员于 2011 年出土了坟墓中的物品，这是对位于现代赛伦塞斯特的一座主要罗马墓地进行长达数年挖掘的一部分。墓地内有 118 个土葬墓和 8 个火葬墓，而孩子的坟墓就在墓地墙外被发现。

paras.en: “Infant mortality during the Roman period was higher than it is today,” Emma Stuart, the director of the local Corinium Museum, says in a statement. The tettina was “likely placed with the burial to provide sustenance to the child’s spirit as it made its way to the underworld,” she explains.
paras.zh: “罗马时期的婴儿死亡率比今天要高，”当地科里尼翁博物馆馆长艾玛·斯图尔特在一份声明中说。她解释说，“tettina”“很可能与埋葬物一起放置，以在孩子进入地下世界时为其灵魂提供寄托”。

paras.en: While the cockerel figurine was restored and displayed at the Corinium Museum soon after its discovery, the tettina, which was found broken into pieces, was only recently reconstructed. It debuted at the museum this month, alongside the cockerel in a special display.
paras.zh: 虽然公鸡雕像在被发现后不久就被修复并在科里尼翁博物馆展出，但被发现破碎成碎片的泰蒂纳直到最近才被重建。它本月在博物馆首次亮相，与公鸡一起进行了特别展览。

paras.en: “To see [the cockerel] reunited with the conserved [tettina] cup after all this time is genuinely special and poignant,” Jess Yarrow, director of the Cirencester History Festival, says in the statement. “It connects us directly to the people who walked these streets two millennia ago.”
paras.zh: 赛伦塞斯特历史节主席杰西·亚罗 (Jess Yarrow) 在声明中表示：“过了这么久，看到[公鸡]与保存完好的[tettina]杯子重聚，确实很特别，也很令人心酸。” “它将我们与两千年前走过这些街道的人们直接联系起来。”

paras.en: Cirencester was once the Roman city of Corinium. Established in the first century—shortly after Roman emperor Claudius invaded Britain in 43 C.E.—it grew into the second largest town in the Roman province of Britannia. Spanning 240 acres, enclosed by a two-mile-long wall, Corinium was smaller only than Londinium (modern-day London).
paras.zh: 赛伦塞斯特曾经是罗马城市科里尼翁。它建于公元一世纪，即公元 43 年罗马皇帝克劳狄乌斯入侵不列颠后不久，现已发展成为罗马不列颠行省的第二大城市。科里尼姆 (Corinium) 占地 240 英亩，周围有两英里长的城墙，面积仅比伦迪尼姆 (Londinium)（现代伦敦）小。

paras.en: The recently restored tettina—from the Italian for “teat”—is essentially a Roman feeding bottle, James Harris, the Corinium Museum’s collections engagement officer, writes in a blog post. The round ceramic artifact has a small opening on top and a drinking spout on the side. About 120 of these artifacts have been unearthed in Britain. Some have been found at military sites, which suggests that they could have been used to nurse injured soldiers. In others, researchers have identified chemical traces of animal milk, suggesting mothers used them to wean their children off breastmilk, or in place of breastmilk entirely.
paras.zh: 科里尼翁博物馆藏品参与官员詹姆斯·哈里斯 (James Harris) 在博客文章中写道，最近修复的 tettina（源自意大利语，意为“奶头”）本质上是一个罗马奶瓶。圆形陶瓷制品顶部有一个小开口，侧面有一个饮水嘴。英国出土了大约 120 件此类文物。其中一些是在军事地点发现的，这表明它们可能被用来护理受伤的士兵。在其他情况下，研究人员发现了动物奶中的化学痕迹，建议母亲用它们来让孩子戒掉母乳，或者完全代替母乳。

paras.en: Once excavated, the Corinium tettina sat in fragments in storage until the Friends of Corinium Museum raised the funds required to have it conserved.
paras.zh: 一旦被挖掘出来，科里尼姆泰蒂纳就以碎片的形式存放在仓库里，直到科里尼姆之友博物馆之友筹集到保护它所需的资金。

paras.en: Together with the rooster figurine, the cup hints at the sentiment and spirituality of the child’s burial, as well as the status of the child’s family.
paras.zh: 杯子与公鸡雕像一起暗示了孩子葬礼的情感和灵性，以及孩子家庭的地位。

paras.en: “To actually put this into the grave of a two- or three-year-old child is not something that you would do lightly,” archaeologist Neil Holbrook told the BBC in 2013. “It really shows that this was a very wealthy, important family, and signifies the love that the parents had for the dead child.”
paras.zh: 考古学家尼尔·霍尔布鲁克 (Neil Holbrook) 2013 年对 BBC 表示：“将这个东西真正放入一个两三岁孩子的坟墓里可不是一件容易的事。这确实表明这是一个非常富有、重要的家庭，也体现了父母对死去孩子的爱。”

paras.en: While the tettina may have ensured that the departed child would not go hungry on the way to the afterlife, the rooster figurine may have held its own symbolism. Ancient Romans associated roosters with the messenger god Mercury, who also was believed to have the job of shepherding souls to the afterlife.
paras.zh: 虽然泰蒂娜可能可以确保死去的孩子在去往来世的路上不会挨饿，但公鸡雕像可能拥有自己的象征意义。古罗马人将公鸡与信使神墨丘利联系在一起，人们相信墨丘利也有带领灵魂进入来世的职责。

paras.en: “The parents … placed the cockerel, a representative of the god Mercury, to crow the way to the underworld so that the child’s spirit didn’t get lost on the journey,” Stuart says in the statement. “It is a sad and touching story, but one that is imbued with care and concern.”
paras.zh: 斯图尔特在声明中说：“父母……放了代表水星的公鸡来鸣叫通往地狱的道路，这样孩子的灵魂就不会在旅途中迷失方向。” “这是一个悲伤而感人的故事，但充满了关怀和关怀。”

With this Peacock TV student discount, eligible college students and young adults ages 18 to 24 can get a full year of Peacock Premium for just $6 a month. That’s $8 in savings per month! To claim this Peacock TV student discount, all you need to do is verify your age.
paras.zh: 作为一名学生，通常意味着要省钱、吃方便面——我们知道你想尽一切办法省钱。通过 Peacock TV 学生折扣，符合条件的大学生和 18 至 24 岁的年轻人每月只需 6 美元即可获得全年的 Peacock Premium 服务。每月可节省 8 美元！要申请 Peacock TV 学生折扣，您所需要做的就是验证您的年龄。

paras.en: Military Members and Teachers Get $7 Off Peacock
paras.zh: 军人和教师可享受 Peacock 立减 7 美元的优惠

paras.en: To unlock more discounts on a Peacock subscription, check whether you qualify for their exclusive offers for students, teachers, military members, medical workers, and other first responders. If you want Peacock for the whole family, you can stream on up to 3 devices at once and create up to 6 profiles with kid-safety settings. Peacock also offers discounts for military members and teachers – verify your status to get 12 months of Peacock Premium for $4 per month.
paras.zh: 要解锁 Peacock 订阅的更多折扣，请检查您是否有资格享受他们为学生、教师、军人、医务人员和其他急救人员提供的独家优惠。如果您希望全家人都能使用 Peacock，您可以同时在最多 3 台设备上进行串流，并创建最多 6 个具有儿童安全设置的配置文件。 Peacock 还为军人和教师提供折扣 - 验证您的身份即可每月 4 美元获得 12 个月的 Peacock Premium 服务。

paras.en: One of the easiest ways to save on streaming services is to bundle them for a major discount. With this Apple TV and Peacock bundle, you get both services together for as little as $15 per month (essentially the price of one). You’ll save over 30% and won’t have to choose between Apple TV and Peacock. The first tier includes Apple TV and Peacock Premium, with movies, TV, Peacock originals, live sports from Peacock, and Apple originals, starting at $15 per month. The next tier, Apple TV and Peacock Premium Plus, includes all of that plus ad-free viewing and downloads, starting at $20 per month. If you already have a Peacock subscription billed directly by Peacock, you can simply sign in and upgrade to the bundle in your account.
paras.zh: 节省流媒体服务的最简单方法之一是将它们捆绑在一起以获得大幅折扣。通过 Apple TV 和 Peacock 捆绑包，您每月只需 15 美元即可获得这两项服务（基本上是一项服务的价格）。您将节省超过 30%，并且无需在 Apple TV 和 Peacock 之间进行选择。第一层包括 Apple TV 和 Peacock Premium，提供电影、电视、Peacock 原创内容、Peacock 的体育直播和 Apple 原创内容，每月 15 美元起。下一层是 Apple TV 和 Peacock Premium Plus，包含所有这些功能以及无广告的观看和下载，每月 20 美元起。如果您已经拥有由 Peacock 直接计费的 Peacock 订阅，您只需登录并升级到您帐户中的捆绑包即可。

paras.en: Save up to 40% With Peacock Apple TV+ and Xfinity Bundle Deals
paras.zh: 使用 Peacock Apple TV+ 和 Xfinity 捆绑优惠可节省高达 40% 的费用

paras.en: If it feels like you’re paying for about 403 streaming services, Peacock has reduced that number by one, at least. Now, you can bundle Xfinity and Peacock and save 40% on all your favorite media content for $15 per month. You can get Peacock, Apple TV+, and Netflix when you add StreamSaver with Xfinity Internet. Prices vary by plan: Netflix with ads is $8 per month, Peacock Premium with ads is $8 per month, and the Peacock Apple TV+ bundle is $15 per month.
paras.zh: 如果你感觉你正在为大约 403 个流媒体服务付费，那么 Peacock 至少将这个数字减少了一个。现在，您可以将 Xfinity 和 Peacock 捆绑在一起，每月只需 15 美元即可享受所有您喜爱的媒体内容的 40% 优惠。当您使用 Xfinity Internet 添加 StreamSaver 时，您可以获得 Peacock、Apple TV+ 和 Netflix。价格因套餐而异：带广告的 Netflix 为每月 8 美元，带广告的 Peacock Premium 为每月 8 美元，Peacock Apple TV+ 捆绑包为每月 15 美元。

paras.en: Watch Your Favorites and New Peacock TV Releases This Month
paras.zh: 本月观看您最喜欢的节目和新发布的孔雀电视节目

paras.en: There’s a wide range of new content coming to Peacock this month, including some new releases for reality TV fans like me. Some of the newest content coming to Peacock includes horror-comedy Five Nights at Freddy's 2, the sequel to the animatronic original nightmare. Plus, rejoice because baseball season is here, and you can catch up on the action by streaming MLB games on Peacock, including Sunday Night Baseball, MLB Sunday Leadoff, and the thrilling Postseason Wild Card Round.
paras.zh: 本月 Peacock 推出了大量新内容，其中包括一些专为像我这样的真人秀粉丝推出的新内容。 Peacock 的一些最新内容包括恐怖喜剧《玩具熊的五夜后宫 2》，这是电子动画原版噩梦的续集。另外，庆幸的是，棒球赛季即将到来，您可以通过 Peacock 观看 MLB 比赛，包括周日棒球之夜、MLB 周日开赛以及激动人心的季后赛外卡赛。

paras.en: If you’re like me and love to absolutely turn your brain off (I’m talking no neuron flare-ups would be detected in an MRI) and watch reality TV, let me introduce you to the wonderful world of Love Island. If you love watching Instagram models go from room to room, to the pool, to the gym, and back again in a long-form version of a game of Telephone, this is the show for you. The great part is that every episode is about an hour long, and there are approximately 4,200 episodes per season.
paras.zh: 如果你像我一样喜欢完全关闭你的大脑（我是说在核磁共振成像中不会检测到任何神经元爆发）并观看真人秀节目，那么让我向你介绍爱情岛的奇妙世界。如果您喜欢观看 Instagram 模特在电话游戏的长篇版本中从一个房间到另一个房间、到游泳池、到健身房然后再返回，那么这部剧就是适合您的。最棒的是每集大约一个小时，每季大约有 4,200 集。

paras.en: If you’re caught up on the latest Love Island drama, get stoked for their newest spin-off, Love Island: Beyond the Villa, where the clueless cast from the latest season tries to attempt the impossible challenge of juggling multiple social media brand endorsements. It’s a real nail-biter.
paras.zh: 如果您正在追看最新的《爱情岛》电视剧，不妨看看他们最新的衍生剧《爱情岛：别墅之外》，最新一季中毫无头绪的演员们试图尝试在多个社交媒体品牌代言之间进行不可能的挑战。这真是一个令人抓狂的事情。

paras.en: Beyond beloved reality TV shows and dramas, Peacock truly has something for everyone—especially sports fans. Tons of live games stream on the Peacock app. To watch, log in on your phone, tablet, or streaming device, then navigate to the Sports section to watch your favorite teams.
paras.zh: 除了深受喜爱的真人秀节目和戏剧之外，《Peacock》确实适合每个人，尤其是体育迷。 Peacock 应用程序上有大量直播游戏。要观看，请登录您的手机、平板电脑或流媒体设备，然后导航至“体育”部分以观看您喜爱的球队。

paras.en: Basketball season is upon us again, and Peacock is likely the most reliable way to catch all your favorite NBA teams. Basketball fans, you’re in luck: 100 regular-season games are now available on NBC and Peacock, along with NBA playoff games, the Conference Finals, the NBA All-Star Game, and Monday games and Tuesday night doubleheaders throughout the regular season. Note that the basic "Select" subscription tier doesn't include live sports, but Plus and Premium do. Be sure to check the NBA schedule on Peacock and NBC for the full lineup.
paras.zh: 篮球赛季再次来临，Peacock 可能是观看所有您喜爱的 NBA 球队的最可靠方式。篮球迷们，你们很幸运：NBC 和 Peacock 现已播出 100 场常规赛，以及整个常规赛期间的 NBA 季后赛、分区决赛、NBA 全明星赛以及周一和周二晚上的双赛。请注意，基本的“精选”订阅套餐不包括现场体育赛事，但 Plus 和 Premium 包括。请务必在 Peacock 和 NBC 上查看 NBA 赛程表，了解完整阵容。

paras.en: If I’m being honest, one of the biggest reasons I have Peacock is its NFL coverage, including Sunday Night Football and playoff games. (Yes, I love Love Island and football; I contain multitudes.) After living across the country, I like to regularly watch the Chiefs, Bills, Niners, Raiders, Lions, and Chargers to keep up with the fandoms I’ve become part of. Trying to find where to watch Sunday Night Football was a headache, but now I can have the big game in my living room. (Now I’m just wondering when technology will catch up and bring Jalen Hurts into my living room as well.) Sports fans rejoice because Peacock often gets exclusive streaming rights to specific games. For example, last NFL season, Peacock was the place to stream the Week 1 game.
paras.zh: 老实说，我拥有 Peacock 的最大原因之一是它的 NFL 报道，包括周日橄榄球之夜和季后赛。 （是的，我喜欢爱情岛和足球；我包容了很多人。）在全国各地生活之后，我喜欢定期观看酋长队、比尔队、九人队、突袭者队、雄狮队和闪电队的比赛，以跟上我所加入的球迷群体。试图找到在哪里观看周日夜间足球赛是一件令人头疼的事情，但现在我可以在客厅里观看大型比赛。 （现在我只是想知道技术什么时候会赶上并把杰伦伤害带进我的客厅。）体育迷们很高兴，因为孔雀经常获得特定比赛的独家流媒体播放权。例如，上个 NFL 赛季，Peacock 是直播第一周比赛的地方。

paras.en: Like other streaming services, Peacock offers plans for every type of binge-watcher. Their subscription tiers let you customize based on what you’ll actually watch and your budget: Select, for $8 per month; Premium, for $11 per month, which includes Peacock’s catalog, live sports, current NBC and Bravo shows, and over 50 channels. Premium Plus is $17 per month or $170 per year and includes: no ads, the ability to download titles to watch offline, and access to your local NBC channel live 24/7. Peacock Premium includes over 80k hours of streaming, with new and old shows, films, and originals, live sports, currently running NBC and Bravo shows (OG Real Housewives fans know), and over 50 channels that are always streaming something. The Premium Plus plan includes everything I just mentioned, plus no ads (a huge W for people who chronically get on their phones during commercials and forget to pay attention when the show comes back on). Check out the full details on the differing Peacock plans to figure out which is right for you.
paras.zh: 与其他流媒体服务一样，Peacock 为各种类型的追剧者提供套餐。他们的订阅等级可让您根据实际观看的内容和预算进行定制：选择，每月 8 美元； Premium，每月 11 美元，其中包括 Peacock 的目录、体育直播、当前的 NBC 和 Bravo 节目以及 50 多个频道。 Premium Plus 的价格为每月 17 美元或每年 170 美元，包括：无广告、下载影片以离线观看的能力以及访问本地 NBC 频道的 24/7 直播。 Peacock Premium 包含超过 80,000 小时的流媒体内容，包括新老节目、电影和原创节目、体育直播、目前正在运行的 NBC 和 Bravo 节目（OG Real Housewives 粉丝都知道），以及超过 50 个始终在流媒体播放内容的频道。 Premium Plus 计划包括我刚才提到的所有内容，而且没有广告（对于那些经常在广告期间使用手机而在节目重新播放时忘记注意的人来说，这是一个巨大的 W）。查看不同 Peacock 计划的完整详细信息，找出最适合您的计划。

paras.en: Not sure what gift to get for your next celebration? A Peacock gift card gives your loved one over 80,000 hours of TV, movies, and sports. You can get a digital gift card right on Peacock’s website and send it to a recipient via email or text, with no cumbersome shipping required. With a Peacock gift card, you can pay for a Peacock streaming plan using the “Redeem Gift Card” button on the checkout page. If you’ve already made a Peacock account, you can add the gift card on your Account page. Once you’ve added the Peacock gift card to your account, you’ll be able to see the credit balance, and it will be applied to your subscription until it runs out.
paras.zh: 不确定下次庆祝活动该送什么礼物？一张 Peacock 礼品卡可为您所爱的人提供超过 80,000 小时的电视、电影和体育节目。您可以直接在 Peacock 网站上获取数字礼品卡，然后通过电子邮件或短信将其发送给收件人，无需繁琐的运输。使用 Peacock 礼品卡，您可以使用结帐页面上的“兑换礼品卡”按钮支付 Peacock 流媒体套餐的费用。如果您已经创建了 Peacock 帐户，则可以在您的帐户页面上添加礼品卡。将 Peacock 礼品卡添加到您的帐户后，您将能够看到信用余额，并且它将应用于您的订阅，直到用完为止。

articles.title: Uber Eats Promo Codes: $15 Off│October 2026
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: Uber began as a modern alternative to taxis, letting riders order through a phone app, track the driver’s route in real time, share their location with contacts, and even split the fare in the app—it was the convenience-obsessed answer to the old way of hailing cabs. Then in 2014, Uber leveled up with Uber Eats. Much like Uber was the convenient, modern answer to taxis, Uber Eats was the equivalent for food delivery.
paras.zh: Uber 最初是作为出租车的现代替代品，让乘客通过手机应用程序订购、实时跟踪司机的路线、与联系人分享他们的位置，甚至在应用程序中分摊车费——这是对传统叫车方式的痴迷的答案。然后在 2014 年，Uber 升级为 Uber Eats。就像 Uber 是出租车的便捷、现代的解决方案一样，Uber Eats 也相当于食品配送。

paras.en: Instead of calling a local restaurant and enlisting a delivery driver from that restaurant, Uber Eats draws from hundreds of participating restaurants, cafes, and stores in your area, tailoring deals and picks to your location and preferences. So if you want fresh sushi from your favorite local spot for a date night in, or just need some Advil and Gatorade after a night out, Uber Eats delivers the goods in minutes flat. Whether you’re new to the service or a longtime devotee, we have an Uber Eats promo code and other Uber Eats coupon codes to help you save big—and stay at home.
paras.zh: Uber Eats 优食无需致电当地餐厅并招募该餐厅的送货司机，而是从您所在地区的数百家参与活动的餐厅、咖啡馆和商店中挑选，根据您的位置和偏好定制优惠和选择。因此，如果您想在约会之夜从您最喜欢的当地餐厅购买新鲜寿司，或者只是在外出过夜后需要一些 Advil 和佳得乐，Uber Eats 优食只需几分钟即可送达。无论您是该服务的新手还是长期拥护者，我们都提供 Uber Eats 优食促销代码和其他 Uber Eats 优食优惠券代码，帮助您节省大笔费用并足不出户。

paras.en: One of the easiest ways to save big on Uber Eats is to create a new account. First-time Uber customers can save 30 to 50% on their first order, plus new offers with up to $20 off rides or $15 off Uber Eats orders. You don’t even need an Uber Eats promo code to get this steep discount—this offer applies automatically when you create your account and book your first trip or delivery.
paras.zh: 在 Uber Eats 优食上省大钱的最简单方法之一就是创建一个新帐户。首次使用 Uber 的客户首次下单可节省 30% 至 50% 的费用，此外还可享受新优惠，乘车优惠最高可达 20 美元，Uber Eats 优食订单优惠最高可达 15 美元。您甚至不需要 Uber Eats 优食促销代码即可获得如此大幅折扣 - 当您创建帐户并预订首次行程或送货时，此优惠将自动适用。

paras.en: If you use the rideshare app often or order takeout multiple nights a week, an Uber One membership will pay for itself within a few weeks. At $10 per month, it offers major perks that add up over time if you use the service frequently. You’ll get tons of perks across rides and food delivery, including $0 delivery fees on eligible food, grocery, and retail orders, up to 10% off eligible Uber Eats orders, 5% back in Uber One credits on eligible rides, and automatic surge savings. Uber One members save $29 on average every month.
paras.zh: 如果您经常使用拼车应用程序或每周多晚订购外卖，Uber One 会员资格将在几周内收回成本。它提供每月 10 美元的主要福利，如果您经常使用该服务，这些福利会随着时间的推移而增加。您将在乘车和送餐方面获得大量福利，包括符合条件的食品、杂货和零售订单的 0 美元送货费、符合条件的 Uber Eats 优食订单最高 10% 的折扣、符合条件的乘车 5% 的 Uber One 积分返还，以及自动激增节省。 Uber One 会员每月平均节省 29 美元。

paras.en: Uber Eats Promo Code: 50% Off Your First Uber Ride
paras.zh: Uber Eats 优食促销代码：首次乘坐 Uber 出行可享受 50% 折扣

paras.en: As mentioned above, the simplest way to save big with Uber is to be a first-time user. You’ll save 30 to 50% on your first ride, including up to $20 off all rides or $15 off Uber Eats orders. You don’t even need an Uber promo code. Uber welcome discounts apply automatically once you create your account and book your first trip. Trust me, you’ll get used to the convenience of a rideshare app and a food and delivery service app, all in one place—in the palm of your hand.
paras.zh: 如上所述，使用 Uber 省钱最简单的方法就是成为首次用户。首次乘车可节省 30% 至 50%，其中所有乘车最高可享受 20 美元优惠，Uber Eats 优食订单可享受最高 15 美元优惠。您甚至不需要 Uber 促销代码。一旦您创建帐户并预订首次行程，优步迎新折扣就会自动适用。相信我，您会习惯拼车应用程序和食品和送货服务应用程序的便利性，所有这些都在一个地方 - 在您的手掌中。

paras.en: Share the Gift of an Uber Eats Gift Card
paras.zh: 分享 Uber Eats 优食礼品卡

paras.en: One of my go-to gifts lately is an Uber Eats gift card. I find it especially thoughtful and useful as a convenience gift, whether that’s after a death, loss, birth, or a big life change. An Uber Eats gift card is more than just a gift card. It takes another thing off someone’s plate and offers an easy, comforting meal, especially during times of grief or celebration. Uber Eats gift cards start at $15 and can be purchased from participating retailers or sent instantly through the app to friends and family.
paras.zh: 我最近最喜欢的礼物之一是 Uber Eats 优食礼品卡。我发现它作为一份方便的礼物特别贴心和有用，无论是在死亡、失去、出生还是重大生活改变之后。 Uber Eats 优食礼品卡不仅仅是一张礼品卡。它可以为某人减少另一件事，并提供一顿简单、舒适的饭菜，尤其是在悲伤或庆祝的时候。 Uber Eats 优食礼品卡起价 15 美元，可以从参与活动的零售商处购买，也可以通过应用程序立即发送给朋友和家人。

paras.en: Being a student often means tight budgets, long nights, and limited kitchen space (and culinary knowledge). Investing in an Uber One account may be a good idea—for only $10 per month, you can get, on average, $30 in savings on Uber rides and Uber grocery and meal delivery. You won’t have to worry about meal planning or expensive takeout bills. With Uber One discounts and promos, you can get multiple meals for the week at a lower cost. And if you’re a student, you can try Uber One for free for four weeks to make sure the service is a fit. After that, the service is half off at only $5 per month. No Uber Eats coupon code necessary. Just verify your student status to get the four weeks for free and $5 per month after.
paras.zh: 作为一名学生通常意味着预算紧张、漫长的夜晚和有限的厨房空间（和烹饪知识）。投资 Uber One 账户可能是个好主意——每月只需 10 美元，您在 Uber 乘车、Uber 杂货和送餐服务上平均可以节省 30 美元。您不必担心膳食计划或昂贵的外卖账单。通过 Uber One 折扣和促销，您可以以较低的成本获得一周的多餐。如果您是学生，则可以免费试用 Uber One 四个星期，以确保该服务适合您。此后，该服务可享受半价优惠，每月仅需 5 美元。无需 Uber Eats 优食优惠券代码。只需验证您的学生身份，即可免费获得四个星期的服务，之后每月获得 5 美元。

paras.en: Get Your Groceries Delivered with Uber Eats
paras.zh: 通过 Uber Eats 优食送餐

paras.en: If you’re not in the mood to eat out, stay in and get groceries delivered with Uber Eats. Uber Eats partners with hundreds of grocery stores near you—including your favorite supermarkets—for same-day delivery in as little as 25 minutes. Using your location, Uber Eats offers fast delivery from drugstores, grocery chains, and local stores, so whether you need toilet paper or a gallon of milk, Uber Eats delivers.
paras.zh: 如果您没有心情外出就餐，可以呆在家里，享受 Uber Eats 优食送餐服务。 Uber Eats 优食与您附近的数百家杂货店（包括您最喜欢的超市）合作，可在短短 25 分钟内提供当日送达服务。 Uber Eats 优食可利用您的位置，从药店、杂货连锁店和当地商店提供快速送货服务，因此无论您需要卫生纸还是一加仑牛奶，Uber Eats 优食都能送货。

paras.en: Get Your Starbucks Delivered With Uber Eats
paras.zh: 通过 Uber Eats 优食为您的星巴克送餐

paras.en: If you’re like me and need about 40 oz of coffee to get through the day, you know how important it is to have caffeine at a moment’s notice. With Uber Eats’ vast network, you can now get your Starbucks delivered. Starbucks delivery with Uber Eats couldn’t be easier. There are hundreds of Starbucks locations across the country, with both delivery and pickup available through the convenient app. Enter your zip code to see the nearest matching pickup location. Whether you’re catering for a big meeting or just want a quick breakfast.
paras.zh: 如果您像我一样需要大约 40 盎司的咖啡来度过一天，您就会知道立即摄入咖啡因是多么重要。借助 Uber Eats 优食庞大的网络，您现在可以享受星巴克送餐服务。星巴克通过 Uber Eats 优食送餐再简单不过了。全国有数百家星巴克门店，通过便捷的应用程序可以提供送货和取货服务。输入您的邮政编码以查看最近的匹配取货地点。无论您是要举办大型会议还是只想吃一顿快餐。

paras.en: Yes, Uber Eats regularly offers first-order discounts for new customers, often a percentage off or a capped dollar amount (like $15–$25 off) on your first delivery.
paras.zh: 是的，Uber Eats 优食会定期为新客户提供首单折扣，通常会在首次送货时提供百分比折扣或上限金额（例如 15 至 25 美元折扣）。

paras.en: In the app, go to your account menu, select "Promotions" (or "Add promo/gift card" at checkout), enter the code, and it should apply automatically if valid and still active.
paras.zh: 在应用程序中，转到您的帐户菜单，选择“促销”（或结账时“添加促销/礼品卡”），输入代码，如果有效且仍然有效，它应该会自动应用。

paras.en: Yes, Uber Eats has expanded beyond restaurants to include grocery, convenience, and retail delivery, and many promo codes apply across these categories
paras.zh: 是的，Uber Eats 优食已从餐厅扩展到杂货店、便利店和零售配送，并且许多促销代码适用于这些类别

paras.en: No. Uber Eats and Uber rides promo codes/credits are generally separate, though Uber One membership benefits apply across both rides and Eats.
paras.zh: 不会。Uber Eats 优食和 Uber 乘车促销代码/积分通常是分开的，但 Uber One 会员权益适用于乘车和乘车服务。

articles.title: HBO Max Promo Code: 50% Off | October 2026
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: HBO Max is not just for The Sopranos anymore (but it is the only place to stream The Sopranos). Subscription video service HBO Max not only has The Sopranos, but other content from the best entertainment libraries, including: Warner Bros., Discovery Channel, CNN, Cartoon Network, Adult Swim, Animal Planet, and other brands.
paras.zh: HBO Max 不再仅适用于《黑道家族》（但它是唯一播放《黑道家族》的地方）。订阅视频服务 HBO Max 不仅有《黑道家族》，还有来自最佳娱乐库的其他内容，包括：华纳兄弟、探索频道、CNN、卡通网络、成人游泳、动物星球和其他品牌。

paras.en: We at WIRED also watch a lot of content—obviously, because we are always testing TVs, soundbars, and streaming devices—and regularly round up our newest favorites from HBO Max so that you’ll know what to watch once you nab an HBO Max promo code. Whether you’re wanting to watch an HBO original series like Succession or a smash hit movie like Barbie, HBO Max has the content you’re looking for, and WIRED has the perfect promo codes to help you save on these sometimes-pricey subscription plans.
paras.zh: 我们《连线》还观看大量内容——显然，因为我们一直在测试电视、条形音箱和流媒体设备——并定期收集 HBO Max 中我们最喜欢的最新内容，以便您在获得 HBO Max 促销代码后知道该看什么。无论您是想观看《继承之战》等 HBO 原创剧集，还是《芭比娃娃》等热门电影，HBO Max 都能提供您想要的内容，而《连线》则拥有完美的促销代码，可帮助您节省这些有时价格昂贵的订阅计划。

paras.en: Students rejoice, you don’t have to try to mooch off your friends’ parents' HBO Max subscriptions anymore when you want to rewatch Euphoria for the 15th time (...not speaking from personal experience or anything). HBO Max is offering a Student Discount, where you can save and get 50% off subscriptions with a promo code. This means the price is only $5 a month. This discounted plan is eligible for The HBO Max Basic With Ads monthly plan, so you’ll get unlimited access to all of HBO, hit series, movies, news, sports, and more on up to two devices at once.
paras.zh: 学生们很高兴，当你想第 15 次重看《幸福感》时，你不必再试图从朋友父母的 HBO Max 订阅中获得好处了（……不是从个人经历或其他任何角度来说）。 HBO Max 提供学生折扣，您可以使用促销代码节省并获得 50% 的订阅折扣。这意味着每月的价格仅为 5 美元。此折扣套餐符合 HBO Max Basic With Ads 月度套餐的资格，因此您可以同时在最多两台设备上无限制地访问所有 HBO、热门剧集、电影、新闻、体育节目等。

paras.en: Save 35% by Bundling HBO Max, Disney+ and Hulu
paras.zh: 捆绑 HBO Max、Disney+ 和 Hulu 可节省 35%

paras.en: This deal is honestly one of the best I’ve ever seen, and I’ve been thinking of switching as well, because with this Magic Bundle, you can get HBO Max, Disney+, and Hulu for just $17 a month. (which is crazy because I pay that much alone for my Hulu! Again, I’m convincing myself while writing this that I should switch to this plan.) This crazy good deal is for those three streaming services with ads, but you’ll be saving 35% on the original price. If you’re impatient like me, you can get the same deal without ads for $30 a month, which is definitely higher than with ads but you’re still saving almost $19 a month with this Evergreen deal.
paras.zh: 老实说，这笔交易是我见过的最好的交易之一，我也一直在考虑转换，因为有了这个 Magic Bundle，你每月只需 17 美元即可获得 HBO Max、Disney+ 和 Hulu。 （这太疯狂了，因为我一个人为我的 Hulu 支付了这么多钱！再次，我在写这篇文章时说服自己我应该改用这个计划。）这个疯狂的优惠适用于这三个带有广告的流媒体服务，但您将在原价的基础上节省 35%。如果你像我一样不耐烦，你可以每月 30 美元获得同样的无广告优惠，这肯定比有广告的要高，但通过这个 Evergreen 优惠，你每月仍然可以节省近 19 美元。

paras.en: Like other streaming services, HBO Max has different tiers at different prices for streaming, so you can choose which one fits you (or your “household;” wink) best. Basic with ads allows you to stream on two devices at once in full HD for $10 a month. Standard is midrange, where you get everything from the previous basic plus 30 available downloads so you can watch on the go, for $17 a month. If you are impatient and a movie/TV buff, you might want to choose the premium, where you can stream on four devices at once, have 4k Ultra HD video quality, Dolby Atmos immersive audio, and 100 downloads to watch on the go for $21 a month.
paras.zh: 与其他流媒体服务一样，HBO Max 提供不同等级、不同价格的流媒体服务，因此您可以选择最适合您（或您的“家庭”；眨眼）的服务。带有广告的基本版允许您同时在两台设备上以全高清流媒体播放，每月费用为 10 美元。标准版是中档版，您可以获得以前基本版的所有内容，再加上 30 个可用下载，以便您可以随时随地观看，每月费用为 17 美元。如果您不耐烦并且是电影/电视爱好者，您可能想要选择高级版，您可以同时在四台设备上进行流媒体播放，享受 4k 超高清视频质量、杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 沉浸式音频，以及 100 次下载以供随时随地观看，每月费用为 21 美元。

paras.en: HBO Max is known for being one of the most heralded platforms in entertainment. These new shows and films on HBO Max are sure to be a hit too. We’re most excited for Task, a new series set in the working-class suburbs of Philadelphia, where an FBI agent heads a task force aiming to end the violent robberies led by an unsuspecting family man. There’s also a new GOT spin-off series, A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, which premiered on January 18. Taking place a century before the events of Game of Thrones, set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory. There’s also Chair Company from the oddball mind of Tim Robinson, and IT: Welcome to Derry, a spin off set in the IT universe for fans of horror.
paras.zh: HBO Max 被誉为娱乐界最受推崇的平台之一。 HBO Max 上的这些新节目和电影也一定会大受欢迎。我们最兴奋的是《Task》，这是一部以费城工人阶级郊区为背景的新剧集，一名联邦调查局特工领导一支特别工作组，旨在结束一名毫无戒心的家庭男人领导的暴力抢劫案。还有一部新的《权力的游戏》衍生剧《七国骑士》于 1 月 18 日首播。故事发生在《权力的游戏》事件发生一个世纪前，当时坦格利安家族仍然掌握着铁王座，而最后一条龙还没有从人们的记忆中消失。此外，还有蒂姆·罗宾逊 (Tim Robinson) 的《Chair Company》和《IT：欢迎来到德里》(IT: Welcome to Derry)，这是一部为恐怖迷打造的 IT 宇宙衍生作品。

paras.en: And especially right now, several of my absolute favorite shows are returning for a brand-new season or their last season. Long-awaited season three of Euphoria returns, with more drug-fueled drama. Hacks, the final season premiered and I’m going to miss the tumultuous relationships that orbit Deborah Vance’s solar system. Like everyone else, I’m libbing out every Thursday with the sexy doctors in The Pitt. Please don’t go, I love you so. Plus, I’ve been loving the new Steve Carell comedy Rooster, about a wholesome but goofy romance writer that begins a tenure at college.
paras.zh: 尤其是现在，我最喜欢的几个节目正在以全新的一季或最后一季回归。期待已久的《欣快感》第三季回归，带来更多毒品刺激的剧情。黑客，最后一季首播，我会怀念围绕黛博拉·万斯太阳系运行的混乱关系。和其他人一样，我每周四都会和皮特医院的性感医生一起狂欢。请不要走，我是如此爱你。另外，我一直很喜欢史蒂夫·卡瑞尔的新喜剧《公鸡》，讲述了一位健康但愚蠢的浪漫作家开始在大学任职的故事。

paras.en: I missed the GOT boat, and it’s a little too violent for me, but my brother recommended A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, the newest Game of Thrones spinoff that’s a little lighter and more family-friendly than the first and I think I’m becoming a late bandwagon-er. There’s also The Dark Wizard, an in-depth four-part documentary about extreme climber Dean Potter that I have in my queue for next weekend.
paras.zh: 我错过了《权力的游戏》的船，这对我来说有点太暴力了，但我哥哥推荐了《七国骑士》，这是最新的《权力的游戏》衍生剧，比第一部更轻松，更适合家庭，我想我正在成为一个后来的潮流者。还有《黑巫师》，这是一部关于极限登山者迪恩·波特的深入四集纪录片，我已经在下周末排队观看了。

paras.en: Watch Your Favorite Shows on HBO Max for Free
paras.zh: 免费在 HBO Max 上观看您喜爱的节目

paras.en: Because HBO knows how tempting (and sexy) teasing can be, folks can sample episodes of new and fan-favorite original steamy series, like Euphoria, Industry, or The Idol for free without a subscription. When you inevitably get hooked (too soon after the Euphoria reference?) on that sweet, sweet content, you’ll need an HBO Max subscription to stream the full library. To continue to tease, you can stream nearly endless options, like White Lotus and Heated Rivalry, and my personal faves: The Last of Us, The Penguin, and Hacks, right now. Hurry, you don’t want to miss out on the shows everyone is talking about around the proverbial water cooler.
paras.zh: 因为 HBO 知道戏弄的诱惑力（和性感），所以人们可以免费试听深受粉丝喜爱的原创热血连续剧的剧集，例如《幸福感》、《工业》或《偶像》，无需订阅。当您不可避免地沉迷于那些甜蜜的内容时（在提到《Euphoria》之后太快了？），您将需要订阅 HBO Max 才能观看完整的图书馆。为了继续取笑，你现在可以播放几乎无穷无尽的选项，例如《白莲花》和《激烈的竞争》，以及我个人的最爱：《最后生还者》、《企鹅》和《黑客》。快点，您不想错过每个人都在众所周知的饮水机旁谈论的节目。

articles.title: Treasury imposes $1.21B in penalties on Bank of America

paras.en: Oct. 13 (UPI) -- The U.S. Treasury on Tuesday imposed three separate penalties totaling more than $1.21 billion against Bank of America for failing to mitigate and report national security risks and violating U.S. sanction laws.
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日（UPI）——美国财政部周二对美国银行处以三项单独处罚，总金额超过 12.1 亿美元，原因是其未能减轻和报告国家安全风险以及违反美国制裁法。

paras.en: The largest of the penalties was a $1.2 billion fine, the third largest in the Treasury's history, for failing to report more than $5 billion in suspicious activity in a timely manner to the department's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network. The Treasury said that as the issues arose, Bank of America prioritized its revenue and worked to minimize the impact on its required compliance resources.
paras.zh: 其中最大的一笔罚款是 12 亿美元的罚款，这是财政部历史上第三大罚款，原因是未能及时向财政部金融犯罪执法网络报告超过 50 亿美元的可疑活动。美国财政部表示，随着问题的出现，美国银行优先考虑其收入，并努力尽量减少对其所需合规资源的影响。

paras.en: It said more than $1 billion of the suspicious transactions involved national security-related and other priority illicit financial risks, including transactions indicative of Chinese money laundering networks, fraud and potential trade-based money laundering with "a substantial nexus to the southwest border." FinCEN said Bank of America admitted to willfully violating the Bank Secrecy Act through its compliance failures.
paras.zh: 报告称，超过10亿美元的可疑交易涉及国家安全相关和其他优先非法金融风险，包括表明中国洗钱网络、欺诈和“与西南边境有重大联系”的潜在贸易洗钱活动的交易。 FinCEN 表示，美国银行承认因合规失败而故意违反《银行保密法》。

paras.en: "Financial institutions are on the front lines of protecting our economic and national security. When a bank of this size fails to meet its anti-money laundering and sanctions obligations, the consequences extend far beyond its own walls, exposing the entire U.S. financial system to significant illicit finance risks," Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a statement.
paras.zh: “金融机构处于保护我们经济和国家安全的前线。当这种规模的银行未能履行反洗钱和制裁义务时，其后果将远远超出其自身范围，使整个美国金融体系面临重大非法金融风险，”财政部长斯科特·贝森特在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: The Treasury's Office of the Comptroller of the Currency also assessed its largest-ever $750 million civil penalty against the bank over its deficient and ineffective anti-money laundering compliance program, though FinCEN agreed to count the civil money penalty toward its $1.2 billion fine, according to the 95-page consent order.
paras.zh: 根据这份长达 95 页的同意令，财政部货币监理署还因该银行反洗钱合规计划缺陷且无效而对其处以有史以来最高的 7.5 亿美元民事罚款，不过 FinCEN 同意将民事罚款计入 12 亿美元罚款中。

paras.en: The third action was an $11.6 million settlement announced by the Office of Foreign Assets Control over apparent violations of numerous sanctions programs involving Iran, Russia, narcotics and global terrorism, the Treasury said.
paras.zh: 美国财政部表示，第三项行动是外国资产控制办公室宣布以 1160 万美元和解，解决其明显违反涉及伊朗、俄罗斯、毒品和全球恐怖主义的众多制裁计划的情况。

paras.en: "Today's actions send a clear message that even the biggest financial institutions are not above the law," Bessent said.
paras.zh: 贝森特表示：“今天的行动发出了一个明确的信息，即即使是最大的金融机构也不能凌驾于法律之上。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for Bank of America, the second-largest U.S. bank, told UPI in an emailed statement that the bank worked with regulators to reach these penalty resolutions.
paras.zh: 美国第二大银行美国银行的发言人在一份电子邮件声明中告诉合众国际社，该银行与监管机构合作达成了这些处罚决议。

paras.en: "Financial crime compliance is serious, and we are responsible for getting it right," the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示：“金融犯罪合规问题非常严重，我们有责任采取正确的措施。”

paras.en: "We have invested billions of dollars in technology and dedicated thousands of employees to combat financial crime, and our team is far along with and committed to completing the work required to address the issues raised by our regulators."
paras.zh: “我们在技术上投资了数十亿美元，并投入了数千名员工来打击金融犯罪，我们的团队一直配合并致力于完成解决监管机构提出的问题所需的工作。”

paras.en: The spokesperson said the penalties stem from violations cited in the 2024 OCC Consent Order and FinCEN's investigation, while the Treasury stated that even after agreeing to the 2024 order, "the bank still failed to prioritize" compliance with money-laundering monitoring responsibilities.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示，处罚源于 2024 年 OCC 同意令和 FinCEN 调查中提到的违规行为，而财政部表示，即使在同意 2024 年命令之后，“银行仍然未能优先考虑”遵守洗钱监管职责。

paras.en: "We will continue to support federal and local law enforcement across thousands of investigations and report hundreds of thousands of suspicious activity reports each year," the Bank of America spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 美国银行发言人表示：“我们将继续支持联邦和地方执法部门开展数千项调查，并每年报告数十万份可疑活动报告。”

articles.title: Tropical Storm Trudy forms, forecast to become major hurricane

paras.en: Oct. 13 (UPI) -- Tropical Storm Trudy formed in the Pacific on Tuesday and was forecast to rapidly intensify into a major hurricane over the next few days, the National Hurricane Center said.
paras.zh: 10 月 13 日（UPI）——国家飓风中心表示，热带风暴特鲁迪于周二在太平洋形成，预计将在未来几天内迅速增强为大型飓风。

paras.en: The storm was located about 440 miles south-southeast of Acapulco, Mexico, and about 725 miles southeast of Manzanillo, Mexico, the NHC said in its 9 p.m. CST update.
paras.zh: NHC 在晚上 9 点表示，风暴位于墨西哥阿卡普尔科东南约 440 英里、墨西哥曼萨尼约东南约 725 英里处。国家标准时间更新。

paras.en: It had maximum sustained winds of 45 mph, an increase of 3 mph over the last six hours, and was moving northwest at 10 mph.
paras.zh: 最大持续风速为 45 英里/小时，在过去 6 小时内增加了 3 英里/小时，并以 10 英里/小时的速度向西北移动。

paras.en: No watches or warnings were in effect, but forecasters urged residents of southwestern and west-central Mexico to monitor Trudy's progress.
paras.zh: 没有任何有效的监视或警告，但预报员敦促墨西哥西南部和中西部的居民监测特鲁迪的进展。

paras.en: "A motion between west-northwest and northwest should continue through Wednesday night," the NHC said.
paras.zh: NHC 表示：“西北偏西和西北之间的运动应该会持续到周三晚上。”

paras.en: "A turn toward the north-northwest and a decrease in forward speed is expected on Thursday."
paras.zh: “预计周四将转向西北偏北且前进速度下降。”

paras.en: In a discussion on the storm, the NHC said Trudy could be "very close" to the Mexican coast over the weekend.
paras.zh: 在有关风暴的讨论中，国家飓风中心表示特鲁迪周末可能“非常接近”墨西哥海岸。

paras.en: Trudy formed south of Hurricane Simon, which was essentially stationary off the west-central coast of Mexico on Tuesday evening.
paras.zh: 特鲁迪在飓风西蒙以南形成，周二晚上该飓风在墨西哥中西部海岸附近基本静止。

articles.title: Government watchdog files Hatch Act complaint over Ilhan Omar raid

paras.en: Oct. 14 (UPI) -- A bipartisan government watchdog has filed a Hatch Act complaint against the Trump administration alleging that the federal law enforcement raid on Rep. Ilhan Omar's residence this week was intended to influence the outcome of November's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日（合众社）——两党政府监管机构根据《哈奇法案》对特朗普政府提起诉讼，指控联邦执法部门本周对众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔 (Ilhan Omar) 的住所进行突袭，旨在影响 11 月中期选举的结果。

paras.en: Agents with Homeland Security Investigations conducted a pre-dawn raid of the Minnesota Democrat's home on Monday as part of a criminal investigation, reportedly stemming from paperwork her late father filed when they immigrated to the United States decades ago when she was 12 years old.
paras.zh: 作为刑事调查的一部分，国土安全调查人员周一黎明前对这位明尼苏达州民主党人的家进行了突击搜查，据报道，调查源于她已故父亲数十年前移民到美国时提交的文件，当时她 12 岁。

paras.en: Critics and Democrats swiftly condemned the raid as further evidence of President Donald Trumps' weaponization of executive power to target his perceived opponents and asserted that its timing violated Justice Department policies and norms because it was conducted just days before early voting begins in Minnesota for the Nov. 3 midterm election, in which Omar is a candidate.
paras.zh: 批评者和民主党人迅速谴责这次突袭，认为这是唐纳德·特朗普总统将行政权力武器化以针对其认为的对手的进一步证据，并声称其时机违反了司法部的政策和规范，因为这次突袭是在明尼苏达州 11 月 3 日中期选举提前投票开始前几天进行的，奥马尔是其中的候选人。

paras.en: The complaint was filed Tuesday by the Democracy Defenders Fund, calling on Special Counsel Charles Baldis to investigate whether the Trump administration's raid violated the Hatch Act, which prohibits federal executive branch employees from using their position to influence the outcome of elections.
paras.zh: 民主捍卫者基金会周二提出申诉，呼吁特别顾问查尔斯·巴尔迪斯调查特朗普政府的突袭是否违反了《哈奇法案》，该法案禁止联邦行政部门雇员利用职务影响选举结果。

paras.en: "DOJ and DHS' decision to instigate this raid at this very moment and for these alleged reasons is unexplainable -- except for as a politically motivated use of power to influence the Minnesota congressional election in violation of the Hatch Act. A review of this matter is therefore immediately necessary," the complaint sent to Baldis said.
paras.zh: 发给巴尔迪斯的投诉称：“司法部和国土安全部决定在此时发起这次突袭，并出于这些所谓的原因，是无法解释的——除非是出于政治动机，利用权力影响明尼苏达州国会选举，违反了《哈奇法案》。因此，必须立即对此事进行审查。”

paras.en: The complaint was signed by three Democracy Defenders Fund officials: Norman Eisen, its co-founder and executive chair and a former U.S. ambassador to the Czech Republic; Virginia Canter, its chief counsel and director of ethics and anti-corruption; and Christopher Swartz, its senior counsel and deputy director of ethics and anti-corruption.
paras.zh: 该起诉书由民主捍卫者基金会的三名官员签署：诺曼·艾森，其联合创始人兼执行主席、前美国驻捷克共和国大使；弗吉尼亚·坎特 (Virginia Canter)，其首席法律顾问兼道德与反腐败总监；以及其高级法律顾问兼道德与反腐败副主任克里斯托弗·斯沃茨(Christopher Swartz)。

paras.en: Richard Painter, a former associate counsel to President George W. Bush and a professor of corporate law at the University of Minnesota Law School, also signed the complaint.
paras.zh: 乔治·W·布什总统的前副法律顾问、明尼苏达大学法学院公司法教授理查德·佩因特也签署了这份起诉书。

paras.en: Omar immigrated to the United States with her family in 1995 and was naturalized as a U.S. citizen at the age of 17 in 2000.
paras.zh: 奥马尔于1995年与家人移民到美国，并于2000年17岁时加入美国国籍。

paras.en: The progressive Democrat was first elected to office in November 2016, winning a seat in the Minnesota House of Representatives, before being elected to the U.S. House of Representatives two years later.
paras.zh: 这位进步的民主党人于 2016 年 11 月首次当选，赢得明尼苏达州众议院席位，两年后当选美国众议院议员。

paras.en: Omar has long been a target of Republican criticism, including insults from Trump, who has called her "garbage" and demanded that she be "sent back from where she came from." Critics have characterized some of his remarks as racist.
paras.zh: 奥马尔长期以来一直是共和党批评的目标，包括特朗普的侮辱，特朗普称她为“垃圾”，并要求“将她从她来的地方送回去”。批评者将他的一些言论定性为种族主义。

paras.en: The raid on her home sparked outrage from her fellow Democrats, many whom accused Trump of abusing his power to go after a woman he openly feuds with.
paras.zh: 对她家的搜查激起了她的民主党同僚的愤怒，许多人指责特朗普滥用职权，追捕一名与他公开不和的女性。

paras.en: "Donald Trump has used racist and dehumanizing language to target Ilhan Omar for nearly a decade. This is one more escalation in his campaign to use the power of the federal government to target anyone he perceives as a political enemy," Rep. Yassamin Ansari, D-Ariz., said online following the raid.
paras.zh: “近十年来，唐纳德·特朗普一直使用种族主义和非人性化的语言来针对伊尔汗·奥马尔。这是他利用联邦政府的权力针对任何他认为是政治敌人的人的竞选活动的又一次升级，”亚利桑那州民主党众议员亚萨明·安萨里(Yassamin Ansari)在突袭后在网上表示。

paras.en: "It's fascism and abuse of office on a scale we have never seen. This is the stuff of dictatorships."
paras.zh: “这是我们从未见过的法西斯主义和滥用职权。这就是独裁统治。”

paras.en: Omar is the latest Democrat and perceived political opponent of the president to face federal investigations. Since returning to the White House, Trump has employed the power of the executive office to impose what critics characterize as punitive measures, against targets ranging from law firms linked to his critics to sitting lawmakers, including Rep. Jason Crow and Sen. Adam Schiff, as well as former FBI Director James Comey and New York Attorney General Letitia James.
paras.zh: 奥马尔是最新一位面临联邦调查的民主党人和被视为总统的政治对手。回到白宫后，特朗普利用行政办公室的权力，对批评者实施所谓的惩罚性措施，对象包括与批评者有联系的律师事务所、现任议员，包括众议员杰森·克劳和参议员亚当·希夫，以及前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米和纽约州总检察长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯。

articles.title: After F1 Singapore Concert, Lana Del Rey Hints at Another Visit to Asia
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Max Verstappen wasn’t the only winner at the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix on Sunday night (Oct. 11). Lana Del Rey gathered an enormous crowd when she headlined the F1’s music festival, in what was a rare appearance in Asia. And she hinted at more to come.
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘并不是周日晚（10 月 11 日）一级方程式新加坡航空新加坡大奖赛的唯一获胜者。拉娜·德雷 (Lana Del Rey) 在 F1 音乐节上担任主角时，吸引了大批观众，这在亚洲很少见。她还暗示还会有更多的事情发生。

paras.en: The superstar U.S. pop artist had top billing on the final night of the F1, for an exclusive performance and first headline spot in this city state. Del Rey drew an enormous crowd at the Padang Stage, numbering some 60,000 and presented in front of the 18 towering Corinthian columns of Singapore’s City Hall.
paras.zh: 这位美国流行巨星在 F1 的最后一晚获得了最高收视率，因为他在这个城市国家进行了独家表演并首次成为头条新闻。 《Del Rey》在巴东舞台吸引了大批观众，人数约 60,000，并在新加坡市政厅 18 根高耸的科林斯式圆柱前进行了演出。

paras.en: On a typically steamy October night, Lana cruised through a 75-minute set that got underway with “Young and Beautiful,” and strolled through her various eras, including “Ultraviolence,” “Chemtrails Over the Country Club,” “Did you know that there’s a tunnel under Ocean Blvd,” and “Born to Die.”
paras.zh: 在十月一个典型的闷热夜晚，拉娜在《年轻而美丽》开始的 75 分钟片场中畅游，并漫步在她的各个时代，包括《超暴力》、《乡村俱乐部上空的化学痕迹》、《你知道海洋大道下有一条隧道吗》和《生而死》。

paras.en: Lana and her backing singers and dancers looked right at home in their Southern-Gothic “shotgun” house, the centerpiece of a stage design which has popped up for recent stadium and festival tours.
paras.zh: 拉娜和她的伴唱和舞者在他们的南哥特式“霰弹枪”房子里看起来就像在家里一样，这是最近在体育场和节日巡演中出现的舞台设计的核心。

paras.en: “Oh my goodness Singapore, how are you,” she remarked after an early-set rendition of “Video Games.” “Did you get to see the races?”
paras.zh: “天哪，新加坡，你好吗，”她在演唱完《电子游戏》后说道。 “你去看比赛了吗？”

paras.en: The 14-song spot wrapped up with “Summertime Sadness,” and the warmest of assurances. “I know it’s not going to be the last time we see you,” she enthused near the finale. “Thank-you very much for my first big, big show here.”
paras.zh: 这首包含 14 首歌曲的歌曲以“夏日悲伤”和最温暖的保证结束。 “我知道这不会是我们最后一次见到你，”她在接近结局时热情地说。 “非常感谢你们为我在这里举办的第一场大型演出。”

paras.en: Fans in this part of the world have been starved of Lana and her sad girl anthems. She made a brief appearance in Singapore back in 2012 for an intimate performance at a Mulberry store, and has visited China for private events. A full-scale regional tour, however, has yet to materialize.
paras.zh: 这个地区的歌迷们非常渴望听到拉娜和她悲伤的女孩歌曲。 2012 年，她曾短暂出现在新加坡，在 Mulberry 专卖店进行了一场亲密表演，并曾访问中国参加私人活动。然而，全面的区域巡演尚未实现。

paras.en: Del Rey’s concert drew an end to the three-day F1 entertainment, which included sets by JJ Lin, Split Enz, The Killers, Goo Goo Dolls, Zara Larsson, Janet Jackson and Mark Ronson.
paras.zh: Del Rey 的演唱会为为期三天的 F1 娱乐活动画上句号，林俊杰、Split Enz、The Killers、Goo Goo Dolls、Zara Larsson、Janet Jackson 和 Mark Ronson 都参与了演出。

paras.en: Earlier on the night, Red Bull’s four-times world champion Max Verstappen collected his maiden Singapore Grand Prix, taking the checkered flag from pole position. It took the Dutch master 10 attempts to win on the Marina Bay street circuit.
paras.zh: 当晚早些时候，红牛四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘首次参加新加坡大奖赛，从杆位上夺得了方格旗。这位荷兰大师在滨海湾街道赛道上尝试了 10 次才取得胜利。

articles.title: Costco’s Exclusive ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Trading Card Set Includes 11 Rarity Levels & A Character-Inspired Frame
articles.author: Sophie Dunne

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: KPop Demon Hunters fans have a new collectible to add to their wish lists. Global trading card brand Kayou has teamed up with Netflix’s hit animated film for a special Collector Box available exclusively for Costco members. Priced at $53.99, the set comes in two versions inspired by HUNTR/X and the Saja Boys.
paras.zh: KPop Demon Hunters 粉丝们有一个新的收藏品可以添加到他们的愿望清单中。全球交易卡品牌 Kayou 与 Netflix 热门动画电影合作，推出专为 Costco 会员提供的特别收藏盒。该套装售价 53.99 美元，有两个版本，灵感来自 HUNTR/X 和 Saja Boys。

paras.en: Each box includes 10 Energy Edition trading card packs inspired by the Oscar-winning movie, with eight cards per pack, bringing the total to 80 cards. The collection spans 130 cards across 11 rarity levels, giving fans plenty of possibilities to explore as they hunt for their favorite characters and rare pulls. Every box also includes a special Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird promotional card and a character-inspired acrylic card frame. Both versions are available on Costco’s website.
paras.zh: 每盒包含 10 个能源版交易卡包，灵感源自奥斯卡获奖电影，每包有 8 张卡片，使卡片总数达到 80 张。该系列包含 130 张卡牌，涵盖 11 个稀有度级别，为粉丝寻找自己最喜欢的角色和稀有拉力时提供了充足的探索可能性。每个盒子还包含一张特殊的 Derpy Tiger 和 Sussie Bird 促销卡和一个受角色启发的亚克力卡框。这两个版本都可以在 Costco 网站上找到。

paras.en: HUNTR/X fans can choose the Collector Box inspired by the film’s fierce girl group. The difference between this and the Saja Boys Collector Box is the acrylic card frame with the HUNTR/X members featured in the design.
paras.zh: HUNTR/X 粉丝可以选择以电影中凶猛女团为灵感的收藏盒。它与 Saja Boys Collector Box 的区别在于亚克力卡框上印有 HUNTR/X 成员的设计。

paras.en: Prefer the movie’s charismatic rival group? The Saja Boys Collector Box offers a matching option for fans who want to celebrate the boy band. Like the HUNTR/X edition, it comes with an acrylic card frame featuring the boy band instead.
paras.zh: 更喜欢电影中富有魅力的对手群体？ Saja Boys 收藏盒为想要庆祝男孩乐队的粉丝提供了搭配选择。与 HUNTR/X 版本一样，它配备了一个以男孩乐队为主题的亚克力卡框。

paras.en: The Costco-Exclusive KPop Demon Hunters Trading Cards Rarity Levels Explained
paras.zh: Costco 独家 KPop Demon Hunters 交易卡稀有度解释

paras.en: - Scenario-E (SE): Includes four “Golden” trading cards, one of each HUNTR/X member and one of the group together.
paras.zh: - 场景-E (SE)：包括四张“黄金”交易卡，每个 HUNTR/X 成员一张，以及团体一张。

paras.en: - Brush Rare (BR): Includes three spotlight trading cards featuring each HUNTR/X member.
paras.zh: - Brush Rare (BR)：包括三张以每位 HUNTR/X 成员为主角的聚光集换卡。

paras.en: - Parallel Creative Rare (CR): Includes eight cards, one for each HUNTR/X and Saja Boys member, in a different international city.
paras.zh: - Parallel Creative Rare (CR)：包括八张卡片，每个 HUNTR/X 和 Saja Boys 成员一张，位于不同的国际城市。

paras.en: - Special Picture (SP): Includes six HUNTR/X Exclusive trading cards, two for each member of the girl group.
paras.zh: - 特别图片 (SP)：包括六张 HUNTR/X Exclusive 集换卡，女团每位成员各两张。

paras.en: - Legacy Rare (LR): Includes six Saja Boys Exclusive trading cards, one for each member of the group and one featuring the entire group in demon-red clothing.
paras.zh: - Legacy Rare (LR)：包括六张 Saja Boys Exclusive 集换卡，一张供团队中的每位成员使用，另一张则为整个团队穿着恶魔红色服装的图案。

paras.en: - Ultra Rare (UR): Includes 13 Signature Cards, featuring one HUNTR/X and Saja Boys member per card.
paras.zh: - 超稀有 (UR)：包括 13 张签名卡，每张卡上有一名 HUNTR/X 和 Saja Boys 成员。

paras.en: - Titan Rare (TR): Includes eight cards, one for each HUNTR/X and Saja Boys member, singing on stage.
paras.zh: - Titan Rare (TR)：包括八张卡片，每一张代表 HUNTR/X 和 Saja Boys 成员，在舞台上唱歌。

paras.en: - Quaint Rare (QR): Includes 24 cards in anime style, featuring the HUNTR/X members, the Saja Boys, demons, a “Rujinu” love-heart card, Sussie, Derpy and animated references to the movie.
paras.zh: - 古色古香的稀有 (QR)：包括 24 张动漫风格的卡片，其中包括 HUNTR/X 成员、Saja Boys、恶魔、一张“Rujinu”爱心卡片、Sussie、Derpy 以及对电影的动画引用。

paras.en: - Holo Rare (HR): Includes 24 holographic trading cards depicting memorable movie moments.
paras.zh: - Holo Rare (HR)：包括 24 张描绘令人难忘的电影时刻的全息交易卡。

paras.en: - Super Spark Rare (SSR): Includes 16 Concert Ticket trading cards with the HUNTR/X members in two distinct outfits and the Saja Boys in their “Soda Pop” and demon outfits.
paras.zh: - Super Spark Rare (SSR)：包括 16 张演唱会门票集换卡，其中 HUNTR/X 成员穿着两种不同的服装，而 Saja Boys 则穿着“Soda Pop”和恶魔服装。

paras.en: - Super Rare (SR): Includes 18 Incoming Calls trading cards featuring HUNTR/X, the Saja Boys, Sussie, Derpy, Bobby, Celine and demons.
paras.zh: - 超级稀有 (SR)：包括 18 张来电集换卡，其中包含 HUNTR/X、Saja Boys、Sussie、Derpy、Bobby、Celine 和恶魔。

paras.en: What You Need to Know About a Costco Membership
paras.zh: 关于 Costco 会员您需要了解的信息

paras.en: Costco is a membership-based retailer known for its wide selection of groceries, household goods, electronics, clothing and other products at competitive prices. Customers can shop at its warehouses or browse a broader selection through Costco’s website.
paras.zh: Costco 是一家会员制零售商，以其品种齐全且价格具有竞争力的杂货、家居用品、电子产品、服装和其他产品而闻名。顾客可以在 Costco 的仓库购物，也可以通过 Costco 的网站浏览更多选择。

paras.en: A Costco membership is generally required to purchase member-exclusive products, including this Kayou Collector Box. If you’re already a member, ordering online offers a convenient way to add the collectible to your cart without making a trip to a warehouse.
paras.zh: 通常需要持有 Costco 会员资格才能购买会员专享产品，包括这款 Kayou Collector Box。如果您已经是会员，在线订购提供了一种将收藏品添加到购物车的便捷方式，而无需前往仓库。

articles.title: Dom Dolla Launches Good Fortune Records
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Dom Dolla, the superstar EDM DJ and producer can now add “label chief” to his resume.
paras.zh: 超级巨星 EDM DJ 兼制作人 Dom Dolla 现在可以在他的简历中添加“厂牌总监”。

paras.en: The Australian artist today unveils Good Fortune Records, which launches proper this Friday (Oct. 16) with its first release, Torren Foot & rhys from the sticks’ “DANCE.”
paras.zh: 这位澳大利亚艺术家今天揭开了 Good Fortune Records 的面纱，该唱片公司将于本周五（10 月 16 日）推出首张专辑《Torren Foot & rhys》，来自 the Sticks 的《DANCE》。

paras.en: Good Fortune expands on a party series Dom created in 2024 to bring into the spotlight emerging and established artists, doing so in unique spaces and locations. Dom’s Good Fortune nights have kicked off in Melbourne, Los Angeles, New York, Miami, Detroit, London and Manchester, and featured performances and back-to-back sets with the likes of Solomun, Green Velvet, Tiga, Fcukers and Skream.
paras.zh: Good Fortune 对 Dom 于 2024 年创作的派对系列进行了扩展，旨在让新兴和知名艺术家在独特的空间和地点成为人们关注的焦点。 Dom 的好运之夜已在墨尔本、洛杉矶、纽约、迈阿密、底特律、伦敦和曼彻斯特拉开帷幕，并与 Solomun、Green Velvet、Tiga、Fcukers 和 Skream 等乐队进行表演和连续演出。

paras.en: “After 20 years of DJing, I still find nothing more exciting than discovering new records that rip holes through a dance floor,” remarks Dom in a statement. “This week, I’m finally launching Good Fortune Records. A record label that began as a party brand I’ve been running events under for the last few years. A place where both new up and coming artists and established legends can come together and do what they do best.”
paras.zh: “从事 DJ 20 年之后，我仍然觉得没有什么比发现在舞池中炸裂的新唱片更令人兴奋的了，”Dom 在一份声明中说道。 “本周，我终于推出了 Good Fortune Records。这个唱片公司最初是一个派对品牌，过去几年我一直在用这个品牌举办活动。在这里，新晋艺术家和知名传奇人物可以齐聚一堂，做他们最擅长的事情。”

paras.en: Dom debuted “DANCE” in December 2025 when he played Sydney’s Allianz Stadium, marking the first time a homegrown DJ had filled a stadium in these parts.
paras.zh: Dom 于 2025 年 12 月在悉尼安联体育场演出时首次推出了《DANCE》，这标志着本土 DJ 首次在这些地区占据了整个体育场。

paras.en: When Dom established another record last month, with his hometown show at Melbourne’s Marvel Stadium, he dropped the track to some 60,000 fans. Torren has been teasing “DANCE” on socials over the past month, keeping a list of all the DJs playing it — a tally that includes the groundbreaking Docklands show where he joined Dom on stage for a performance. Dom has since played the track with Ketama at Head Trip Festival 2026 in California.
paras.zh: 当 Dom 上个月在墨尔本漫威体育场举办家乡演出时创造了另一项纪录时，他将这首歌曲吸引到了大约 60,000 名粉丝。过去一个月，Torren 一直在社交媒体上调侃《DANCE》，并保留了所有播放该歌曲的 DJ 名单，其中包括开创性的 Docklands 演出，当时他与 Dom 一起登台表演。此后，Dom 在加利福尼亚州 2026 年 Head Trip Festival 上与 Ketama 一起演奏了这首歌曲。

paras.en: “It’s been a staple in my set for the last 12 months,” Dom enthuses.
paras.zh: “过去 12 个月里，它一直是我作品中的主打产品，”Dom 兴奋地说。

paras.en: There’s never a dull moment for Dom. Raised in Darwin, Dom (real name: Dominic Matheson) became a fixture on Melbourne’s club scene before taking his talents to the world.
paras.zh: 对于 Dom 来说，从来没有一个沉闷的时刻。 Dom（真名：Dominic Matheson）在达尔文长大，在将自己的才华推向世界之前，他已成为墨尔本俱乐部的常客。

paras.en: Last year, he was nominated for a Grammy Award; won a slew of ARIA Awards, including the inaugural ARIA Global Impact Award; sold-out two nights at Madison Square Garden and ticked off a bucket list item when he released “No Room For A Saint,” the soundtrack for F1: The Movie. It’s been more of the same this year with an itinerary that has included major festival and headline shows across Asia, Latin and North America, the United Kingdom and Europe, a 13-week residency at Hï Ibiza, an extension of his residency at LIV Las Vegas, and new releases, including a remix of Puretone’s “Addicted To Bass” (dubbed “Dom Dolla Relapse“).
paras.zh: 去年，他获得了格莱美奖提名；荣获多项 ARIA 奖项，包括首届 ARIA 全球影响力奖；麦迪逊广场花园的两晚门票全部售空，并在发行《F1：电影》原声带“No Room For A Saint”时完成了他的愿望清单。今年的行程也大同小异，包括亚洲、拉丁美洲和北美、英国和欧洲的大型音乐节和头条演出、在 Hï Ibiza 进行为期 13 周的驻场演出、在拉斯维加斯 LIV 驻场演出的延期，以及新专辑，包括 Puretone 的《Addicted To Bass》（又名《Dom Dolla Relapse》）的混音版。

paras.en: Just two days after he performed at Marvel Stadium, Dom was on the ground of another Aussie stadium, the Melbourne Cricket Ground, where he made a cameo during Kylie Minogue’s halftime entertainment spot at the 2026 AFL Grand Final.
paras.zh: 就在漫威体育场表演两天后，Dom 来到了另一个澳大利亚体育场——墨尔本板球场，在 2026 年 AFL 总决赛凯莉·米洛 (Kylie Minogue) 的中场娱乐节目中客串了一番。

articles.title: Pablo Torre Reveals Art of Play Security Camera Footage, and It Doesn’t Look Great for Kelly Clarkson
articles.author: Anthony Maglio

paras.en: Pablo Torre promised us security footage from Kelly Clarkson’s now-viral visit to Art of Play in Brooklyn. Well, we did get the video on Tuesday night, but no audio — bummer.
paras.zh: 巴勃罗·托雷向我们承诺，会提供凯莉·克拉克森在布鲁克林参观 Art of Play 的安全录像，该录像现已在网上疯传。好吧，我们确实在周二晚上收到了视频，但没有音频——真糟糕。

paras.en: The OG American Idol was in the toy store for exactly four minutes, 50 seconds. What we could see of the brief visit does not bode well for the “Stronger (What Doesn’t Kill You)” singer.
paras.zh: 元代《美国偶像》在玩具店里停留了整整 4 分 50 秒。我们从这次短暂访问中看到的情况对于这位“更强（什么不会杀死你）”歌手来说并不是好兆头。

paras.en: For most of her time in the shop, Clarkson can be seen playing around with what appears to be a kaleidoscope near the shop’s entrance. Her interaction with the Art of Play owner was relatively brief. She does appear to inquire with the shop owner about “Molly,” the automaton bird mounted to the wall. After a short conversation, Clarkson walks away from the man to another part of the shop. The store owner appears to attempt to regain her attention, pointing to what appears to be another product on an adjacent wall. She does not appear to respond, and the Art of Play owner moves on to assist another customer.
paras.zh: 在店里的大部分时间里，可以看到克拉克森在商店入口附近摆弄一个看似万花筒的东西。她与《游戏艺术》所有者的互动相对简短。她似乎确实向店主询问了“莫莉”，即安装在墙上的自动鸟。短暂交谈后，克拉克森离开该男子，走到商店的另一部分。店主似乎试图重新引起她的注意，并指着相邻墙上的另一种产品。她似乎没有回应，而《Art of Play》的老板则继续帮助另一位顾客。

paras.en: On her way out of the store, Clarkson appears to share strong feelings toward a second man, who is working the cash register. She’d share those same strong feelings on social media exactly 15 minutes after her exit.
paras.zh: 在走出商店的路上，克拉克森似乎对另一个在收银台工作的男人有着强烈的感情。离开后 15 分钟，她在社交媒体上分享了同样强烈的感受。

paras.en: “Just drove all the way to Brooklyn to check out this store I thought looked really rad and had a few things in mind to buy and literally was looked at as if I couldn’t afford it and was told he could find something comparable for me,” Miss Independent wrote. “Wow, dude. You’re an idiot and just lost a huge sale. But y’all should go check out Art of Play in Brooklyn if you enjoy being treated like Julia Roberts character in Pretty Woman. For sure, check it out 👎”
paras.zh: 独立小姐写道：“我一路开车去布鲁克林看看这家商店，我觉得它看起来真的很酷，并且想买一些东西，但实际上他们看起来好像我买不起，并被告知他可以为我找到类似的东西。” “哇，伙计。你是个白痴，刚刚失去了一笔大生意。但是，如果你喜欢像《风月俏佳人》中朱莉娅·罗伯茨的角色那样受到对待，那么你们都应该去布鲁克林的 Art of Play 看看。当然，去看看吧👎”

paras.en: The “comparable” product was a pair of other automaton birds made by a German clockmaker. It cost $2,000. Torre purchased it, unveiled it on his show, and said he would auction it off.
paras.zh: “类似”产品是德国钟表匠制造的另外一对自动鸟。花费了 2,000 美元。托雷购买了它，在他的节目中展示了它，并表示他将拍卖它。

paras.en: In response to Clarkson’s initial post, The Art of Play owner said his “small local business was suddenly attacked by 8 million people who have never visited our store.”
paras.zh: 在回应克拉克森最初的帖子时，The Art of Play 老板表示，他的“当地小型企业突然遭到 800 万从未去过我们商店的人的攻击。”

paras.en: “Yesterday, Kelly Clarkson visited us in Brooklyn and inquired about buying ‘Molly,’ a one-of-a-kind singing and dancing bird automaton who plays an important role in the magic shows we host here,” Art of Play posted. “Molly is permanently attached to the wall and isn’t for sale. However, the negative experience Kelly described on Twitter would resonate with anyone who has ever felt judged in a shop.
paras.zh: “昨天，凯莉·克拉克森 (Kelly Clarkson) 到布鲁克林拜访了我们，并询问是否购买‘莫莉’，这是一种独一无二的能歌善舞的小鸟机器人，在我们在这里举办的魔术表演中发挥着重要作用，”Art of Play 发帖称。 “莫莉永久地固定在墙上，并且不出售。然而，凯利在推特上描述的负面经历会引起任何在商店里感到被评判的人的共鸣。

paras.en: “At Art of Play whether someone comes in to make a purchase or simply look around for a while, they are equally welcome. We greet everyone who walks in the door with the invitation to ‘pick things up and play.’ And they do, many stay for hours enjoying our puzzles, games and toys.”
paras.zh: “在 Art of Play，无论是来购物还是只是四处看看，我们都同样受到欢迎。我们会向每一位走进门的人致意，并邀请他们‘拿起东西来玩’。他们确实这样做了，许多人会在这里呆上几个小时，享受我们的拼图、游戏和玩具。”

paras.en: Clarkson and Art of Play (and the rest of X, fka Twitter) went back and forth from there, which led Torre to take up the cause.
paras.zh: 克拉克森和 Art of Play（以及 X 的其他成员，fka Twitter）从那里来来回回，这导致托雷​​开始着手这项事业。

articles.title: Two Internet Sensations Collide: Lola Blankets Gets a LoveShackFancy Makeover
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Two social media sensations have joined forces on a limited-edition launch that blends a soft aesthetic with an even softer feel.
paras.zh: 两大社交媒体轰动人士联手推出限量版，将柔和的美感与更柔和的感觉融为一体。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Oct. 14 at 8 a.m. PT/ 11 a.m. ET, Lola Blankets and LoveShackFancy are dropping their first-ever co-designed faux fur throws, pairing the former’s unmatched plush fabric with the latter’s unmistakable feminine motifs. The result is the Lola Original covered in two collaboration-exclusive colorways: Rosy Bows and Petal Pink. Each is available in four sizes: Baby ($125), Medium ($275), Large ($325) and XL ($425).
paras.zh: 太平洋时间 10 月 14 日星期二上午 8 点/东部时间上午 11 点，Lola Blankets 和 LoveShackFancy 即将推出首款联合设计的人造皮草休闲毯，将前者无与伦比的毛绒面料与后者明显的女性化图案相结合。 Lola Original 采用了两种合作专属配色：Rosy Bows 和 Petal Pink。每款都有四种尺寸：婴儿（125 美元）、中号（275 美元）、大号（325 美元）和 XL（425 美元）。

paras.en: As for the two designs, Rosy Bows features LoveShackFancy’s signature bow motif, while Petal Pink is double-dyed for a frosted, dimensional effect. Each blanket comes with an exclusive branded tote bag, making it an easy (and highly sought-after) holiday gifting option.
paras.zh: 至于这两种设计，Rosy Bows 采用 LoveShackFancy 的标志性蝴蝶结图案，而 Petal Pink 采用双重染色，呈现磨砂立体效果。每条毯子都配有一个独特的品牌手提袋，使其成为一种简单（且备受追捧）的节日礼物选择。

paras.en: For those not yet familiar, Lola Blankets’ signature throw has taken the internet — and Hollywood — by storm, and, to be honest, it really is that good. Selena Gomez, Simone Biles, Oprah Winfrey and Tate McRae are just a handful of the viral brand’s famous fans — Gomez was pictured writing her vows wrapped in the Lola Original, while Oprah’s Favorite Things 2025 list featured the newer Lola Weighted blanket.
paras.zh: 对于那些还不熟悉的人来说，Lola Blankets 的标志性投掷方式已经席卷了互联网和好莱坞，而且说实话，它确实有那么好。赛琳娜·戈麦斯 (Selena Gomez)、西蒙·拜尔斯 (Simone Biles)、奥普拉·温弗瑞 (Oprah Winfrey) 和泰特·麦克雷 (Tate McRae) 都是该品牌的知名粉丝中的一小部分——戈麦斯被拍到裹着 Lola Original 写下自己的誓言，而《奥普拉 2025 年最喜欢的事物》清单则以新款 Lola Weighted 毛毯为特色。

paras.en: Beyond its loyal celebrity following, Lola is known for its limited-edition creator, sports and brand partnerships, from California-cool apparel label Aviator Nation to the New York Yankees. Similarly, LoveShackFancy is no stranger to buzzy brand collabs — Havaianas, Pottery Barn, Stanley and the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are just a few of its past partners.
paras.zh: 除了忠实的名人追随者之外，Lola 还因其限量版创作者、体育运动和品牌合作伙伴关系而闻名，其中包括加州酷炫服装品牌 Aviator Nation 和纽约洋基队。同样，LoveShackFancy 对热门品牌合作并不陌生——Havaianas、Pottery Barn、Stanley 和达拉斯牛仔啦啦队只是其过去的几个合作伙伴。

paras.en: Back to the current crossover, the Lola Blankets x LoveShackFancy styles will be available on both LolaBlankets.com and LoveShackFancy.com starting Oct. 14 at 8 a.m. PT/ 11 a.m. ET, and given each of the brands involved and the limited quantity made, product is expected to move fast.
paras.zh: 回到目前的联名款，Lola Blankets x LoveShackFancy 款式将于 10 月 14 日太平洋时间上午 8 点/东部时间上午 11 点开始在 LolaBlankets.com 和 LoveShackFancy.com 上发售，考虑到涉及的每个品牌和限量生产，预计产品会快速销售。

paras.en: Related: Parke Brings Back Its Sold-Out Shrunken Sweatshirt in Fan-Favorite Colorways
paras.zh: 相关：Parke 以粉丝最喜欢的配色重新推出已售罄的缩小运动衫

articles.title: Ben Affleck Calls Filming ‘Justice League’ a “Low Point” in His Career: “About as Gross as It Gets”
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Ben Affleck has determined that filming Justice League was a “low point” in his acting career.
paras.zh: 本·阿弗莱克认为拍摄《正义联盟》是他演艺生涯的“低谷”。

paras.en: The actor-producer-director made a recent appearance on the Happy Sad Confused podcast, where he opened up to host Josh Horowitz about why making the movie was such a negative experience. Affleck played Bruce Wayne/Batman in the 2017 superhero pic.
paras.zh: 这位演员兼制片人兼导演最近出现在 Happy Sad Confused 播客中，他向乔什·霍洛维茨 (Josh Horowitz) 讲述了为什么制作这部电影是一次如此消极的经历。阿弗莱克在 2017 年的超级英雄电影中饰演布鲁斯·韦恩/蝙蝠侠。

paras.en: “The truth is, the experience of Justice League for me was so, so negative for lots of different reasons,” he admitted. “Some of which having to do with where I was personally, some of which having to do with the tragedy that happened during the time, and also the fact that I really saw how not to make a movie like that when the studio is at odds with the filmmaker. You’re really making a mistake. That was what really doomed that.”
paras.zh: “事实是，由于许多不同的原因，正义联盟对我来说的经历非常非常消极，”他承认。 “其中一些与我个人的处境有关，另一些与当时发生的悲剧有关，还有一个事实是，当工作室与电影制片人不和时，我真的看到了如何不拍这样的电影。你真的犯了一个错误。这才是真正注定的事情。”

paras.en: After 2016’s Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice became a major critical disappointment and didn’t meet Warner Bros.’ box office expectations, the studio wanted Zack Snyder’s Justice League to be a lighter tone, despite the filmmaker’s darker creative vision for the film.
paras.zh: 2016 年的《蝙蝠侠大战超人：正义黎明》在评论界大失所望，并且没有达到华纳兄弟的票房预期后，华纳兄弟希望扎克·施奈德的《正义联盟》能有一个轻松的基调，尽管电影制片人对这部电影的创作愿景较为黑暗。

paras.en: During post-production, Snyder stepped away from the movie following the death of his daughter. Warner Bros. then brought in director Joss Whedon to oversee extensive reshoots, which ultimately lightened the tone.
paras.zh: 在后期制作过程中，斯奈德在女儿去世后退出了这部电影。华纳兄弟随后聘请导演乔斯·韦登监督大量重拍，最终缓和了基调。

paras.en: “Boy, that was shitty,” Affleck said. “Him being taken off that movie, and the reshoots that we did — if you want the low point of my career, [it] was that.”
paras.zh: “天哪，这太糟糕了，”阿弗莱克说。 “他被从那部电影中删除，以及我们所做的重拍——如果你想要我职业生涯的最低点，那就是。”

paras.en: Horowitz also asked the Animals star and director if he had any kind of “epiphany” while working on Justice League as he saw “this film kind of collapsing in front of you.”
paras.zh: 霍洛维茨还问这位《动物》明星兼导演，在拍摄《正义联盟》时是否有任何“顿悟”，因为他看到“这部电影在你面前崩溃了”。

paras.en: “Somebody’s death by suicide, that eclipses everything,” Affleck replied. “And the way in which that was, I thought, frankly, used as an excuse… I just thought that was one of the shittiest things I’ve ever seen. It was so gross. And then the whole environment and vibe, much of which I wasn’t privy to, but that I sort of heard about secondhand in terms of Ray [Fisher] and Gal [Gadot] and other people’s experiences. It was just like, ‘Wow, this is about as gross as it gets.'”
paras.zh: “有人自杀身亡，这让一切都黯然失色，”阿弗莱克回答道。 “坦率地说，我认为这被用作借口……我只是觉得这是我见过的最糟糕的事情之一。太恶心了。然后是整个环境和氛围，其中大部分我并不知情，但我从雷[费舍尔]和盖尔[加朵]和其他人的经历中听说过。就像是，‘哇，这真是太恶心了。’”

paras.en: Several years later, fans finally got to see Snyder’s version of the film. A Justice League director’s cut was released in 2021 on HBO Max following a global fan campaign, a strategy shift for the streamer and Warner Bros. investing $70 million to finish visual effects and editing.
paras.zh: 几年后，影迷们终于看到了施奈德版本的这部电影。经过全球粉丝宣传活动、流媒体策略转变以及华纳兄弟投资 7000 万美元完成视觉效果和剪辑后，《正义联盟》导演剪辑版于 2021 年在 HBO Max 上发布。

paras.en: “I was really glad and gratified that Zack got to release [his cut], and he did it in a very kind of canny way… manipulated his way into getting his thing released, which was fucking great,” Affleck said. “I was really happy for him.”
paras.zh: “我真的很高兴扎克能够发布[他的剪辑]，他以一种非常精明的方式做到了......操纵他的方式让他的东西发布，这真是太棒了，”阿弗莱克说。 “我真的为他感到高兴。”
