articles.title: Dave Roberts keeps Shohei Ohtani in Dodgers' NLCS Game 3 lineup despite postseason struggles

paras.en: Los Angeles Dodgers manager Dave Roberts probably never thought he'd have to take Shohei Ohtani out of his lineup during a postseason series. Ever.
But after the team went down 2-0 in the NLCS to the Milwaukee Brewers, with Ohtani struggling at the plate, a decision had to be made heading into Game 3 at Dodger Stadium.
The final verdict? Roberts will be trusting his Japanese superstar.

"He’s adamant he feels good enough to be in there," Roberts told reporters, via The New York Post, during the team’s off-day on Tuesday regarding Ohtani’s left knee and right arm ailments he’s been dealing with. "He’s close to finding something with his swing. I feel great about it."

Ohtani has been serving as the Dodgers’ designated hitter, but he has been slumping throughout the postseason. His batting average is now down to a measly .150 after going 0-for-4 with two strikeouts in the Game 2 loss to the Brewers in Milwaukee. He also hasn’t had an extra-base hit or an RBI in the playoffs.
It was Roberts who started the debate over whether Ohtani should be in the Game 3 lineup after his postgame comments on Monday night to The Athletic.
Roberts ultimately decided the four-time MVP should get another shot after having a meeting with president of baseball operations Andrew Friedman and general manager Brandon Gomes.
"He was very convicted that he is onto something mechanically," Roberts added. "He was adamant that he can help us, he’s well enough to help us win a baseball game. So, that’s all I needed to hear."
Ohtani, through his interpreter Will Ireton, added: "The symptoms shouldn’t be the reason why I can’t hit. He said he takes "full responsibility" for how he’s played thus far in October.
Ohtani’s injuries are ones he’s dealt with throughout the regular season, with his arm requiring an injured list stint to try and get better.
But it’s clearly stymied the slugger, who hasn’t hit a home run since Aug. 18 – a stretch Ohtani is not used to.
Roberts noted that his confidence in Ohtani has "never wavered," and his Game 3 decision is a testament to that.
Will it work out in a game that feels like a must-win to get momentum back on the side of the back-to-back World Series champions?

articles.title: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani says he won't fire NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch despite socialist pressure

paras.en: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Tuesday he has "no plans" to fire NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch, pushing back against calls from his democratic socialist allies to remove the city's top cop following protests over an ICE-involved shooting in the Bronx.
Ahead of a ceremony Tuesday honoring fallen NYPD officers, Mamdani was asked about Tisch's future as head of the department.
"Jessica Tisch is the police commissioner. I have no plans to change that," Mamdani told reporters.

"The reason that I made the decision to have Jessica Tisch as the police commissioner was because of her record of uprooting corruption from the upper echelons of the NYPD while lowering crime across our city," he continued. "And over the last 10 months that we've worked together, we have delivered the lowest recorded number of murders in our city's history, the lowest recorded number of shootings as well as shooting victims."

The mayor's comments came after the New York City chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) called for Tisch's removal following last week's ICE shooting and demanded that Mamdani use his authority to drive ICE out of New York City.
The demand followed last week's shooting of Oscar Belgal during a federal immigration operation in the Bronx.

According to the Department of Homeland Security, Belgal, a 28-year-old Dominican national, was shot after allegedly refusing to comply with officers' orders during a targeted ICE operation to arrest him.
Following the incident, a City Hall spokesperson said Mamdani was reviewing the circumstances surrounding the shooting but had no plans to remove Tisch.

Scott Munro, president of the Detectives' Endowment Association — the union representing active and retired NYPD detectives — was also asked by reporters Tuesday about the DSA urging Mamdani to fire Tisch.
Munro said he believes Mamdani supports the police commissioner, noting that crime was down and Tisch was "doing her job."

Mamdani and Tisch appeared together Tuesday at the New York City Police Memorial, where they honored 42 fallen NYPD members, including 41 who died from illnesses related to the Sept. 11 terrorist attacks and their aftermath. The ceremony also honored Detective First Grade Didarul Islam, who was killed in a Midtown Manhattan mass shooting in 2025.
The mayor paid tribute to the fallen officers and their families during the ceremony, which Tisch also attended.
"While we cannot feel the silence they left behind, we will refuse to let their memory fade," Mamdani said.
Earlier this week, Mamdani directed the NYPD to conduct a comprehensive review of its use-of-force policies and practices.
He also announced reforms aimed at strengthening accountability when police officers are accused of serious misconduct.

articles.title: Tampa Bay Rays win game two over Guardians thanks to terrible error from José Ramírez, even ALCS at 1-1

paras.en: The American League Championship Series has pitted two of the most unlikely franchises against each other, with a trip to the World Series on the line.

The Tampa Bay Rays entered the 2026 season with one of the three lowest payrolls in baseball, as they usually do. They made few big additions, preferring to trust their farm system, player development staff, and the ability to mix and match players in specific situations.

Meanwhile, the Cleveland Guardians found a way to reduce spending even further, running the lowest payroll in Major League Baseball, in order to maximize profits for team ownership. Fast-forward to October, and the Rays and Guardians are the two AL teams, not the Yankees or Red Sox. Not the Astros and Rangers from big markets in Texas. Or the Blue Jays, with their top-5 payroll, or even Detroit, where the Tigers ran the 11th highest payroll in baseball and by far the highest in the AL Central.
As surprising as it comes, if you haven't watched baseball before. But maybe even more surprising? How game one of the ALCS between these two teams played out.

Cleveland, hardly known as an offensive powerhouse, fell behind 2-0 against one of the best run prevention teams in baseball. Then, starting in the sixth inning, they started scoring and never stopped. Home runs from Chase DeLauter and light-hitting catcher Patrick Bailey tied it, and a parade of hits led to a 4-3 lead in the eighth, which they promptly expanded to 7-3 by the ninth.

The team that finished 24th in the league in runs scored, exploding for seven runs in game one of the ALCS against one of the best pitching staffs in baseball. If that doesn't demonstrate the randomness of postseason baseball, it's hard to know what does.

That set up what amounts to a must-win situation for the favored Tampa Bay Rays in game two, who sent midseason trade addition Freddy Peralta, acquired from the lowly New York Mets, to the mound hoping to even the series. Cleveland countered with Parker Messick, coming off an outstanding season of his own. But on Tuesday, Peralta, despite his struggles in New York, was electric.

Six shutout innings, with six strikeouts and just four hits allowed, with an average fastball velocity over 2.5 mph higher than his season average. And he got a little help from his defense too, as star third baseman Junior Caminero made a nice play on a liner to his left, and hit the Dikembe Mutombo finger wag afterward.
Just as you'd expect from the Tampa pitching lab, Peralta's start lowered his ERA to just 0.81 over his last eight starts in a Rays uniform. Somehow, they do it every single time.

On offense, the Rays' lineup got to Messick in the fourth thanks to some shaky Cleveland defense. After Victor Mesa Jr. beat out an infield single, overturned on review, Jonny DeLuca struck out and Ben Williamson hit what seemed to be a routine grounder to third. But it took a funny hop and got through Guardians third baseman José Ramírez, scoring Mesa from third. Then Liam Hicks made it really hurt, lacing a line drive single to center to score Williamson and Chandler Simpson and extend the lead to 3-0.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The Guardians, as has become their trademark of late, battled back in the seventh. Patrick Bailey worked a leadoff walk after an ABS challenge, and got to second on a one-out Steven Kwan single. After José Ramírez flew out, Chase DeLauter drove in a run with a 105mph double to right. With the tying run at second base, Cleveland sent up Jo Adell, another impactful midseason acquisition who helped seal the game one win with a two-run single in the ninth inning. But Ian Seymour shut the door, getting Adell swinging on a changeup out of the zone.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The Guardians couldn't get anything going in the eighth, and Tampa went into the ninth inning with their dominant closer, Bryan Baker, looking to finish it out. And he did on just seven pitches, going through a quick 1-2-3 inning to even the series at a game apiece.

Tampa entered the series as big favorites, thanks to their deep pitching staff, and a lineup that's better as a whole than the sum of its parts. Plus Baker, who's followed up his 1.44 ERA in the regular season with four scoreless innings and four saves in the playoffs.

Tuesday's game two was a microcosm of this year's postseason; dominant pitching and timely, often advantageous hitting. Given these two teams' strengths, that's likely to continue for the remainder of the series.

The ALCS now shifts to Cleveland for game three, where Gavin Williams, coming off a dominant ALDS start against the White Sox, is expected to face Tampa bulk pitcher Griffin Jax. Expect a raucous crowd at Progressive Field, as the Guardians look to make progress towards a return to the World Series for the first time since 2016.

articles.title: $20m public liability insurance to rally in a park: how council red tape hinders the right to protest
articles.author: Jordyn Beazley

paras.en: Council red tape is stymieing the right to protest, a report has said, after a regional New South Wales council told a protest organiser they needed a $20m public liability insurance policy to hold a rally in a park.

A report released on Wednesday, co-authored by Australian Democracy Network (ADN) and Deakin University’s Centre for Law as Protection, raised concerns about incidents in which councils have required protest organisers to obtain insurance when rallies are held on council land.
It also expressed concern about the power some regional and urban councils have to issue financial penalties if public gatherings are held without a council permit.

In July, Mariella Gussoni notified Bathurst regional council she was holding a protest in a local park against the culling of brumbies in Kosciuszko national park. In her email to the council, seen by Guardian Australia, she said the protest would be part of nationwide rallies on a set day in August. The protest would include speakers and music, and she wasn’t sure if five or 50 people would attend, she wrote.

The council responded by letter, seen by Guardian Australia, saying it would permit her to hold her planned protest on the condition she take out a $20m public liability insurance policy, noting the council would not be liable for any loss or injury.

Nervous about what that could mean, and how much it would cost, the 61-year-old decided to hold the protest, which was attended by an estimated 120 people, next to the park. She notified police of her intention to hold the rally on the footpath – which is not council land – and said it went ahead without any issues.
“It scared me that I would be liable,” she said. “I had just let the council know as a courtesy.”
A spokesperson for Bathurst council said: “Council engaged with the event organisers at the time and won’t be providing any further comment on the matter.”

Report co-author and ADN protest rights campaigner, Anastasia Radievska, said council red tape such as insurance requirements could have a chilling effect on people speaking up about what’s happening in their local neighbourhoods.
“Often, community groups might spring up in relation to a specific local issue,” she said. “The more councils do this, the more other councils think that this is the way to interact with protest.”

The report said that across most Australian jurisdictions, “protest is unlawful or unprotected” without “permission from police, councils or place managers” and called for existing permit systems to be considered a process of notification rather than authorisation. It also recommended there be no insurance requirements.

NSW carries a $2,200 fine if a public gathering is held on council land without a permit, the report noted. This is a default requirement under the Local Government Act, but some councils have their own policies which deviate from the act. The city of Sydney has passed a number of motions affirming the right to protest on council land.

This requirement exists in addition to the police’s form 1 process, in which protesters can notify police of an intention to protest and gain immunity from being charged for offences such as obstructing a road in a designated area.
Tim Roberts, the president of the Council for Civil Liberties, said council demands for insurance or permits were “unhelpful” and a “reactionary approach”.
“It’s a blatant contravention of the right to protest,” Roberts said, referring to the implied right to freedom of political communication in the Australian constitution.

He agreed that protest organisers should only be required to give notice and not seek authorisation. He equated the council requiring insurance with calls for a user-pays system for the policing of protests.

Last week, a community group opposing a proposed $2.9bn datacentre on Sydney’s Cooks River was told by Bayside council it needed public liability insurance to hold a rally at Cahill Park in Wolli Creek.

The council also told the organisers it required an event application because their event included food, a film, and amplified sound. One of the organisers for Stop the Cooks River AI Project (SCRAP), Caitlin Boyce, said the council said it would need eight weeks to assess the application.

After receiving pro bono legal advice, the group decided to take their chances and go ahead with the protest without making an event application to the council. Boyce said she hasn’t heard from the council since going ahead with the rally.

A spokesperson for the Bayside council said it was not opposed to the public gathering, but the planned activities – which it said included a barbecue and smoking ceremony – “constitute an organised event and are subject to Council’s event approval requirements”.
Local Government NSW and the Office of Local Government were approached for comment.

articles.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon previously visited farm where he later allegedly tried to sink bodies, court told
articles.author: Kat Wong

paras.en: Beau Lamarre-Condon previously visited a farm where he later tried to sink the bodies of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies, the prosecution has told a Sydney court.
The rural property belonged to the family of a man the police officer had met on a dating app and the two visited the farm together months before the alleged murders.
Lamarre-Condon, 31, has been accused of shooting dead Baird and Davies with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home on 19 February 2024.
He has pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder and one charge of aggravated break and enter.

The prosecution on Wednesday read out a statement from Michael Cella who was 20 years old when he spoke with police in 2024. Cella said he matched with Lamarre-Condon on the dating app Hinge in March 2023.
They began seeing each other, with the pair going to Bondi Junction to watch Hunger Games and the Taylor Swift movie in late 2023. They also ate sushi together.
In November 2023, Lamarre-Condon invited the younger man on a weekend trip to a cabin.
But because the proposed trip was too expensive, Cella invited the police officer to go to his family’s hobby farm in Bungonia.
The property had four dams, animals, a fence and a front gate with chains and a padlock, the court heard on Wednesday.

On 6 November, they drove around the area, looked at the animals and stayed overnight, with Lamarre-Condon recording the farm and posting it to his Instagram story with the Taylor Swift song You Belong With Me.
Cella later learned about Baird when he saw Lamarre-Condon’s Instagram posts with him.
“Beau told me they were friends. I sensed there was something more and Beau was not telling me everything,” Cella said in his 2024 statement read to the jury.
Communication between Lamarre-Condon and Cella slowed significantly about mid-November 2023 and the latter soon lost interest.
He received some messages from Lamarre-Condon in January 2024 but ignored them, blocked his contact number and deleted their text message conversation, the court heard.
Days later, he received a call from a number with no called ID and did not answer, followed by a message on the encrypted messaging app Signal from a contact with the name Bob. Cella did not respond.
After the deaths of Baird and Davies, Lamarre-Condon allegedly made an unsuccessful attempt to sink their bodies at the bottom of a dam at Cella Farm, the prosecution has told the jury.
They were later found at the fence line of a monastery about 20km from the property.
The defence has not disputed the officer attempted to clean up the scene or dispose of the bodies, claiming he “panicked considerably” after acting in self-defence.
But the events inside Baird’s home are contested.
The defence has argued the couple were accidentally shot in two separate struggles.
The prosecution has told the court that Lamarre-Condon shot Baird twice in the kitchen before shooting Davies through a bedroom door.
A computer-generated video outlining the crown’s version of events was played to the New South Wales supreme court jury earlier on Wednesday.

The 3D recreation of the Paddington terrace on the morning of the shootings allowed the jury to see the path Lamarre-Condon allegedly took through the home. The reconstruction included photos of bullet holes and marks.
The potential trajectory of the bullets was also highlighted.
Before the video was shown, justice Natalie Adams said it was the crown case that Baird was shot at close range but the defence argued he was shot from further away.
The judge warned the kitchen was not shown to scale and that not all the evidence relevant to the angle or distance of the shot to Baird’s head had been adduced.
The NSW police firearms examiner, Lucas Van Der Walt, said he was more certain of the trajectory of the bullet through the bedroom door because it had passed through 35mm thick wood.
Van Der Walt told the court that “stippling” had been found on the door around a bullet hole that the prosecution alleged was covered with putty and a plastic hook.
Stippling is the pattern made by gun shot propellant particles. The closer a target is to a barrel, the smaller the spread pattern would be, Van Der Walt said on Wednesday.
“[It] is going to pepper itself into that softer surface – in this case a painted door,” he told the jury.
The court was shown a video of police taking the door from Baird’s bedroom and shooting it with the same gun and ammunition that was allegedly used by Lamarre-Condon.

The pictures of both the original and test bullet hole were compared and shown to the jury. Van Der Walt said there was a “very similar spread pattern of the propellant particles impacting with the paint and the wood in the door”.
He suggested the muzzle of the firearm was 10 to 20cm away from Davies when it was discharged.
On the side of the door the bullet would have exited, he noted the splintering looked more opaque in the original hole, but he said that was because wood putty had been used to fill the hole.
Defence lawyer John Stratton SC suggested the bullet hole could have been created if there was a body in front of the door, but Van Der Walt said the “clear stippling” would prevent that scenario.
Asked why there was no other bullet marks or bullets found in the room, the expert said it could have hypothetically hit a pillow, jacket or similar item.
“If that bullet continued and penetrated any of these surfaces and that object was removed and discarded, we’ll never find that bullet,” he told the court.
Bullets shot in this way fell to the ground, he said, and given the scene had been cleaned extensively, a casing could have been picked up by cleaners, Van Der Walt told the jury.
The trial before justice Adams continues.

articles.title: Australian politics live: Albanese says ‘completely wrong’ he ‘cleaned up’ after Chalmers on credit card ban; Coalition continues to target Aly
articles.author: Krishani Dhanji

paras.en: Taylor claims Albanese repeatedly ‘humiliated’ Chalmers
paras.zh: 泰勒声称阿尔巴尼亚人一再“羞辱”查默斯

paras.en: How much more humiliation will Jim Chalmers endure before the PM puts him out of his misery and sacks him, asks AngusTaylor.
paras.zh: 安格斯·泰勒（ AngusTaylor ）问道，在首相将他从痛苦中解雇并解雇他之前，吉姆·查默斯（ Jim Chalmers ）还会忍受多少屈辱。

paras.en: The leader of the opposition is trying to stoke the fire, and says the PM was forced to step in to clean up the treasurer’s mess on the ATO credit card ban and before that stepped in to stop the taxing of unrealised capital gains on small businesses.
paras.zh: 反对派领导人正试图煽动火灾，并表示总理被迫介入清理财务主管对ATO信用卡禁令的混乱，在此之前，他介入阻止对小企业未实现的资本收益征税。

paras.en: Anthony Albanese tries to pour cold water over the commentary that he went over Chalmers’ head to delay the credit card ban.
paras.zh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯（ Anthony Albanese ）试图将冷水倒在评论上，评论说他越过了查尔默斯（ Chalmers ）的头脑，推迟了信用卡禁令。

paras.en: Everything is, like, totally fine he says.
paras.zh: 他说，一切都很好。

paras.en: The whole premise of it is completely wrong. The treasurer and I had a discussion last week. We convened the expenditure review committee, and we unanimously, right across the leadership of the government, agreed that the decision by the ATO, to have a limited period of pause on the ban.
paras.zh: 整个前提是完全错误的。我和财务主管上周进行了一次讨论。我们召集了支出审查委员会，我们在政府领导层一致同意ATO的决定，对禁令暂停一段时间。

paras.en: Taylor tries to make a point of order, but you regular readers of the blog will know that if the opposition leader – as he has here – has asked a broad political question, he’ll get a broad political answer.
paras.zh: 泰勒试图提出程序问题，但博客的普通读者会知道，如果反对派领导人--就像他在这里所做的那样--提出了一个广泛的政治问题，他会得到一个广泛的政治答案。

paras.en: Albanese then pulls out the Josh Frydenberg card:
paras.zh: 然后Albanese拿出Josh Frydenberg的卡片：

paras.en: Our version of aspiration is health, housing, jobs and opportunity. The Liberal party version of aspiration is Josh Frydenberg. There he is, a failed treasurer who couldn’t even hold his seat … And overcoming his innate shyness to be out there. You can’t turn on a TV without seeing Josh Frydenberg. He’s out there every single day.
paras.zh: 我们的愿望是健康、住房、工作和机会。自由党版本的愿望是乔希·弗莱登伯格（ Josh Frydenberg ）。他来了，一个失败的司库，他甚至坐不住……克服了他与生俱来的羞怯。看不到乔希·弗莱登伯格（ Josh Frydenberg ） ，就无法打开电视。他每天都在外面。

paras.en: RBA warns staff pay rise ‘will not proceed’ if rejected ahead of vote
paras.zh: 澳大利亚央行警告，如果在投票前被否决，员工加薪“将不会继续”

paras.en: The Reserve Bank of Australia has told its staff they will miss out on their pay rise if they don’t support a disputed wage deal.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚储备银行告诉其工作人员，如果他们不支持有争议的工资协议，他们将错过加薪的机会。

paras.en: RBA staff rejected a 9% increase over three years in July and have fought management for a better offer but the bank will put a roughly similar offer to a vote tomorrow.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚央行工作人员在7月份拒绝了三年内9%的涨幅，并与管理层争夺更好的报价，但该行将在明天的投票中提出大致相似的报价。

paras.en: Susan Woods, the RBA’s chief operating officer, told staff in an email today the 9% offer was competitive. She said:
paras.zh: 澳大利亚央行首席运营官苏珊·伍兹（ Susan Woods ）今天在一封电子邮件中告诉员工， 9%的报价具有竞争力。她说：

paras.en: We have genuinely negotiated to arrive at this position and are at the limit of what we can responsibly offer while meeting our obligations as a public institution and Australia’s central bank.
paras.zh: 我们为实现这一目标进行了真诚的谈判，并且在履行我们作为公共机构和澳大利亚中央银行的义务时，我们所能以负责任的方式提供的服务已经达到了极限。

paras.en: Staff have already missed six weeks of pay rise as their deal would have started in September. Woods told staff the RBA would not offer any backpay, adding:
paras.zh: 员工已经错过了六周的加薪，因为他们的交易将在9月开始。伍兹告诉工作人员， RBA不会提供任何背薪，并补充说：

paras.en: This is the Bank’s best offer for the 2026 EA. A further “no” vote will not recover the salary already forgone, and the proposed 3.7 per cent increase will not proceed … Bargaining would continue, with no guarantee that this would result in a higher wage outcome.
paras.zh: 这是该行对2026年EA的最佳报价。再次投反对票将无法收回已经放弃的工资，拟议的3.7%加薪也不会继续……谈判将继续进行，不能保证这将导致更高的工资结果。

paras.en: The RBA has compared its bargaining to federal public service, which is also offering 9%, and the Commonwealth Bank, which yesterday agreed pay rises over three years of 13% for its lowest paid staff but 5% for those on over $165,000.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚央行将其讨价还价与联邦公共服务部门进行了比较，联邦公共服务部门也提供9%的薪酬，而英联邦银行昨天同意在三年内将其最低薪员工的薪酬提高13% ，但超过$ 165,000的人的薪酬提高5%。

paras.en: The Finance Sector Union has asked RBA staff to reject the deal and fight for an 11% three year deal. The vote will close at 5pm AEDT on Monday.
paras.zh: 金融部门工会已要求RBA员工拒绝这笔交易，并争取达成11%的三年协议。投票将于周一下午5点结束。

paras.en: That’s all from me on the politics blog today, thank you for following along.
paras.zh: 这是我今天在政治博客上的所有内容，感谢您的关注。

paras.en: I’ll leave you with the magnetic Luca Ittimani (to borrow from Jason Clare) for the rest of the afternoon, and will see you back here bright and early tomorrow!
paras.zh: 在下午剩下的时间里，我将带着磁铁卢卡·伊蒂马尼（ Luca Ittimani ） （从杰森·克莱尔（ Jason Clare ）那里借用）留给你，明天明亮而清晨地在这里见到你！

paras.en: Anthony Albanese said he and Jim Chalmers were in complete lockstep on delaying the ATO credit card ban, trying hard to pour cold water over commentary that the prime minister had gone over his treasurer’s head. Angus Taylor said Chalmers’ had been “humiliated” and called for him to be sacked.
paras.zh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯（ Anthony Albanese ）表示，他和吉姆·查尔默斯（ Jim Chalmers ）完全同步推迟了ATO信用卡禁令，并试图对总理已经超越其财务主管的评论泼冷水。安格斯·泰勒（ Angus Taylor ）说，查尔默斯被“羞辱” ，并要求解雇他。

paras.en: Small business minister Anne Aly faced more questions from the opposition who accused her of “waging a war” on small business. She tried to counter saying small business numbers were going up.
paras.zh: 小企业部长安妮·阿利（ Anne Aly ）面临反对派的更多问题，反对派指责她对小企业“发动战争”。她试图反驳小企业数量正在上升的说法。

paras.en: Communications minister Anika Wells used a dixer to implore the Coalition to support the government’s digital duty of care bill.
paras.zh: 通讯部长阿妮卡·威尔斯（ Anika Wells ）使用Dixer恳求联盟支持政府的数字关怀义务法案。

paras.en: Josh Frydenberg’s name got more of a workout by Labor - it’s getting old so here’s to hoping that soon ends.
paras.zh: Josh Frydenberg的名字更像是工党的锻炼-它越来越老了，所以希望这很快就会结束。

paras.en: And despite an at times pretty rowdy question time, as well as a few behavioural warnings, there were no ejections today!
paras.zh: 尽管有时会出现相当吵闹的提问时间，以及一些行为警告，但今天没有弹出！

paras.en: NSW One Nation leader tours state parliament, says party is ‘living rent free’ in government’s head
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州One Nation领导人参观州议会，称该党在政府头脑中“免租金生活”

paras.en: The NSW One Nation leader, Mike Newman, has been a surprise presence in and around state parliament today, appearing in the upper and lower house and hosting an unannounced press conference outside.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州One Nation领导人迈克·纽曼（ Mike Newman ）今天在州议会及其周围出人意料地出现，出现在上议院和下议院，并在外面举行了一场未经宣布的新闻发布会。

paras.en: The NSW party does not have any MPs in either chamber, but is polling at 25%, in second place behind Labor, according to a September Sydney Morning Herald Resolve poll. During question time in the legislative assembly, Newman stood just inside the doorway by the opposition benches. He was asked to leave by the serjeant at arms before the premier, Chris Minns, used a question to criticise Newman for rejecting a legislative bid to compel One Nation to cost their election promises.
paras.zh: 根据9月份《悉尼先驱晨报》(Sydney Morning Herald Resolve)的一项民意调查，新南威尔士州两院都没有任何议员，但民调结果为25% ，仅次于工党。在立法议会接受质询期间，纽曼站在反对党议席的门口。在总理克里斯·明斯（ Chris Minns ）用一个问题批评纽曼拒绝立法要求迫使一个国家付出选举承诺的代价之前，他被要求离开。

paras.en: Newman, the candidate for the lower house seat of Cessnock at next year’s election, told reporters this afternoon that One Nation was “living rent free in their heads”. “No seats in upper or lower house, they still have to mention us,” he said.
paras.zh: 在明年大选中竞选塞斯诺克下议院席位的候选人纽曼今天下午告诉记者，一个国家“在他们的头脑中过着免费租金”。他说： “上议院或下议院都没有座位，他们仍然必须提到我们。”

paras.en: Newman was accompanied at a press conference by Libertarian upper house member, John Ruddick, who, like him, was also wearing a bright orange tie. Asked if Ruddick was joining One Nation, Newman, who later insisted he was not on a “recruitment drive”, said:
We haven’t had that discussion at all. John’s John, I’m me. Don’t let the orange tie fool you.

Newman, a former investment banker and trade bureaucrat, is not a Cessnock local and returned to Australia after spending 25 years working in Japan. He was quizzed on his knowledge of the electorate, fielding questions on his favourite Cessnock pub, restaurant, what he likes to order there and the name of the local footy team.

Nationals deputy leader Darren Chester asks the prime minister if he takes responsibility “for the average mortgage–holder now paying $30,000 more per year because of the 16 interest rate rises under his government.
Anthony Albanese says he does take responsibility for the two budget surpluses and budget improvements under the Labor government.
The fact that we’ve produced eight separate either budgets or budget updates – every one of which has had a savings measure in it. We take responsibility for the fact that over 260,000 Australians...
The opposition tries to interject – the PM hasn’t said he takes responsibility for the higher mortgage payments, and the Coalition are trying to back him into a corner.
It doesn’t work, Albanese opts to sit down, indicating he’s finished his answer.
Sharkie questions government over aged care funding

Independent Rebekha Sharkie is next and asks the aged care minister why the Australian National Aged Care Classification – the funding model for residential aged care – has only received a 2.55% funding increase, below inflation.

We need 10,000 new aged care beds annually, last year just 800 were added. Thousands of our elderly are stuck in hospitals waiting for an aged care bed around our nation. Minister, this is a disaster on your watch. Will you lift the ANACC funding to at least match inflation?
The aged care minister, Sam Rae, says the government increases funding to the ANACC based on independent advice.

The government sets aged care funding based on the independent advice from the independent funding authority. It provides expert [advice] to myself and Minister Butler … with a view to working out the efficient cost of delivering care.
‘Miscommunication’ over digital duty of care, Wells tells One Nation MP

Anika Wells gets another question on the DDOC, this time from One Nation’s David Farley, who asks about an issue which has strongly activated right-wing opponents of the bill – powers for regulators to establish “sockpuppet” accounts online.

Wells said such fake accounts had been used by “malevolent” actors online for nefarious purposes, but that regulators would use it for “mystery shopping” purposes, like doing research on how platforms serve up particular types of content to particular types of users.

They need to mystery shop what is happening on platforms in order to test whether the platforms are actually doing what they say that they are doing. So if they say they are asking a 14-year-old for their age, we need to test if they are actually doing that.
What the eSafety commission, or accredited researchers do, is create an account, as a 14-year-old girl, and test those hypotheses. They do it for good purposes.
We think that we should be able to mark tech platforms’ homework – they should not get to mark their own homework. So that is the purpose of sockpuppets.
Nationals MP Jamie Chaffey asks the prime minister about the federal court ruling that the government blocked a billion-dollar goldmine in central-west NSW without authority.
Anthony Albanese doesn’t want to bite – he says it’s a legal matter so won’t comment.

I understand the federal court found the declaration was not validly made. This was a complex legal case and as it’s a legal matter we will work through the judgment together with the attorney general and we’ll consider the findings very carefully indeed.
‘Magnificent, marvellous, magnetic’, the House plays a guessing game on Clare’s dixers
There’s a bit of a running joke on the education minister, Jason Clare’s, dixers.
Clare loves a bit of alliteration when thanking a backbencher for a pre-planned softball question.
Yesterday it was the “dazzling member for Deakin”.
Today the question comes from the member for Menzies, Gabriel Ng, and the opposition tries to guess the adjective as Clare steps up to the dispatch box.
They try, “magnificent”, and “marvellous”.
Clare laughs and thanks “the magnetic member for Menzies”.
‘Put your politics to the side’, Wells urges Coalition on online safety

The communications minister, Anika Wells, says Labor’s proposed digital duty of care “moves the safety net upstream” to require tech companies do better, taking a shot at the Coalition for refusing to discuss the legislation.

Wells will introduce the legislation tomorrow, then give a major speech at the National Press Club about it. She tells question time Australia already has “one of the most comprehensive online safety frameworks in the world”, but more work is needed.

“An independent statutory review has found that it is not able to cope with the growing scale of problems in the online world. Just last week, the AFP commissioner, Krissy Barrett, warned that the police cannot be the only safety net when it comes to the radicalisation of young people online. By the time the AFP is knocking on a door, the harm is already done.
She said the digital duty of care would “shift the burden from the shoulders of victims … to the companies that are creating the environments where harms occur.”
It moves the safety net upstream to the people who design the product before it ever reaches the child.
Wells said she was surprised at the Coalition’s reticence over the bill, after shadow spokesperson Sarah Henderson said the opposition wasn’t interested in negotiating.

Last week, they were criticising our online safety laws for not having enough parliamentary scrutiny. This week, they’re criticising our online safety lords for having too much parliamentary scrutiny.
Put your politics to the side, listen to the AFP commissioner, and help us pass these laws.

Independent Monique Ryan is next and asks the health minister if he can guarantee that Victorian children won’t slip through the gap under Thriving Kids – which will replace NDIS services for children under nine with low level needs.
Mark Butler says that the state delivery of the program basically mean that those jurisdictions provide some of the services they used to before the NDIS was implemented.
He concedes there will be a degree of variation between jurisdictions about the type of service and the location of that service.
But he says there will still be standards they will have to meet:

We have been very clear that there are outcomes that we expect to see, performance indicators that we expect to have met by all state and territory jurisdictions. They are incorporated into the Thriving Kids bilateral agreements that all state governments have signed.

articles.title: Lena Dunham's Girls to return for limited HBO run

paras.en: HBO's award-winning show Girls will return to screens for a limited run ten years after the series finale aired.
paras.zh: HBO屡获殊荣的节目《Girls》将在系列结局播出十年后重返银幕。

paras.en: Lena Dunham â the show's creator, writer, and one of its stars â shared the announcement in a mock zoom call with members of the original cast Allison Williams, Jemima Kirke, Zosia Mamet and Andrew Rannells.
paras.zh: 该节目的创作者、作家和明星之一莉娜·邓纳姆（ Lena Dunham ）在与原始演员艾莉森·威廉姆斯（ Allison Williams ）、杰米玛·柯克（ Jemima Kirke ）、佐西亚·马梅特（ Zosia Mamet ）和安德鲁·兰内尔斯（ Andrew Rannells ）的模拟缩放电话中

paras.en: All five actors, whose careers launched off the back of Girls, will be part of the five-episode revival with production set to begin in 2027. Judd Apatow, who helped get the show green lit with HBO, will also return as executive producer.
paras.zh: 所有五名演员的职业生涯都是在《女孩》的背后发起的，他们将成为五集复兴的一部分，将于2027年开始制作。贾德·阿帕托（ Judd Apatow ）也将以执行制片人的身份回归，他曾帮助HBO让节目变绿。

paras.en: "We always said we would only return to 'Girls' if there was a specific story we were burning to tell," Dunham said in a statement.
paras.zh: “我们总是说，只有当我们渴望讲述一个特定的故事时，我们才会回到'女孩' ，”邓纳姆在一份声明中说。

paras.en: "I've missed these characters, but for a long time I couldn't quite picture them in the present day," she said.
paras.zh: 她说： “我错过了这些角色，但很长一段时间我都无法想象他们现在的样子。”

paras.en: "Then, right around my 40th birthday, they started talking to me in the shower. And, as you may remember, once this fivesome starts talking it's pretty hard to get them to stop," she said.
paras.zh: “然后，在我40岁生日的时候，他们开始在洗澡时和我说话。而且，你可能还记得，一旦这五个人开始说话，就很难让他们停下来，”她说。

paras.en: Girls, which ran for six seasons from 2012 to 2017, was nominated for 19 Emmys and won two, including best casting.
paras.zh: 从2012年到2017年， Girls连续六个赛季获得了19项艾美奖提名，并获得了两项奖项，其中包括最佳选角。

paras.en: It follows the lives of four friends â Hannah, played by Dunham, Marnie, played by Williams, Jessa, played by Kirke and Shoshanna, played by Mamet â living in New York City during their 20s.
paras.zh: 它讲述了四个朋友的生活--由Dunham扮演的Hannah ，由Williams扮演的Marnie ，由Jessa扮演的Kirke和Shoshanna ，由Mamet扮演的Mamet ，他们20多岁时住在纽约市。

paras.en: The show, created by Dunham when she was 23-years-old, attracted both praise and controversy during its airing. The BBC ranked it as number 30 on its 100 Greatest TV Shows of the 21st Century.
paras.zh: 该节目由Dunham在23岁时创作，在播出期间引起了赞誉和争议。英国广播公司将其列为21世纪100大电视节目的第30名。

paras.en: "We're thrilled to have Lena turn her gaze from the tumult of one's twenties to the milestone of turning forty," Amy Gravitt, executive vice-president of HBO programming, said.
paras.zh: HBO节目执行副总裁艾米·格拉维特（ Amy Gravitt ）说： “我们很高兴让莉娜把目光从20多岁的动荡转向40岁的里程碑。”

paras.en: "To say the world has changed since we last saw Hannah, Marnie, Shoshanna, Jessa, and Elijah is a massive understatement, but we know fans - old and new - will be happy to see how they've grown and relieved to see that they're still the 'Girls' we knew way back when."
paras.zh: “说自从我们上次见到Hannah ， Marnie ， Shoshanna ， Jessa和Elijah以来，世界已经发生了变化，这是一个非常轻描淡写的说法，但我们知道，无论新老粉丝，都会很高兴看到他们是如何成长和松了一口气的，因为他们仍然是我们以前认识的'女孩'。”

paras.en: The title of the limited run has yet to be announced, but Dunham did ask her fellow cast on the mock zoom call, "can we still call it Girls?", before joking "because we're old as".
paras.zh: 限量放映的标题尚未公布，但邓纳姆在模拟缩放电话中问她的同伴， “我们还能称之为女孩吗？” ，然后开玩笑说“因为我们已经老了”。

paras.en: Other cast and production members, most notably actor Adam Driver, were absent from HBO's official statement. Driver, in his breakout role, played Dunham's on-and-off again love interest in the show.
paras.zh: 其他演员和制作成员，最着名的是演员Adam Driver ，没有出现在HBO的官方声明中。在他的突破性角色中，司机再次扮演了Dunham对节目的热爱。

paras.en: In her 2026 bestselling memoir Famesick, Dunham alleged Driver's on-set behaviour at times turned verbally aggressive and physically imposing. Driver has not publicly commented on the allegations.
paras.zh: 在她2026年的畅销回忆录《Famesick》中， Dunham指责Driver的现场行为有时会变得言语攻击性和身体强势。合作车主尚未公开评论这些指控。

paras.en: In Famesick, Dunham also wrote about the breakdown of her working relationship and friendship with co-showrunner and executive producer Jenni Konner. Konner is not included in HBO's statement about the show's revival.
paras.zh: 在Famesick中， Dunham还写下了她与联合节目主持人兼执行制片人Jenni Konner的工作关系和友谊的破裂。康纳不包括在HBO关于该节目复兴的声明中。

paras.en: Dunham wrote on her Substack that "it's rare in life that you get the chance to return to something you love with new knowledge and a ... ton of gratitude.
paras.zh: 邓纳姆在她的Substack上写道： “在生活中，你很少有机会用新知识和...大量的感激之情回到你喜欢的东西。

paras.en: "I love these girls (and boy) and I love all the people who have reminded us afresh why we do this, which is the joy of being together and the chance to wear yellow meshâ¦" she wrote.
paras.zh: 她写道： “我爱这些女孩（和男孩） ，我爱所有重新提醒我们为什么这样做的人，这是在一起的快乐，也是穿黄色网布的机会。”

paras.en: Since Girls ended, Dunham has gone on to create the Netflix series Too Much in 2025 and indie film Sharp Stick.
paras.zh: 自《Girls》结束以来， Dunham继续在2025年创作Netflix系列《Too Much》和独立电影《Sharp Stick》。

articles.title: Russia arrests Japanese journalist on alleged espionage

paras.en: Russian authorities have charged a Japanese journalist for espionage, accusing him of gathering information related to Moscow's defence capabilities for Tokyo.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯当局指控一名日本记者从事间谍活动，指控他收集有关莫斯科在东京防御能力的信息。

paras.en: The journalist, identified as Yuki Imai from the Hokkaido Shimbun, was detained in Russia's far eastern region of Sakhalin, a day before he was due to leave the country.
paras.zh: 这名记者名叫今井由纪（ Yuki Imai ） ，来自北海道新闻（ Hokkaido Shimbun ） ，在俄罗斯远东地区的萨哈林（ Sakhalin ）被拘留，就在他即将离开该国的前一天。

paras.en: The arrest comes as tensions worsen between the two nations after Russian leader Vladimir Putin visited the disputed Kuril Islands, claimed by both countries, in August.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯领导人弗拉基米尔·普京（ Vladimir Putin ）于8月访问了有争议的千岛群岛（ Kuril Islands ）后，两国之间的紧张局势恶化。

paras.en: Japan has not commented at length on the arrest. On Tuesday, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said authorities are "verifying the facts" and will "respond appropriately" thereafter.
paras.zh: 日本尚未就逮捕事件发表详细评论。周二，总理高市早苗（ Sanae Takaichi ）表示，当局正在“核实事实” ，此后将“适当回应”。

paras.en: Russian authorities allege that Imai had "acted on the instructions of [Japan's] national intelligence service" to gather information about people involved in a special military operation on the Kuril Islands, state news agency TASS reported.
paras.zh: 据国家通讯社塔斯社报道，俄罗斯当局声称今井“按照[日本]国家情报局的指示行事” ，收集有关参与千岛群岛特别军事行动人员的信息。

paras.en: The Kuril islands sit between Hokkaido in northern Japan and Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula. The archipelago is administered by Russia, but four of the southernmost islands are claimed by Japan, which calls them the Northern Territories.
paras.zh: 千岛群岛位于日本北部的北海道和俄罗斯的堪察加半岛之间。该群岛由俄罗斯管理，但最南端的四个岛屿被日本声称拥有主权，日本称之为北方领土。

paras.en: Imai has been taken to Moscow and will be remanded until 12 December, before the trial begins, according to Interfax, another Russian news agency.
paras.zh: 据另一家俄罗斯通讯社国际文传电讯社报道， Imai已被带到莫斯科，并将在审判开始前被还押至12月12日。

paras.en: Those convicted of espionage in Russia can be jailed up to 20 years in prison.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯被判犯有间谍罪的人可能被判处长达20年的监禁。

paras.en: "Tokyo's attempts to use its correspondents in Russia, who hold foreign journalist status, to gather information aimed at undermining our country's security are regrettable," Russian foreign ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said in a statement on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯外交部发言人玛丽亚·扎哈罗娃（ Maria Zakharova ）周二在一份声明中表示： “东京试图利用其拥有外国记者身份的俄罗斯记者收集旨在破坏我国安全的信息，这是令人遗憾的。”

paras.en: "We cannot help but point out that today's incident is not an isolated one," she noted, but did not name other journalists or media outlets that are allegedly involved in similar activity.
paras.zh: “我们不得不指出，今天的事件并非孤立事件，”她指出，但没有提及涉嫌参与类似活动的其他记者或媒体机构。

paras.en: Imai's published work has covered Russia's relations with North Korea and life in Sakhalin.
paras.zh: 今井出版的作品涵盖了俄罗斯与朝鲜的关系以及在萨哈林的生活。

paras.en: Hokkaido Shimbun ran a report on the arrest without naming the reporter, but did not comment further on the incident.
paras.zh: 北海道新闻报道了这起逮捕事件，但没有透露记者的姓名，也没有对此事件发表进一步评论。

paras.en: Russia and Japan have been locked in a dispute over the Kurils for decades, and it is the main reason Moscow and Tokyo did not sign a peace treaty after World War Two.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和日本几十年来一直陷入千岛群岛争端，这是莫斯科和东京在第二次世界大战后没有签署和平条约的主要原因。

paras.en: Takaichi slammed Putin's visit in August â his first-ever to the islands â saying it "wounded the feelings of the Japanese people" and is "incompatible with Japan's consistent position on the Northern Territories".
paras.zh: Takaichi猛烈抨击普京8月份的访问-他有史以来第一次访问这些岛屿-称其“伤害了日本人民的感情” ，并且“与日本在北方领土上的一贯立场不相容”。

paras.en: Moscow dismissed her criticism as "politically inappropriate" and "legally unfounded".
paras.zh: 莫斯科驳斥她的批评是“政治上不恰当”和“没有法律依据”。

paras.en: Over the years, attempts to resolve the territorial dispute have made little progress. Bilateral ties have also remained frosty, with Japan imposing sanctions against Russia for its invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
paras.zh: 多年来，解决领土争端的尝试进展甚微。双边关系也仍然严峻，日本因2022年入侵乌克兰而对俄罗斯实施制裁。

paras.en: Last week, Moscow again angered Tokyo for requesting the extradition of the president of the International Criminal Court (ICC), who is Japanese.
paras.zh: 上周，莫斯科再次激怒了东京，要求引渡国际刑事法院院长，他是日本人。

paras.en: The president Tomoko Akane, along with other ICC officials, has been placed on Russia's wanted list since 2023 after the court issued an arrest warrant for Putin over war crimes in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 自2023年以来，总统Tomoko Akane和其他国际刑事法院官员一直被列入俄罗斯通缉名单，此前法院就乌克兰战争罪向普京发出逮捕令。

paras.en: In 2023, Russia detained The Wall Street Journal's Evan Gershkovich on espionage charges and later sentenced him to 16 years in prison.
paras.zh: 2023年，俄罗斯以间谍罪名拘留了《华尔街日报》的埃文·格什科维奇（ Evan Gershkovich ） ，后来判处他16年监禁。

paras.en: Gershkovich, a US citizen, was in 2024 released in a prisoner swap, the largest exchange since the Cold War took place.
paras.zh: 美国公民格什科维奇于2024年在一次囚犯交换中获释，这是自冷战以来最大的交换。

paras.en: In 2019, Moscow detained an unnamed Japanese journalist from Kyodo News on suspicion of attempting to obtain military secrets. The journalist, who was picked up in Vladivostok, was ordered to leave the country within 72 hours.
paras.zh: 2019年，莫斯科拘留了一名来自共同社的日本记者，涉嫌企图获取军事机密。这名记者在符拉迪沃斯托克被捕，被命令在72小时内离开该国。

articles.title: Russian strikes hit key power plant in Kyiv, Zelensky says

paras.en: A key energy facility supplying Kyiv with heating and electricity has been hit in a Russian ballistic missile attack, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）表示，一个为基辅供暖和供电的关键能源设施在俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击中遭到袭击。

paras.en: Darnytska CHP-4, or CHPP-4, and a residential building were hit in a strike the president said came with "no early warning from our partners".
paras.zh: 总统说， Darnytska CHP-4或CHPP-4和一栋住宅楼在罢工中遭到袭击， “我们的合作伙伴没有发出早期警告”。

paras.en: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said two people had been killed and 21 injured in the missile strike on the apartment block late on Tuesday. He said "several energy facilities" in Kyiv had been hit in what he, without giving more detail.
paras.zh: 基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科（ Vitali Klitschko ）表示，在周二晚些时候对公寓楼的导弹袭击中，有两人死亡， 21人受伤。他说，基辅的“几个能源设施”遭到袭击，但没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: Kyiv has reported multiple Russian strikes since US President Donald Trump said an energy ceasefire had been agreed by Russia and Ukraine two days ago.
paras.zh: 自美国总统唐纳德特朗普两天前表示俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意能源停火以来，基辅报告了多次俄罗斯罢工。

paras.en: In the early hours of Wednesday, Klitschko said the "massive missile attacks" had knocked out power to parts of Kyiv.
paras.zh: 周三凌晨，克里琴科表示， “大规模导弹袭击”已经破坏了基辅部分地区的电力供应。

paras.en: Kyiv officials have urged residents to stay in shelters after declaring a red alert due to a "missile threat".
paras.zh: 由于“导弹威胁” ，基辅官员在宣布红色警报后敦促居民留在避难所。

paras.en: Following the strikes on Tuesday, Zelensky said: "Ukraine supported an energy ceasefire. Russia is targeting yet another power plant and the lives of our people.
paras.zh: 在周二的罢工之后，泽伦斯基说： “乌克兰支持能源停火。俄罗斯的目标是另一座发电厂和我们人民的生命。

paras.en: "This is absolutely unjust: when they are destroying our energy infrastructure, and Ukraine is not even receiving early warnings about ballistic missile launches," he added.
paras.zh: “这绝对是不公正的：当他们摧毁我们的能源基础设施时，乌克兰甚至没有收到有关弹道导弹发射的早期警告，”他补充说。

paras.en: "It is important that the world does not stay silent about this. And it is important that the United States really see what is happening and who is responsible for this war continuing."
paras.zh: “重要的是，世界不要对此保持沉默。重要的是，美国要真正看到正在发生的事情，以及谁应对这场持续不断的战争负责。”

paras.en: It is the second night in a row Kyiv has been hit by Russian missiles.
paras.zh: 这是基辅连续第二晚遭到俄罗斯导弹袭击。

paras.en: Following strikes on Monday night, there was speculation America had cut off access to key intelligence enabling Ukraine to track incoming threats.
paras.zh: 在周一晚上的罢工之后，有人猜测美国已经切断了对关键情报的访问，使乌克兰能够跟踪传入的威胁。

paras.en: Earlier on Tuesday, Trump denied that was the case.
paras.zh: 周二早些时候，特朗普否认了这种情况。

paras.en: "We are helping them and we are sharing intel," he said.
paras.zh: “我们正在帮助他们，我们正在分享情报，”他说。

paras.en: "We want the war to end. So we're working with them and with Russia on getting the war to end."
paras.zh: “我们希望战争结束。因此，我们正在与他们和俄罗斯合作，以结束战争。”

paras.en: Asked about Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy sites, Trump said: "Ukraine hit many sites the day before."
paras.zh: 当被问及俄罗斯对乌克兰能源基地的袭击时，特朗普说： “乌克兰前一天袭击了许多地点。”

paras.en: But he demurred when asked if Russia had broken a ceasefire. He said both countries want the war to "come to an end" but "just don't know how to get there".
paras.zh: 但当被问及俄罗斯是否违反了停火协议时，他表示反对。他说，两国都希望战争“结束” ，但“只是不知道如何到达那里”。

paras.en: It comes after Zelensky said on Sunday that a 60-day ceasefire would allow â his country to hold presidential elections, following comments from Trump that "it's time for Ukraine to get a new president".
paras.zh: 此前，泽伦斯基周日表示，为期60天的停火将允许他的国家举行总统选举，此前特朗普发表评论称， “现在是乌克兰选出新总统的时候了”。

paras.en: Following Trump's announcement on Sunday, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said Ukraine doesn't deserve the "respite" a ceasefire would bring.
paras.zh: 在特朗普周日宣布后，俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫（ Sergey Lavrov ）表示，乌克兰不应该得到停火带来的“喘息机会”。

paras.en: Lavrov added that under any ceasefire, Europe would be able to "pump [Ukraine] with new weapons" for it to continue the war.
paras.zh: 拉夫罗夫补充说，根据任何停火协议，欧洲将能够“向[乌克兰]输送新武器” ，以使其继续战争。

paras.en: CHPP-4, which provides heating and electricity to the Dniprovskyi district and parts of the Darnytskyi district, has been hit multiple times during the war.
paras.zh: 为第聂伯罗夫斯基区和达尔尼茨基区部分地区供暖和供电的CHPP-4在战争期间多次受到打击。

paras.en: It was severely damaged in a separate Russian missile attack in February this year, which forced it to shut down.
paras.zh: 它在今年2月的另一次俄罗斯导弹袭击中受到严重破坏，迫使它关闭。

paras.en: That strike left more than 1,000 residential buildings without heating and hot water, along with 47 schools, 72 kindergartens and 18 medical institutions, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，这次罢工导致1000多座住宅楼没有供暖和热水，还有47所学校、72所幼儿园和18家医疗机构。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.

articles.title: BendPak Launches Ranger DST30PX Balancer
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Ranger Division of BendPak has introduced the next-generation DST Series wheel balancer, the DST30PX. As shops face larger OEM wheel assemblies and heavy aftermarket truck tires, older balancing platforms can slow production. The DST30PX is built to handle oversized wheels and prevent bottlenecks with a new hood design, larger shaft and overhauled structural chassis.

The hood accommodates a wider range of tire shapes and sizes, including oversized off-road and fleet tires, without repositioning. An open-side design allows wider tires, aggressive offsets and bulky sidewalls to slide in more easily, reducing setup time and enabling operators to position wheel assemblies up to 43 inches in diameter.

Ranger reinforced the chassis and hood assembly to handle the added mass of larger assemblies without flexing, compromising alignment or generating excess vibration. The added rigidity helps maintain consistent measurements for accuracy. A 40 mm shaft increases stiffness and accuracy for heavier wheels while supporting standard cones and accessories.

“The Ranger DST30PX represents a fundamental shift in how modern shops handle today’s radically heavier, oversized wheel configurations,” said Sean Price, director of product development for BendPak Inc. “By optimizing the physical layout and integrating a high-precision sensor array, we ensure technicians can mount, spin and perfectly balance oversized assemblies without a single second of wasted motion — turning massive wheel packages into a rapid, routine six-second floor-to-floor operation.”

The DST30PX features a 64-tooth magnetic transducer encoder with precision-cut square teeth to convert rotary position into a digital electronic signal, helping achieve accurate profile readings and top-dead-center positioning for precise weight placement. The extra encoder resolution supports cleaner correction, smaller weight changes and better placement accuracy for performance wheels, larger tiresand customers sensitive to vibration.
User-friendly Design for Fast Turnarounds

The DST30PX streamlines repetitive wheel service by reducing unnecessary motion. Simple wheel data entry, precise rolling weight readings, automatic braking, manual or automatic hood-start operation, and a rapid cycle time help technicians balance more wheels with fewer errors.

A quick-release hub nut, side-position brake, top-dead-center weight indicator, and tiered placement indicators accelerate setup and correction. Onboard storage includes a high-volume top tray, side cone pegs, and a side shelf designed to accommodate Ranger Quick-Peel adhesive tape weight rolls.
- 145-lb. capacity, 30-in. wheel diameter range, and 43-in. max tire diameter
- Low-RPM balancing operation and six-second cycle time
- Dynamic, Static and Performance Alloy settings
- 16-bit processor and multi-directional quartz piezoelectric sensors
- Ergonomic controls and full-tilt LED display control panel
- Automatic braking and self-calibration

The DST30PX is positioned as an upgrade for shops seeking higher precision, faster workflow and an advanced measuring system for modern wheels without moving to a larger machine. It is ETL-certified to meet applicable UL and CSA safety standards in the U.S. and Canada. It comes with a starter kit of adhesive and clip-on steel wheel weights. Ranger Select setup and training is available.
For more information, click here or call (800) 253-2363.

articles.title: ADAS Assist Launches Calibration Verification Platform
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: ADAS Assist has announced the launch of its calibration verification and business management platform for collision repair shops and ADAS calibration providers.
Built by collision and calibration professionals, ADAS Assist is designed to close the accuracy gap when required calibrations are missed after a repair.

Modern vehicles rely on cameras, radars and sensors often located where collisions occur. Determining which calibrations a repair requires means matching each line of a collision estimate to the correct OEM procedure. A single miss can lead to a safety failure, liability claim or comeback. The ADAS Assist team said they experienced that risk firsthand and relied on a third-party scrubbing tool with real-world accuracy around 70%. After finding similar shortcomings in other tools, they decided to build their own.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “In ADAS calibration, accuracy is not a ‘nice to have’, it’s a ‘got to have,’” said James Rodis of ADAS Assist. “A 30% margin for error was not something we could keep living with. We are not programmers. We are collision professionals who have run shops, managed technicians and answered for a missed calibration. We built ADAS Assist because we needed it ourselves first.”

- ADAS Verification System (AVS): A quoting and scrubbing engine that reads a body shop estimate and identifies the required calibrations and related operations. AVS releases nothing until it clears well over 90% confidence, ties each operation to the estimate line that triggered it, and links directly to the governing OEM procedure so technicians and estimators can see exactly what is required and why.

- Customer Management System (CMS): Built to run the calibration operation for body shops and calibration centers from one place, including custom pricing, technician management, a daily technician calendar, job scheduling and invoicing.

Shops submit requests by uploading an estimate and answering questions about the vehicle’s damage. They receive a documented quote for the vehicle’s VIN, along with direct access to the supporting OEM documentation.

“AVS and CMS were built to work together, not as two separate tools stapled to one login,” Rodis said. “That is how the work actually flows in a real shop, and it is what sets ADAS Assist apart from tools designed by people who have never stood in a bay.
“Today, this AVS and CMS system is functioning in a real-world environment handling the calibration quoting needs and workflows for hundreds of body shops across the country.”
ADAS Assist is available now to collision repair shops and calibration. For more information or to request an account, call (402) 315-5800 or visit ADASAssist.net.

articles.title: Fix Auto USA Announces Opening of Fix Auto South Salt Lake
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Fix Auto USA has announced the opening of Fix Auto South Salt Lake, located at 3218 S W Temple Street in South Salt Lake, Utah.

Owned and operated by Efrain Perez, Fix Auto South Salt Lake is Perez’s third Fix Auto USA location and further expands his commitment to delivering high-quality collision repair services while maintaining a strong focus on family values, customer care and community involvement.

The approximately 14,000-square-foot facility is staffed by a team of five professionals and is equipped to provide full-service collision repair with room to support future growth. Services include body and structural repairs, estimating, refinishing and paint matching, parts replacement, vehicle diagnostics, glass replacement and post-repair calibrations. The shop works with all insurance carriers and assists customers throughout the claims and repair process to ensure a seamless repair experience.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: For Perez, the collision repair industry is more than a profession. It’s a lifelong passion rooted in family and tradition.

“I grew up in my father’s body shop in Colombia, surrounded by the sounds of tools, welding sparks, bodywork and fresh paint,” said Perez. “Although my father hoped I would choose an easier career, I was drawn to the industry and learned by watching him and helping wherever I could. He taught me honesty, responsibility, hard work and the importance of being proud of anything that carries your name. Today, owning three body shops is something I am incredibly grateful for, and the values my father instilled in me continue to guide how we serve our customers and community every day.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Perez added that the business has become a true family endeavor.

“What makes this journey especially meaningful is that Fix Auto USA has become a family business in every sense. My wife, Rebeca, serves as co-owner and general manager, and my brother, my son, several close friends and even my father are actively involved in the business. Seeing everything come full circle, from growing up in my father’s shop in Colombia to building this business together as a family, is incredibly special.”
As the South Salt Lake location grows, the team looks forward to supporting local families, schools, youth programs and community events while building lasting relationships throughout the region.

“We joined Fix Auto because its values align with our commitment to quality, integrity and customer service,” said Perez. “The franchise provides strong operational support, industry resources, national brand recognition and access to a trusted network, while still allowing us to remain locally owned and actively involved in our community.”

“Efrain’s story is a powerful example of entrepreneurship, perseverance and dedication to the collision repair industry,” said Damien Reyna, COO, Driven Brand Collision Group. “From learning the trade in his father’s shop in Colombia to building a successful multi-location business in the U.S., Efrain has remained committed to quality repairs, exceptional customer service and investing in the communities he serves. We are proud to celebrate the opening of Fix Auto South Salt Lake and welcome this location to the growing Fix Auto USA network.”
