articles.title: James Webb reveals a massive cosmic structure that challenges our understanding of the Universe

paras.en: James Webb reveals a massive cosmic structure that challenges our understanding of the Universe
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯揭示了一个巨大的宇宙结构，挑战了我们对宇宙的理解

paras.en: Webb has revealed a massive, dark matter-packed galaxy cluster that formed surprisingly early, challenging scientistsâ understanding of how the universe evolved.
paras.zh: 韦伯揭示了一个巨大的、充满暗物质的星系团，它形成的时间出人意料地早，挑战了科学家对宇宙如何演化的理解。

paras.en: - NASAâs James Webb Space Telescope has revealed an ancient galaxy cluster with an unexpectedly dense concentration of dark matter, challenging theories about how the universe developed. The discovery also uncovered a surprising connection between scattered starlight and invisible dark matter that could transform how astronomers study the early cosmos.
paras.zh: - 美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜揭示了一个古老的星系团，其中暗物质的浓度出乎意料地密集，对宇宙如何发展的理论提出了挑战。这一发现还揭示了散射星光和不可见暗物质之间的惊人联系，这可能会改变天文学家研究早期宇宙的方式。

paras.en: A massive galaxy cluster dating back to an era when such enormous structures were only beginning to take shape is challenging scientists' understanding of how the universe evolved. New observations from NASA's James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) reveal that the cluster contains an unusually dense concentration of matter, suggesting that some cosmic structures may have developed much faster than current models predict.
paras.zh: 一个巨大的星系团可以追溯到如此巨大的结构刚刚开始形成的时代，它正在挑战科学家对宇宙如何演化的理解。美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）的新观测结果表明，该星团含有异常密集的物质，这表明某些宇宙结构的发展速度可能比当前模型预测的要快得多。

paras.en: The galaxy cluster, known as XLSSC 122, has become the focus of three recent studies led by researchers at IPAC, Caltech's science and data center for astrophysics and planetary science. Their findings establish XLSSC 122 as the most distant galaxy cluster known to exhibit strong gravitational lensing, a phenomenon that allows astronomers to measure the mass of otherwise invisible matter. The research was presented at a press conference on June 17, 2026, during the 248th meeting of the American Astronomical Society.
paras.zh: 这个被称为 XLSSC 122 的星系团已成为加州理工学院天体物理学和行星科学科学与数据中心 IPAC 的研究人员最近领导的三项研究的焦点。他们的发现将 XLSSC 122 确定为已知表现出强引力透镜效应的最遥远星系团，这种现象使天文学家能够测量其他不可见物质的质量。该研究于 2026 年 6 月 17 日在美国天文学会第 248 届会议期间的新闻发布会上公布。

paras.en: Located approximately 10.4 billion light-years from Earth, XLSSC 122 stood out to astronomers because of its surprising maturity. Although it existed during a period when galaxy clusters were still assembling, it already displayed the size and organized structure typically associated with clusters in the modern universe.
paras.zh: XLSSC 122 距离地球约 104 亿光年，因其令人惊讶的成熟度而引起天文学家的关注。尽管它存在于星系团仍在聚集的时期，但它已经显示出通常与现代宇宙中的星系团相关的大小和组织结构。

paras.en: Webb has now uncovered another remarkable feature. XLSSC 122 happens to lie directly in front of one or more galaxies that are even farther away. The cluster's powerful gravity bends and distorts the light traveling from those background galaxies, creating a rare effect called strong gravitational lensing. This fortunate alignment has given scientists an exceptionally precise way to measure how mass is distributed throughout the cluster.
paras.zh: 韦伯现在发现了另一个显着的特征。 XLSSC 122 恰好位于一个或多个距离更远的星系的正前方。该星团强大的引力使从背景星系发出的光线发生弯曲和扭曲，从而产生一种罕见的效应，称为强引力透镜效应。这种幸运的排列为科学家提供了一种异常精确的方法来测量质量在整个星团中的分布情况。

paras.en: "When we got those first images back from JWST, we said, 'wow, look at this, there's strong lensing coming from this cluster!'" said Kyle Finner, a staff scientist at IPAC and lead author of the first paper examining the cluster. "XLSSC 122 has now set the record for the most distant galaxy cluster displaying strong lensing, which is a valuable tool for astronomers."
paras.zh: “当我们从 JWST 收到第一批图像时，我们说，‘哇，看看这个，这个星团发出了强烈的透镜效应！’”IPAC 的科学家、第一篇研究该星团的论文的主要作者凯尔·芬纳 (Kyle Finner) 说道。 “XLSSC 122 现在已经创下了显示强透镜效应的最遥远星系团的记录，这对天文学家来说是一个有价值的工具。”

paras.en: An Ancient Galaxy Cluster Challenges Cosmic Predictions
paras.zh: 古老星系团挑战宇宙预测

paras.en: The newly detected gravitational lensing has allowed researchers to examine the distribution of mass in an ancient galaxy cluster in greater detail than ever before. XLSSC 122 dates to a period known as "cosmic noon," roughly 10 billion years ago, when the universe was experiencing its most intense era of star formation.
paras.zh: 新检测到的引力透镜使研究人员能够比以往更详细地检查古代星系团中的质量分布。 XLSSC 122 可以追溯到大约 100 亿年前的一个被称为“宇宙正午”的时期，当时宇宙正在经历恒星形成最激烈的时期。

paras.en: During this time, galaxies were producing stars at rates up to 100 times higher than those observed in the present-day universe. Galaxy clusters were also becoming increasingly common as smaller systems gradually combined into larger structures.
paras.zh: 在此期间，星系产生恒星的速度比当今宇宙中观测到的速度高出 100 倍。随着较小的系统逐渐组合成较大的结构，星系团也变得越来越普遍。

paras.en: Yet XLSSC 122 appears to have developed in an unexpected way. The new measurements show that a remarkably large amount of its mass is packed into its central region. According to standard cosmological models, the growth of massive structures should have been more gradual, making such a concentrated cluster particularly surprising at this early stage of cosmic history.
paras.zh: 然而 XLSSC 122 的发展似乎出乎意料。新的测量结果表明，其质量的很大一部分集中在其中心区域。根据标准宇宙学模型，大质量结构的增长应该更加渐进，使得如此集中的星团在宇宙历史的早期阶段尤其令人惊讶。

paras.en: "XLSSC 122 is one of the first clusters we know of that formed in the universe, and it has a mass concentration that doesn't agree with our cosmological model predictions," said Finner.
paras.zh: 芬纳说：“XLSSC 122 是我们所知的最早在宇宙中形成的星团之一，它的质量浓度与我们的宇宙学模型预测不符。”

paras.en: To investigate the mystery further, Finner and his collaborators conducted two additional JWST studies, first authored by Zachary Scofield and Hyungjin Joo at Yonsei University. Together, the three papers provide a much more complete picture of this unusual cluster and offer new insights into galaxy cluster formation during cosmic noon.
paras.zh: 为了进一步探究这个谜团，芬纳和他的合作者进行了另外两项 JWST 研究，该研究的第一作者是延世大学的 Zachary Scofield 和 Hyungjin Joo。这三篇论文共同提供了这个不寻常星团的更完整的图像，并为宇宙正午期间星系团的形成提供了新的见解。

paras.en: Astronomers originally identified XLSSC 122 in 2014 through an X-ray survey carried out by the European Space Agency's XMM-Newton spacecraft. Later observations with the Hubble Space Telescope helped establish its distance of approximately 10.4 billion light-years and confirmed that the cluster appeared unusually developed for its age.
paras.zh: 天文学家最初于 2014 年通过欧洲航天局 XMM-牛顿航天器进行的 X 射线勘测发现了 XLSSC 122。后来哈勃太空望远镜的观测帮助确定了它的距离约为 104 亿光年，并证实该星团在其年龄看来异常发达。

paras.en: However, Hubble did not reveal clear evidence of strong gravitational lensing. That changed when JWST captured distinctive curved arcs of light surrounding the cluster's center, providing the first definitive signs of this phenomenon in XLSSC 122.
paras.zh: 然而，哈勃没有揭示强引力透镜的明确证据。当 JWST 捕捉到星团中心周围独特的弯曲光弧时，情况发生了变化，在 XLSSC 122 中提供了这种现象的第一个明确迹象。

paras.en: "Before JWST, we couldn't do this level of science in the early, distant universe," said Finner.
paras.zh: “在 JWST 之前，我们无法在早期遥远的宇宙中进行这种水平的科学，”芬纳说。

paras.en: The gravitational distortions are caused primarily by something astronomers cannot directly observe: dark matter.
paras.zh: 引力扭曲主要是由天文学家无法直接观察的东西引起的：暗物质。

paras.en: Although XLSSC 122 contains visible stars and glowing gas, these familiar forms of matter account for only a small fraction of the gravitational lensing effect. Most of the distortion comes from dark matter, an invisible substance that has not been directly detected through light but whose gravitational influence is supported by extensive astronomical evidence.
paras.zh: 尽管 XLSSC 122 包含可见恒星和发光气体，但这些熟悉的物质形式仅占引力透镜效应的一小部分。大部分扭曲来自暗物质，这是一种看不见的物质，尚未通过光直接检测到，但其引力影响得到了广泛的天文学证据的支持。

paras.en: Scientists estimate that dark matter is approximately five times more abundant than ordinary matter, which makes up stars, planets, and everything around us. Its gravity helps hold galaxies together and shapes the universe's enormous network of galaxy groups, clusters, and filaments.
paras.zh: 科学家估计，暗物质的数量大约是普通物质的五倍，普通物质构成了恒星、行星和我们周围的一切。它的引力有助于将星系聚集在一起，并塑造宇宙中由星系群、星系团和细丝组成的巨大网络。

paras.en: Because dark matter plays such an important role in cosmic structure, determining how it was distributed billions of years ago offers a powerful way to test theories describing the universe's development since the Big Bang approximately 13.8 billion years ago.
paras.zh: 由于暗物质在宇宙结构中扮演着如此重要的角色，确定它在数十亿年前的分布方式为测试描述自大约 138 亿年前大爆炸以来宇宙发展的理论提供了一种强有力的方法。

paras.en: "Strong lensing is a way to measure the dark matter without actually seeing the dark matter," said Finner. "It gives us a sensitive probe of our cosmological models."
paras.zh: 芬纳说：“强透镜效应是一种在不实际看到暗物质的情况下测量暗物质的方法。” “它让我们对宇宙学模型有了敏感的探索。”

paras.en: A Wider View Reveals a Galaxy Cluster Merger
paras.zh: 更广阔的视野揭示了星系团的合并

paras.en: In their second paper, the researchers investigated XLSSC 122 using another form of gravitational lensing known as weak lensing.
paras.zh: 在他们的第二篇论文中，研究人员使用另一种形式的引力透镜（称为弱透镜）研究了 XLSSC 122。

paras.en: Strong gravitational lensing produces obvious distortions, including the striking arcs captured by JWST. Weak lensing, by comparison, causes much smaller changes in the apparent shapes of distant galaxies. These subtle effects are difficult to identify individually, so astronomers rely on statistical methods to detect them.
paras.zh: 强引力透镜效应会产生明显的扭曲，包括 JWST 捕捉到的引人注目的弧线。相比之下，弱透镜效应对遥远星系的外观形状造成的变化要小得多。这些微妙的影响很难单独识别，因此天文学家依靠统计方法来检测它们。

paras.en: The two techniques provide complementary information. Strong lensing is especially useful for measuring the mass concentrated near a cluster's center, while weak lensing can reveal how matter is distributed across its outer regions.
paras.zh: 这两种技术提供了互补的信息。强透镜效应对于测量集中在星团中心附近的质量特别有用，而弱透镜效应可以揭示物质在其外部区域的分布情况。

paras.en: "Weak gravitational lensing can constrain mass much further out, so you can get a better picture of the surrounding cluster area," said Finner.
paras.zh: 芬纳说：“弱引力透镜效应可以将质量限制得更远，这样你就可以更好地了解周围的星团区域。”

paras.en: By combining these measurements with X-ray and radio observations from other telescopes, the scientists determined that XLSSC 122 is still undergoing a merger. Its galaxies are continuing to come together as the larger cluster takes shape.
paras.zh: 通过将这些测量结果与其他望远镜的 X 射线和射电观测结果相结合，科学家们确定 XLSSC 122 仍在进行合并。随着更大的星团的形成，它的星系继续聚集在一起。

paras.en: The broader analysis also reinforced the earlier finding that an unusually large amount of mass is concentrated near the cluster's center.
paras.zh: 更广泛的分析也强化了先前的发现，即异常大量的质量集中在星团中心附近。

paras.en: Ancient Starlight Offers New Clues to Dark Matter
paras.zh: 古代星光为暗物质提供了新线索

paras.en: The team's third and most recent paper revealed another important feature of XLSSC 122: faint light produced by stars that are no longer bound to individual galaxies.
paras.zh: 该团队的第三篇也是最新的论文揭示了 XLSSC 122 的另一个重要特征：不再与单个星系结合的恒星产生的微弱光。

paras.en: Known as intracluster light, this diffuse glow comes from stars scattered into the spaces between galaxies. Webb's observations represent the earliest known detection of intracluster light, providing another way to examine the development of galaxy clusters in the distant universe.
paras.zh: 这种漫射光被称为星团内光，来自散布在星系之间空间的恒星。韦伯的观测代表了已知最早的星系团内光探测，为研究遥远宇宙中星系团的发展提供了另一种方法。

paras.en: The widespread distribution of this light supports the conclusion that XLSSC 122 is undergoing a merger. As galaxies interact and collide, some stars are pulled away from their original galaxies and spread throughout the cluster. In XLSSC 122, many of these displaced stars appear not to have settled into its dense central region.
paras.zh: 这种光的广泛分布支持了 XLSSC 122 正在合并的结论。当星系相互作用和碰撞时，一些恒星被拉离原来的星系并散布到整个星团中。在 XLSSC 122 中，许多移位的恒星似乎并未定居在其致密的中心区域。

paras.en: The researchers also uncovered an intriguing connection between these wandering stars and dark matter.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现了这些流浪恒星与暗物质之间的有趣联系。

paras.en: Near the cluster's center, the shape of the intracluster light closely matches the distribution of dark matter inferred from strong gravitational lensing. This suggests that the faint glow of stars between galaxies could potentially serve as a visible indicator of where invisible dark matter is concentrated.
paras.zh: 在星团中心附近，星团内光的形状与强引力透镜推断出的暗物质分布非常匹配。这表明星系之间恒星发出的微弱光芒有可能成为不可见暗物质集中位置的可见指示器。

paras.en: If astronomers observe the same relationship in other clusters, particularly those from the early universe, intracluster light could become a valuable new tool for mapping dark matter across cosmic history.
paras.zh: 如果天文学家在其他星团中观察到相同的关系，特别是来自早期宇宙的星团，那么星团内的光可能成为绘制宇宙历史上的暗物质的有价值的新工具。

paras.en: "In this cluster, the intracluster light essentially traces the dark matter," said Finner. "That light tells us that the cluster is in a merging state."
paras.zh: “在这个星团中，星团内的光基本上追踪暗物质，”芬纳说。 “那光告诉我们星团正处于合并状态。”

paras.en: Could More Ancient Galaxy Clusters Challenge Cosmology?
paras.zh: 更古老的星系团能否挑战宇宙学？

paras.en: The next goal for Finner and his colleagues is to identify and investigate dozens of additional galaxy clusters from similarly early periods in the universe's history.
paras.zh: 芬纳和他的同事的下一个目标是识别和研究来自宇宙历史类似早期时期的数十个额外的星系团。

paras.en: Finding these distant objects requires a different approach from studying them in detail. Although JWST is exceptionally powerful, its relatively narrow field of view makes it better suited to examining selected targets than searching enormous areas of the sky.
paras.zh: 寻找这些遥远的物体需要采用不同于详细研究它们的方法。尽管 JWST 非常强大，但其相对狭窄的视野使其更适合检查选定的目标，而不是搜索大片天空区域。

paras.en: Instead, astronomers must first identify promising candidates through wide-area X-ray and radio surveys, similar to the observations that originally revealed XLSSC 122.
paras.zh: 相反，天文学家必须首先通过广域 X 射线和射电勘测来识别有希望的候选者，类似于最初揭示 XLSSC 122 的观测结果。

paras.en: One promising technique relies on the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect, which occurs when energetic particles inside galaxy clusters scatter radiation from the cosmic microwave background, the faint afterglow of the Big Bang.
paras.zh: 一项有前途的技术依赖于孙亚耶夫-泽尔多维奇效应，当星系团内的高能粒子散射来自宇宙微波背景（大爆炸的微弱余辉）的辐射时，就会发生这种效应。

paras.en: This interaction can create distinctive regions that appear as "holes" in observations of the cosmic microwave background. By searching for these signatures, astronomers can locate galaxy clusters that might otherwise be difficult to detect.
paras.zh: 这种相互作用可以产生独特的区域，在宇宙微波背景的观测中显示为“洞”。通过搜索这些特征，天文学家可以定位原本难以探测到的星系团。

paras.en: Finding more objects like XLSSC 122 could have major implications for cosmology. If other ancient clusters also contain unexpectedly concentrated dark matter and display unusually advanced development, scientists may need to revise some of their basic assumptions about how quickly large cosmic structures formed.
paras.zh: 找到更多像 XLSSC 122 这样的天体可能会对宇宙学产生重大影响。如果其他古老的星团也包含出乎意料的集中暗物质，并表现出异常先进的发展，科学家可能需要修改他们关于大型宇宙结构形成速度的一些基本假设。

paras.en: For now, XLSSC 122 provides an important test of existing models, but a larger sample will be necessary to determine whether its unusual properties are rare or part of a broader pattern in the early universe.
paras.zh: 目前，XLSSC 122 提供了对现有模型的重要测试，但需要更大的样本来确定其不寻常的特性是否罕见，或者是早期宇宙中更广泛模式的一部分。

paras.en: "It's still early in the JWST era," said Finner, "and if we can start to get data on tens or hundreds of these types of objects at this stage in the universe, then we can really start putting our cosmological models to the test."
paras.zh: “现在还处于 JWST 时代的早期，”芬纳说，“如果我们能够在宇宙的这个阶段开始获取数十或数百个此类物体的数据，那么我们就可以真正开始测试我们的宇宙学模型。”

paras.en: - Hyungjin Joo, M. James Jee, Kyle Finner, Zachary P. Scofield, Sangjun Cha, Jinhyub Kim, Ranga-Ram Chary, Andreas Faisst, Bomee Lee. articles.title: SpaceX rocket launch creates incredible 'space jellyfish' visible throughout US East Coast (photos)
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: Rockets are launching to space on a near-daily basis these days, but short of livestreaming a liftoff from the comfort of your Wi-Fi router, relatively few spectators are in the right place and time to see one with their own eyes.
paras.zh: 如今，火箭几乎每天都会发射到太空，但由于缺乏从舒适的 Wi-Fi 路由器上现场直播火箭升空的情况，相对较少的观众能够在正确的地点和时间亲眼目睹火箭的升空。

paras.en: That wasn't the case Tuesday morning (Oct. 13), when SpaceX launched the CRS-35 mission for NASA. A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida at 6:35 a.m. EDT (1035 GMT), carrying a cargo variant of SpaceX's Dragon spacecraft on the company's 35th commercial resupply mission to the International Space Station (ISS). Following the northward path of the space station's orbit at the time, the rocket flew a trajectory along the United States' East Coast.
paras.zh: 周二早上（10 月 13 日）情况并非如此，当时 SpaceX 为 NASA 发射了 CRS-35 任务。美国东部时间上午 6 点 35 分（格林尼治标准时间 1035），一枚猎鹰 9 号火箭从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站的 40 号发射台升空，运载着 SpaceX 龙飞船的货运版本，执行该公司第 35 次飞往国际空间站 (ISS) 的商业补给任务。火箭沿着当时空间站轨道向北的路径，沿美国东海岸飞行。

paras.en: Falcon 9's expanding engine plume grew substantially wider than the rocket itself as it climbed in altitude into thinner, less dense air, and was illuminated by the early dawn light, making the sight visible to millions. "You can imagine my surprise when I opened my back door to let the dogs out this morning," Ellen Alence told Space.com. She snapped a pic of the rocket from her farm Colbert, Georgia.
paras.zh: 随着猎鹰 9 号爬升到稀薄、密度较小的空气中，猎鹰 9 号不断膨胀的发动机羽流变得比火箭本身更宽，并被黎明的光线照亮，使数百万人可以看到这一景象。埃伦·阿伦斯告诉 Space.com：“今天早上，当我打开后门放狗出来时，你可以想象我的惊讶。”她在佐治亚州科尔伯特农场拍摄了一张火箭的照片。

paras.en: "Many of you are talking about the 'space jellyfish' following this morning's launch from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida," NASA's Kennedy Space Center wrote in a post on X. The post explains the "jellyfish" phenomenon that is sometimes visible during dawn and dusk launches, and included additional photos of the launch.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局肯尼迪航天中心在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道：“今天早上从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站 40 号太空发射综合体发射升空后，很多人都在谈论‘太空水母’。”该帖子解释了黎明和黄昏发射时有时可见的“水母”现象，并附上了发射的更多照片。

paras.en: "A jellyfish happens near sunrise or sunset when the exhaust plume from the rocket becomes brightly illuminated, creating a glowing shape resembling a jellyfish," the post said.
paras.zh: 帖子称：“水母出现在日出或日落附近，此时火箭排出的尾气被明亮地照亮，形成类似水母的发光形状。”

paras.en: Further up the coast, Richard Mack Wilson-Leigh spotted the flight from Durham, North Carolina. His view of the rocket came just seconds before the vehicle's stage separation, which was followed immediately by the rocket's main booster performing an engine burn to right its trajectory for landing back at the Cape. Wilson-Leigh said that part caught him off guard more than the initial site of the rocket. "I thought it blew up at first," he jokingly told Space.com.
paras.zh: 在海岸的更远处，理查德·麦克·威尔逊·利发现了这架从北卡罗来纳州达勒姆起飞的航班。他看到的火箭就在火箭级分离前几秒钟，随后火箭的主助推器立即燃烧发动机以纠正其弹道，以便返回海角。威尔逊-利说，这个部分比火箭最初的地点更让他措手不及。 “我一开始以为它爆炸了，”他开玩笑地告诉 Space.com。

paras.en: "At first, I thought it was a comet," Wilson-Leigh said. "My mind jumped between two thoughts: that is just beautiful beyond belief, and it is the end of the world.”
paras.zh: “起初，我以为这是一颗彗星，”威尔逊-利说。 “我的思绪在两个想法之间跳跃：那真是难以置信的美丽，而且这是世界末日。”

paras.en: That stage separation came about 2.5 minutes after liftoff, and put on a dazzling display for those awake to see it this morning. As Falcon 9's booster began the journey to its landing zone, the rocket's second stage continued onward to orbit with Dragon and the capsule's 6,300 pounds (2,860 kilograms) of cargo for the ISS.
paras.zh: 升空后大约 2.5 分钟发生了阶段分离，为今天早上醒来的人们带来了一场令人眼花缭乱的表演。当猎鹰 9 号的助推器开始前往着陆区时，火箭的第二级继续与龙号和太空舱的 6,300 磅（2,860 公斤）货物一起进入轨道，运往国际空间站。

paras.en: The spacecraft will spend roughly two days catching up to the ISS, where a recent personnel rotation swapped the astronauts of SpaceX's Crew-12 mission with those of Crew-13. The latter arrived aboard the orbital laboratory Oct. 1, which was followed several days later by the return of Crew-12 to Earth on Oct. 8.
paras.zh: 该航天器将花费大约两天的时间赶上国际空间站，最近在国际空间站进行了人员轮换，将 SpaceX Crew-12 任务的宇航员与 Crew-13 任务的宇航员进行了交换。后者于 10 月 1 日抵达轨道实验室，几天后 Crew-12 于 10 月 8 日返回地球。

paras.en: The Dragon carrying the contents of CRS-35's manifest will arrive at the station Thursday morning (Oct. 15), and will autonomously dock to the space-facing port of the Harmony module at around 11 a.m. EDT (1500 GMT). Coverage of the arrival here at Space.com beginning at 9:15 a.m. EDT (1315 GMT).
paras.zh: 载有 CRS-35 清单内容的龙飞船将于周四上午（10 月 15 日）抵达空间站，并将于美国东部时间上午 11 点（格林威治标准时间 1500）自动停靠在和谐号模块的面向太空的端口上。 Space.com 的报道将于美国东部时间上午 9:15（格林尼治标准时间 1315）开始。

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer. He is a writer and photographer with a passion for science and space exploration, and has been working the space beat since 2016. Josh has covered the evolution of NASA's Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon, commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions from the Space Coast, NASA science missions and more. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Joshdinner) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人。他是一位对科学和太空探索充满热情的作家和摄影师，自 2016 年以来一直致力于太空节拍。乔什报道了 NASA 阿尔忒弥斯计划的演变和人类重返月球、商业航天合作伙伴关系以及太空海岸的载人任务、NASA 科学任务等。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。

articles.title: Earth's poles shifted surprisingly fast during the age of dinosaurs, ancient sea levels reveal
articles.author: Keith Cooper

paras.en: The location of Earth's geographic poles has changed several times over the past 320 million years in a process known as true polar wander, according to measurements of ancient flooding brought about by sea level changes resulting from our planet's crust shifting relative to Earth's spin axis.
paras.zh: 根据对古代洪水的测量，在过去的 3.2 亿年里，地球地理两极的位置发生了数次变化，这一过程被称为真正的极移。由于地壳相对于地球自转轴的移动而导致海平面变化，从而导致了海平面的变化。

paras.en: Such a shift can affect climate, both on local scales and globally, as regions that were by the poles find themselves moving down to lower latitudes and vice versa. This can then affect atmospheric circulation patterns, which affect climate across the world.
paras.zh: 这种转变可能会影响局部和全球范围内的气候，因为两极地区发现自己正在向低纬度地区移动，反之亦然。这会影响大气环流模式，进而影响世界各地的气候。

paras.en: The changes would have affected the environments in which life developed and evolved, from the age of the dinosaurs through to some of our oldest primate ancestors.
paras.zh: 这些变化会影响生命发育和进化的环境，从恐龙时代到我们一些最古老的灵长类祖先。

paras.en: True polar wander is not the same as a change in the rotational axis of the Earth. Currently, Earth spins at an angle of 23.4 degrees relative to the plane of its orbit around the sun, and this rotational axis can vary periodically over tens of thousands of years as a result of the Milankovitch cycles caused by the gravitational pull of the sun and planets.
paras.zh: 真正的极移与地球自转轴的变化不同。目前，地球相对于其围绕太阳的轨道平面以23.4度的角度自转，并且由于太阳和行星的引力引起的米兰科维奇周期，该旋转轴可以在数万年的时间内周期性变化。

paras.en: True polar wander is different. Here, the angle of Earth's spin axis does not change relative to its orbital plane. Instead, Earth's crust and mantle shift relative to that rotational axis. This is because Earth is not perfectly spherical. Instead, it is oblate, with Earth's rotation causing the equator to bulge out and the poles to slightly flatten. Because Earth is not spherical, it has multiple axes of inertia, the largest one being aligned with the rotational axis.
paras.zh: 真正的极地漫游是不同的。在这里，地球自转轴的角度相对于其轨道平面没有改变。相反，地壳和地幔相对于该旋转轴发生移动。这是因为地球不是完美的球形。相反，它是扁圆的，地球自转导致赤道凸出，两极稍微变平。因为地球不是球形的，所以它有多个惯性轴，其中最大的一个与旋转轴对齐。

paras.en: These axes need to be balanced to prevent Earth's rotation from becoming chaotic. However, plate tectonics and indeed the Milankovitch cycles can upset that balance of mass, for example by causing more continental crust to congregate in one hemisphere than another.
paras.zh: 这些轴需要保持平衡，以防止地球自转变得混乱。然而，板块构造和实际上的米兰科维奇循环可能会破坏这种质量平衡，例如导致一个半球比另一个半球聚集更多的大陆地壳。

paras.en: To rebalance things, Earth's crust and mantle must become decoupled from our planet's core, which stays aligned with the rotational axis. In physical terms, if there is more continental crust in one hemisphere, the crust and mantle might rotate in that direction relative to the rotational axis and the Earth's core in order to balance itself. This sees the geographical locations of the poles change, hence the name 'true polar wander'.
paras.zh: 为了重新平衡事物，地壳和地幔必须与地球的核心脱钩，而核心与旋转轴保持一致。从物理角度来说，如果一个半球有更多的大陆地壳，地壳和地幔可能会相对于旋转轴和地核朝该方向旋转，以保持自身平衡。这会看到两极的地理位置发生变化，因此被称为“真正的极地漫游”。

paras.en: Currently, true polar wander takes place at a rate of 10 centimeters (4 inches) per year, but figuring out when and how fast true polar wander has occurred in the past is not without its difficulties, not least since plate tectonics can mask and even mimic the signal of true polar wander.
paras.zh: 目前，真正的极地漂移以每年 10 厘米（4 英寸）的速度发生，但弄清楚过去真正的极地漂移发生的时间和速度并非没有困难，尤其是因为板块构造可以掩盖甚至模仿真正的极地漂移的信号。

paras.en: Previous studies relied on paleomagnetism, the study of residual magnetic traces in ancient rocks, since the orientation of those magnetic traces would have varied depending upon where that rock was located relative to Earth's magnetic field. Alas, it's not a terribly accurate means of measuring true polar wander and scientists arrived at substantially different conclusions using this technique.
paras.zh: 以前的研究依赖于古地磁学，即对古代岩石中残留磁迹的研究，因为这些磁迹的方向会根据岩石相对于地球磁场的位置而变化。可惜的是，这并不是一种测量真实极地漂移的非常准确的方法，科学家们使用这种技术得出了截然不同的结论。

paras.en: Nevertheless, based on paleomagnetism, scientists had concluded that true polar wander had been negligible, or slow to proceed, in the distant past. However, new results from researchers at the Centre for Planetary Habitability at the University of Oslo in Norway, led by Mathew Domeier, have shown this not to be the case.
paras.zh: 然而，根据古地磁学，科学家们得出结论，在遥远的过去，真正的极地漂移可以忽略不计，或者进展缓慢。然而，由马修·多梅尔领导的挪威奥斯陆大学行星宜居中心研究人员的最新研究结果表明，情况并非如此。

paras.en: Domeier's team looked through the geological record to track how sea level has changed across millions of years. True polar wander would bring about an identifiable pattern in sea-level changes as the oceans reacted in response to changes in the mass distribution of the planet. The sea level changes would be equal but opposite between hemispheres — sea level rises on one side of one hemisphere would be matched by rises on the other side of the opposite hemisphere, creating a 'quadrupolar' effect.
paras.zh: 多梅尔的团队通过地质记录来追踪海平面数百万年来的变化。真正的极地漂移会带来可识别的海平面变化模式，因为海洋会对地球质量分布的变化做出反应。半球之间的海平面变化将是相等但相反的——一个半球一侧的海平面上升将与另一半球另一侧的海平面上升相匹配，从而产生“四极”效应。

paras.en: By using statistical modeling on maps of sea level changes across intervals of 10 million years, Domeier's team identified four periods of true polar wander: in the early Jurassic period 190—200 million years ago, the late Jurassic — early Cretaceous period 140—150 million years ago, during the mid-Cretaceous 90—100 million years ago and from the Oligocene period 30 million years ago through to the Miocene 20 million years ago.
paras.zh: 通过对每1000万年的海平面变化地图进行统计建模，多梅尔的团队确定了四个真正的极地漂移时期：190-2亿年前的侏罗纪早期、140-1.5亿年前的侏罗纪晚期-白垩纪早期、90-1亿年前的白垩纪中期以及3000万年前的渐新世至中新世2000万年前。

paras.en: The results show that, contrary to established opinion, true polar wander can happen in bursts that are relatively fast on geological timescales, with the results showing that during the episodes of true polar wander the Earth's surface shifted by as much as 0.6 degrees per million years relative to the spin axis. This is slow by human standards, but fairly fast on geological timescales, certainly quicker than plate tectonics.
paras.zh: 结果表明，与既定观点相反，真正的极地漂移可能会在地质时间尺度上相对较快的爆发中发生，结果表明，在真正的极地漂移期间，地球表面相对于自转轴每百万年移动多达 0.6 度。以人类标准来看，这是缓慢的，但在地质时间尺度上相当快，肯定比板块构造更快。

paras.en: Domeier's team were also able to rule out a suspected case of true polar wander around 300 million years ago when the last great supercontinent, Pangea, migrated northwards. It turns out that Pangea's movements were entirely due to plate tectonics.
paras.zh: 多迈尔的团队还排除了大约 3 亿年前最后一块超级大陆盘古大陆向北迁移时发生的真正极地漂移的疑似病例。事实证明，盘古大陆的运动完全是由于板块构造造成的。

paras.en: The findings were published on Oct. 1 in the journal Science.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在 10 月 1 日的《科学》杂志上。

paras.en: Keith Cooper is a freelance science journalist and editor in the United Kingdom, and has a degree in physics and astrophysics from the University of Manchester. He's the author of "The Contact Paradox: Challenging Our Assumptions in the Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence" (Bloomsbury Sigma, 2020) and has written articles on astronomy, space, physics and astrobiology for a multitude of magazines and websites.
paras.zh: 基思·库珀 (Keith Cooper) 是英国自由科学记者和编辑，拥有曼彻斯特大学物理学和天体物理学学位。他是《接触悖论：在寻找外星智慧生命中挑战我们的假设》（Bloomsbury Sigma，2020 年）一书的作者，并为众多杂志和网站撰写了有关天文学、太空、物理学和天体生物学的文章。

articles.title: World Space Week 2026 Celebrates the “Rocket Revolution”
articles.author: World Space Week Association

paras.en: HOUSTON, Texas (September 30, 2026)— World Space Week events, beginning October 4 in 100 nations, will celebrate how launch innovation has stimulated the rapidly-growing space economy and enabled new uses of space to help the world.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州休斯顿（2026 年 9 月 30 日）——世界太空周活动将于 10 月 4 日在 100 个国家开始，庆祝发射创新如何刺激快速增长的太空经济，并实现太空的新用途来帮助世界。

paras.en: “This year’s theme is the Rocket Revolution,” said Dennis Stone, World Space Week Association President. “It recognizes how increased space access and falling launch prices have stimulated the space ecosystem and exciting new space applications,” he said. The rocketry theme will also be used to inspire student interest in STEM, he added.
paras.zh: “今年的主题是火箭革命，”世界太空周协会主席丹尼斯·斯通说。他说：“它认识到太空准入的增加和发射价格的下降如何刺激了太空生态系统并令人兴奋的新太空应用。”他补充说，火箭主题还将用于激发学生对 STEM 的兴趣。

paras.en: Planned World Space Week 2026 activities include:
paras.zh: 2026 年世界空间周计划活动包括：

paras.en: ESA and The Pokémon Company International will celebrate World Space Week 2026 with a Europe-wide family exhibition combining real space science with Pokémon, alongside special Pokémon GO activities at participating museums.
paras.zh: ESA 和 Pokémon Company International 将为庆祝 2026 年世界太空周举办一场欧洲范围内的家庭展览，将真实的太空科学与 Pokémon 相结合，并在参与的博物馆举办特别的 Pokémon GO 活动。

paras.en: NASA Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex will host a World Space Week Expo featuring Space Shuttle Atlantis, highlighting the Rocket Revolution and its impact on space exploration and access.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局肯尼迪航天中心游客中心将举办世界航天周博览会，以亚特兰蒂斯号航天飞机为主题，突出火箭革命及其对太空探索和进入的影响。

paras.en: Students and rocket clubs around the world will put the Rocket Revolution into action by launching model rockets. In the U.S., enthusiasts will launch Vulcan model rockets provided by United Launch Alliance and Estes.
paras.zh: 世界各地的学生和火箭俱乐部将通过发射模型火箭将火箭革命付诸实践。在美国，爱好者将发射由联合发射联盟和 Estes 提供的 Vulcan 模型火箭。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Education and SUPARCO, Pakistan’s national space agency, will lead large-scale national celebrations, with thousands of schools and events engaging students and the public in World Space Week.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯教育部和巴基斯坦国家航天局 SUPARCO 将领导大规模的全国庆祝活动，数千所学校和活动将吸引学生和公众参与世界空间周。

paras.en: UN-declared World Space Week, the largest space event on Earth, last year was celebrated by 50,000 events held by space agencies, schools, aerospace companies, and others according to the Association. World Space Week is held each October 4-10.
paras.zh: 据该协会称，联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，去年由太空机构、学校、航空航天公司和其他机构举办了 50,000 场活动来庆祝。世界空间周于每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行。

paras.en: John Elbon, former ULA Interim CEO, serves as Honorary Chair of World Space Week 2026 to help showcase the launch industry. Tory Bruno, President of Blue Origin National Security, will serve as Honorary Chair in 2027 with the theme “To the Moon.”
paras.zh: ULA 前临时首席执行官 John Elbon 担任 2026 年世界太空周名誉主席，帮助展示发射行业。蓝色起源国家安全总裁托里·布鲁诺 (Tory Bruno) 将担任 2027 年名誉主席，主题为“To the Moon”。

paras.en: “We encourage students and the public to celebrate space in their own way next week as part of the biggest space event in the world,” Stone said. The public can see what’s planned in their area at worldspaceweek.org.
paras.zh: 斯通说：“我们鼓励学生和公众下周以自己的方式庆祝太空，作为世界上最大的太空活动的一部分。”公众可以在 worldspaceweek.org 上查看他们所在地区的计划。

paras.en: The largest space event on Earth, UN-declared World Space Week is celebrated October 4–10 annually. It is an international celebration of the contribution of space science and technology to the betterment of the human condition. World Space Week consists of numerous space-related events held by space agencies, aerospace companies, schools, planetaria, museums, astronomy clubs, and others in a common timeframe to achieve greater student and public impact through synchronization. In 2025, 50,000 events were reported in 102 countries.
paras.zh: 联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行庆祝活动。这是一次国际性庆祝空间科学技术对改善人类状况所做贡献的活动。世界空间周由航天机构、航空航天公司、学校、天文馆、博物馆、天文学俱乐部和其他机构在同一时间范围内举办的众多与太空相关的活动组成，以通过同步实现更大的学生和公众影响。 2025 年，102 个国家报告了 50,000 起事件。

paras.en: World Space Week Association is the global coordinator of World Space Week. As an international non-government, non-profit organization, it serves as a permanent observer on the UN Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space and is supported by voluntary contributions from sponsors including Blue Origin, United Launch Alliance, Texas Instruments, Firefly Aerospace, L3 Harris, BAE Systems, Black Sky, Airbus, Club for the Future, Cesium Astro, Space Foundation, Gaia Horizons, and Space News. The Association was founded in 1982 and is one of the world’s oldest space advocacy organizations.
paras.zh: 世界空间周协会是世界空间周的全球协调机构。作为一个国际非政府、非营利组织，它是联合国和平利用外层空间委员会的常任观察员，并得到了赞助商的自愿捐款支持，这些赞助商包括蓝色起源、联合发射联盟、德州仪器、Firefly Aerospace、L3 Harris、BAE Systems、Black Sky、空客、未来俱乐部、Cesium Astro、太空基金会、Gaia Horizo​​ns 和 Space News。该协会成立于 1982 年，是世界上历史最悠久的太空倡导组织之一。

paras.en: Dennis Stone, dstone@worldspaceweek.org (USA)
paras.zh: 丹尼斯·斯通，dstone@worldspaceweek.org（美国）

paras.en: Alma Okpalefe, aokpalefe@worldspaceweek.org (Nigeria)
paras.zh: Alma Okpalefe，aokpalefe@worldspaceweek.org（尼日利亚）

paras.en: Ilayda Edali, iedali@worldspaceweek.org (Netherlands)
paras.zh: Ilayda Edali，iedali@worldspaceweek.org（荷兰）

articles.title: Announcing the finalists for the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: The SpaceNews Icon Awards celebrate the year’s most iconic achievements in shaping the future of the space industry. Today, we’re proud to announce the shortlist for 2026 — a selection of individuals, organizations, and missions that exemplify excellence in innovation, exploration and sustainability.
paras.zh: 太空新闻偶像奖旨在表彰今年在塑造航天工业未来方面最具标志性的成就。今天，我们很自豪地宣布 2026 年入围名单，其中包括在创新、探索和可持续发展方面表现卓越的个人、组织和使命。

paras.en: This year’s honorees represent a range of accomplishments — from returning astronauts to the vicinity of the moon and expanding the capacity to run AI on orbit to accelerating the realization of on-orbit servicing and advancing scale through partnerships and acquisitions. These finalists reflect the creativity and ambition propelling today’s growth.
paras.zh: 今年的获奖者代表了一系列成就——从让宇航员重返月球附近、扩大在轨道上运行人工智能的能力，到加速实现在轨服务以及通过合作和收购扩大规模。这些决赛入围者反映了推动当今发展的创造力和雄心。

paras.en: Winners will be announced at the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards on Dec. 1 in Washington D.C., where we’ll celebrate their contributions and share the stories behind their successes. In addition to recognizing this year’s winners, Space Force Gen. Michael Guetlein, direct reporting program manager for Golden Dome for America, will join us for a keynote address.
paras.zh: 获奖者名单将于 12 月 1 日在华盛顿特区举行的 2026 年太空新闻偶像奖上公布，届时我们将庆祝他们的贡献并分享他们成功背后的故事。除了表彰今年的获奖者之外，美国金顶的直接报告项目经理、太空军上将迈克尔·盖特兰 (Michael Guetlein) 也将与我们一起发表主题演讲。

paras.en: Tickets are available now – register by Oct. 31 to take advantage of our early bird rate.
paras.zh: 门票现已发售——请在 10 月 31 日之前注册，以享受我们的早鸟价。

paras.en: Honoring individuals whose leadership and vision have left a lasting impact on the space industry, shaping exploration, national security and commercial growth for generations.
paras.zh: 表彰其领导力和远见对航天工业产生持久影响、影响几代人的探索、国家安全和商业增长的个人。

paras.en: Mark Dankberg. A satellite communications pioneer who co-founded Viasat and spent decades advancing high-capacity satellite broadband, helping reshape how satellite technology connects consumers, governments and businesses.
paras.zh: 马克·丹克伯格。卫星通信先驱，Viasat 的联合创始人，花费数十年时间推进高容量卫星宽带的发展，帮助重塑卫星技术连接消费者、政府和企业的方式。

paras.en: Jean-Yves Le Gall. One of Europe’s most influential space leaders, with decades of leadership at CNES and Arianespace that helped strengthen Europe’s launch capabilities, international partnerships and position in the global space economy.
paras.zh: 让-伊夫·勒加尔。欧洲最具影响力的太空领导者之一，在法国国家空间研究中心和阿丽亚娜航天公司拥有数十年的领导地位，帮助加强了欧洲的发射能力、国际合作伙伴关系以及在全球太空经济中的地位。

paras.en: Chris Scolese. Capped a career spanning NASA and national security space after nearly seven years as director of the National Reconnaissance Office, where he oversaw a transformation of the agency’s architecture and growing integration of commercial capabilities. Scolese previously served as NASA’s chief engineer and director of Goddard Space Flight Center.
paras.zh: 克里斯·斯科莱斯。在担任国家侦察办公室主任近七年后，他在美国宇航局和国家安全领域的职业生涯结束了，在那里他监督了该机构架构的转型和商业能力的不断整合。斯科莱斯此前曾担任美国宇航局总工程师和戈达德太空飞行中心主任。

paras.en: Karen St. Germain. Helped shape NASA’s Earth science enterprise through senior leadership roles overseeing missions, research and the use of satellite observations to better understand Earth’s climate and environment.
paras.zh: 凯伦·圣日耳曼。通过监督任务、研究和卫星观测使用的高级领导角色，帮助塑造美国宇航局的地球科学事业，以更好地了解地球的气候和环境。

paras.en: Coyote Smith. A longtime military space leader and educator whose career has helped shape thinking about spacepower, national security space strategy and the development of the next generation of space professionals.
paras.zh: 郊狼·史密斯。一位长期的军事太空领导者和教育家，其职业生涯帮助塑造了对太空力量、国家安全太空战略和下一代太空专业人员发展的思考。

paras.en: Recognizing partnerships that bring together organizations and nations to advance space exploration, science and commerce.
paras.zh: 认可将组织和国家聚集在一起推动太空探索、科学和商业的伙伴关系。

paras.en: Clay Mowry. Now chief executive of the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA), he has worked across industry, government and professional organizations to build connections within an increasingly international and multidisciplinary space community.
paras.zh: 克莱·莫里。他现任美国航空航天学会 (AIAA) 首席执行官，曾在行业、政府和专业组织中工作，在日益国际化和多学科的太空社区中建立联系。

paras.en: Loft Orbital–Marlan Space. U.S.-French and Emirati capabilities joined in a major international space initiative, including plans for the 50-satellite Altair-Next Gen constellation combining Earth observation, onboard computing and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 阁楼轨道——马兰空间。美国、法国和阿联酋联合参与了一项重大国际太空计划，其中包括由 50 颗卫星组成的 Altair-Next Gen 星座计划，该星座结合了地球观测、机载计算和人工智能。

paras.en: K2 Space–SES. Paired K2 Space’s high-power satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads for meoSphere, a next-generation MEO network beginning with 28 spacecraft and designed to serve commercial and defense customers.
paras.zh: K2 空间——SES。将 K2 Space 的高功率卫星平台与 SES 软件定义的 meoSphere 有效载荷配对，meoSphere 是下一代 MEO 网络，从 28 颗航天器开始，旨在为商业和国防客户提供服务。

paras.en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. Brought together NASA, ESA, JAXA, France’s CNES, Germany’s Max Planck Institute for Astronomy and institutions across the scientific community to develop a next-generation observatory for studying dark energy, exoplanets and the evolution of the universe. Roman launched Aug. 30, beginning a new chapter in international space science.
paras.zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜。美国宇航局、欧空局、日本宇宙航空研究开发机构、法国国家空间研究中心、德国马克斯·普朗克天文研究所以及整个科学界的机构聚集在一起，开发下一代天文台，用于研究暗能量、系外行星和宇宙演化。 Roman 于 8 月 30 日发射升空，开启了国际空间科学的新篇章。

paras.en: SMILE. The Solar wind Magnetosphere Ionosphere Link Explorer brought ESA and the Chinese Academy of Sciences together for the first mission jointly designed, implemented, launched and operated by Europe and China. The spacecraft launched May 19 to study the interaction between the solar wind and Earth’s magnetosphere.
paras.zh: 微笑。太阳风磁层电离层链接探测器将欧空局和中国科学院联合起来，执行欧洲和中国联合设计、实施、发射和运营的首次任务。该航天器于 5 月 19 日发射升空，旨在研究太阳风与地球磁层之间的相互作用。

paras.en: Recognizing new or rapidly growing companies driving innovation and opening new markets in the space economy.
paras.zh: 认可在太空经济中推动创新和开辟新市场的新公司或快速成长的公司。

paras.en: Benoît Deper / Aerospacelab. Built Aerospacelab into a rapidly expanding European satellite manufacturer and operator, pursuing vertically integrated spacecraft production and constellation development from Europe and the United States.
paras.zh: 伯努瓦·德佩 / 航空航天实验室。将航空航天实验室打造成一家快速扩张的欧洲卫星制造商和运营商，追求欧洲和美国垂直整合的航天器生产和星座开发。

paras.en: Lux Aeterna. Emerged from stealth with plans to develop reusable satellites capable of returning payloads to Earth, raising $10 million in 2026 as it works toward its first reentry demonstration mission.
paras.zh: 永恒之光。该公司计划开发能够将有效载荷返回地球的可重复使用卫星，并在 2026 年筹集 1000 万美元，以实现首次再入演示任务。

paras.en: Katalyst Space Technologies. Pushed commercial satellite servicing into new territory with LINK, a rapidly developed robotic spacecraft sent to attempt the rescue of NASA’s Swift observatory, while expanding into GEO servicing, deorbiting and other robotic space operations.
paras.zh: 催化剂空间技术。 LINK 是一种快速开发的机器人航天器，被派去尝试救援 NASA 的雨燕天文台，将商业卫星服务推向新领域，同时扩展到 GEO 服务、离轨和其他机器人太空操作。

paras.en: Skyroot Aerospace. Advanced India’s growing private launch sector with Vikram-1, India’s first privately developed orbital-class launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 天根航空航天公司。 Vikram-1 是印度第一个私人开发的轨道级运载火箭，推动印度不断发展的私人发射领域。

paras.en: Recognizing technologies that push the boundaries of engineering and create new capabilities for space operations.
paras.zh: 认识到突破工程界限并为太空作战创造新能力的技术。

paras.en: Cailabs. Advanced laser communications from individual optical ground stations toward shared infrastructure, launching an optical-ground-station-as-a-service model with plans for an international network of roughly 15 stations.
paras.zh: 凯拉布斯。从单个光学地面站到共享基础设施的先进激光通信，推出了光学地面站即服务模型，并计划建立一个由大约 15 个站组成的国际网络。

paras.en: D-Orbit. Continued expanding the capabilities of its ION orbital transfer vehicle beyond satellite deployment into hosted payloads, orbital transportation, cloud computing and other in-space logistics services.
paras.zh: D 轨道。继续将 ION 轨道传输飞行器的功能扩展到卫星部署之外，扩展到托管有效载荷、轨道运输、云计算和其他太空物流服务。

paras.en: Xona Space Systems. Advanced a commercial alternative to traditional GPS with Pulsar, a low Earth orbit positioning, navigation and timing architecture designed to provide more precise, resilient navigation services from a new generation of satellites.
paras.zh: 希纳空间系统公司。 Pulsar 是一种低地球轨道定位、导航和授时架构，旨在通过新一代卫星提供更精确、更有弹性的导航服务，从而推出传统 GPS 的商业替代品。

paras.en: Recognizing individuals whose leadership and innovation have set new benchmarks for excellence and inspired progress across the space community.
paras.zh: 表彰其领导力和创新能力为卓越树立新基准并激励整个航天界进步的个人。

paras.en: Steve Altemus, Intuitive Machines. Continued expanding Intuitive Machines from lunar transportation into a broader space infrastructure company, including the $800 million acquisition of Lanteris Space Systems and investments in communications, navigation and data services.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·阿尔特穆斯，《直觉机器》。继续将 Intuitive Machines 从月球运输扩展到更广泛的空间基础设施公司，包括以 8 亿美元收购 Lanteris Space Systems 以及对通信、导航和数据服务的投资。

paras.en: Ian Cinnamon, Apex. Helped establish a new model for satellite manufacturing at Apex, emphasizing standardized spacecraft platforms, faster production and an approach designed to bring mass-production economics to the satellite industry.
paras.zh: 伊恩·肉桂，Apex。帮助 Apex 建立卫星制造的新模式，强调标准化航天器平台、更快的生产以及旨在为卫星行业带来大规模生产经济效益的方法。

paras.en: Rafal Modrzewski, Iceye. Led Iceye’s continued expansion of the world’s largest commercial synthetic aperture radar satellite fleet, combining commercial services with increasingly important sovereign intelligence capabilities for governments around the world.
paras.zh: 拉法尔·莫杰夫斯基，冰眼。 LED Iceye 持续扩大全球最大的商业合成孔径雷达卫星群，将商业服务与对世界各国政府日益重要的主权情报能力结合起来。

paras.en: Shey Sabripour, CesiumAstro. Built CesiumAstro around advanced active phased-array communications technology, helping move high-throughput, software-defined connectivity from a promising technology toward operational space systems.
paras.zh: Shey Saripour，CesiumAstro。围绕先进的有源相控阵通信技术构建 CesiumAstro，帮助将高吞吐量、软件定义的连接从有前景的技术转向可操作的空间系统。

paras.en: Recognizing transactions and investments that reshape markets, create new competitors or alter the trajectory of the space industry.
paras.zh: 认可重塑市场、创造新竞争对手或改变航天工业轨迹的交易和投资。

paras.en: AE Industrial Partners–Rocketdyne. AE Industrial agreed to acquire a controlling interest in L3Harris’ Space Propulsion and Power Systems business, reviving the Rocketdyne name for a company whose propulsion heritage stretches back more than six decades.
paras.zh: AE 工业合作伙伴——Rocketdyne。 AE Industrial 同意收购 L3Harris 太空推进和动力系统业务的控股权，从而为一家其推进历史可追溯至六十多年前的公司重新启用 Rocketdyne 名称。

paras.en: EQT–Exolaunch. EQT agreed to acquire Exolaunch, giving the previously self-funded German launch integration and deployment company its first outside investment and resources to expand internationally and develop new services.
paras.zh: EQT-Exolaunch。 EQT 同意收购 Exolaunch，为这家之前自筹资金的德国发射集成和部署公司提供了第一笔外部投资和资源，以进行国际扩张和开发新服务。

paras.en: Intuitive Machines–Lanteris Space Systems. Intuitive Machines completed its $800 million acquisition of the former Maxar Space Systems, adding decades of satellite manufacturing experience as it seeks to become a vertically integrated space prime.
paras.zh: 直观机器——兰特里斯空间系统。 Intuitive Machines 完成了对前 Maxar Space Systems 的 8 亿美元收购，在其寻求成为垂直整合的太空巨头的过程中，增加了数十年的卫星制造经验。

paras.en: Katalyst Space Technologies–NASA. NASA turned to Katalyst for an unusually rapid commercial servicing mission designed to rendezvous with and raise the orbit of the agency’s Swift observatory, testing a new model for acquiring time-sensitive in-space services.
paras.zh: Katalyst 空间技术——美国宇航局。 NASA 向 Katalyst 寻求一项异常快速的商业服务任务，旨在与该机构的雨燕天文台交会并提升其轨道，测试一种获取时间敏感的太空服务的新模型。

paras.en: SpaceX IPO. SpaceX’s long-awaited public offering brought one of the world’s most valuable private companies to public markets in a landmark transaction for the commercial space sector.
paras.zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股。 SpaceX 期待已久的公开发行将世界上最有价值的私营公司之一带到了公开市场，这是商业航天领域具有里程碑意义的交易。

paras.en: Recognizing advances that harness artificial intelligence and high-performance computing to transform spacecraft, space data and operations.
paras.zh: 认识到利用人工智能和高性能计算来改变航天器、空间数据和操作的进步。

paras.en: Aethero. Launched its Phobos spacecraft with an NVIDIA-powered edge-computing module, demonstrating a platform designed for continuous onboard processing and compute-as-a-service applications.
paras.zh: 埃泰罗。推出了配备 NVIDIA 驱动的边缘计算模块的 Phobos 航天器，展示了一个专为连续机载处理和计算即服务应用程序而设计的平台。

paras.en: Alex Greenberg, Loft Orbital. Helped drive Loft Orbital’s push to bring artificial intelligence and high-performance computing directly into orbit, enabling satellites to process increasingly large volumes of data before sending actionable information to the ground.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·格林伯格，阁楼轨道。帮助推动 Loft Orbital 推动人工智能和高性能计算直接进入轨道，使卫星能够在向地面发送可操作信息之前处理越来越多的数据。

paras.en: Starcloud. Advanced the emerging concept of space-based data centers by developing high-performance orbital computing infrastructure intended to run increasingly demanding AI workloads in space.
paras.zh: 星云.通过开发旨在在太空中运行要求日益严格的人工智能工作负载的高性能轨道计算基础设施，推进新兴的天基数据中心概念。

paras.en: Recognizing companies and missions that have advanced commercial space capabilities and contributed to the growth of the space economy.
paras.zh: 表彰具有先进商业航天能力并为航天经济增长做出贡献的公司和任务。

paras.en: Iceye. Expanded its synthetic aperture radar network while deploying a new generation of spacecraft capable of imagery down to 16-centimeter resolution and supporting both commercial and sovereign missions worldwide.
paras.zh: 冰眼。扩大其合成孔径雷达网络，同时部署能够将图像分辨率低至 16 厘米的新一代航天器，并支持全球商业和主权任务。

paras.en: Impulse Space and Starfish Space. Demonstrated autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations using Impulse Space’s Mira spacecraft and Starfish Space technology, advancing commercial capabilities needed for future satellite servicing and other in-space operations.
paras.zh: 脉冲空间和海星空间。使用 Impulse Space 的 Mira 航天器和 Starfish Space 技术展示了自主交会和邻近操作，提高了未来卫星服务和其他太空操作所需的商业能力。

paras.en: SEOPS and Exolaunch. Expanded launch integration and rideshare services at a time of growing demand for alternatives in the commercial launch market, helping satellite operators secure access to orbit across a broader range of launch vehicles.
paras.zh: SEOPS 和 Exolaunch。在商业发射市场对替代品的需求不断增长之际，扩大了发射集成和乘车共享服务，帮助卫星运营商确保更广泛的运载火箭进入轨道。

paras.en: Recognizing leadership in using space technology to protect Earth and advancing more sustainable operations in space.
paras.zh: 认可在利用空间技术保护地球和推进更可持续的太空运营方面的领导地位。

paras.en: Hydrosat. Expanded the use of thermal infrared satellite data for water, agriculture and climate applications while unveiling Osiris, a next-generation constellation designed to combine 25-meter thermal imagery with broad-area coverage and daily revisit.
paras.zh: 海德萨特。扩大了热红外卫星数据在水、农业和气候应用中的使用，同时推出了 Osiris，这是一个下一代星座，旨在将 25 米热图像与大面积覆盖和每日重访相结合。

paras.en: Space Data Association. Continued bringing satellite operators together to share operational data and promote collision avoidance, responsible operations and sustainable use of increasingly congested orbital environments.
paras.zh: 空间数据协会。继续将卫星运营商聚集在一起，共享运行数据并促进避免碰撞、负责任的运行和可持续利用日益拥挤的轨道环境。

paras.en: Vera C. Rubin Observatory. Began issuing real-time scientific alerts in February, creating a system expected to eventually generate millions of alerts each night about changing objects and events ranging from asteroids to supernovae.
paras.zh: 维拉·C·鲁宾天文台。从二月份开始发布实时科学警报，创建了一个系统，预计最终将在每晚生成数百万个关于从小行星到超新星等物体和事件变化的警报。

paras.en: Celebrating breakthroughs in exploration, science and public-sector space missions.
paras.zh: 庆祝探索、科学和公共部门太空任务方面的突破。

paras.en: Artemis 2 Team. Returned astronauts to the vicinity of the moon for the first time in more than half a century, carrying NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover and Christina Koch and Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen on a nearly 10-day flight around the moon aboard Orion. The April mission brought together NASA, international partners and a vast industrial team supporting Orion, the Space Launch System and ground systems.
paras.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯2小队。半个多世纪以来，宇航员首次返回月球附近，美国宇航局宇航员里德·怀斯曼、维克多·格洛弗、克里斯蒂娜·科赫以及加拿大宇航员杰里米·汉森乘坐猎户座飞船进行了近 10 天的绕月飞行。四月份的任务汇集了美国宇航局、国际合作伙伴以及支持猎户座、太空发射系统和地面系统的庞大工业团队。

paras.en: Copernicus Sentinel-1D Team. Brought Sentinel-1D into full operations in May, restoring and strengthening Europe’s flagship radar Earth observation capability and continuing more than a decade of global environmental monitoring through Copernicus.
paras.zh: 哥白尼哨兵-1D 团队。 Sentinel-1D 于 5 月全面投入运行，恢复和加强了欧洲旗舰雷达地球观测能力，并通过哥白尼继续进行了十多年的全球环境监测。

paras.en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Team. Successfully launched NASA’s next flagship astrophysics observatory Aug. 30, beginning a mission designed to survey the universe far faster than Hubble while investigating dark energy, exoplanets and some of astronomy’s biggest unanswered questions.
paras.zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜团队。 8 月 30 日成功发射了 NASA 的下一个旗舰天体物理观测站，开始了一项旨在以比哈勃望远镜快得多的速度观测宇宙的任务，同时研究暗能量、系外行星和一些天文学上尚未解答的最大问题。

paras.en: Recognizing individuals, organizations and missions making significant contributions to national security space capabilities.
paras.zh: 表彰对国家安全太空能力做出重大贡献的个人、组织和任务。

paras.en: Gurpartap “GP” Sandhoo. Took leadership of the Space Development Agency while also becoming the Space Force’s portfolio acquisition executive for missile warning and tracking, overseeing deployment of the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture and its growing constellation of military satellites.
paras.zh: 古尔帕塔普·“GP”·桑胡。领导太空发展局，同时还成为太空部队负责导弹预警和跟踪的采购主管，监督扩散战士太空架构及其不断增长的军事卫星群的部署。

paras.en: Impulse Space. Expanded its national security role with a $28 million Space Force contract for a future space domain awareness mission using its highly maneuverable Mira spacecraft in low Earth orbit.
paras.zh: Impulse Space.通过一份价值 2800 万美元的太空部队合同，扩大了其在国家安全方面的作用，该合同将使用其高度机动的 Mira 航天器在近地轨道上执行未来的太空领域感知任务。

paras.en: SpaceWERX. Continued using the Space Force’s small-business innovation programs to move emerging commercial technologies toward military applications and broaden the pool of companies contributing to national security space.
paras.zh: SpaceWERX。继续利用太空军的小型企业创新计划，将新兴商业技术推向军事应用，并扩大为国家安全领域做出贡献的公司群体。

paras.en: VICTUS HAZE Team. Demonstrated the Space Force’s most advanced tactically responsive space mission to date, with Rocket Lab and True Anomaly spacecraft supporting realistic rendezvous and proximity operations and space domain awareness scenarios after a rapid-response launch campaign.
paras.zh: VICTUS HAZE 团队。展示了太空军迄今为止最先进的战术响应太空任务，火箭实验室和真实异常航天器在快速响应发射活动后支持现实的交会和接近操作以及空间域感知场景。

paras.en: Join us for the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards in Washington, D.C., on Dec. 1.
paras.zh: 请与我们一起参加 12 月 1 日在华盛顿特区举行的 2026 年太空新闻偶像奖。

articles.title: Jena-Optronik is proud to partner with MDA Space for its first ASTRO HP mission.
articles.author: Jena-Optronik

paras.en: MDA Space, a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, space exploration and infrastructure, will utilize Jena-Optronik’s ASTRO HP star sensor on a LEO mission. This milestone underscores our ability to provide cutting-edge technology that meets the demands of international space missions.
paras.zh: MDA Space 是通信卫星、地球和空间观测、太空探索和基础设施领域的全球领导者，将在低地球轨道任务中使用 Jena-Optronik 的 ASTRO HP 星传感器。这一里程碑强调了我们提供满足国际太空任务需求的尖端技术的能力。

paras.en: In a market that moves fast, the ASTRO HP optical head provides the perfect balance: high performance thanks to the radiation-hard Faintstar2 detector, the very fast optics in a compact, lightweight design optimized for small and medium-sized, high-performance satellites.
paras.zh: 在快速变化的市场中，ASTRO HP 光学头提供了完美的平衡：高性能得益于抗辐射 Faintstar2 探测器，非常快速的光学器件采用紧凑、轻量的设计，针对中小型高性能卫星进行了优化。

paras.en: The new sensor leverages the proven heritage of Jena Optronik technologies: combining the precision and agility of the ASTRO APS3 with the flight-proven electronics and software of the ASTRO CL, all unified by our easy-to-integrate ASTROlib software.
paras.zh: 新型传感器利用了 Jena Optronik 技术的成熟传统：将 ASTRO APS3 的精度和敏捷性与经过飞行验证的 ASTRO CL 电子设备和软件相结合，所有这些都通过我们易于集成的 ASTROlib 软件进行统一。

paras.en: The ASTRO HP optical head delivers next-level attitude accuracy and rate capabilities without forcing you to redesign your platform. This modular approach provides unique flexibility to tailor performance and cost directly to your mission specific needs.
paras.zh: ASTRO HP 光学头可提供更高水平的姿态精度和速率功能，而无需迫使您重新设计平台。这种模块化方法提供了独特的灵活性，可以直接根据您的任务特定需求定制性能和成本。

paras.en: Furthermore, the advanced ASTROlib enables specialized SSA capabilities. The first flight ready version will be rolled out for this particular program.
paras.zh: 此外，先进的 ASTROlib 还支持专门的 SSA 功能。第一个飞行就绪版本将针对该特定计划推出。

articles.title: UN aid operation underway in Nepal following fresh floods

paras.en: UN aid operation underway in Nepal following fresh floods
paras.zh: 联合国在尼泊尔发生新洪水后开展援助行动

paras.en: The United Nations has rushed to assist Nepal following new flash floods in the central Gorkha district on Sunday that swept away homes and bridges just weeks after catastrophic flooding in the north.
paras.zh: 周日，廓尔喀中部地区再次发生山洪，在北部发生灾难性洪水几周后，联合国已紧急向尼泊尔提供援助，洪水冲毁了房屋和桥梁。

paras.en: At least five people are missing and 95 have been rescued, according to the authorities. Hundreds are affected.
paras.zh: 据当局称，至少有 5 人失踪，95 人已获救。数百人受到影响。

paras.en: It is believed the disaster was caused by a landslide that blocked the Budhi Gandaki River.
paras.zh: 据信，这场灾难是由山体滑坡堵塞布迪甘达基河造成的。

paras.en: “Our hearts are with every family affected by the Budhi Gandaki floods,” the UN Country Team said on social media. “We stand with Nepal.”
paras.zh: 联合国国家工作队在社交媒体上表示：“我们的心与每一个受布迪甘达基洪水影响的家庭同在。” “我们与尼泊尔站在一起。”

paras.en: The UN is supporting the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) in getting food to those who lost their homes.
paras.zh: 联合国正在支持国家灾害风险减少和管理局（NDRRMA）为失去家园的人们提供食物。

paras.en: The World Food Programme (WFP) said on Sunday that three trucks carrying ready-to-eat food and relief supplies were on the way to help meet the immediate needs of affected communities.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）周日表示，三辆载有即食食品和救援物资的卡车正在路上，以帮助满足受影响社区的迫切需求。

paras.en: The “devastating” floods have damaged key roads, crops and livestock, threatening local food security, the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) said in a post on social media.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）在社交媒体上发帖称，“毁灭性”洪水损坏了主要道路、农作物和牲畜，威胁到当地粮食安全。

paras.en: The UN Country Team said FAO drones and satellite imagery by the UN humanitarian affairs office OCHA are being used to “map damage in places roads can’t reach.”
paras.zh: 联合国国家工作队表示，粮农组织无人机和联合国人道主义事务办公室人道协调厅提供的卫星图像被用来“绘制道路无法到达地区的受损情况”。

paras.en: The raging flood waters disrupted essential services that children and families rely on, including water supply, education and healthcare. Displaced families now require safe shelter, clean drinking water, child protection and psychosocial support
paras.zh: 汹涌的洪水扰乱了儿童和家庭赖以生存的基本服务，包括供水、教育和医疗保健。流离失所的家庭现在需要安全的住所、清洁的饮用水、儿童保护和社会心理支持

paras.en: UN children’s agency UNICEF is supporting rapid assessments to identify impacts and to determine priorities for the immediate response.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会正在支持快速评估，以确定影响并确定立即应对的优先事项。

paras.en: UNICEF also has stocks of emergency supplies pre-positioned and ready for deployment, including hygiene kits, water treatment supplies, dignity kits, winter clothing, education materials and psychosocial support services.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会还预先储备了应急物资储备，可供部署，包括卫生用品包、水处理用品、尊严包、冬季服装、教育材料和心理社会支持服务。

paras.en: Communities in Nepal are still reeling from the impact of flooding in late August that was triggered by a glacier collapse in the Himalayas. At least 1,400 people were killed and more than 5,000 are still missing.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔的社区仍在遭受八月下旬喜马拉雅山冰川崩塌引发的洪水的影响。至少1,400人死亡，5,000多人仍然失踪。

articles.title: Global action to end violence against children is lagging behind risks: UN expert

paras.en: Global action to end violence against children is lagging behind risks: UN expert
paras.zh: 联合国专家：结束暴力侵害儿童行为的全球行动落后于风险

paras.en: “Almost 45 million children are displaced because of conflict, but also because of natural disasters, because of the climate crisis,” said Najat Maalla M’jid, briefing journalists at UN Headquarters in New York on Monday.
paras.zh: “近 4500 万儿童因冲突、自然灾害和气候危机而流离失所，”纳贾特·马拉·姆吉德周一在纽约联合国总部向记者通报情况时表示。

paras.en: Food insecurity and the rapid spread of technology are also hampering efforts to reduce violence against children, Ms. M’jid noted, after delivering her final report to the General Assembly, which she described as “a wake-up call” for greater mobilization.
paras.zh: 姆吉德女士在向大会提交最终报告后指出，粮食不安全和技术的迅速普及也阻碍了减少暴力侵害儿童行为的努力，她称该报告为加强动员提供了“警钟”。

paras.en: Her presentation to Member States coincided with the 20th anniversary of the first-ever UN global study on violence against children. Although the world has changed since then, she highlighted “ongoing complex multiple crises” facing the international community in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic.
paras.zh: 她向会员国发表的演讲恰逢联合国首次关于暴力侵害儿童问题的全球研究 20 周年。尽管自那时以来世界发生了变化，但她强调了新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 大流行后国际社会面临的“持续的复杂多重危机”。

paras.en: Today, one in five children lives in extreme poverty “and not only in the poor countries but also in the wealthy countries despite all the money put in cash transfers, cash benefits, and so on”, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，如今，五分之一的儿童生活在极端贫困中，“不仅在贫穷国家，而且在富裕国家，尽管所有资金都投入了现金转移、现金福利等”。

paras.en: Other issues of concern include rising prices globally and food insecurity, while some countries are seeing a pushback against human rights.
paras.zh: 其他令人担忧的问题包括全球价格上涨和粮食不安全，而一些国家的人权却受到阻碍。

paras.en: Added to this is what she called “the wonderful, very, very quick spread of technology, including AI, that offers opportunity but opens huge avenues for child sexual exploitation, but also cyberbullying, deepfakes and enrollment in criminal activities”.
paras.zh: 除此之外，她所说的“包括人工智能在内的技术的奇妙、非常、快速的传播，提供了机会，但也为儿童性剥削、网络欺凌、深度伪造和参与犯罪活动开辟了巨大的途径”。

paras.en: Ms. M’jid began her remarks by reflecting on the 2006 UN study, which showed that violence against children occurs in every country and across all settings, whether at home, school, in the community and beyond.
paras.zh: 姆吉德女士首先回顾了 2006 年联合国的研究，该研究表明，针对儿童的暴力行为发生在每个国家和所有环境中，无论是在家庭、学校、社区还是其他地方。

paras.en: She recalled the years of work and engagement – including with children and young people – to produce the document.
paras.zh: 她回顾了多年来为编写这份文件所做的工作和参与——包括与儿童和年轻人的接触。

paras.en: “This landmark study really highlights two big principles: violence is always preventable and violence is never justifiable,” she said, noting that these messages were also reiterated in the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
paras.zh: 她说：“这项具有里程碑意义的研究确实强调了两大原则：暴力总是可以预防的，而暴力永远是没有道理的。”她指出，这些信息也在《2030 年可持续发展议程》中得到了重申。

paras.en: The Special Representative said the past two decades have brought legal and policy reforms, but also “many difficulties to effectively ensure their implementation and to make services accessible to children and their caregivers”.
paras.zh: 特别代表表示，过去二十年带来了法律和政策改革，但也“在有效确保其实施以及为儿童及其照顾者提供服务方面遇到了许多困难”。

paras.en: She pointed to “lessons learned”, such as the importance of having strong political commitment that translates into services that uphold child protection and well-being, with a dedicated budget.
paras.zh: 她指出了“经验教训”，例如拥有强有力的政治承诺的重要性，这种承诺可以转化为维护儿童保护和福祉的服务，并有专门的预算。

paras.en: She also hailed the increasing participation of children and youth at all levels, as well as stronger integrated services in all regions.
paras.zh: 她还赞扬各级儿童和青少年的参与不断增加，以及各地区综合服务的加强。

paras.en: “But the problem is that it is not put at scale, that we are not going fast,” she said. “The problem is our solutions are always lagging behind the risks.”
paras.zh: “但问题是，它没有规模化，我们进展不快，”她说。 “问题是我们的解决方案总是落后于风险。”

paras.en: Twenty years after the first UN General Assembly report on child violence, success in combating it still depends on effective multilateralism, Ms. M’jid said, specifically, how can children again unite the world to ensure their protection and well-being.
paras.zh: 姆吉德女士表示，在联合国大会首次发布关于儿童暴力的报告二十年后，打击儿童暴力的成功仍然取决于有效的多边主义，具体来说，儿童如何再次团结世界，确保他们的保护和福祉。

paras.en: She announced that 55 countries have joined the Pathfinding Global Alliance on Ending Violence against Children, “and more are coming”.
paras.zh: 她宣布已有 55 个国家加入了终止针对儿童的暴力行为探路全球联盟，“而且还会有更多国家加入”。

paras.en: Launched in 2024, the State-led platform aims to support countries in translating political commitments into concrete actions through measures such as peer learning, strengthening co-operation, and sharing practices.
paras.zh: 该平台于2024年启动，旨在支持各国通过同行学习、加强合作、分享实践等措施，将政治承诺转化为具体行动。

paras.en: Ms. M’jid concluded her remarks by stressing that children and young people are part of the solution to ending the violence they suffer.
paras.zh: 姆吉德女士最后强调，儿童和青少年是结束他们所遭受的暴力的解决方案的一部分。

paras.en: “Children are not waiting,” she said. “Children are already taking action.”
paras.zh: “孩子们不会等待，”她说。 “孩子们已经开始行动了。”

articles.title: Disasters cost $228 billion in housing losses every year

paras.en: Disasters cost $228 billion in housing losses every year
paras.zh: 每年因灾害造成的住房损失达 2,280 亿美元

paras.en: $228 billion is a staggering amount of money to find, but that’s exactly what communities around the world are faced with every year, to rebuild housing after disaster strikes.
paras.zh: 2280 亿美元是一个惊人的资金数额，但这正是世界各地社区每年在灾难发生后重建住房所面临的问题。

paras.en: Highlighting the need for greater investment in stronger homes and better preparedness, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said that millions of homes are damaged or destroyed annually “displacing families and deepening poverty”.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯强调需要加大投资力度，建设更坚固的房屋并做好更好的准备，他表示，每年有数百万房屋遭到破坏或摧毁，“导致家庭流离失所，贫困加剧”。

paras.en: Marking the International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction, the UN chief stressed that “as climate and disaster risks multiply, building safer dwellings is the shared responsibility of governments, developers, engineers and communities”.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长在纪念国际减少灾害风险日时强调，“随着气候和灾害风险的增加，建设更安全的住宅是政府、开发商、工程师和社区的共同责任”。

paras.en: Echoing that message, the UN Office for Disaster Risk Reduction – UNDRR – noted that damage to housing alone accounts for 43 per cent of the direct cost of cyclones, floods, tsunamis and earthquakes.
paras.zh: 联合国减少灾害风险办公室 (UNDRR) 响应这一信息，指出仅住房受损就占飓风、洪水、海啸和地震直接损失的 43%。

paras.en: Spokesperson Jeanette Elsworth stressed that reducing the impacts of disaster depended on building resilient homes and households that had prepared for the worst.
paras.zh: 发言人珍妮特·埃尔斯沃思强调，减少灾难的影响取决于建设有抵御能力的房屋和家庭，为最坏的情况做好准备。

paras.en: “Among those people who had received an advance warning during a disaster, only 27 per cent of those who had neither a household disaster plan nor confidence in their ability to protect themselves…were able to act on that warning,” she said, citing data from the Lloyd’s Register Foundation World Risk Poll 2026.
paras.zh: “在那些在灾难期间收到预先警告的人中，只有 27% 的人既没有家庭灾难计划，也不相信自己有能力保护自己……能够根据警告采取行动，”她引用劳埃德船级社基金会 2026 年世界风险民意调查的数据说。

paras.en: “By contrast, 83 per cent of those who had both a plan and confidence in their ability to respond were able to take action.”
paras.zh: “相比之下，83% 那些既有计划又对自己的应对能力充满信心的人能够采取行动。”

paras.en: Ms. Elsworth noted that progress in reducing disaster deaths over the last 11 years has not been matched by reductions in their economic impact.
paras.zh: 埃尔斯沃斯女士指出，过去 11 年在减少灾害死亡方面取得的进展并没有与其经济影响的减少相匹配。

paras.en: All households should have access to risk information, early warning alerts and the resources they need to protect themselves, she maintained, in a call to put housing resilience at the centre of disaster risk reduction efforts.
paras.zh: 她坚持认为，所有家庭都应该能够获得风险信息、预警警报以及保护自己所需的资源，并呼吁将住房抵御能力置于减少灾害风险工作的中心。

paras.en: Governments, the private sector and community authorities could do this by “building in safer locations, enforcing resilient building standards, retrofitting existing homes and empowering households with the knowledge and tools they need to prepare for disasters”, she continued.
paras.zh: 她继续说，政府、私营部门和社区当局可以通过“在更安全的地点进行建设、执行弹性建筑标准、改造现有房屋以及向家庭提供应对灾难所需的知识和工具”来做到这一点。

paras.en: The UN International Organization for Migration (IOM) helped 1.4 million people in 2025 across 39 countries with disaster risk reduction programmes, supporting nearly 1,200 communities.
paras.zh: 联合国国际移民组织 (IOM) 到 2025 年通过减少灾害风险项目帮助了 39 个国家的 140 万人，支持了近 1,200 个社区。

paras.en: Maria Moita, Director, Department of Humanitarian Response and Recovery at IOM, said that for many people, the end of a disaster is “only the beginning of a much longer struggle to return home, restore livelihoods and rebuild their lives”.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织人道主义应对和恢复部主任玛丽亚·莫伊塔表示，对许多人来说，灾难的结束“只是返回家园、恢复生计和重建生活的更长期斗争的开始”。

paras.en: The agency also helped extend early warning coverage to more than 1.2 million people.
paras.zh: 该机构还帮助将预警覆盖范围扩大到超过 120 万人。

paras.en: Recent emergencies in Nepal, Venezuela and Colombia have demonstrated how planning for disaster and data gathering can have a significant bearing on recovery.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔、委内瑞拉和哥伦比亚最近发生的紧急情况表明，灾难规划和数据收集可以对恢复产生重大影响。

paras.en: In Nepal, where devastating flooding caused by a glacier collapsing in August affected more than 84,000 people and damaged approximately 7,500 homes, IOM assessments across 48 displacement sites identified 3,650 displaced people and 28 sites still operational.
paras.zh: 在尼泊尔，8 月份冰川崩塌引发的毁灭性洪水影响了超过 84,000 人，并损坏了约 7,500 所房屋，国际移民组织对 48 个流离失所地点的评估发现，有 3,650 名流离失所者，28 个营地仍在运作。

paras.en: In Venezuela, following the June earthquakes, the agency assisted 50,600 people, providing temporary accommodation, essential supplies, health care and protection.
paras.zh: 在委内瑞拉，六月地震后，该机构向 50,600 人提供了援助，提供临时住所、基本用品、医疗保健和保护。

paras.en: Surveys indicated that more than half of affected households identified housing repairs as a priority. “The lesson was clear: recovery planning had to begin early, before temporary displacement became prolonged,” Ms. Moita stressed.
paras.zh: 调查显示，超过一半的受影响家庭将房屋维修作为首要任务。 “教训很明确：在临时流离失所时间延长之前，恢复计划必须尽早开始，”莫伊塔女士强调。

paras.en: In Colombia, an earthquake in August reportedly affected nearly 500,000 people and damaged more than 200,000 homes, leaving an estimated 20,000 families displaced in Cali.
paras.zh: 据报道，哥伦比亚 8 月发生的地震影响了近 50 万人，超过 20 万所房屋受损，卡利估计有 2 万个家庭流离失所。

paras.en: “Rebuilding homes alone is not enough, communities also need functioning services and opportunities to rebuild their lives,” the IOM official noted.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织官员指出：“仅重建家园是不够的，社区还需要有效的服务和重建生活的机会。”

paras.en: “We need sustained investment in early warnings, local preparedness, safer housing, and recovery efforts that begin from the outset and build resilience. Disasters may strike suddenly. Displacement can last much longer,” Ms. Moita said.
paras.zh: “我们需要在早期预警、地方准备、更安全的住房以及从一开始就建立复原力的恢复工作方面进行持续投资。灾害可能会突然发生。流离失所的情况可能会持续更长时间，”莫伊塔女士说。

articles.title: McIlroy: LIV Golf was half a good idea

paras.en: Rory McIlroy says LIV Golf was 'half a good idea, executed poorly' but would welcome players back to DP World Tour
paras.zh: 罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 表示 LIV Golf “只是一个好主意，但执行得很糟糕”，但欢迎球员重返 DP 世界巡回赛

paras.en: Speaking ahead of DP World India Championship, Rory McIlroy speaks about LIV Golf, saying breakaway was 'half a good idea, executed poorly'; Northern Irishman no longer feels LIV Golf is threat following PIF's withdrawal of support; McIlroy says he would welcome LIV players back
paras.zh: 在 DP 世界印度锦标赛之前，罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 在谈到 LIV Golf 时表示，突破“只是一个好主意，但执行得很糟糕”； PIF 撤回支持后，北爱尔兰人不再认为 LIV Golf 是威胁；麦克罗伊表示他欢迎 LIV 球员回归

paras.en: Rory McIlroy believes LIV Golf was "half a good idea, executed poorly" and the breakaway is no longer a threat to the traditional game as it tries to relaunch after filing for bankruptcy.
paras.zh: 罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 认为 LIV Golf 是“半个好主意，但执行得很糟糕”，这种分离不再对传统运动构成威胁，因为它试图在申请破产后重新启动。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) ploughed in £3.7bn over four years, luring the likes of Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau away from the PGA Tour, before withdrawing its support this year.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金 (PIF) 在四年内投入了 37 亿英镑，吸引了琼·拉姆 (Jon Rahm) 和布赖森·德尚博 (Bryson DeChambeau) 等人退出美巡赛，但今年又撤回了支持。

paras.en: That led to Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings in the United States with a view to relaunching as LIV 2.0, having received a potential $300m (£227m) backing from BC Partners Capital providing a specified number of players re-sign for the new venture.
paras.zh: 这导致了美国破产法第 11 章破产程序，旨在以 LIV 2.0 的形式重新启动，并获得 BC Partners Capital 潜在的 3 亿美元（2.27 亿英镑）支持，提供指定数量的玩家重新签约新公司。

paras.en: Rahm has already announced he will not be continuing and news this week that any player signing up for LIV will be barred from DP World Tour membership and Ryder Cup eligibility has delivered a crippling blow.
paras.zh: 拉姆已经宣布他将不再继续比赛，本周有消息称，任何签约 LIV 的球员都将被禁止获得 DP 世界巡回赛会员资格，而莱德杯资格也带来了沉重打击。

paras.en: "LIV had probably like, half of a good idea that was executed pretty poorly," McIlroy told the Bloomberg New Economy forum in New Delhi, where he is playing this week in the DP World India Championship.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊在新德里举行的彭博新经济论坛上表示：“LIV 可能有一半的好想法执行得很糟糕。”麦克罗伊本周将参加新德里的 DP 世界印度锦标赛。

paras.en: "They had a lot of capital but I think a lot of that capital was wasted in some ways and I think they could have used that money a lot more strategically and could have partnered with some of the governing bodies of the game and certainly could have done better things with it instead of just enriching tour pros who were already making a lot of money.
paras.zh: “他们有很多资本，但我认为很多资本在某些方面都被浪费了，我认为他们可以更有战略性地使用这些钱，可以与比赛的一些管理机构合作，当然可以用它做更好的事情，而不是仅仅让已经赚了很多钱的巡回赛职业选手变得更加富有。

paras.en: "BC Partners have come in and seen an opportunity (but) it looks like every day that goes by there's another player that was on LIV who is not going to join LIV 2.0 so I think it is going to be very difficult to get out of this Chapter 11 bankruptcy and go forward.
paras.zh: “BC Partners 进来并看到了机会，但看起来每天都有另一位 LIV 参与者不会加入 LIV 2.0，所以我认为摆脱第 11 章破产并继续前进将非常困难。

paras.en: "But if they do it is certainly not going to be a threat to the traditional order of the game as it once was."
paras.zh: “但如果他们这样做，肯定不会像以前那样对传统的比赛秩序构成威胁。”

paras.en: A more pertinent issue now seems to be what happens to those players quitting LIV.
paras.zh: 现在一个更相关的问题似乎是那些退出 LIV 的玩家会发生什么。

paras.en: The PGA Tour invokes a one-year suspension, denying them access until August next year, and while the DP World Tour has stiffened its rules its membership remains divided.
paras.zh: PGA 巡回赛暂停了一年，直到明年 8 月才允许他们参赛，尽管 DP 世界巡回赛加强了规则，但其会员资格仍然存在分歧。

paras.en: "I'm sure some members who stayed loyal would feel hard done by if these guys can just walk straight back in but, on the other side, having these players back on the tour is good for business and it can drive revenues up and everyone can benefit from that," added McIlroy.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊补充道：“我确信，如果这些人能够直接回归，一些保持忠诚的会员会感到很难受，但另一方面，让这些球员重返巡回赛对生意有利，可以增加收入，每个人都可以从中受益。”

paras.en: "I would vote for them to come back. A rising tide lifts all boats and I think having some of these players back is beneficial for the business of the tours."
paras.zh: “我会投票支持他们回来。水涨船高，我认为其中一些球员的回归对巡回赛的业务有利。”

paras.en: It is not a view shared by six-time DP World Tour winner Joost Luiten.
paras.zh: 六届 DP 世界巡回赛冠军 Joost Luiten 并不认同这种观点。

paras.en: "Four years ago they didn't give a s*** about the DP World Tour," he told Today's Golfer.
paras.zh: “四年前，他们根本不在乎 DP 世界巡回赛，”他告诉《今日高尔夫球手》。

paras.en: "They made a decision to go after the money and now all of a sudden, the money is gone and they want to come back and act like nothing happened. I don't think that's right.
paras.zh: “他们决定去追钱，但现在突然间，钱不见了，他们想回来装作什么都没发生过。我认为这是不对的。”

paras.en: "If they think they are that good then show it at Q-School (qualifying school) and beat the guys. That's how every other guy that wants to play on this tour has to go."
paras.zh: “如果他们认为自己有那么好，那么就在Q-School（资格学校）展示自己并击败其他人。这就是其他每个想参加这次巡回赛的人都必须走的路。”

articles.title: Energy prices rise after Trump’s ‘energy ceasefire’ fails to move Russia or Ukraine
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: Oil and gas prices rose Monday after an “energy ceasefire” announced by President Donald Trump on Sunday failed to gain traction.
paras.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普总统周日宣布的“能源停火”未能获得支持后，石油和天然气价格周一上涨。

paras.en: Brent crude oil jumped 2% to almost $108 per barrel and U.S. crude oil rose more than 2% to about $94. Meanwhile, diesel futures fully erased a small drop they saw last week.
paras.zh: 布伦特原油上涨 2%，至每桶近 108 美元，美国原油上涨超过 2%，至每桶约 94 美元。与此同时，柴油期货完全消除了上周的小幅下跌。

paras.en: Just weeks out from the Nov. 3 midterm elections, the price pressures are mounting. Republicans face a steep climb to maintain their majorities in Congress, and voters across the country cite high gas prices as a key issue affecting their votes.
paras.zh: 距离 11 月 3 日中期选举仅几周时间，价格压力就在不断加大。共和党人为了维持在国会的多数席位而面临着大幅攀升，全国各地的选民都将高油价视为影响他们选票的一个关键问题。

paras.en: The average nationwide price of diesel fuel Monday was $6.26 per gallon, nearly 80% higher than it had been at the start of the year, according to AAA data.
paras.zh: 根据 AAA 的数据，周一全国柴油平均价格为每加仑 6.26 美元，比年初上涨近 80%。

paras.en: The rising prices Monday came less than 24 hours after Trump declared that a ceasefire had been agreed to.
paras.zh: 周一价格上涨是在特朗普宣布同意停火后不到 24 小时。

paras.en: “Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!” Trump wrote on Truth Social.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争已实现能源停火，立即生效。双方都已同意。不要破坏它！”特朗普在《真相社会》上撰文。

paras.en: Shortly after the president’s post, Russia renewed strikes against Ukrainian energy assets.
paras.zh: 总统上任后不久，俄罗斯再次对乌克兰能源资产发动袭击。

paras.en: Pressed by reporters Monday as to why neither the Kremlin nor Kyiv had firmly committed to his ceasefire, Trump indicated that he knew when he made the announcement on Sunday that he did not yet have a commitment from either side.
paras.zh: 周一，在被记者追问为何克里姆林宫和基辅都没有坚定地承诺停火时，特朗普表示，当他周日宣布这一消息时，他知道双方都还没有做出承诺。

paras.en: “They agreed, you know why? Because I said ‘You agree,” Trump told reporters at the White House. As for getting Russian President Vladimir Putin to commit, Trump said, “We’re going to see what happens.”
paras.zh: “他们同意了，你知道为什么吗？因为我说‘你同意’，”特朗普在白宫对记者说。至于让俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京做出承诺，特朗普表示，“我们将看看会发生什么。”

paras.en: Asked if he was aware that Russia had already violated the ceasefire Trump had announced, the president replied, “I’m not sure about that,” before claiming there had been “violations on both sides.”
paras.zh: 当被问及是否知道俄罗斯已经违反了特朗普宣布的停火协议时，总统回答说，“我不确定”，然后声称“双方都违反了协议”。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine learned about Trump’s ceasefire from media reports and was given no advance warning. He reiterated his position that Ukraine was open to an agreement not to target enemy energy infrastructure as long as Moscow agrees to it, too.
paras.zh: 总统泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰是从媒体报道中得知特朗普停火的，并且没有收到任何提前警告。他重申了自己的立场，即只要莫斯科也同意，乌克兰就不会以敌方能源基础设施为目标的协议持开放态度。

paras.en: In the meantime, Russia continued with “glide bomb strikes and strikes on our energy infrastructure,” Zelenskyy said Monday, noting that a power plant in Kharkiv had recently been attacked.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯继续“对我们的能源基础设施进行滑翔炸弹袭击”，泽连斯基周一表示，并指出哈尔科夫的一座发电厂最近遭到袭击。

paras.en: “Ukraine has proposed many de-escalatory steps. Putin had one answer to all of them — ‘nyet,’” Zelenskyy said, using the Russian word for “no.”
paras.zh: “乌克兰提出了许多缓和局势的措施。普京对所有这些措施只有一个答案——‘不’，”泽连斯基说，他用的是俄语中的“不”一词。

paras.en: The Kremlin on Monday neither confirmed nor denied having agreed to a deal.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周一既没有证实也没有否认已同意达成协议。

paras.en: Trump’s Sunday announcement closely mirrored a similar post he made in September, when he announced that “Ukraine has agreed not to hit Russian Energy targets. Russia has agreed to do, likewise!”
paras.zh: 特朗普周日的声明与他九月份发表的类似帖子非常相似，当时他宣布“乌克兰已同意不攻击俄罗斯的能源目标。俄罗斯也同意这样做！”

paras.en: There, too, Zelenskyy said Ukraine’s participation hinged on Russia’s agreement to comply, which never came. Neither Ukrainian nor Russian strikes on the other’s energy assets slowed down in September.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基也表示，乌克兰的参与取决于俄罗斯是否同意遵守，但俄罗斯从未同意遵守。 9月份，乌克兰和俄罗斯对对方能源资产的打击都没有放缓。

paras.en: The dubious ceasefire Trump declared over the weekend followed a stunning announcement Friday in which the president said Russia would supply millions of barrels of diesel “to the American and Global Marketplace.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周末宣布的可疑停火是在周五发布的令人震惊的声明之后宣布的，其中总统表示俄罗斯将“向美国和全球市场”供应数百万桶柴油。

paras.en: The announcement came after a phone call Friday between Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin that reportedly lasted over an hour.
paras.zh: 据报道，周五特朗普与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行了长达一个多小时的通话后宣布了这一消息。

paras.en: Trump said the deal with Putin would “immediately supply over 300,000 Tons of Diesel Fuel to the American and Global Marketplace.” That would translate into about 2.25 million barrels of diesel, or less diesel than the United States uses in just one day.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，与普京的协议将“立即向美国和全球市场供应超过 30 万吨柴油”。这意味着约 225 万桶柴油，比美国一天使用的柴油还要少。

paras.en: Further details and logistics of Russia’s plan had yet to be announced Monday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯计划的更多细节和后勤工作尚未于周一公布。

paras.en: In addition to the Russia deal, Trump has pressured G7 allies to release more diesel fuel supplies in recent days and lifted domestic restrictions on an off-road variety of diesel.
paras.zh: 除了与俄罗斯的协议外，特朗普最近几天还向七国集团盟友施压，要求释放更多柴油供应，并取消了国内对越野柴油的限制。

paras.en: In order to clear a legal path for the diesel deal, the Treasury Department announced a six-month suspension of the fuel sanctions imposed on the Kremlin in 2022 for its illegal invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 为了为柴油交易扫清法律道路，美国财政部宣布暂停对克里姆林宫2022年因非法入侵乌克兰而实施的燃料制裁六个月。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials, European allies and some U.S. lawmakers were aghast at the deal and the U.S. decision to unilaterally ease Russia sanctions.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员、欧洲盟友和一些美国议员对该协议以及美国单方面放松对俄罗斯制裁的决定感到震惊。

paras.en: Trump defended the deal Monday, calling it “the right choice for the American People.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周一为该协议辩护，称其为“美国人民的正确选择”。

paras.en: Trump also said more diesel fuel would be made available “within a short period of time,” if Russia’s refineries could produce it.
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，如果俄罗斯炼油厂能够生产更多柴油，“在短时间内”将提供更多柴油。

paras.en: Yet experts are highly skeptical that there will be any significant resumption of Russian diesel exports in the near term.
paras.zh: 然而，专家们对俄罗斯柴油出口短期内能否大幅恢复持高度怀疑态度。

paras.en: Due to Ukrainian strikes deep inside Russia, refiners that produce oil, gas and diesel have suffered heavy damage.
