paras.zh: 由于乌克兰对俄罗斯境内的袭击，生产石油、天然气和柴油的炼油厂遭受了严重损失。

paras.en: “Reported gasoline output is down by 20% compared with 2025 levels, while diesel production is estimated to have fallen by nearly 30%, prompting the government to restrict fuel exports to protect domestic supplies,” analysts at the International Energy Agency wrote in a September report.
paras.zh: 国际能源署分析师在 9 月份的一份报告中写道：“与 2025 年水平相比，报告的汽油产量下降了 20%，而柴油产量估计下降了近 30%，促使政府限制燃料出口以保护国内供应。”

paras.en: For weeks, Trump has focused on the price of diesel fuel, which began rising as a result of the Iran war that the U.S. and Israel launched in February.
paras.zh: 几周来，特朗普一直关注柴油价格，由于美国和以色列二月份发动伊朗战争，柴油价格开始上涨。

paras.en: In July, escalations in the Russia-Ukraine war began adding to the pressure on diesel prices.
paras.zh: 7月份，俄罗斯和乌克兰战争的升级开始加大柴油价格的压力。

paras.en: As Ukrainian drones systematically targeted Russian energy assets, the Kremlin responded by restricting diesel exports in order to preserve its supply for domestic use.
paras.zh: 当乌克兰无人机有系统地瞄准俄罗斯能源资产时，克里姆林宫的回应是限制柴油出口，以保留其国内使用的供应。

paras.en: Until then, Russia had been one of the world’s top exporters of refined oil products, which include diesel fuel.
paras.zh: 在此之前，俄罗斯一直是世界上最大的成品油出口国之一，其中包括柴油。

paras.en: Russia said Friday that it would lift some of its export restrictions in order to accommodate the deal with Trump. But it was unclear how fast that would happen.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯周五表示，将取消部分出口限制，以适应与特朗普的协议。但尚不清楚这会发生多快。

articles.title: Britain faces ‘new era’ of security threats from Iran and Russia, MI5 says
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: LONDON — Iran is escalating its campaign of threats on British soil, expanding attacks beyond dissidents abroad and Jewish sites to now focusing on harder military targets, the country’s domestic intelligence chief said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 伦敦——伊朗国内情报负责人周二表示，伊朗正在升级对英国领土的威胁行动，将攻击范围从国外持不同政见者和犹太场所扩大到现在的重点军事目标。

paras.en: MI5 Director General Ken McCallum was speaking less than two weeks after the United States rushed to withdraw its bombers from a key air base in England, with American officials saying there had been reports of a possible Iranian drone attack.
paras.zh: 军情五处局长肯·麦卡勒姆在美国紧急从英国一个重要空军基地撤出轰炸机不到两周后发表了上述讲话，美国官员表示，有报道称伊朗可能发动无人机袭击。

paras.en: Giving a wide-ranging “annual threat update” at MI5’s Thames House headquarters in London, McCallum warned that Britain and Europe had “entered a new era of national security,” which he likened to the shift that came after the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001.
paras.zh: 麦卡勒姆在伦敦军情五处泰晤士宫总部发布了内容广泛的“年度威胁更新”，警告说英国和欧洲已经“进入了国家安全的新时代”，他将其比作 2001 年 9 月 11 日恐怖袭击后发生的转变。

paras.en: His speech comes at a moment of tumult not just for the Middle East and Ukraine, which continue to be ravaged by war, but also the rest of Europe, which has suffered so-called hybrid aggression from Moscow and Tehran including sabotage, arson and cyberattacks. European governments are now openly telling people to stockpile food and prepare for more of their taxes to be spent on defense, warning that Russia may launch a direct attack on their soil.
paras.zh: 他发表讲话之际，不仅中东和乌克兰继续遭受战争蹂躏，欧洲其他地区也陷入动荡，欧洲其他地区遭受了莫斯科和德黑兰所谓的混合侵略，包括破坏、纵火和网络攻击。欧洲各国政府现在公开告诉人们储存食物，并准备将更多税收用于国防，并警告俄罗斯可能对他们的土地发动直接攻击。

paras.en: MI5 is now devoting more resources than it had during the Cold War to countering threats from countries such as Russia, Iran, China and others, McCallum said.
paras.zh: 麦卡勒姆表示，军情五处现在比冷战期间投入更多资源来应对来自俄罗斯、伊朗、中国等国家的威胁。

paras.en: “Russia remains aggressor No. 1, as Putin’s Kremlin continues to lash out at the U.K. and its allies,” he added.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯仍然是第一大侵略者，因为普京的克里姆林宫继续猛烈抨击英国及其盟友，”他补充说。

paras.en: But another arch belligerent is Iran, whose leaders have been “attempting to expand their hybrid campaign” of “using criminal proxies to try to intimidate oppositionists, Iranian media organizations and Israeli sites,” the spy chief said.
paras.zh: 但另一个主要交战国是伊朗，这位间谍负责人表示，伊朗领导人一直在“试图扩大他们的混合行动”，即“利用犯罪代理人试图恐吓反对派、伊朗媒体组织和以色列网站”。

paras.en: “Much of this aggression has been aimed at British Jewish communities, with whom I want to express solidarity,” he said. But this year has seen a shift of “Iranian ambitions to come at harder targets, like military sites.”
paras.zh: “这种侵略行为很大程度上是针对英国犹太社区，我想向他们表示声援，”他说。但今年，“伊朗的野心发生了转变，转向更难的目标，比如军事地点。”

paras.en: Over the past year, intelligence operations have led to more than 50 Iran-linked arrests in Britain, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，过去一年，情报行动导致英国逮捕了 50 多名与伊朗有关的人。

paras.en: McCallum made reference to the incident last month at RAF Fairford, the military base in rural England from where the U.S. had been launching bombers involved in the assault against Iran. He declined to give details, citing ongoing investigations and operations, but said the case was “not unique.”
paras.zh: 麦卡勒姆提到了上个月在英国乡村地区的英国皇家空军费尔福德军事基地发生的事件，美国一直从那里发射轰炸机参与对伊朗的袭击。他以正在进行的调查和行动为由拒绝透露细节，但表示此案“并非独一无二”。

paras.en: Details are hazy, but in the early hours of Sept. 27, a member of the public called the police after spotting three vans in a country lane near the base. Seven men in their 20s, one of them a dual British-Iranian national, have been arrested and released on bail. Authorities said they found only gasoline in the vehicles.
paras.zh: 细节尚不清楚，但 9 月 27 日凌晨，一名公众在基地附近的乡村小路上发现三辆货车后报了警。七名 20 多岁的男子被捕，现已获保释，其中一名拥有英国和伊朗双重国籍。当局表示，他们在车内只发现了汽油。

paras.en: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham told lawmakers in Parliament on Monday that the incident “is highly likely to have been coordinated in Iran, almost certainly directed” by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, the powerful political, military and economic group that holds huge sway in the country.
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆周一在议会对议员们表示，这起事件“极有可能是在伊朗境内协调的，几乎可以肯定是由伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队指挥的”，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队是一个在该国拥有巨大影响力的强大政治、军事和经济组织。

paras.en: A week after the incident, Washington hastily withdrew its bombers from the base because, according to two U.S. officials, of reports of a possible drone attack against the site.
paras.zh: 事件发生一周后，华盛顿匆忙从该基地撤出轰炸机，据两名美国官员称，因为有报道称该基地可能遭到无人机袭击。

paras.en: On Tuesday, McCallum downplayed fears that Iran could mount such a complex attack, saying it has so far been hiring unsophisticated criminals for operations in the United Kingdom. But he warned that could change.
paras.zh: 周二，麦卡勒姆淡化了人们对伊朗可能发动如此复杂袭击的担忧，称伊朗迄今为止一直在雇佣简单的犯罪分子在英国开展行动。但他警告说，这种情况可能会改变。

paras.en: On Russia, McCallum said its military and intelligence services “are once again escalating their attempts at hybrid warfare,” being careful not to trigger NATO’s Article 5 threshold, in which other countries would be expected to defend their allies.
paras.zh: 关于俄罗斯，麦卡勒姆表示，俄罗斯的军事和情报部门“再次加大混合战争的尝试”，小心翼翼地不要触发北约第五条的门槛，根据该门槛，其他国家将保卫自己的盟友。

paras.en: “We see them scrambling to pay criminals to do their bidding,” he said. “The whole aim of hybrid tactics is to try to intimidate us.”
paras.zh: “我们看到他们争先恐后地付钱给犯罪分子来执行他们的命令，”他说。 “混合战术的全部目的就是试图恐吓我们。”

paras.en: Within the U.K.’s “multifaceted relationship with China” — Beijing is a major trading partner to London — MI5 has been focused on efforts by the Chinese government “to conduct espionage, coercion or democratic interference.”
paras.zh: 在英国“与中国的多方面关系”中——北京是伦敦的主要贸易伙伴——军情五处一直专注于中国政府“进行间谍活动、胁迫或民主干涉”的活动。

paras.en: On Al Qaeda and the Islamic State terrorist group, or ISIS, MI5 still has to respond “to attempts to carry out mass casualty attacks,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说，对于基地组织和伊斯兰国恐怖组织，军情五处仍然必须对“企图实施造成大规模伤亡的袭击”做出反应。

paras.en: But perhaps the gravest warning came when it came to artificial intelligence, which he said in the future could be used by terrorist groups and other actors to create new “bioweapons.”
paras.zh: 但最严重的警告也许是在人工智能方面，他表示，未来可能被恐怖组织和其他行为者用来制造新的“生物武器”。

paras.en: And “beyond misuse of AI by human adversaries sit the potential risks posed by AI itself,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说，“除了人类对手滥用人工智能之外，还有人工智能本身带来的潜在风险。”

paras.en: “Put at its simplest, human history has given us no experience of facing an actor which is smarter than we are. Is capable of out-thinking us. This is genuinely novel. And deserves the serious attention it is getting, including in MI5.”
paras.zh: “最简单地说，人类历史上从未有过面对比我们更聪明的演员的经历。能够超越我们。这确实是新颖的。值得认真关注，包括军情五处。”

articles.title: Why advanced U.S. weapons aren’t stopping Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has one of the world’s most expensive and sophisticated arsenals, filled with American warplanes, missile defenses and other cutting-edge technology.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯拥有世界上最昂贵、最先进的军火库之一，里面装满了美国战机、导弹防御系统和其他尖端技术。

paras.en: But in recent days it has appeared helpless in the face of barrages of missiles and drones fired by the Houthi rebel group from neighboring Yemen. The attacks have struck Saudi airports, killed at least 14 people and forced schoolchildren and businesspeople to stay indoors and work from home.
paras.zh: 但最近几天，面对邻国也门胡塞叛乱组织发射的导弹和无人机的攻击，它显得无能为力。这些袭击袭击了沙特机场，造成至少 14 人死亡，并迫使学童和商人呆在室内在家工作。

paras.en: The Iran-backed Houthis, once seen as little more than a ragtag militia, have grown into a formidable fighting force. They have inflicted damage on the region’s top oil producer, threatened critical supply routes in the Red Sea and now risk reigniting a full-scale war on the Arabian Peninsula that displaced millions and killed tens of thousands.
paras.zh: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装曾经被视为一支乌合之众的民兵，如今已发展成为一支强大的战斗力量。他们对该地区最大的石油生产国造成了损害，威胁了红海的关键供应路线，现在还可能在阿拉伯半岛重新引发一场全面战争，造成数百万人流离失所、数万人死亡。

paras.en: The Houthis are attacking Saudi Arabia because it supports government forces in Yemen the rebels seek to overthrow. As Saudi Arabia investigates how its air defenses failed to stop the Houthis’ attacks, it must also consider how to respond and what the rebels might do next.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装正在攻击沙特阿拉伯，因为它支持叛军试图推翻的也门政府军。当沙特阿拉伯调查其防​​空系统为何未能阻止胡塞武装的袭击时，它还必须考虑如何应对以及叛军下一步可能采取的行动。

paras.en: Here’s what we know and don’t know about the Saudi and Houthi conflict:
paras.zh: 以下是我们对沙特和胡塞武装冲突的了解和不了解：

paras.en: Saudi Arabia is the world’s top purchaser of American weapons, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute. It says the Saudis received 12% of all U.S. arms exports from 2021-2025.
paras.zh: 根据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所的数据，沙特阿拉伯是全球最大的美国武器购买国。报告称，2021年至2025年期间，沙特获得了美国所有武器出口的12%。

paras.en: Over the years, the Saudis have purchased American F-15 warplanes, Patriot air defense systems, as well as advanced radars and offensive missile systems, according to the think tank, which tracks global arms transfers.
paras.zh: 据追踪全球武器转让的智库称，多年来，沙特购买了美国的 F-15 战机、爱国者防空系统以及先进雷达和进攻性导弹系统。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s annual budget for 2026 listed $83 billion for military expenditures. Earlier this year, it struck a $9 billion deal with Washington for 730 Patriot missiles.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯2026年年度预算列出了830亿美元的军费开支。今年早些时候，它与华盛顿达成了价值 90 亿美元的 730 枚爱国者导弹协议。

paras.en: The Houthis have been able to exploit Saudi Arabia’s large size.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装已经能够利用沙特阿拉伯的庞大面积。

paras.en: Vulnerable energy, civilian and military assets are scattered across the country’s sparsely populated territory roughly three times the size of Texas. Its border with Yemen stretches more than 800 miles through rugged desert areas.
paras.zh: 脆弱的能源、民用和军事资产分散在该国人口稀少的地区，面积大约是德克萨斯州的三倍。它与也门的边界绵延 800 多英里，穿过崎岖的沙漠地区。

paras.en: “Expecting a country the size of Saudi Arabia to intercept every missile is simply unrealistic. No defense can guarantee complete protection,” Ali Shihabi, a Saudi analyst, said in a post online Monday.
paras.zh: “指望像沙特阿拉伯这样大的国家拦截每一枚导弹是不现实的。任何防御措施都不能保证完全保护，”沙特分析师阿里·谢哈比周一在网上发帖称。

paras.en: At the same time, regional officials say that Saudi Arabia is running low on interceptors and has reached out to allies for help.
paras.zh: 与此同时，地区官员表示，沙特阿拉伯的拦截弹所剩无几，已向盟友寻求帮助。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia recently struck a joint defense pact with Pakistan and Turkey. But so far, the two countries appear to be largely staying on the sidelines or limiting their support.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯最近与巴基斯坦和土耳其达成了联合防御协议。但到目前为止，两国似乎基本上保持观望或限制支持。

paras.en: President Donald Trump said this week he is evaluating whether the U.S. should join Saudi strikes on the Houthis. But he has not yet announced a decision.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统本周表示，他正在评估美国是否应该加入沙特对胡塞武装的打击。但他尚未宣布决定。

paras.en: Like their patron Iran, the Houthis have deployed asymmetric warfare for the 21st century by capitalizing on their strengths — primarily drones and missiles. For the Houthis, success on the battlefield doesn’t require toppling Saudi Arabia; disrupting the Saudi economy and sowing fear within its society may be enough to give the Houthis leverage in any possible negotiations to end the fighting.
paras.zh: 与他们的赞助人伊朗一样，胡塞武装利用自己的优势（主要是无人机和导弹）部署了 21 世纪的不对称战争。对于胡塞武装来说，在战场上取得成功并不需要推翻沙特阿拉伯；扰乱沙特经济并在社会中散布恐惧可能足以让胡塞武装在任何可能结束战斗的谈判中发挥影响力。

paras.en: The Houthis have a large arsenal capable of striking targets well over 1,000 miles away. Some warheads change direction during flight and pose an extra challenge to air defenses.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装拥有庞大的武器库，能够打击 1000 英里外的目标。有些弹头在飞行过程中会改变方向，对防空系统构成额外挑战。

paras.en: The group has fired hundreds of drones and missiles at Israel since its war in Gaza erupted in October 2023. While most were intercepted, a handful managed to land, in one case killing an Israeli man. Another strike hit an Israeli airport last year.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 10 月加沙战争爆发以来，该组织已向以色列发射了数百架无人机和导弹。虽然大多数被拦截，但少数成功着陆，其中一次杀死了一名以色列男子。去年，另一次袭击袭击了以色列机场。

paras.en: Andreas Krieg, a professor at King’s College London, said this experience in challenging Israel’s cutting-edge air defenses has given the Houthis confidence and expertise as they now strike Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院教授安德烈亚斯·克里格表示，挑战以色列尖端防空系统的经验让胡塞武装在袭击沙特阿拉伯时充满了信心和专业知识。

paras.en: “They’ve learned how to over-saturate the radars,” he said.
paras.zh: “他们已经学会了如何使雷达过度饱和，”他说。

paras.en: The Houthis, working with allied militias in Iraq, have also targeted Saudi oil installations, including a vital pipeline used to export oil through the Red Sea while movement through the Strait of Hormuz is limited. The Houthis have also seized territory in Yemen near the Bab el-Mandeb, a key Red Sea waterway, putting additional pressure on Saudi oil exports.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装与伊拉克的盟军民兵合作，还瞄准了沙特的石油设施，包括一条用于通过红海出口石油的重要管道，而通过霍尔木兹海峡的活动受到限制。胡塞武装还占领了也门红海重要水道曼德海峡附近的领土，给沙特石油出口带来了额外压力。

paras.en: Michael Ratney, a former U.S. ambassador to Saudi Arabia, says the kingdom assumed the Houthis wouldn’t strike civilian targets like airports. Doing so marked “a paradigm shift,” he said.
paras.zh: 美国前驻沙特阿拉伯大使迈克尔·拉特尼表示，沙特本以为胡塞武装不会袭击机场等民用目标。他说，这样做标志着“范式转变”。

paras.en: Ratney, now an adviser at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, said the Saudis now find themselves in a position where they have to respond while also trying to prevent the fighting from spinning out of control.
paras.zh: 现任战略与国际研究中心顾问的拉特尼表示，沙特现在发现自己必须做出回应，同时还要努力防止战斗失控。

paras.en: “They can’t not strike back — they were attacked in a very brutal way by their archenemies,” he said. “They need to exert military pressure on the Houthis and then find a way to kind of deescalate.”
paras.zh: “他们不能不反击——他们的宿敌以非常残酷的方式攻击了他们，”他说。 “他们需要对胡塞武装施加军事压力，然后找到一种方法来缓和局势。”

paras.en: Rather than sending troops into Yemen, the Saudis will likely launch airstrikes against the Houthis and ramp up support of nationalist forces, several analysts said.
paras.zh: 几位分析人士表示，沙特可能不会向也门派遣军队，而是可能对胡塞武装发动空袭，并加大对民族主义势力的支持。

paras.en: “It will be surrogate warfare,” Krieg said.
paras.zh: “这将是替代战争，”克里格说。

paras.en: While the Houthis don’t have the firepower of Saudi Arabia, they have grown into a fearsome force controlling roughly one-third of Yemen thanks to help from Iran.
paras.zh: 虽然胡塞武装没有沙特阿拉伯的火力，但在伊朗的帮助下，他们已经发展成为一支可怕的力量，控制着也门约三分之一的领土。

paras.en: The United Nations estimates that the Houthis by 2024 had recruited up to 350,000 fighters. That’s up from just 30,000 in 2015, when Saudi Arabia intervened in the internationally recognized Yemeni government’s civil war against the Houthis and imposed a naval blockade.
paras.zh: 联合国估计，到2024年，胡塞武装已招募了多达35万名武装分子。这个数字比 2015 年的 3 万人有所增加，当时沙特阿拉伯干预了国际公认的也门政府针对胡塞武装的内战，并实施了海上封锁。

paras.en: Ratney says the Houthis now have a “symbiotic relationship” with Iran and should not be seen as an Iranian puppet.
paras.zh: 拉特尼表示，胡塞武装现在与伊朗有着“共生关系”，不应被视为伊朗的傀儡。

paras.en: The strikes on Saudi airports and economic assets symbolize a sharing of lessons in asymmetric warfare between the Houthis and the Iranians: how to not just puncture expensive air defenses, but also damage vulnerable energy installations and threaten global maritime routes.
paras.zh: 对沙特机场和经济资产的袭击象征着胡塞武装和伊朗人在不对称战争中分享经验教训：如何不仅击穿昂贵的防空系统，而且还破坏脆弱的能源设施并威胁全球海上航线。

paras.en: “Over the course of the past few years, the Iranians have been innovating and sharing that with the Houthis and it’s gone both ways. The Houthis have been innovating, and sharing it with the Iranians,” Ratney said. “It’s no coincidence that they’ve ended up with a similar approach.”
paras.zh: “在过去的几年里，伊朗人一直在创新，并与胡塞武装分享，这是双向的。胡塞武装一直在创新，并与伊朗人分享，”拉特尼说。 “他们最终采取了类似的方法，这并非巧合。”

paras.en: Their recent military successes have made the Houthis feel “untouchable,” said Farea Al-Muslimi, a fellow at Chatham House focused on Yemen.
paras.zh: 查塔姆研究所研究也门问题的研究员法雷亚·阿尔-穆斯利米表示，胡塞武装最近的军事胜利让他们感到“不可触碰”。

paras.en: “It’s very hard to convince a man he’s going on the wrong side if he just moved forward and he has a gun in his hand,” he said. But the Houthis are now likely to suffer a brutal Saudi counterattack, he said.
paras.zh: “如果一个人手里拿着枪，只是向前走，那么很难让他相信他走错了一边，”他说。但他说，胡塞武装现在可能会遭受沙特的残酷反击。

articles.title: Sexual and family violence against children at 'crisis point', study finds
articles.author: Coco Veldkamp

paras.en: Violence and sexual violence against children have increased sharply across Australia, research by the University of Sydney has found.
paras.zh: 悉尼大学的研究发现，澳大利亚各地针对儿童的暴力和性暴力急剧增加。

paras.en: The study examined Australian administrative data from 2014 to 2024, including police recorded assaults, hospitalisations, and child protection data.
paras.zh: 该研究调查了 2014 年至 2024 年澳大利亚的行政数据，包括警方记录的袭击、住院和儿童保护数据。

paras.en: The lead researcher says we are at a "crisis point" and that all levels of government need to respond.
paras.zh: 首席研究员表示，我们正处于“危机点”，各级政府都需要做出回应。

paras.en: Child sexual assault and family violence-related assaults against kids have surged across Australia in the past decade, according to new research by the University of Sydney.
paras.zh: 悉尼大学的最新研究表明，过去十年来，澳大利亚各地儿童性侵犯和与家庭暴力相关的针对儿童的攻击激增。

paras.en: Warning: this story contains information about child abuse.
paras.zh: 警告：这个故事包含有关虐待儿童的信息。

paras.en: The study examined rates of children's exposure to violence over the past decade, using national police-recorded victimisation, hospitalisations for assault, and child protection data.
paras.zh: 该研究利用国家警察记录的受害情况、袭击住院情况和儿童保护数据，调查了过去十年儿童遭受暴力的比率。

paras.en: It found the rate of sexual assault against girls aged from birth to nine increased by 32 per cent, and for girls aged 10 to 17 years old by 51 per cent over the decade.
paras.zh: 报告发现，过去十年中，针对出生至 9 岁女孩的性侵犯率增加了 32%，针对 10 至 17 岁女孩的性侵犯率增加了 51%。

paras.en: For boys aged 10 to 17, there was a 60 per cent increase in sexual assault over the 10 years, including a sharp rise of 15.7 per cent a year from 2021.
paras.zh: 对于10岁至17岁的男孩来说，性侵犯事件在过去10年里增加了60%，其中从2021年开始每年急剧增加15.7%。

paras.en: "Sexual assault and family and domestic violence have increased over the decade, but what's particularly concerning is that the steepest increases were in the last three to five years."
paras.zh: “过去十年来，性侵犯以及家庭暴力有所增加，但特别令人担忧的是，增幅最大的是在过去三到五年。”

paras.en: Dr Grummitt said the increases could be linked to factors such as rising income inequality, the COVID-19 pandemic, cost-of-living pressures, and changing online gender norms.
paras.zh: Grummitt 博士表示，这一增长可能与收入不平等加剧、COVID-19 大流行、生活成本压力以及网络性别规范变化等因素有关。

paras.en: The research found that during the same time where was no increase in hospitalisations for assault-related injuries to children, and no increase in substantiated child maltreatment cases through the child protection system.
paras.zh: 研究发现，与此同时，儿童因袭击相关伤害而住院的人数没有增加，通过儿童保护系统证实的虐待儿童案件也没有增加。

paras.en: That divergence, researches said, raises important questions about what's driving the increases they found.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这种差异引发了重要问题：是什么推动了他们发现的增长。

paras.en: "These differences … underscore the need for better data and cross-sector integration,"
paras.zh: “这些差异......强调了对更好的数据和跨部门整合的需求，”

paras.en: "Our child maltreatment rates describe substantiated cases, meaning they've undergone an investigation by child protective services. One concern is that the declines we found reflect an issue with system capacity rather than a true decline in exposure."
paras.zh: “我们的儿童虐待率描述了已证实的案例，这意味着它们已经接受了儿童保护服务机构的调查。一个令人担忧的是，我们发现的下降反映了系统容量的问题，而不是暴露率的真正下降。”

paras.en: Child sexual exploitation expert Conrad Townson said the escalation rates over the decade were "staggering".
paras.zh: 儿童性剥削专家康拉德·汤森表示，过去十年的升级速度“令人震惊”。

paras.en: "It really is quite alarming," he said. "It really presents some significant concerns for what we are seeing ahead of us."
paras.zh: “这确实非常令人担忧，”他说。 “这确实对我们所看到的情况提出了一些重大担忧。”

paras.en: Mr Townson said the persistent and escalating rates of violence post-COVID is of particular concern.
paras.zh: 汤森先生表示，新冠疫情后持续不断且不断升级的暴力事件尤其令人担忧。

paras.en: "Cost of living … all of those things that are going to increase stressors; we already know from a sexual violence perspective there were spikes," he said.
paras.zh: “生活成本……所有这些都会增加压力源；从性暴力的角度来看，我们已经知道压力会出现激增，”他说。

paras.en: "But what we have seen since that is still an increase over time, so we can no longer just blame COVID-19."
paras.zh: “但此后我们所看到的情况仍然随着时间的推移而增加，因此我们不能再仅仅归咎于 COVID-19。”

paras.en: Mr Townson also said some of the increases could be explained by people being more willing and able to report abuse.
paras.zh: 汤森先生还表示，增加的部分原因可能是人们更愿意并且能够举报虐待行为。

paras.en: The researchers want federal and state governments to invest more in prevention and early detection, including by implementing the recommendations of the Rapid Review of Prevention Approaches.
paras.zh: 研究人员希望联邦和州政府在预防和早期发现方面投入更多资金，包括实施预防方法快速审查的建议。

paras.en: "We actually have good evidence on what needs to be done, and I think now it's about governments working together to achieve that," Dr Grummitt said.
paras.zh: 格鲁米特博士说：“我们实际上有充分的证据表明需要采取哪些行动，我认为现在需要各国政府共同努力实现这一目标。”

paras.en: "I would like to see government's recognise that violence against children is a human rights issue, and because of that, it's not the responsibility of one government department — it needs a whole-of-government approach."
paras.zh: “我希望看到政府认识到针对儿童的暴力行为是一个人权问题，正因为如此，这不是某个政府部门的责任——它需要整个政府的共同努力。”

paras.en: Former national children's commissioner Anne Hollonds said now was the time for action, rather than more inquiries or reviews.
paras.zh: 前国家儿童事务专员安妮·霍隆兹 (Anne Hollonds) 表示，现在是采取行动的时候，而不是进行更多调查或审查。

paras.en: "Childhood is the most powerful prevention opportunity within our reach. We need to make child safety, rights and wellbeing a national priority," she said.
paras.zh: “童年是我们力所能及的最有力的预防机会。我们需要将儿童安全、权利和福祉作为国家优先事项，”她说。

paras.en: Centre for Excellence in Child and Family Welfare CEO Jamie Crosby said there was a "desperate and immediate" need for governments to take action.
paras.zh: 儿童和家庭福利卓越中心首席执行官杰米·克罗斯比表示，政府“迫切且迫切”需要采取行动。

paras.en: "There is much that governments can do, and that communities can get behind, if we choose to act on this data and prioritise the safety and wellbeing of our children," Mr Crosby said.
paras.zh: 克罗斯比先生说：“如果我们选择根据这些数据采取行动并优先考虑我们孩子的安全和福祉，政府可以做很多事情，社区也可以支持。”

articles.title: Breaking: Tupac killer sentenced to minimum 40 years

paras.en: Duane Davis, the former Los Angeles gang leader who boasted in books and interviews of his involvement in the killing of rapper Tupac Shakur only to deny it when he came to trial, has been sentenced to a minimum 40 years in prison.
paras.zh: 前洛杉矶黑帮头目杜安·戴维斯 (Duane Davis) 被判处至少 40 年监禁，他在书籍和采访中吹嘘自己参与杀害说唱歌手图帕克·沙库尔 (Tupac Shakur)，但在受审时却否认了这一点。

paras.en: "You don't get to take a man from his family. You don't get to take his very life, his whole future from him, and just walk away from it. Especially when that man is Tupac Shaker," Judge Carli Kierny told a Las Vegas court as she handed down the 40-years-to-life sentence.
paras.zh: 卡莉·基尔尼法官在拉斯维加斯法庭宣判 40 年至无期徒刑时表示：“你不能夺走一个人的家人。你不能夺走他的生命，夺走他的整个未来，然后就走开。尤其是当那个人是图派克·夏克 (Tupac Shaker) 时。”

paras.en: For years, Duane Keith Davis, known as Keffe D, claimed to have played a part in the fatal drive-by shooting.
paras.zh: 多年来，杜安·基思·戴维斯（Duane Keith Davis）（绰号 Keffe D）声称参与了这起致命的驾车枪击事件。

paras.en: Those comments led authorities to reopen the case.
paras.zh: 这些评论导致当局重新审理此案。

paras.en: Davis, who is accused of providing the gun used to kill Shakur, is now the centre of a murder trial over the attack.
paras.zh: 戴维斯被指控提供了用来杀死沙库尔的枪，现在他是这起袭击事件的谋杀案审判的中心人物。

articles.title: White House asks US envoy in Athens to resign, new press secretary says

paras.en: The White House has asked the US Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle to resign.
paras.zh: 白宫已要求美国驻希腊大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔辞职。

paras.en: The announcement was made during the first appearance of new White House press secretary Katie Zacharia.
paras.zh: 这一消息是在新任白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚首次亮相时宣布的。

paras.en: Ms Guilfoyle had been under pressure over allegations she asked a Trump donor to pay off a $143,000 credit card balance.
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔女士因被指控要求特朗普捐助者偿还 143,000 美元的信用卡余额而承受压力。

paras.en: The new White House press secretary, Katie Zacharia, has used her first press briefing to announce that the US's ambassador to Greece has been asked to resign.
paras.zh: 新任白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚(Katie Zacharia)在她的第一次新闻发布会上宣布，美国驻希腊大使已被要求辞职。

paras.en: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been at the centre of a growing controversy in recent weeks regarding alleged improper and possibly illegal conduct before and during her tenure in Athens.
paras.zh: 最近几周，金伯利·吉尔福伊尔 (Kimberly Guilfoyle) 一直处于日益激烈的争议之中，有关她在雅典任职之前和期间涉嫌不当甚至可能非法的行为。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump had previously told the media he was "not happy" with the allegations and that his administration was "looking at it".
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普此前曾对媒体表示，他对这些指控“不满意”，他的政府正在“考虑此事”。

paras.en: Ms Guilfoyle previously worked at US cable network Fox News and dated Mr Trump's son, Donald Trump Jr, as well as California Governor Gavin Newsom.
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔女士此前曾在美国有线电视网络福克斯新闻工作，并与特朗普的儿子小唐纳德·特朗普以及加州州长加文·纽瑟姆约会过。

paras.en: In her first appearance before the White House briefing room, Ms Zacharia said Ms Guilfoyle "has been a wonderful asset to the team, and we wish her well".
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚女士在首次出现在白宫简报室时表示，吉尔福伊尔女士“是团队的宝贵财富，我们祝愿她一切顺利”。

paras.en: Ms Zacharia was appointed press secretary earlier this year after Karoline Leavitt resigned, citing a wish to spend more time with her family.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，卡罗琳·莱维特 (Karoline Leavitt) 辞职后，扎卡里亚 (Zacharia) 被任命为新闻秘书，理由是希望有更多时间陪伴家人。

paras.en: Ms Zacharia's appearance at the lectern was brief, taking only three questions from reporters and saying that Mr Trump was "his own best spokesperson".
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚在讲台上的露面时间很短，只回答了记者的三个问题，并表示特朗普是“他自己最好的发言人”。

paras.en: In a series of stories dating to late last month, The Wall Street Journal has reported questionable conduct by Ms Guilfoyle, including an alleged threat to a host country official, accepting improper gifts and services and offering to use her influence inside the administration in return for the payment of a large credit card bill.
paras.zh: 在上个月末的一系列报道中，《华尔街日报》报道了吉尔福伊尔女士的可疑行为，包括涉嫌威胁东道国官员、接受不当礼物和服务，以及提出利用她在政府内部的影响力来换取一大笔信用卡账单。

paras.en: The newspaper reported that she asked Eric Deters, an influential Trump supporter, to pay off $US100,000 ($143,000) in personal credit card debt shortly before her Senate confirmation hearing in July 2025.
paras.zh: 该报报道称，在 2025 年 7 月参议院确认听证会前不久，她要求特朗普的颇具影响力的支持者埃里克·德特斯 (Eric Deters) 偿还 10 万美元（143,000 美元）的个人信用卡债务。

paras.en: "Honey please I need you to get this done for me today," she wrote to Mr Deters in a message accompanied by instructions for paying her credit card company, according to the Journal, which published screenshots of the exchanges.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，她在给德特斯先生的一封邮件中写道：“亲爱的，我今天需要你帮我完成这件事，”并附有向她的信用卡公司付款的说明。该报还公布了交易的屏幕截图。

paras.en: Mr Deters refused to make the payment, telling the newspaper that doing so would have cost him his marriage.
paras.zh: 德特斯先生拒绝付款，并告诉该报，这样做会让他失去婚姻。

paras.en: Ms Guilfoyle has not addressed the reports directly.
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔女士没有直接回应这些报道。

paras.en: In a statement released late on Sunday, her lawyers denied she had done anything wrong and claimed that the money she was seeking from the Trump donor was payment for services, public appearances and speaking engagements that predate her ambassadorial nomination, that had not been paid.
paras.zh: 在周日晚些时候发布的一份声明中，她的律师否认她做错了任何事，并声称她向特朗普捐助者寻求的资金是她在大使提名之前的服务、公开露面和演讲活动的费用，但尚未支付。

paras.en: The lawyers, David Schwartz and Jesse Binnall, also rejected allegations of impropriety related to Ms Guilfoyle's travel on private planes.
paras.zh: 律师大卫·施瓦茨 (David Schwartz) 和杰西·宾纳尔 (Jesse Binnall) 也驳回了与吉尔福伊尔女士乘坐私人飞机旅行有关的不当行为的指控。

paras.en: They said before every such trip she "sought, obtained and followed State Department guidance and followed the department's travel regulations," they said.
paras.zh: 他们说，在每次此类旅行之前，她都“寻求、获得并遵循国务院的指导，并遵守该部门的旅行规定”。

articles.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle, U.S. ambassador to Greece, resigns after reports alleging corruption

paras.en: Kimberly Guilfoyle, U.S. ambassador to Greece, resigns after reports alleging corruption
paras.zh: 美国驻希腊大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔因腐败报道而辞职

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal reported questionable conduct and possible corruption by Guilfoyle, which she denies
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》报道了吉尔福伊尔的可疑行为和可能的腐败行为，但她否认了这一点

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump's ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, resigned on Tuesday after allegations of improper conduct but insisted she'll "vigorously defend" herself.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普驻希腊大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔因被指控行为不当而于周二辞职，但坚称她将“大力捍卫”自己。

paras.en: Trump's administration said earlier Tuesday it had asked Guilfoyle to leave her post after she faced severe criticism over allegations she engaged in improper and possibly illegal conduct before and during her tenure in Athens.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府周二早些时候表示，吉尔福伊尔因在雅典任职之前和任职期间从事不当甚至可能非法行为的指控而受到严厉批评，因此已要求她辞职。

paras.en: "She went to Greece, she was doing a good job, but we didn't like what we were reading," Trump told reporters at the White House before leaving on a trip to campaign for congressional Republicans.
paras.zh: “她去了希腊，她做得很好，但我们不喜欢我们读到的内容，”特朗普在出发前往国会共和党竞选之前对记者说。

paras.en: In a series of stories, the Wall Street Journal has reported questionable conduct by Guilfoyle, including an alleged threat to a host country official, accepting improper gifts and services and offering to use her influence inside the Republican administration in return for the payment of a large credit card bill.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》在一系列报道中报道了吉尔福伊尔的可疑行为，包括涉嫌威胁东道国官员、接受不当礼物和服务以及提出利用她在共和党政府内部的影响力以换取大笔信用卡账单。

paras.en: Guilfoyle denied the allegations on Tuesday and vowed to "vigorously defend my name, my reputation and my integrity."
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔周二否认了这些指控，并发誓要“大力捍卫我的名字、我的声誉和我的正直”。

paras.en: "I have dedicated my professional life to fighting for justice, standing up for what is right and defending the values that make America exceptional," she said. "I will not allow false accusations to define my decades of public service."
paras.zh: 她说：“我的职业生涯致力于为正义而战，坚持正义，捍卫使美国与众不同的价值观。” “我不会允许虚假指控来定义我数十年的公共服务。”

paras.en: Guilfoyle, 57, lasted just over one year in the role, having been narrowly confirmed by the Senate in a vote that hewed close to party lines. Democrats doubted her qualifications and said the appointment smacked of patronage, as Guilfoyle had dated and once been engaged to Donald Trump Jr.
paras.zh: 57 岁的吉尔福伊尔在参议院的投票中以接近党派路线的投票结果以微弱优势获得了该职位，任期仅一年多。民主党人怀疑她的资格，并表示这一任命带有赞助的味道，因为吉尔福伊尔曾与小唐纳德·特朗普约会并曾订婚。

paras.en: Greek, U.S. opposition parties want more info
paras.zh: 希腊和美国反对党希望获得更多信息

paras.en: Ahead of Tuesday's announcement, Greek opposition parties had called on the Foreign Ministry to summon Guilfoyle to respond to the allegations made against her.
paras.zh: 在周二宣布这一消息之前，希腊反对党呼吁外交部传唤吉尔福伊尔，以回应针对她的指控。

paras.en: "This, most importantly, is an issue of national dignity," Sia Anagnostopoulou, a former deputy foreign minister, said in parliament Friday. Greek Foreign Minister Giorgos Gerapetritis responded that Guilfoyle had been treated "the same way as every other ambassador" and argued that an official summons had not been necessary.
paras.zh: “最重要的是，这是一个国家尊严问题，”前外交部副部长西亚·阿纳格诺斯托普卢周五在议会表示。希腊外交部长乔治·杰拉佩特里蒂斯(Giorgos Gerapetritis)回应称，吉尔福伊尔受到“与其他大使相同的待遇”，并辩称没有必要发出正式传票。

paras.en: On Capitol Hill, a number of Democrats serving on House and Senate committees have already called for an investigation into Guilfoyle's tenure.
paras.zh: 在国会山，众议院和参议院委员会的一些民主党人已经呼吁对吉尔福伊尔的任期进行调查。

paras.en: - Analysis Hoekstra's missteps in Canada are mild compared to some of Trump's ambassadors
paras.zh: - 分析 与特朗普的一些大使相比，霍克斯特拉在加拿大的失误并不严重

paras.en: - Analysis U.S. ambassador resents meddling in foreign electoral politics, but Trump doesn't seem to mind doing so
paras.zh: - 分析 美国大使不满干涉外国选举政治，但特朗普似乎并不介意这样做

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal's first report said Guilfoyle had told guests at a reception that the United States could undermine the Greek government if it chose to, promoted the business interests of one particular Greek construction and energy company and allowed its lobbyist into private diplomatic meetings.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》的第一份报道称，吉尔福伊尔在一次招待会上告诉客人，如果美国愿意的话，美国可以削弱希腊政府，促进一家特定希腊建筑和能源公司的商业利益，并允许其游说者参加私人外交会议。

paras.en: While in Greece last week, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio berated journalists for asking about the allegations.
paras.zh: 上周在希腊时，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥斥责记者询问这些指控。

paras.en: "You guys walk around thinking that because some source told you something and you reported it, it's the gospel. It's not the gospel. It's not the gospel for me. That's not the way we do things," said Rubio.
paras.zh: “你们四处走动，以为因为某个消息来源告诉了你们一些事情，然后你们报道了，那就是福音。这不是福音。这对我来说不是福音。这不是我们做事的方式，”卢比奥说。

paras.en: While Rubio was in Athens, the Journal reported — citing text messages — that Guilfoyle had asked a Trump donor and supporter to pay a $100,000 US credit card bill just before her confirmation hearing, promising him access to administration officials if he did.
paras.zh: 当卢比奥在雅典时，《华尔街日报》援引短信报道称，吉尔福伊尔在她的确认听证会之前要求特朗普的一位捐助者和支持者支付 10 万美元的信用卡账单，并承诺如果他这样做，他可以与政府官员会面。

paras.en: In a statement released late Sunday, Guilfoyle's lawyers denied she had done anything wrong and claimed that the money she was seeking from a Trump donor was payment for services — public appearances and speaking engagements that predate her ambassadorial nomination — that had not been paid.
paras.zh: 在周日晚间发布的一份声明中，吉尔福伊尔的律师否认她做错了任何事，并声称她向特朗普捐助者寻求的资金是她尚未支付的服务费用——在她获得大使提名之前的公开露面和演讲活动。

paras.en: The lawyers, David Schwartz and Jesse Binnall, also rejected allegations of impropriety related to Guilfoyle's travel on private planes, saying that before every such trip she "sought, obtained and followed State Department guidance and followed the department's travel regulations."
paras.zh: 律师大卫·施瓦茨 (David Schwartz) 和杰西·宾纳尔 (Jesse Binnall) 也驳回了有关吉尔福伊尔乘坐私人飞机旅行的不当指控，称在每次此类旅行之前，她“都寻求、获得并遵循国务院的指导，并遵守该部门的旅行规定”。

paras.en: The Journal also reported that Guilfoyle had been enraged about not being invited to a Greek-themed event at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, earlier this year.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》还报道称，吉尔福伊尔对今年早些时候没有被邀请参加在瑞士达沃斯举行的世界经济论坛上以希腊为主题的活动感到愤怒。

paras.en: White House press secretary Katie Zacharia, at her first media briefing Tuesday morning, said Guilfoyle "has been a wonderful asset to the team, and we wish her well."
paras.zh: 白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚在周二上午的第一次媒体吹风会上表示，吉尔福伊尔“对团队来说是一笔宝贵的财富，我们祝愿她一切顺利。”

paras.en: Trump-aligned ambassadors and diplomats in his second term have ruffled feathers in a handful of countries, including Canada, where a series of provocative comments made by U.S. Ambassador Pete Hoekstra led to a petition signed by tens of thousands of Canadians calling for his removal.
paras.zh: 在特朗普第二任期内，与特朗普结盟的大使和外交官激怒了包括加拿大在内的少数几个国家，美国大使皮特·霍克斯特拉(Pete Hoekstra)发表了一系列挑衅性言论，导致数万名加拿大人签署了一份请愿书，要求将他免职。

paras.en: - Jared Kushner-linked development project in Albania faces growing resistance
paras.zh: - 阿尔巴尼亚与贾里德·库什纳相关的发展项目面临越来越大的阻力

paras.en: - Listen How Ivanka Trump helped spark Albania's 'Flamingo Revolution'
paras.zh: - 听听伊万卡·特朗普如何帮助引发阿尔巴尼亚的“火烈鸟革命”

paras.en: In France, government officials accused U.S. Ambassador Charles Kushner of interfering in the country's internal affairs after he sent an unsolicited letter to President Emmanuel Macron, accusing the country of not doing enough to combat antisemitism. Kushner is the father of Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner, who has been employed by the White House in negotiations with foreign powers.
paras.zh: 在法国，美国大使查尔斯·库什纳主动向法国总统马克龙发出信函，指责法国在打击反犹太主义方面做得不够，政府官员指责美国大使查尔斯·库什纳干涉该国内政。库什纳是特朗普女婿贾里德·库什纳的父亲，后者曾受雇于白宫与外国势力进行谈判。

paras.en: The aggressive posture of the second Trump administration concerning U.S. interests in in the North Atlantic has also led to diplomatic flaps, as when Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry, serving in a special envoy role, said it was an honour to serve Trump "in this volunteer position to make Greenland a part of the U.S."
paras.zh: 特朗普第二届政府对美国在北大西洋利益的咄咄逼人姿态也导致了外交风波，担任特使的路易斯安那州州长杰夫·兰德里表示，很荣幸“以志愿者的身份为特朗普服务，让格陵兰岛成为美国的一部分”。

paras.en: As well, Billy Long, Washington's ambassador to Iceland, apologized after joking about the country becoming the "52nd state" of the U.S.
paras.zh: 同样，华盛顿驻冰岛大使比利·朗在开玩笑说冰岛将成为美国的“第52个州”后道歉。

articles.title: Canada, allies say they 'deeply regret' Palestinian elections being postponed

paras.en: Canada, allies say they 'deeply regret' Palestinian elections being postponed
paras.zh: 加拿大及其盟友表示，他们对巴勒斯坦选举被推迟“深感遗憾”

paras.en: Holding elections was a condition for Canada's recognition of state of Palestine
paras.zh: 举行选举是加拿大承认巴勒斯坦国的条件

paras.en: Canada has joined allies France, the U.K. and Australia in saying they "deeply regret" the postponement of Palestinian presidential and legislative elections.
paras.zh: 加拿大与盟友法国、英国和澳大利亚一起表示，他们对推迟巴勒斯坦总统和立法选举“深感遗憾”。

paras.en: The votes were set to happen next month but Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas has delayed them until September 2027.
paras.zh: 投票原定于下个月举行，但巴勒斯坦总统马哈茂德·阿巴斯将投票推迟至 2027 年 9 月。

paras.en: In a statement, Canada and its allies say the delay deprives Palestinians of the chance to vote and elections are an important element of the Palestinian Authority's commitment to reform.
paras.zh: 加拿大及其盟国在一份声明中表示，推迟选举剥夺了巴勒斯坦人投票的机会，选举是巴勒斯坦权力机构改革承诺的重要组成部分。

paras.en: The statement also acknowledges what it calls significant challenges and impediments to the ability to conduct elections in a manner consistent with international standards.
paras.zh: 声明还承认，以符合国际标准的方式举行选举的能力面临着重大挑战和障碍。

paras.en: While Canada was among a group of nations that recognized the state of Palestine last year, that recognition was predicated upon several conditions, including elections being held in 2026.
paras.zh: 虽然加拿大是去年承认巴勒斯坦国的国家之一，但这种承认是基于几个条件的，包括 2026 年举行选举。

paras.en: The Palestinian Authority has maintained it is unable to hold a vote in Gaza as long as the war continues.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦权力机构坚称，只要战争继续，它就无法在加沙举行投票。

articles.title: Cornell suspends all frat parties as alleged gang rape fuels continued calls for action
articles.author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours

paras.en: Cornell suspends all frat parties as alleged gang rape fuels continued calls for action
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学暂停所有兄弟会聚会，因涉嫌轮奸事件引发持续呼吁采取行动

paras.en: 'Zero tolerance' for violating new directive, university president says
paras.zh: 大学校长表示对违反新指令的行为“零容忍”

paras.en: Cornell University has suspended all frat parties and events for the rest of the 2026-27 academic year, president Michael Kotlikoff announced Tuesday, as an alleged gang rape at one of the school's fraternities continues to fuel calls for action and accountability.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学校长迈克尔·科特里科夫 (Michael Kotlikoff) 周二宣布，康奈尔大学已暂停 2026-27 学年剩余时间里的所有兄弟会聚会和活动，因为该校一个兄弟会涉嫌轮奸事件继续引发要求采取行动和追究责任的呼声。

paras.en: Kotlikoff, who has faced pressure to resign over the case, said there would be "zero tolerance" for any violations of the new directive.
paras.zh: 因该案而面临辞职压力的科特里科夫表示，对任何违反新指令的行为都将“零容忍”。

paras.en: "Any fraternity holding an in-house party or social event will receive an immediate emergency suspension," he said in a written statement posted on Cornell's website.
paras.zh: 他在康奈尔大学网站上发布的一份书面声明中表示：“任何举办内部聚会或社交活动的兄弟会都将立即被紧急暂停。”

paras.en: It's among a series of measures Kotlikoff said the university is taking "to strengthen campus safety, better support survivors, and begin addressing the social context of sexual violence at Cornell."
paras.zh: 科特里科夫表示，这是该大学正在采取的一系列措施之一，“以加强校园安全，更好地支持幸存者，并开始解决康奈尔大学性暴力的社会背景。”

paras.en: The case has drawn international media attention after a woman filed a lawsuit last month against the university and her alleged assailants.
paras.zh: 一名妇女上个月对大学及其涉嫌袭击者提起诉讼后，此案引起了国际媒体的关注。

paras.en: The woman, referred to as Jane Doe in court documents, has accused seven members of Cornell's Chi Phi fraternity of raping her at the frat house in October 2024, while she was incapacitated.
paras.zh: 法庭文件中，这名女子被称为“无名氏”(Jane Doe)，她指控康奈尔大学 Chi Phi 兄弟会的 7 名成员于 2024 年 10 月在兄弟会会所强奸了她，当时她已经丧失行为能力。

paras.en: The case set off a wave of protests, including on the university campus in Ithaca, N.Y., and calls for justice and, more broadly, an end to sexual violence.
paras.zh: 此案引发了包括纽约州伊萨卡大学校园在内的一波抗议浪潮，人们呼吁伸张正义，更广泛地呼吁结束性暴力。

paras.en: - What to know about the case of the 'Cornell 7'
paras.zh: - 关于“康奈尔7号”案件需要了解什么

paras.en: - Alleged gang rape 'deeply disturbing,' Cornell president says
paras.zh: - 康奈尔大学校长表示，涉嫌轮奸“令人深感不安”

paras.en: - Audio Creating a culture of consent on university campuses
paras.zh: - 音频 在大学校园营造同意文化

paras.en: Earlier this month, New York Gov. Kathy Hochul appointed Letitia James, the state's attorney general, as a special prosecutor to investigate the case.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔任命该州总检察长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯为特别检察官，调查此案。

paras.en: Cornell also said last week that it had appointed Sally Yates, a former U.S. deputy attorney general, to review how the school "prevents and responds to sexual harassment, sexual assault and related misconduct on campus."
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学上周还表示，已任命美国前副总检察长萨莉·耶茨(Sally Yates)来审查学校如何“预防和应对校园内的性骚扰、性侵犯和相关不当行为”。

paras.en: That includes a review of how the university responded to Doe's allegations, it said.
paras.zh: 报告称，这包括对大学如何回应能源部指控的审查。

paras.en: In Tuesday's statement, Kotlikoff said the university would appoint a dedicated case manager to help individuals who report sexual misconduct navigate processes such as housing and academic accommodations.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫在周二的声明中表示，学校将任命一名专门的案件经理，帮助举报不当性行为的个人处理住房和学术住宿等流程。

paras.en: Kotlikoff also said Cornell would allow criminal investigators from the New York State Police, who are independent of the university, to investigate sex assault allegations on campus.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫还表示，康奈尔大学将允许独立于大学的纽约州警方刑事调查人员调查校园内的性侵犯指控。

paras.en: Campus police, who have full law enforcement powers but are controlled by the university, generally investigate crimes reported on Cornell's campus.
paras.zh: 校园警察拥有完全的执法权，但由大学控制，通常调查康奈尔大学校园内举报的犯罪行为。

articles.title: DR Congo: Kabila’s move towards M23 raises questions over peace

paras.en: Joseph Kabila's decision to lead a new political-military movement, the Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN), puts the former president of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) in more direct confrontation with President Felix Tshisekedi's government. Kabila announced the FRN on October 12 in Goma, eastern DRC, at his residence, where leaders of the AFC/M23 rebel movements joined him.
paras.zh: 约瑟夫·卡比拉决定领导一个新的政治军事运动——国家重建阵线（FRN），使刚果民主共和国（刚果民主共和国）前总统与菲利克斯·齐塞克迪总统的政府进行更直接的对抗。卡比拉于 10 月 12 日在刚果民主共和国东部戈马的官邸宣布成立 FRN，AFC/M23 反叛运动领导人也加入了他的行列。

paras.en: FRN coalition adviser, Claude Ibalanky, said the group would unite opposition forces, including figures associated with the AFC/M23 movement. The new structure succeeds the Congo River Alliance (AFC), which had been allied with the M23 rebellion. Its leadership includes former AFC leader Corneille Nangaa and M23 political leader Bertrand Bisimwa. Sultani Makenga, a senior M23 military commander, was also assigned a senior role in the new organization.
paras.zh: FRN 联盟顾问克劳德·伊巴兰基 (Claude Ibalanky) 表示，该组织将联合反对派力量，其中包括与 AFC/M23 运动相关的人物。新组织继承了刚果河联盟 (AFC)，该联盟曾与 M23 叛乱分子结盟。其领导层包括前亚足联领导人 Corneille Nangaa 和 M23 政治领导人 Bertrand Bisimwa。 M23 高级军事指挥官 Sultani Makenga 也被任命为新组织的高级职务。

paras.en: The announcement comes as diplomatic initiatives seek to end fighting between Congolese government forces and the rebellion.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布之际，正值外交举措寻求结束刚果政府军与叛乱分子之间的战斗。

paras.en: Congolese authorities have accused Kabila of supporting the insurgency, allegations he has denied. On September 30, 2025, a military court sentenced him to death in absentia after convicting him of treason, war crimes and other offenses linked to the conflict in eastern DRC. Kabila has rejected the case as politically motivated.
paras.zh: 刚果当局指责卡比拉支持叛乱分子，但他否认了这一指控。 2025 年 9 月 30 日，军事法庭在判定他犯有叛国罪、战争罪和其他与刚果民主共和国东部冲突有关的罪行后，缺席判处他死刑。卡比拉以政治动机为由拒绝了此案。

paras.en: Adolph Amisi Makutano, an official of the ruling Union for Democracy and Social Progress (UDPS), criticized the former president for taking a more public role.
paras.zh: 执政的民主与社会进步联盟 (UDPS) 官员阿道夫·阿米西·马库塔诺 (Adolph Amisi Makutano) 批评前总统扮演更加公开的角色。

paras.en: "It was a lack of courage that made this gentleman drag his feet. They held several meetings and today he is being pushed to step out into the open. But it is a disgrace for the DRC," Makutano said.
paras.zh: “正是因为缺乏勇气，这位先生才拖拖拉拉。他们举行了几次会议，今天他被迫公开露面。但这对刚果民主共和国来说是一种耻辱，”马库塔诺说。

paras.en: Eastern DRC has experienced decades of conflict involving armed groups, competition over territory andmineral resources, and tensions with neighboring countries.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国东部经历了数十年涉及武装团体的冲突、领土和矿产资源的争夺以及与邻国的紧张关系。

paras.en: The aftermath of Rwanda's 1994 genocide against the Tutsicontributed to successive regional conflicts, as armed groups and refugees crossed borders and neighboring states became involved in Congo's civil wars.
paras.zh: 1994 年卢旺达针对图西族的种族灭绝导致了连续的地区冲突，武装团体和难民越过边界，邻国卷入刚果内战。

paras.en: M23 takes its name from a March 23, 2009, peace agreement. The movement says the Congolese government failed to honor commitments to integrate its fighters and protect minority Congolese Tutsis.
paras.zh: M23 得名于 2009 年 3 月 23 日签署的和平协议。该运动表示，刚果政府未能履行融合其武装人员和保护少数民族刚果图西族的承诺。

paras.en: Kinshasa, the United Nations (UN) and Western governments haveaccused Rwanda of supporting M23 and exercising influence over its operations. Rwanda denies backing the rebellion and cites security threats posed by armed groups operating in Congo. In 2025, M23 captured Goma and Bukavu, two major cities in eastern Congo. Its territorial gains weakened government control across parts of the region, displaced civilians and intensified an already severe humanitarian crisis.
paras.zh: 金沙萨、联合国和西方政府指责卢旺达支持“3·23”运动并对其行动施加影响。卢旺达否认支持叛乱，并指出在刚果活动的武装团体构成的安全威胁。 2025年，M23占领了刚果东部的两个主要城市戈马和布卡武。它获得的领土削弱了政府对该地区部分地区的控制，导致平民流离失所，并加剧了本已严重的人道主义危机。

paras.en: Kabila's leadership of the new front raises questions about whether he intends to consolidate opposition to Tshisekedi, strengthen the rebellion's political leadership, or pursue both.
paras.zh: 卡比拉对新阵线的领导引发了人们的疑问：他是打算巩固对齐塞克迪的反对派，加强叛乱分子的政治领导，还是两者兼而有之。

paras.en: Alex Vines, Africa program director at the European Council on Foreign Relations, sees the move as evidence that Kabila remains politically ambitious. "It shows Kabila's political ambition is alive and kicking and he is prepared to challenge Tshisekedi," Vines told DW.
paras.zh: 欧洲外交关系委员会非洲项目主任亚历克斯·瓦因斯认为此举证明卡比拉仍然具有政治野心。瓦因斯告诉德国之声：“这表明卡比拉的政治野心充满活力，他已准备好挑战齐塞克迪。”

paras.en: Timo Roujean, head of the Konrad Adenauer Foundation's office in Kinshasa, cautioned against assessing Kabila's potential support based on ethnic identity alone. He told DW that economic performance and political dynamics in Kabila's home region of Katanga are also relevant.
paras.zh: 康拉德·阿登纳基金会金沙萨办事处负责人蒂莫·鲁让警告说，不要仅根据种族身份来评估卡比拉的潜在支持。他告诉德国之声，卡比拉家乡加丹加地区的经济表现和政治动态也与之相关。

paras.en: The new front could give the movement more explicitly political leadership, but it remains unclear whether the reorganization will broaden its domestic support or alter its negotiating position. Conflict analyst Cliffton Chifuwe told DW the alliance does not rule out a negotiated settlement, but could make a durable agreement harder to achieve.
paras.zh: 新战线可以赋予该运动更明确的政治领导力，但目前尚不清楚重组是否会扩大其国内支持或改变其谈判立场。冲突分析师克利夫顿·奇富韦（Cliffton Chifuwe）告诉德国之声，该联盟并不排除通过谈判解决的可能性，但可能会使持久协议更难达成。

paras.en: "The Kabila alliance with M23 does not make peace impossible. However, it raises the threshold for achieving that settlement and its ability to hold," Chifuwe told DW.
paras.zh: 奇富威告诉德国之声：“卡比拉与‘3·23’运动的联盟并不会让和平变得不可能。然而，它提高了实现和解及其维持和平的能力的门槛。”

paras.en: For Chifuwe, lasting peace requires more than a cessation of hostilities. It also depends on credible security arrangements, the restoration of state authority, humanitarian access, and conditions that allow displaced people to return safely. The new FRN coalition also raises questions for mediators about whether existing peace frameworks can accommodate the political realignment and whether the parties involved can ensure compliance with any agreement.
paras.zh: 对于奇富韦来说，持久和平需要的不仅仅是停止敌对行动。它还取决于可靠的安全安排、国家权力的恢复、人道主义准入以及允许流离失所者安全返回的条件。新的FRN联盟还向调解人提出了现有和平框架是否能够适应政治重组以及有关各方是否能够确保遵守任何协议的问题。

paras.en: As this new development plays out, the central issue for civilians in eastern Congo remains whether the leadership change will open a path to settlement or make an already complex conflict harder to resolve.
paras.zh: 随着这一新事态发展的展开，刚果东部平民面临的核心问题仍然是领导层更迭是否会开辟解决之路，还是使本已复杂的冲突更难解决。

paras.en: Wendy Bashi, Saleh Mwanamilongo and Jean Noel Ba Mweze contributed to this article
paras.zh: Wendy Bashi、Saleh Mwanamilongo 和 Jean Noel Ba Mweze 对本文做出了贡献

articles.title: How will emergency rule in Pakistan's northwest affect Afghan ties?

paras.en: Pakistan on Sunday announced that the northwestern province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa had been put under emergency rule.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦周日宣布，西北省份开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省已进入紧急状态。

paras.en: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's federal government defended the move, saying the provincial administration — led by imprisoned former Prime Minister Imran Khan's Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) party — was working "hand in glove" with the Pakistani Taliban, known as Tehrik-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP).
paras.zh: 总理谢巴兹·谢里夫的联邦政府为此举辩护，称由被监禁的前总理伊姆兰·汗领导的正义运动党（PTI）领导的省政府正在与巴基斯坦塔利班“密切合作”，即巴基斯坦塔利班运动（TTP）。

paras.en: "The PTI government in the province has not equipped the police and security forces to counter militancy. Instead, they have links with TTP and did not cooperate with the federal government to fight terrorism," Talal Chaudhry, minister of state for interior affairs, told DW.
paras.zh: 内政部长塔拉尔·乔杜里 (Talal Chaudhry) 告诉德国之声：“该省的 PTI 政府没有配备警察和安全部队来打击武装分子。相反，他们与 TTP 有联系，并且不与联邦政府合作打击恐怖主义。”

paras.en: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said the government had "solid evidence" to support its allegations, the Associated Press news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，信息部长阿塔乌拉·塔拉尔表示，政府有“确凿的证据”支持其指控。

paras.en: He said the suspension and imposition of a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa would allow security forces and the new administration to better coordinate efforts to combat terrorism.
paras.zh: 他表示，暂停并在开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省实施紧急状态将使安全部队和新政府能够更好地协调打击恐怖主义的努力。

paras.en: The move comes as thousands of Khan supporters continue to stage anti-government protests and demand the former leader be released from jail.
paras.zh: 此举发生之际，数千名汗支持者继续举行反政府抗议活动，要求释放这位前领导人。

paras.en: But the federal government has denied that its action was driven by domestic politics.
paras.zh: 但联邦政府否认其行动是由国内政治驱动的。

paras.en: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, which has suffered an increasing number of militant attacks in recent months, is a political stronghold of former PM Khan.
paras.zh: 开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省近几个月遭受越来越多的武装袭击，是前总理汗的政治据点。

paras.en: The cricketer-turned-politician has been in jail since 2023 on corruption and other charges that he and his supporters say are politically motivated.
paras.zh: 这位板球运动员出身的政治家自 2023 年以来一直因腐败和其他指控而入狱，他和他的支持者称这些指控是出于政治动机。

paras.en: His PTI party had long governed the volatile province, but Islamabad's decision to impose emergency rule has now effectively removed it from power.
paras.zh: 他领导的公正党长期以来一直统治着这个动荡的省份，但伊斯兰堡实施紧急统治的决定实际上已经使其下台。

paras.en: Pakistan's constitution allows the federal government to take over from provincial authorities during an emergency.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦宪法允许联邦政府在紧急情况下接管省政府的权力。

paras.en: Islamabad said Khyber Pakhtunkhwa would now be administered directly by a new governor, assisted by an advisory council. This arrangement will initially be in place for six months, but could be extended for as long as necessary, authorities said.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰堡表示，开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省现在将由新省长在顾问委员会的协助下直接管理。当局表示，这一安排最初将持续六个月，但可以根据需要延长。

paras.en: Khan's party has lambasted the suspension of the provincial government.
paras.zh: 汗的政党严厉谴责了省政府的停职。

paras.en: "This is more a coup disguised as emergency and governor rule," said PTI spokesperson Sayed Zulfikar Bukhari.
paras.zh: PTI 发言人 Sayed Zulfikar Bukhari 表示：“这更像是一场伪装成紧急状态和州长统治的政变。”

paras.en: It has also sparked questions about provincial autonomy and the future of civilian rule, with critics warning that the abrupt removal of an elected administration risks weakening accountability and deepening political divisions.
paras.zh: 它还引发了人们对省级自治和文官统治未来的质疑，批评者警告说，突然罢免民选政府可能会削弱问责制并加深政治分歧。

paras.en: "Governor's rule should only be imposed in extreme constitutional crises, not political disputes, and its legality should be reviewed by the Constitutional Court," Osama Malik, a senior constitutional expert, told DW.
paras.zh: 资深宪法专家奥萨马·马利克（Osama Malik）告诉德国之声：“州长的统治只能在极端的宪法危机中实施，而不是在政治纠纷中，其合法性应由宪法法院审查。”

paras.en: "While it may temporarily reduce militant attacks, lasting security requires political engagement and stronger civilian law enforcement."
paras.zh: “虽然这可能会暂时减少武装分子的袭击，但持久的安全需要政治参与和更强有力的民事执法。”

paras.en: Raja Qaiser Ahmed, assistant professor of regional security and foreign affairs at Quaid-i-Azam University in Islamabad, echoed this view.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰堡奎德阿扎姆大学地区安全和外交事务助理教授拉贾·凯泽·艾哈迈德也赞同这一观点。

paras.en: "Federal rule can never be a substitute for an elected political authority. The argument of provincial autonomy would also definitely surface amidst this uncharacteristic measure taken," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“联邦统治永远不能取代民选的政治权威。省级自治的论点肯定也会在这种不寻常的措施中浮出水面。”

paras.en: "It may, though, streamline coordination between the federal government and the province, which was a missing link for quite some time."
paras.zh: “不过，这可能会简化联邦政府和省之间的协调，而这在相当长的一段时间内是一个缺失的环节。”

paras.en: Surging militancy poses acute security challenges
paras.zh: 武装分子激增带来严峻的安全挑战

paras.en: Pakistan has seen a surge in militant violence in recent years.
paras.zh: 近年来，巴基斯坦武装暴力事件激增。

paras.en: Authorities have recorded more than 2,800 militant attacks since January, which have killed or wounded about 3,000 people, according to the AP news agency.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，自 1 月份以来，当局已记录了 2,800 多起武装分子袭击事件，造成约 3,000 人死伤。

paras.en: Islamabad blames Afghan-based elements for the attacks and has accused the ruling Taliban of allowing Afghan territory to be used to harbor militants.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰堡将袭击归咎于阿富汗分子，并指责执政的塔利班允许阿富汗领土被用来窝藏武装分子。

paras.en: Pakistan wants Kabul to clamp down on the TTP, which is a separate group but closely linked to the Afghan Taliban. The TTP seeks to impose a hard-line interpretation of Islam, particularly in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦希望喀布尔压制 TTP，该组织是一个独立的组织，但与阿富汗塔利班关系密切。 TTP 试图对伊斯兰教施加强硬解释，特别是在开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省。

paras.en: "We have been asking Kabul to recognize terrorists as terrorists and take action against them. They must do so because their own peace, security, and future are linked to Pakistan," asserted Chaudhry, the deputy interior minister.
paras.zh: 内政部副部长乔杜里表示：“我们一直要求喀布尔承认恐怖分子的身份，并对他们采取行动。他们必须这样做，因为他们自己的和平、安全和未来与巴基斯坦息息相关。”

paras.en: The Afghan Taliban deny the allegations and say they cannot be held accountable for security incidents inside Pakistan.
paras.zh: 阿富汗塔利班否认这些指控，并表示他们不能对巴基斯坦境内的安全事件负责。

paras.en: Will it escalate the Afghanistan-Pakistan conflict?
paras.zh: 是否会导致阿富汗和巴基斯坦冲突升级？

paras.en: The dispute has fueled growing tensions between the neighbors, which have escalated into armed clashes in recent months, heightening fears of a wider confrontation.
paras.zh: 这场争端加剧了邻国之间日益紧张的关系，近几个月来升级为武装冲突，加剧了人们对更广泛对抗的担忧。

paras.en: Ahmed believes the suspension of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's provincial government is likely to aggravate tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 艾哈迈德认为，开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省政府停摆可能会加剧巴基斯坦和阿富汗之间的紧张局势。

paras.en: "Security measures taken in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa would further impinge on the Pakistan-Afghan relationship, which is seemingly locked in a protracted cycle of offense and escalation," said Ahmed.
paras.zh: 艾哈迈德说：“在开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省采取的安全措施将进一步影响巴基斯坦与阿富汗的关系，这种关系似乎陷入了长期的进攻和升级循环之中。”

paras.en: After announcing emergency rule, Islamabad also authorized the deployment of additional army troops and military equipment to the region to support authorities.
paras.zh: 在宣布紧急状态后，伊斯兰堡还授权向该地区部署更多军队和军事装备，以支持当局。

paras.en: Ayesha Siddiqa, an independent military and security analyst, warned that the suspension of the elected provincial government could complicate counterterrorism efforts by deepening resentment among local communities.
paras.zh: 独立军事和安全分析师阿耶莎·西迪卡警告说，民选省政府的停职可能会加深当地社区的不满情绪，从而使反恐工作变得更加复杂。

paras.en: "After ending the political government, I don't think the security situation will improve. In fact, there will be less willingness among local communities to support counterterrorism operations," she told DW.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声：“政治政府结束后，我认为安全局势不会改善。事实上，当地社区支持反恐行动的意愿会降低。”

articles.title: Saudi Arabia's military struggle against Houthi attacks

paras.en: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthi militia continues to escalate its attacks on Saudi Arabia targeting energy facilities but, above all, airports.
paras.zh: 也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞民兵继续升级对沙特阿拉伯的袭击，目标是能源设施，但最重要的是机场。

paras.en: On Saturday, a missile attack on Riyadh's international airport killed 13 people and injured more than 300. In a second attack on Sunday, the militia killed another civilian and injured 11 others.
paras.zh: 周六，利雅得国际机场遭到导弹袭击，造成 13 人死亡、300 多人受伤。在周日的第二次袭击中，民兵杀死了另一名平民，另有 11 人受伤。

paras.en: According to their own statements, the Houthis also attacked Saudi Arabia's airport in Dammam and two oil facilities within the past 24 hours. Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman Al Saud warned of the consequences for energy security and announced a strong response.
paras.zh: 据胡塞武装自己的说法，过去24小时内还袭击了沙特阿拉伯达曼机场和两处石油设施。沙特能源大臣阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·萨勒曼·阿勒沙特亲王就能源安全的后果发出警告，并宣布采取强烈回应。

paras.en: According to a report by the US think tank American Enterprise Institute, Saudi Arabia is targeting Houthi missile launch pads, storage facilities and other military infrastructure in Yemen. The institute quotes Saudi military spokesman Turki al-Maliki in its October 11 report as saying that 136 military targets have already been destroyed.
paras.zh: 美国智库美国企业研究所的报告称，沙特正在瞄准也门胡塞武装的导弹发射台、储存设施和其他军事基础设施。该研究所在10月11日的报告中援引沙特军方发言人图尔基·马利基的话说，136个军事目标已被摧毁。

paras.en: However, years of Saudi-led military intervention between 2015 and 2022 in Yemen have not succeeded in defeating the Houthi militia. Moreover, the Saudi-led international coalition formed in 2015 has fallen apart and the United Arab Emirates has withdrawn its troops.
paras.zh: 然而，2015年至2022年期间沙特领导的对也门的军事干预并没有成功击败胡塞民兵。此外，2015年组建的沙特领导的国际联盟已经分崩离析，阿联酋也已撤军。

paras.en: The Iran-aligned Houthis not only control large parts of northern Yemen but also increasingly the western coastline from where they disrupt international shipping through the Red Sea and the strategically important Bab el-Mandeb Strait. In early September, drones also severely damaged the Saudi East-West oil pipeline. The temporary shutdown disrupted oil exports and increased risks for the energy markets.
paras.zh: 与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装不仅控制了也门北部的大部分地区，而且还越来越多地控制了西部海岸线，他们从那里扰乱了红海和具有重要战略意义的曼德海峡的国际航运。 9月初，无人机还严重破坏了沙特东西石油管道。暂时关闭扰乱了石油出口并增加了能源市场的风险。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia calls on Pakistan, Turkey, the United States
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯呼吁巴基斯坦、土耳其和美国

paras.en: For weeks, the Saudi government has been seeking allies in the fight against the Houthi militia. In late September, the United Kingdom and France pledged military support to defend Saudi infrastructure. London offered aerial refueling for Saudi fighter jets, while Paris announced it would provide troops, radar systems and air defense technology to protect the Yanbu oil terminal.
paras.zh: 几周来，沙特政府一直在寻找盟友来打击胡塞民兵。 9月下旬，英国和法国承诺提供军事支持以保卫沙特基础设施。伦敦为沙特战斗机提供空中加油，巴黎则宣布将提供部队、雷达系统和防空技术来保护延布石油码头。

paras.en: However, while the US recently refused to fight alongside Saudi Arabia against the Houthis, there could now be a change of heart in Washington, writes political analyst Osamah Al-Rawhani in a study by the Yemeni think tank Sanaa Center for Strategic Studies.
paras.zh: 然而，政治分析师奥萨马·拉瓦尼在也门智库萨那战略研究中心的一项研究中写道，尽管美国最近拒绝与沙特阿拉伯一起对抗胡塞武装，但华盛顿现在可能会改变主意。

paras.en: He notes that it remains to be seen whether this could actually lead to a successful offensive, as holding on to captured territories and launching counterattacks require significant financial resources, political commitment and the necessary resolve.
paras.zh: 他指出，这是否真的能带来成功的进攻还有待观察，因为坚守占领的领土并发动反击需要大量的财政资源、政治承诺和必要的决心。

paras.en: In his view, it is questionable whether Saudi Arabia would be able to muster the necessary perseverance. The kingdom could, however, change its current strategy. "If the costs of the war continue to rise, Riyadh might look for a way to withdraw from the conflict," Al-Rawhani says.
paras.zh: 在他看来，沙特阿拉伯是否能够鼓起必要的毅力值得怀疑。然而，沙特王国可以改变其当前的战略。 “如果战争成本继续上升，利雅得可能会寻找退出冲突的方法，”拉哈尼说。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia's asymmetrical war against the Houthis
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯针对胡塞武装的不对称战争

paras.en: Marcus Schneider, project manager at the Friedrich Ebert Foundation's Center of Expertise on Peace and Security in the Middle East and North Africa, shares a similar view.
paras.zh: 弗里德里希·艾伯特基金会中东和北非和平与安全专业中心的项目经理马库斯·施奈德也持有类似的观点。

paras.en: "To eliminate the Houthis, ground troops would be needed but Riyadh has no experience with this type of warfare, especially in a foreign country," Schneider recently told DW. As such, he believes the Saudi leadership is less concerned with achieving a military victory than with reducing its vulnerability, securing the broadest possible coalition of partners and gaining political maneuvering room.
paras.zh: 施奈德最近告诉德国之声：“要消灭胡塞武装，就需要地面部队，但利雅得没有此类战争的经验，尤其是在外国。”因此，他认为沙特领导层更关心的是减少其脆弱性、确保尽可能广泛的合作伙伴联盟并获得政治回旋空间，而不是取得军事胜利。

paras.en: "The Houthis are well-entrenched in Yemen and can withstand considerable blows. Above all, Saudi Arabia needs stability for its Vision 2030 reform set and that is currently further away than ever," Schneider said.
paras.zh: 施奈德表示：“胡塞武装在也门根深蒂固，能够承受相当大的打击。最重要的是，沙特阿拉伯需要稳定来实现其2030年愿景改革计划，而目前这一目标比以往任何时候都更加遥远。”

paras.en: He added that military asymmetry is also a key factor: Saudi Arabia possesses modern weapons and spends enormous sums on its armed forces. The Houthis, on the other hand, do not need to win a conventional war. It is enough for them to deploy missiles and drones, threaten infrastructure and disrupt shipping traffic.
paras.zh: 他补充说，军事不对称也是一个关键因素：沙特阿拉伯拥有现代化武器，并在武装部队上投入巨资。另一方面，胡塞武装不需要赢得常规战争。他们部署导弹和无人机、威胁基础设施并扰乱航运交通就足够了。

paras.en: Are the UAE, Pakistan, Turkey changing course?
paras.zh: 阿联酋、巴基斯坦、土耳其正在改变路线吗？

paras.en: Saudi Arabia may also be able to turn to another partner in the region: the United Arab Emirates (UAE). According to media reports, Anwar Gargash, a senior diplomatic advisor to the UAE president, spoke out in favor of closer security cooperation among the Gulf states. "We are all targets," he stated on X.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯或许还可以寻求该地区的另一个合作伙伴：阿拉伯联合酋长国（UAE）。据媒体报道，阿联酋总统高级外交顾问安瓦尔·加尔加什公开表示支持海湾国家之间加强安全合作。 “我们都是目标，”他在 X 上说道。

paras.en: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have undermined the security of the entire region, he notes. "It is necessary to revitalize cooperation among the Gulf states, particularly in the areas of security and defense, and to strengthen the collective security system," Gargash added.
paras.zh: 他指出，胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的袭击破坏了整个地区的安全。加尔加什补充说：“有必要重振海湾国家之间的合作，特别是在安全和防务领域，并加强集体安全体系。”

paras.en: Pakistan, which signed the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement in early August along with Saudi Arabia and Turkey, also initially ruled out military intervention.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦于八月初与沙特阿拉伯和土耳其签署了《麦加联合防御协议》，最初也排除了军事干预的可能性。

paras.en: According to media reports, however, the country is now said to be carrying out airstrikes on Houthi missile and drone positions — a claim that Islamabad denies. Pakistan does not intend to deploy ground troops. Turkey, another member of the Mecca Pact, rules out an offensive military operation but is providing air defense equipment.
paras.zh: 然而，据媒体报道，据称该国目前正在对胡塞武装的导弹和无人机阵地进行空袭，但伊斯兰堡否认了这一说法。巴基斯坦不打算部署地面部队。麦加条约的另一个成员国土耳其排除了进攻性军事行动的可能性，但正在提供防空设备。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia can thus build on additional military support, according to an analysis by the US think tank Soufan Center. Whether this will result in an effective strategy, however, depends on whether the partners go beyond limited airstrikes and political expressions of solidarity and on whether the fragmented Yemeni government forces can better coordinate their military operations.
paras.zh: 根据美国智库苏凡中心的分析，沙特阿拉伯因此可以获得额外的军事支持。然而，这是否会产生有效的战略，取决于合作伙伴是否超越有限的空袭和政治团结表达，以及支离破碎的也门政府军是否能够更好地协调其军事行动。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Iran has offered to act as a mediator between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis. However, given Iran's support for the Houthis and the recent attacks on Saudi Arabia, it is questionable whether Saudi Arabia will accept this offer.
paras.zh: 与此同时，伊朗提出充当沙特阿拉伯和胡塞武装之间的调解人。不过，考虑到伊朗对胡塞武装的支持以及近期针对沙特的袭击，沙特是否会接受这一提议值得怀疑。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia and the US are allies, whereas Iran and the US have been at war since February. It is also unclear whether Tehran wields sufficient influence over the Yemeni militia to persuade it to halt the attacks.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯和美国是盟友，而伊朗和美国自二月份以来一直处于交战状态。目前还不清楚德黑兰是否对也门民兵拥有足够的影响力以说服其停止袭击。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: Cornell suspends fraternity parties after alleged campus gang rape case

paras.en: Cornell University has suspended fraternity parties for the academic year and will give the New York State Police a role in investigating sex crimes on campus.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学已暂停本学年的兄弟会聚会，并将授权纽约州警方调查校园性犯罪。

paras.en: The Ivy League university announced the major changes on Tuesday, as it sought to reassure the rattled campus community amid the ongoing outrage over its handling of allegations that a female student was sexually assaulted at a fraternity house in 2024.
paras.zh: 这所常春藤联盟大学于周二宣布了这些重大变化，因为它试图安抚不安的校园社区，因为该校对 2024 年一名女学生在兄弟会会所遭到性侵犯的指控的处理方式持续引发愤怒。

paras.en: The accusations came to light after the former student, known as Jane Doe, filed a civil lawsuit last month.
paras.zh: 这些指控是在这位名叫简·多伊(Jane Doe)的前学生上个月提起民事诉讼后曝光的。

paras.en: In addition to the blanket suspension of all parties and social events at fraternity houses through the 2026-27 school year, Cornell President Michael I Kotlikoff announced a new “zero-tolerance” policy for violations, noting that any fraternity chapter that breaks the ban will face an immediate freeze.
paras.zh: 除了在 2026-27 学年全面暂停兄弟会的所有聚会和社交活动外，康奈尔大学校长迈克尔·科特利科夫 (Michael I Kotlikoff) 还宣布了一项新的对违规行为的“零容忍”政策，并指出任何违反禁令的兄弟会分会都将面临立即冻结。

paras.en: “These measures will provide time for a thorough review of fraternity life at Cornell to determine whether and how it can safely continue,” Kotlikoff wrote in a letter addressed to the campus community on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫在周二写给校园社区的一封信中写道：“这些措施将为彻底审查康奈尔大学的兄弟会生活提供时间，以确定其是否以及如何安全地继续下去。”

paras.en: The university president pledged to strengthen Cornell’s sexual misconduct response by adding a dedicated case manager to the Office of Civil Rights to guide survivors through the reporting process.
paras.zh: 大学校长承诺通过在民权办公室增加一名专门的案件经理来指导幸存者完成报告过程，从而加强康奈尔大学对不当性行为的反应。

paras.en: Kotlikoff affirmed that he will be transferring investigative authority from the university police to independent, trauma-informed investigators with the New York State Police in an effort to reform the handling of sexual abuse cases on campus and restore community trust.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫确认，他将把调查权从大学警察手中移交给纽约州警察局的独立、了解创伤的调查人员，以改革校园性虐待案件的处理方式并恢复社区信任。

paras.en: Kotlikoff acknowledged that sexual violence extends beyond fraternities, saying Cornell must also confront a campus culture of excessive drinking and drug use and expand education about students’ responsibility to intervene when others are at risk.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫承认，性暴力不仅仅限于兄弟会，他说康奈尔大学还必须面对过度饮酒和吸毒的校园文化，并扩大教育，让学生了解当其他人面临危险时有责任进行干预。

paras.en: Cornell also plans to add victim advocates and expand sexual violence prevention programmes, including education aimed at encouraging bystanders to intervene, he said, calling the various actions announced Tuesday “first steps toward systemic change on our campus”.
paras.zh: 他说，康奈尔大学还计划增加受害者倡导者并扩大性暴力预防计划，包括旨在鼓励旁观者干预的教育，并称周二宣布的各种行动是“我们校园系统性变革的第一步”。

paras.en: “We will take all necessary steps to address the conditions that led to Jane Doe’s experiences, and those of other survivors,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们将采取一切必要措施，解决导致无名氏和其他幸存者经历的情况。”

paras.en: Doe’s lawsuit was brought against the Chi Phi fraternity at Cornell University and seven of its members, accusing them of drugging and gang raping her during a party on the night of October 19, 2024.
paras.zh: Doe 对康奈尔大学 Chi Phi 兄弟会及其七名成员提起诉讼，指控他们在 2024 年 10 月 19 日晚的一次聚会上对她下药并轮奸她。

paras.en: Following her initial allegations in 2024, Cornell shut down the fraternity and temporarily suspended the accused male students, two of whom were later expelled. But critics have said the university’s response was too lenient, prompting it to launch an independent review into its handling of the case, led by a former top US prosecutor.
paras.zh: 在她于 2024 年提出初步指控后，康奈尔大学关闭了兄弟会，并暂时停课了被指控的男学生，其中两人后来被开除。但批评人士表示，该大学的反应过于宽松，促使其对案件的处理方式展开独立审查，由美国前高级检察官牵头。

paras.en: “We must meet this moment by acknowledging where we have fallen short and taking meaningful action,” Kotlikoff said. “Cornell must be a place where safety is not an open question.”
paras.zh: 科特里科夫说：“我们必须在这个时刻承认我们的不足并采取有意义的行动。” “康奈尔大学一定是一个安全问题不存在的地方。”

articles.title: Russia arrests Japanese reporter for alleged espionage

paras.en: Russian authorities say they have arrested a Japanese journalist on the far eastern Sakhalin Island, accusing him of espionage.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯当局表示，他们在远东萨哈林岛逮捕了一名日本记者，指控他从事间谍活动。

paras.en: The Federal Security Service (FSB) announced the arrest on Tuesday, saying the man was believed to have gathered information on Russia’s defence capabilities for Japanese intelligence. The charges carry up to 20 years in prison.
paras.zh: 联邦安全局（FSB）周二宣布逮捕该男子，称该男子据信为日本情报部门收集了有关俄罗斯防御能力的信息。这些指控可判处最高 20 年监禁。

paras.en: Russia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs named the journalist as Imai Yuki, who it said worked for Japan’s Hokkaido Shimbun newspaper.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯外交部将这名记者命名为今井由纪，据称他为日本《北海道新闻》工作。

paras.en: The Japanese government was trying to verify reports of the journalist’s detention, according to an official at Tokyo’s embassy in Moscow cited by Japan’s Kyodo news agency.
paras.zh: 日本共同社援引东京驻莫斯科大使馆一名官员的话说，日本政府正在试图核实有关这名记者被拘留的报道。

paras.en: The journalist was arrested on Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, the main city on Sakhalin Island, as he was preparing to leave Russia, said the FSB. He was then flown to Moscow, where a court ordered him to be held behind bars pending the probe, the agency added.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局表示，这名记者在萨哈林岛主要城市南萨哈林斯克被捕，当时他正准备离开俄罗斯。该机构补充说，随后他被飞往莫斯科，当地法院下令将他关押在监狱中，等待调查。

paras.en: A video shared by Russia’s TASS news agency, attributed to the FSB, shows masked officers appearing to handcuff the suspect in a hotel room, before transporting him to an interrogation room.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯塔斯社分享的一段来自俄罗斯联邦安全局的视频显示，蒙面警察似乎在酒店房间里给嫌疑人戴上手铐，然后将他送往审讯室。

paras.en: The suspect was then shown boarding a plane accompanied by two FSB servicemen, before appearing in a cage on trial in a Moscow court, which authorised his custody for nearly two months.
paras.zh: 随后，嫌疑人在两名俄罗斯联邦安全局军人的陪同下登上了一架飞机，然后在莫斯科一家法院的笼子里接受审判，该法院授权对他进行近两个月的拘留。

paras.en: The Japanese man’s arrest comes amid a spike in tensions between Russia and Japan following Russian President Vladimir Putin’s trip in August to the Kuril Islands, the Moscow-controlled Pacific archipelago that is claimed by both countries.
paras.zh: 这名日本男子被捕之际，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)8月访问千岛群岛后，俄罗斯和日本之间的紧张局势加剧。千岛群岛是莫斯科控制的太平洋群岛，两国均声称拥有主权。

paras.en: The Sakhalin region includes Sakhalin Island and the four southernmost islands of the Kuril chain, which Japan calls the Northern Territories.
paras.zh: 库页岛地区包括库页岛和千岛链最南端的四个岛屿，日本称之为北方四岛。

paras.en: Russia and Japan never signed a formal World War II peace treaty, with the main obstacle being the unresolved territorial dispute over the Kuril Islands.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和日本从未签署正式的二战和平条约，主要障碍是悬而未决的千岛群岛领土争端。

paras.en: Authorities in Russia have arrested numerous foreigners for alleged espionage since it invaded neighbouring Ukraine in 2022.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年入侵邻国乌克兰以来，俄罗斯当局以涉嫌间谍罪逮捕了多名外国人。

paras.en: One of the most prominent cases was the detention of Wall Street Journal reporter Evan Gershkovich in 2023. He was found guilty of espionage by a Russian court, sentenced to 16 years and then freed in a major prisoner swap involving Russia and Western countries in August 2024.
paras.zh: 最突出的案件之一是 2023 年《华尔街日报》记者埃文·格什科维奇 (Evan Gershkovich) 被拘留。他被俄罗斯法院判定犯有间谍罪，判处 16 年徒刑，然后在 2024 年 8 月涉及俄罗斯和西方国家的重大囚犯交换中获释。

articles.title: EU watchdog urges smart glasses to clearly signal when recording

paras.en: The European Union’s data watchdog has called for smart glasses to clearly show when they are recording, saying bystanders have the right to know when they are being photographed or filmed.
paras.zh: 欧盟的数据监管机构呼吁智能眼镜能够清楚地显示他们何时正在录制，并表示旁观者有权知道他们何时被拍照或拍摄。

paras.en: The European Data Protection Board (EDPB) issued the non-binding recommendation on Tuesday, amid mounting concern about the devices being used to secretly record girls and women.
paras.zh: 欧洲数据保护委员会 (EDPB) 周二发布了这项不具约束力的建议，因为人们越来越担心这些设备被用来秘密记录女孩和妇女的情况。

paras.en: It said the use of smart glasses – which can resemble ordinary glasses but also take photos and videos, make phone calls and translate text when connected to the internet – raises “serious privacy concerns”.
paras.zh: 报告称，智能眼镜的使用——它与普通眼镜相似，但在连接到互联网时也可以拍照和录像、打电话和翻译文本——引发了“严重的隐私问题”。

paras.en: EDPB chair Anu Talus said the glasses should have clear signals when they are recording, such as “bright LED lights, audio signals or voice activation cues, privacy-friendly smartphone notifications, or unique designs”.
paras.zh: EDP​​B 主席 Anu Talus 表示，眼镜在录制时应具有清晰的信号，例如“明亮的 LED 灯、音频信号或语音激活提示、保护隐私的智能手机通知或独特的设计”。

paras.en: “These warnings need to be reliable, hard to ignore, and always up to date,” said Talus. “Even in public spaces, bystanders should clearly understand that someone is filming or photographing them.”
paras.zh: “这些警告必须可靠、难以忽视，并且始终是最新的，”Talus 说。 “即使在公共场所，旁观者也应该清楚地知道有人正在拍摄或拍摄他们。”

paras.en: The devices carry greater risks in “sensitive” spaces like schools and hospitals, as well as public spots like beaches, and raised concerns about children who are “more vulnerable to covert or intrusive processing of their personal data”, the EDPB warned.
paras.zh: EDP​​B 警告称，这些设备在学校和医院等“敏感”空间以及海滩等公共场所存在更大的风险，并引发了人们对“更容易受到秘密或侵入性处理其个人数据”的儿童的担忧。

paras.en: The advisory comes amid campaigns in several European countries to ban or restrict smart glasses over privacy concerns.
paras.zh: 该建议发布之际，多个欧洲国家因隐私问题而发起禁止或限制智能眼镜的运动。

paras.en: Norway’s government said last week it was also worried about privacy invasions and wants a temporary ban on the use of smart glasses in certain public places. The capital Oslo already opted to ban glasses equipped with cameras in schools.
paras.zh: 挪威政府上周表示，也担心隐私受到侵犯，希望暂时禁止在某些公共场所使用智能眼镜。首都奥斯陆已经选择禁止在学校使用配备摄像头的眼镜。

paras.en: France’s e-Enfance association, which operates the national hotline for victims of online abuse, has also sounded the alarm about videos recorded with camera-equipped glasses and shared online.
paras.zh: 法国的 e-Enfance 协会负责为网络虐待受害者提供全国热线，该协会也对用配备摄像头的眼镜录制并在网上分享的视频发出了警报。

paras.en: Last month, French prosecutors said they had opened a criminal probe following sexual harassment complaints related to a social media trend of using smart glasses to film women on the street, without their consent, and posting the videos online.
paras.zh: 上个月，法国检察官表示，他们已对性骚扰投诉展开刑事调查，该投诉涉及社交媒体趋势，即在未经女性同意的情况下使用智能眼镜在街上拍摄女性，并将视频发布到网上。

paras.en: In the United Kingdom and Ireland, a “Stop Smart Glasses” campaign has launched a petition and call for supporters to contact stores to stop their sale. It reached more than 10,000 signatures, which means the UK government must respond.
paras.zh: 在英国和爱尔兰，“停止智能眼镜”运动发起了请愿书，呼吁支持者联系商店停止销售。它达到了超过10,000个签名，这意味着英国政府必须做出回应。

articles.title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in former prime minister's stronghold
articles.author: Betsy Joles

paras.en: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in former prime minister's strongholdPakistan has imposed emergency rule in the province governed by the political party of imprisoned former prime minister Imran Khan.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦对前总理据点实施紧急统治 巴基斯坦对被监禁的前总理伊姆兰·汗的政党管辖的省份实施紧急统治。

paras.en: Pakistan has imposed emergency rule in the province governed by the political party of imprisoned former prime minister Imran Khan.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦在被监禁的前总理伊姆兰·汗所在的政党管辖的省份实施紧急统治。
